projectDesc.p: A plain, archival TEI rendering of the text published on e-Vāgbhaṭa (https://github.com/sushrutaproject/eHrdaya), itself built from the digital edition named in the sourceDesc. The file is generated automatically from the site's chapter pages.

editorialDecl.p: The text is given in IAST as it appears on the web edition. Chapter and verse divisions follow the source edition. Each stretch of text ending in one of the source's verse or section numbers (e.g. ||12||) is encoded as seg[@type='unit'] with that number in @n; the number itself is retained in the text.
This file contains the root text only: all commentary blocks, and the notes anchored in them, have been omitted. Root-text blocks are ab[@type='mula'].
The source has no footnote or variant-reading apparatus. Notes are placed at their point of reference as note[@place='foot'][@type='variant'], with the source's note number in @n.
Each commentary block opens with the siglum used in print (Sa. for the Sarvāṅgasundarā, Ā. rā. for the Āyurvedarasāyana), encoded as label[@type='siglum'].

Hemādri's Āyurvedarasāyana is present in the source only for all of Sūtrasthāna and Kalpasiddhisthāna, the first six adhyāyas of Nidānasthāna and the first seven of Cikitsāsthāna; it is absent from Śārīrasthāna and Uttarasthāna. Its absence elsewhere reflects the source, not an encoding gap.

div.head: āyuṣkāmīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: rāgādirogān satatānuṣaktānaśeṣakāyaprasṛtānaśeṣān| autsukyamohāratidāñjaghāna yo'pūrvavaidyāya namostu tasmai|1|
idānīmiṣṭadevatāṃ namaskṛtya śāstrakārastantramāriripsuridamāha ---- athāta āyuṣkāmīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| (gadyasūtram)||1|| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtram)|2|

ab.seg: āyuḥkāmāyamānena dharmārthasukhasādhanam| āyurvedopadeśeṣu vidheyaḥ paramādaraḥ||2||

div.ab: athāsyāyurvedasya gauravotpādanāyāgamaśuddhiṃ darśayati ---- brahmā smṛtvā''yuṣo vedaṃ prajāpatimajigrahat| so'śvinau tau sahasrākṣaṃ so'triputrādikānmunīn||3|| te'gniveśādikāṃste tu pṛthak tantrāṇi tenire| ------------------------------------------------|4|

nanu yadi taistantrāṇi punaryugānurūpasandarbhaiḥ saṅgṛhītāni| tatkimidānīmanena śāstreṇa kṛtenetyāha ---- ----------------------------------------------| tebhyo'tiviprakīrṇebhyaḥ prāyaḥ sārataroccayaḥ||4|| kriyate'ṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṃ nātisaṃkṣepavistaram| ----------------------------------------------|5|

kāni punastānyaṣṭāṅgānītyāha---- ----------------------------------------------| kāyabālagrahordhvāṅgaśalyadaṃṣṭrājarāvṛṣān||5|| aṣṭāvaṅgāni tasyāhuścikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā| -----------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: kāyasya doṣadhātumalasamudāyatvāttāneva doṣādīn nirdidikṣurāha ---- ----------------------------------------------| vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaśceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ||6||

div.ab: vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca| --------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: idānīmeṣāṃ vyāpināmapi viśiṣṭasthānaṃ vivakṣurāha ---- --------------------------------------------------| te vyāpino'pi hṛnnābhyoradhomadhyordhvasaṃśrayāḥ||7||

div.ab: athaiṣāṃ sakalakālavyāpināmapi niyatakālatvaṃ darśayannāha ---- vayohorātribhuktānāṃ te'ntamadhyādigāḥ kramāt| --------------------------------------------|8|

ab.seg: adhunā'gnisvarūpaṃ prastauti ---- ------------------------------------------------| tairbhavedviṣamastīkṣṇo mandaścāgniḥ samaiḥ samaḥ||8||

div.ab: agnicāturvidhyamuktvā tadāśrayasya koṣṭhasya cāturvidhyaṃ vivakṣurāha ---- koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdurmadhyo madhyaḥ syāttaiḥ samairapi| ------------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: idānīṃ prakṛtisvarūpaṃ prastauti-------------------------------- śukrārtavasthairjanmādau viṣeṇeva viṣakrimeḥ||9||
taiśca tisraḥ prakṛtayo hīnamadhyottamāḥ pṛthak| samadhātuḥ samastāsu śreṣṭhā nindyā dvidoṣajāḥ||10||

div.ab: tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaścalo'nilaḥ| pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam||11|| snigdhaḥ śīto gururmandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ|12|

ab.seg: eṣāṃ ca miśrībhūtānāṃ tantravyavahārārthaṃ saṃjñādvayamāha ----- ------------------------------| saṃsargaḥ sannipātaśca taddvitrikṣayakopataḥ||12||

div.ab: doṣānuktvā dhātava ucyante ---- rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ| sapta dūṣyāḥ-------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: --------------malā mūtraśakṛtsvedādayo'pi ca||13||

div.ab: vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ viparītairviparyayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|14|

varṇitameva vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ, kṣayo viparītairiti| tau tu vṛddhikṣayau yato vāyvādīnāṃ bhavataḥ, tatprakhyāpanārthamāha ---- rasāḥ svādvamlalavaṇatiktoṣaṇakaṣāyakāḥ||14|| ṣaḍ dravyamāśritāste ca yathāpūrvaṃbalāvahāḥ| --------------------------------------------|15|
-----------------------------------------------| tatrādyā mārutaṃ ghnanti trayastiktādayaḥ kapham||15|| kaṣāyatiktamadhurāḥ pittamanye tu kurvate| ---------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: eṣāṃ ca rasānāmāśrayo dravyaṃ, tacca triprakāramityāha ---- śamanaṃ kopanaṃ svasthahitaṃ dravyamiti tridhā||16||

div.ab: tasya vīryamāha ---- uṣṇaśītaguṇotkarṣāttatra vīryaṃ dvidhā smṛtam| ------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: dravyasya guṇānāha ------------------ gurumandahimasnigdhaślakṣṇasāndramṛdusthirāḥ| guṇāḥ sasūkṣmaviśadā viṃśatiḥ saviparyayāḥ||18||
rogakāraṇamāha--------------------- kālārthakarmaṇāṃ yogo hīnamithyātimātrakaḥ| samyagyogaśca vijñeyo rogārogyaikakāraṇam||19||

div.ab: rogārogye ke ucyete ityāha--------------------------- rogāstu doṣavaiṣamyaṃ, doṣasāmyamarogatā| ------------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| nijāgantuvibhāgena tatra rogā dvidhā smṛtāḥ||20||

div.ab: yata evaṃ dehamanasī rogādhiṣṭhānatvena sthite, na kevalo deho nāpi kevalaṃ manaḥ| tasmādato'nantaramidamāha- teṣāṃ kāyamanobhedādadhiṣṭhānamapi dvidhā| ------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: nanu kāyikānāṃ rogāṇāmutpattau hetavo vātādayo doṣāḥ prakupitā uktāḥ| mānasānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ ko hetuḥ, tadarthamāha------------------------ --------------------------------------------| rajastamaśca manaso dvau ca doṣāvudāhṛtau||21||

div.ab: rogopahataśarīrajñānopāyamāha-------------------------- darśanasparśanapraśnaiḥ parīkṣeta ca rogiṇam| ------------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: rogaviśeṣādhigamopāyamāha---------------------------- -------------------------------------------| rogaṃ nidānaprāgrūpalakṣaṇopaśayāptibhiḥ||22||

div.ab: upaśayādiprasaṅge ca deśakālāvapyupayujyete| atastāvapi paṭhati------------ bhūmidehaprabhedena deśamāhuriha dvidhā| ----------------------------------------|23|

dehadeśaḥ śiraḥpāṇyādilakṣaṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ| bhūmideśa ucyate--------------- jāṅgalaṃ vātabhūyiṣṭhamanūpaṃ tu kapholbaṇam||23|| sādhāraṇaṃ samamalaṃ tridhā bhūdeśamādiśet| ----------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: bheṣajasya samyagyogahetuṃ kālamāha--------------------- kṣaṇādirvyādhyavasthā ca kālo bheṣajayogakṛt||24||

div.ab: taccauṣadhaṃ dviprakāramāha------------------------------ śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti samāsādauṣadhaṃ dvidhā| -----------------------------------------------|25|

auṣadhamuktam| tasya viṣayamāha---------------------- ----------------------------------------------| śarīrajānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadham||25|| bastirvireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu| -----------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: kāyādideśamāśritya sarvatra sarvameva śarīrajātānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadhamuktam| atha mānasayordoṣayoḥ kiṃ tatparamauṣadhaṃ syāditi, tadarthamāha-------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------| dhīdhairyātmādivijñānaṃ manodoṣauṣadhaṃ param||26||

evaṃ tāvadanena sakalacikitsitamuktam| tacca pādacatuṣṭayayuktaṃ kāryakaraṃ, tadarthamāha--------------------------------------------- bhiṣak dravyāṇyupasthātā rogī pādacatuṣṭayam| cikitsitasya nirdiṣṭaṃ, pratyekaṃ taccaturguṇam||27||

div.ab: uddeśakrameṇa teṣāṃ guṇānāha-------------------------------- dakṣastīrthāttaśāstrārtho dṛṣṭakarmā śucirbhiṣak| -----------------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| bahukalpaṃ bahuguṇaṃ sampannaṃ yogyamauṣadham||28||

div.ab: upasthātāpi caturvidhaḥ- ------------------------------- anuraktaḥ śucirdakṣo buddhimān paricārakaḥ| -------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: rogyapi caturvidhaḥ------------- ------------------------------------------------| āḍhyo rogī bhiṣagvaśyo jñāpakaḥ sattvavānapi||29||
sukhasādhyādikasya vyādhicatuṣṭayasya lakṣaṇamucyate----------------- (sādhyo'sādhya iti vyādhirdvidhā, tau tu punardvidhā| susādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaśca, yāpyo yaścānupakramaḥ||1||
) sarvauṣadhakṣame dehe yūnaḥ puṃso jitātmanaḥ| amarmago'lpahetvagrarūparūpo'nupadravaḥ||30||
atulyadūṣyadeśartuprakṛtiḥ pādasampadi| graheṣvanuguṇe'ṣvekadoṣamārgo navaḥ sukhaḥ||31||

div.ab: kṛcchrasādhyaṃ vyādhimāha--------------------- śastrādisādhanaḥ kṛcchraḥ saṅkare ca tato gadaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: yāpyo'ta ucyate---------------- -----------------------------------------------| śeṣatvādāyuṣo yāpyaḥ pathyābhyāsādviparyaye||32||
pratyākhyeya ucyate------------- anupakrama eva syātsthito'tyantaviparyaye| autsukyamohāratikṛd dṛṣṭariṣṭo'kṣanāśanaḥ||33||

div.ab: sādhyalakṣaṇayukto'pyāturo nopakramaṇīya iti darśayati-------------- tyajedārtaṃ bhiṣagbhūpairdviṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ dviṣaṃ dviṣam| hīnopakaraṇaṃ vyagramavidheyaṃ gatāyuṣam||34|| caṇḍaṃ śokāturaṃ bhīruṃ kṛtaghnaṃ vaidyamāninam| -------------------------------------------------|35|

evaṃ ca prathame'dhyāye sakalatantrārṇavasya tātparyaṃ vyākhyātam| anantaraṃ sukhasmaraṇārthamadhyāyasaṅgrahaṃ vivakṣuridamāha--------------- --------------------------------------------------| tantrasyāsya paraṃ cāto vakṣyate'dhyāyasaṅgrahaḥ||35|| āyuṣkāmadinartvīhārogānutpādanadravāḥ| annajñānānnasaṃrakṣāmātrādravyarasāśrayāḥ||36|| doṣādijñānatadbhedataccikitsādyupakramāḥ| śuddhyādisnehanasvedarekāsthāpananāvanam||37|| dhūmagaṇḍūṣadṛksekatṛptiyantrakaśastrakam| śirāvidhiḥ śalyavidhiḥ śastrakṣārāgnikarmikau||38|| sūtrasthānamime'dhyāyāstriṃśat--------------------|39|
adhunā śārīramucyate-------------------- -------------------------------śārīramucyate| garbhāvakrāntitadvyāpadaṅgamarmavibhāgikam||39|| vikṛtirdūtajaṃ ṣaṣṭham-------------------|40|

ab.seg: nidānamucyate------------------------ --------------------------nidānaṃ sārvarogikam| jvarāsṛkśvāsayakṣmādimadādyarśotisāriṇām||40||
mūtrāghātapramehāṇāṃ vidradhyādyudarasya ca| pāṇḍukuṣṭhānilārtānāṃ vātāsrasya ca ṣoḍaśa||41||

div.ab: cikitsitamucyate------------------- cikitsitaṃ jvare rakte kāse śvāse ca yakṣmaṇi| vamau madātyaye'rśaḥsu, viśi dvau, dvau ca mūtrite||42|| vidradhau gulmajaṭharapāṇḍuśophavisarpiṣu| kuṣṭhaśvitrānilavyādhivātāsreṣu cikitsitam||43|| dvāviṃśatirime'dhyāyāḥ-------------------------|44|
-----------------------kalpasiddhirataḥ param| kalpo vamervirekasya tatsiddhirbastikalpanā||44|| siddhirbastyāpadāṃ ṣaṣṭho dravyakalpaḥ| -------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------- ata uttaram| bālopacāre tadvyādhau tadgrahe, dvau ca bhūtage||45||
janmāde'tha smṛtibhraṃśe, dvau dvau vartmasu sandhiṣu| dṛktamoliṅganāśeṣu trayo, dvau dvau ca sarvage||46||
karṇanāsāmukhaśirovraṇe, bhaṅge bhagandare| granthyādau kṣudrarogeṣu guhyaroge pṛthagdvayam||47||
viṣe bhujaṅge kīṭeṣu mūṣakeṣu rasāyane| catvāriṃśo'napatyānāmadhyāyo bījapoṣaṇaḥ||48||
ityadhyāyaśataṃ viṃśaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānairudīritam| 48 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne āyuṣkāmīyo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: dinacaryādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

div.ab: asmiṃstantre āyuḥpālanaṃ prakṛtam| tadvividham, svasthavṛttamāturavṛttaṃ ca| tatra maṅgalyatvāt svalpavaktavyatvādāturopayogitvācca svasthavṛttamevādāvucyate--------- brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhetsvastho rakṣārthamāyuṣaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|1|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śarīracintāṃ nirvartya kṛtaśaucavidhistataḥ||1||
arkanyagrodhakhadirakarañjakakubhādijam| prātarbhuktvā ca mṛdvagraṃ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakam||2||
kanīnyagrasamasthaulyaṃ praguṇaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam| bhakṣayeddantapavanaṃ dantamāṃsānyabādhayan||3||
nādyādajīrṇavamathuśvāsakāsajvarārditī| tṛṣṇāsyapākahṛnnetraśiraḥkarṇāmayī ca tat||4||

div.ab: sauvīramañjanaṃ nityaṃ hitamakṣṇostato bhajet| -----------------------------------------------|5|

------------------------------------------------| cakṣustejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣāt śleṣmato bhayam||5|| yojayetsaptarātre'smātsrāvaṇārthaṃ rasāñjanam| -------------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------| tato nāvanagaṇḍūṣadhūmatāmbūlabhāgbhavet||6||
yeṣāṃ tu tāmbūlamapathyaṃ, tānāha------------- tāmbūlaṃ kṣatapittāsrarūkṣotkupitacakṣuṣām| viṣamūrcchāmadārtānāmapathyaṃ śoṣiṇāmapi||7||
tadetatsarvaṃ vidhāya, bhojanāsanne kāle'bhyaṅga ācaraṇīya ityāha------------------ abhyaṅgamācarennityaṃ, sa jarāśramavātahā| dṛṣṭiprasādapuṣṭyāyuḥsvapnasutvaktvadārḍhyakṛt||8||

div.ab: śiraḥśravaṇapādeṣu taṃ viśeṣeṇa śīlayet| --------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: athetadapavādamāha-------- -----------------------------------------------------| varjyo'bhyaṅgaḥ kaphagrastakṛtasaṃśuddhyajīrṇibhiḥ||9||
lāghavaṃ karmasāmarthyaṃ dīpto'gnirmedasaḥ kṣayaḥ| vibhaktaghanagātratvaṃ vyāyāmādupajāyate||10||

div.ab: idānīṃ yenāsau na kāryastaṃ darśayati----------- vātapittāmayī bālo vṛddho'jīrṇo ca taṃ tyajet| ----------------------------------------------|11|
--------------------------------------------------| ardhaśaktyā niṣevyastu balibhiḥ snigdhabhojibhiḥ||11|| śītakāle vasante ca, mandameva tato'nyadā| ---------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| taṃ kṛtvā'nusukhaṃ dehaṃ mardayecca samantataḥ||12||
tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako raktapittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ| ativyāyāmataḥ kāso jvaraśchardiśca jāyate||13||
vyāyāmajāgarādhvastrīhāsyabhāṣyādi sāhasam| gajaṃ siṃha ivākarṣan bhajannati vinaśyati||14||
udvartanaṃ kaphaharaṃ medasaḥ pravilāyanam| sthirīkaraṇamaṅgānāṃ tvakprasādakaraṃ param||15||
dīpanaṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ snānamūrjābalapradam| kaṇḍūmalaśramasvedatandrātṛḍdāhapāpmajit||16||
uṣṇāmbunā'dhaḥkāyasya pariṣeko balāvahaḥ| tenaiva tūttamāṅgasya balahṛtkeśacakṣuṣām||17||
snānaṃ yeṣāmapathyam, tān darśayitumāha----------- snānamarditanetrāsyakarṇarogātisāriṣu| ādhmānapīnasājīrṇabhuktavatsu ca garhitam||18||
jīrṇo hitaṃ mitaṃ cādyānna vegānīrayedbalāt| na vegito'nyakāryaḥ syānnājitvā sādhyamāmayam||19||
sukhārthāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ matāḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ| sukhaṃ ca na vinā dharmāttasmāddharmaparo bhavet||20||

div.ab: bhaktyā kalyāṇamitrāṇi sevetetaradūragaḥ| -----------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| hiṃsāsteyānyathākāmaṃ paiśunyaṃ paruṣānṛte||21||
sambhinnālāpaṃ vyāpādamabhidhyāṃ dṛgviparyayam| pāpaṃ karmeti daśadhā kāyavāṅmanasaistyajet||22||

div.ab: avṛttivyādhiśokārtānanuvarteta śaktitaḥ| ------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------| ātmavatsatataṃ paśyedapi kīṭapipīlikam||23||

div.ab: arcayeddevagovipravṛddhavaidyanṛpātithīn| -------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------| vimukhānnārthinaḥ kuryānnāvamanyeta nākṣipet||24||

div.ab: upakārapradhānaḥ syādapakārapare'pyarau| -------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------| sampadvipatsvekamanā, hetāvīrṣyetphale na tu||25||

div.ab: kāle hitaṃ mitaṃ brūyādavisaṃvādi peśalam| -----------------------------------------|26|

-----------------------------------------| pūrvābhibhāṣī, sumukhaḥ suśīlaḥ karuṇāmṛduḥ||26|| naikaḥ sukhī, na sarvatra viśrabdho, na ca śaṅkitaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|27|
-----------------------------------------| na kañcidātmanaḥ śatruṃ nātmānaṃ kasyacidripum||27|| prakāśayennāpamānaṃ na ca niḥsnehatāṃ prabhoḥ| -----------------------------------------|28|
-----------------------------------------| janasyāśayamālakṣya yo yathā parituṣyati||28|| taṃ tathaivānuvarteta parārādhanapaṇḍitaḥ| -----------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: na pīḍayedindriyāṇi va caitānyati lālayet||29||

div.ab: trivargaśūnyaṃ nārambhaṃ bhajettaṃ cāvirodhayan| -----------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| anuyāyātpratipadaṃ sarvadharmeṣu madhyamām||30||
nīcaromanakhaśmaśrurnirmalāṅghrimalāyanaḥ| snānaśīlaḥ susurabhiḥ suveṣo'nulbaṇojjvalaḥ||31||

div.ab: dhārayetsatataṃ ratnasiddhamantramahauṣadhīḥ| -----------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------| sātapatrapadatrāṇo vicaredyugamātradṛk||32||

div.ab: niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī maulī sahāyavān| -----------------------------------------|33|
---------------------------------------------| caityapūjyadhvajāśastacchāyābhasmatuṣāśucīn||33|| nākrāmeccharkarāloṣṭabalisnānabhuvo na ca| ------------------------------------------|34|
-----------------------------------------| nadīṃ tarenna bāhubhyāṃ, nāgniskandhamabhivrajet||34|| sandigdhanāvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ca nārohedduṣṭayānavat| -----------------------------------------|35|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------| nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ kuryātkṣutihāsyavijṛmbhaṇam||35||
nāsikāṃ na vikuṣṇīyānnākasmādvilikhedbhuvam| nāṅgaiśceṣṭeta viguṇaṃ, nāsītotkaṭakaściram||36||

div.ab: dehavākcetasāṃ ceṣṭāḥ prāk śramādvinivartayet| nordhvajānuściraṃ tiṣṭhet---------------------|37|

ab.seg: ----------------naktaṃ seveta na drumam||37||
tathā catvaracaityāntaścatuṣpathasurālayān| sūnāṭavīśūnyagṛhaśmaśānāni divā'pi na||38||
sarvathekṣeta nādityaṃ, na bhāraṃ śirasā vahet| nekṣeta pratataṃ sūkṣmaṃ dīptāmedhyāpriyāṇi ca||39||

div.ab: madyavikrayasandhānadānādānāni nācaret| -----------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------| purovātātaparajastuṣāraparuṣānilān||40||
anṛjuḥ kṣavathūdgārakāsasvapnānnamaithunam| kūlachāyāṃ nṛpadviṣṭaṃ vyāladaṃṣṭriviṣāṇinaḥ||41||
hīnānāryātinipuṇasevāṃ vigrahamuttamaiḥ| sandhyāsvabhyavahārastrīsvapnādhyayanacintanam||42||
śatrusatragaṇākīrṇagaṇikāpaṇikāśanam| gātravaktranakhairvādyaṃ hastakeśāvadhūnanam||43||
toyāgnipūjyamadhyena yānaṃ dhūmaṃ śavāśrayam| madyātisaktiṃ viśrambhasvātantrye strīṣu ca tyajet||44||
ācāryaḥ sarvaceṣṭāsu loka eva hi dhīmataḥ| anukuryāttamevāto laukike'rthe parīkṣakaḥ||45||
ārdrasantānatā tyāgaḥ kāyavākcetasāṃ damaḥ| svārthabuddhiḥ parārtheṣu paryāptamiti sadvratam||46||
naktaṃdināni me yānti kathambhūtasya samprati| duḥkhabhāṅna bhavatyevaṃ nityaṃ sannihitasmṛtiḥ||47||

div.ab: ityācāraḥ samāsena, yaṃ prāpnoti samācaran| āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ yaśo lokāṃśca śāśvatān|48| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnu śrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dinacaryā nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|2|

div.head: ṛtucaryādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: ṛtuviśeṣavaśāccāhāravihārasevanapratipādanārthamṛtucaryāyā ārambha ityāha---- athāta ṛtucaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: atha ka ṛtavaḥ ? ityāha----- māsairdvisaṃkhyairmāghādyaiḥ kramāt ṣaḍṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ| śiśiro'tha vasantaśca grīṣmo varṣāśaraddhimāḥ||1||
śiśirādyāstribhistaistu vidyādayanamuttaram| ādānaṃ ca, tadādatte nṛṇāṃ pratidinaṃ balam||2||

div.ab: kayā yuktyā balamādatte ? ityāha---------------------- tasmin hyatyarthatīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣā mārgasvabhāvataḥ| ādityapavanāḥ saumyān kṣapayanti guṇān bhuvaḥ||3|| tiktaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭuko balino'tra rasāḥ kramāt| tasmādādānamāgneyam---------------------------|4|

ab.seg: ----------------------yadbalaṃ visṛjatyayam| saumyatvādatra somo hi balavān hīyate raviḥ||5||
meghavṛṣṭyanilaiḥ śītaiḥ śāntatāpe mahītale| snigdhāścehāmlalavaṇamadhurā balino rasāḥ||6||

div.ab: śīte'gryaṃ vṛṣṭidharme'lpaṃ balaṃ madhyaṃ tu śeṣayoḥ| ------------------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: ata evāha śāstrakṛt--------- ----------------------------------------------------| balinaḥ śītasaṃrodhāddhemante prabalo'nalaḥ||7||
bhavatyalpendhano dhātūn sa pacedvāyuneritaḥ| ato hime'sminseveta svādvamlalavaṇātrasān||8||
dairghyānniśānāmetarhi prātareva bubhukṣitaḥ| avaśyakāryaṃ sambhāvya yathoktaṃ śeelayedanu||9||
vātaghnatailairabhyaṅgaṃ mūrdhni tailaṃ vimardanam| niyuddhaṃ kuśalaiḥ sārdhaṃ pādāghātaṃ ca yuktitaḥ||10||
kaṣāyāpahṛtasnehastataḥ snāto yathāvidhi| kuṅkumena sadarpeṇa pradigdho'gurudhūpitaḥ||11||
rasān snigdhān palaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ gauḍamacchasurāṃ surām| godhūmapiṣṭamāṣekṣukṣīrotthavikṛtīḥ śubhāḥ||12||
navamannaṃ vasāṃ tailaṃ, śaucakārye sukhodakam| prāvārājinakauśeyapraveṇīkaucavāstṛtam||13||
uṣṇasvabhāvairlaghubhiḥ prāvṛtaḥ śayanaṃ bhajet| yuktyā'rkakiraṇān svedaṃ pādatrāṇaṃ ca sarvadā||14||
pīvarorustanaśroṇyaḥ samadāḥ pramadāḥ priyāḥ| haranti śītamuṣṇāṅgyo dhūpakuṅkumayauvanaiḥ||15||
aṅgāratāpasantaptagarbhabhūveśmacāriṇaḥ| śītapāruṣyajanito na doṣo jātu jāyate||16||
ayameva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire'pi viśeṣataḥ| tadā hi śeetamadhikaṃ raukṣyaṃ cādānakālajam||17||

div.ab: samprati vasantacaryāṃ vivakṣuridamāha------------------- kaphaścito hi śiśire vasante'rkāṃśutāpitaḥ| hatvā'gniṃ kurute rogānatastaṃ tvarayā jayet||18|| tīkṣṇairvamananasyādyairlaghurūkṣaiśca bhojanaiḥ| vyāyāmodvartanāghātairjitvā śleṣmāṇamulbaṇam||19|| snāto'nuliptaḥ karpūracandanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ| purāṇayavagodhūmakṣaudrajāṅgalaśūlyabhuk||20|| sahakārarasonmiśrānāsvādya priyayā'rpitān| priyāsyasaṅgasurabhīn priyānetrotpalāṅkitān||21|| saumanasyakṛto hṛdyānvayasyaiḥ sahitaḥ pibet| nirgadānāsavāriṣṭasīdhumārdvīkamādhavān||22|| śṛṅgaberāmbu sārāmbu madhvambu jaladāmbu ca| ------------------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: adṛṣṭanaṣṭasūryeṣu maṇikuṭṭimakāntiṣu| parapuṣṭavighuṣṭeṣu kāmakarmāntabhūmiṣu||24||
vicitrapuṣpavṛkṣeṣu kānaneṣu sugandhiṣu| goṣṭhīkathābhiścitrābhirmadhyāhnaṃ gamayetsukhī||25||
adhunā grīṣmacaryāmupadidikṣurāha------------ ----------------------------------------------------| tīkṣṇāṃśuratitīkṣṇāṃśurgrīṣme saṃkṣipatīva yat||26||
pratyahaṃ kṣīyate śleṣmā tena vāyuśca vardhate| ato'sminpaṭukaṭvamlavyāyāmārkakarāṃstyajet||27||

div.ab: kimatra sevyam ? ityāha---------- bhajenmadhuramevānnaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ himaṃ dravam| ------------------------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: sāmānyena bhojanamuktvā viśeṣeṇāha---------- ------------------------------------------------------------| suśītatoyasiktāṅgo lihyātsaktūn saśarkarān||28||
uktavidhyatikrame doṣamāha------------ ------------------------------------------------------------| anyathāśoṣaśaithilyadāhamohān karoti tat||29||

div.ab: ------------------------------------------------------------| pibedrasaṃ nātighanaṃ rasālāṃ rāgakhāṇḍavau||30|| pānakaṃ pañcasāraṃ vā navamṛdbhājane sthitam| mocacocadalairyuktaṃ sāmlaṃ mṛnmayaśuktibhiḥ||31|| pāṭalāvāsitaṃ cāmbhaḥ sakarpūraṃ suśītalam|32|

kasmin svapyāt ? ityāha--------------- --------------------------------------------| sugandhihimapānīyasicyamānapaṭālike||34|| kāyamāne cite cūtapravālaphalalumbibhiḥ| --------------------------------------------|35|

īdṛśe kāyamāne sthito yādṛśe śayane śayīta tannirūpayannāha--------------- --------------------------------------------| kadalīdalakahlāramṛṇālakamalotpalaiḥ||35|| komalaiḥ kalpite talpe hasatkusumapallave| madhyaṃdine'rkatāpārtaḥ svapyāddhārāgṛhe'thavā||36|| pustastrīstanahastāsyapravṛttośīravāriṇi| --------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: ---------svasthacittasya candanārdrasya mālinaḥ| nivṛttakāmatantrasya susūkṣmatanuvāsasaḥ||38||
jalārdrāstālavṛntāni vistṛtāḥ padminīpuṭāḥ| utkṣepāśca mṛdūtkṣepā jalavarṣihimānilāḥ||39||
karpūramallikāmālā hārāḥ saharicandanāḥ| manoharakalālāpāḥ śiśavaḥ sārikāḥ śukāḥ||40||
mṛṇālavalayāḥ kāntāḥ protphullakamalojjvalāḥ| jaṅgamā iva padminyo haranti dayitāḥ klamam||41||
idānīṃ varṣācaryāṃ nirdidikṣuridamāha--------------------- ādānaglānavapuṣāmagniḥ sanno'pi sīdati| varṣāsu doṣairduṣyanti te'mbulambāmbude'mbare||42||
satuṣāreṇa marutā sahasā śītalena ca| bhūbāṣpeṇāmlapākena malinena ca vāriṇā||43||
vahninaiva ca mandena, teṣvityanyonyadūṣiṣu| bhajetsādhāraṇaṃ sarvamūṣmaṇastejanaṃ ca yat||44||

div.ab: kiṃ tatsādhāraṇamiti? tadudāharaṇārthamāha---------------------- āsthāpanaṃ śuddhatanurjīrṇaṃ dhānyaṃ rasān kṛtān| jāṅgalaṃ piśitaṃ yūṣān madhvariṣṭaṃ cirantanam||45|| mastu sauvarcalāḍhyaṃ vā pañcakolāvacūrṇitam| divyaṃ kaupaṃ śṛtaṃ cāmbho bhojanaṃ tvatidurdine||46|| vyaktāmlalavaṇasnehaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ kṣaudravallaghu| --------------------------------------------------|47|

athā'tra kāle yādṛśaḥ puruṣaḥ syāttaṃ darśayati------------- ----------------------------------------| apādacārī surabhiḥ satataṃ dhūpitāmbaraḥ||47|| harmyapṛṣṭhe vasedbāṣpaśītaśīkaravarjite| ---------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------| nadījalodamanthāhaḥsvapnāyāsātapāṃstyajet||48||

div.ab: varṣāśītocitāṅgānāṃ sahasaivārkaraśmibhiḥ| taptānāṃ sañcitaṃ vṛṣṭau pittaṃ śaradi kupyati||49|| tajjayāya ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ vireko raktamokṣaṇam| ------------------------------------------|50|
-----------------------------------------------| tiktaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ ca kṣudhito'nnaṃ bhajellaghu||50|| śālimudgasitādhātrīpaṭolamadhujāṅgalam| -----------------------------------------------|51|

--------------------------------------------------| taptaṃ taptāṃśukiraṇaiḥ śītaṃ śītāṃśuraśmibhiḥ||51|| samantādapyahorātramagastyodayanirviṣam| śuci haṃsodakaṃ nāma nirmalaṃ malajijjalam||52|| nābhiṣyanti na vā rūkṣaṃ pānādiṣvamṛtopamam| --------------------------------------------------|53|
-------------------------------------------| candanośīrakarpūramuktāsragvasanojjvalaḥ||53|| saudheṣu saudhadhavalāṃ candikāṃ rajanīmukhe| -------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------| tuṣārakṣārasauhityadadhitailavasātapān||54||
tīkṣṇamadyadivāsvapnapurovātān parityajet| -------------------------------------------||55||

div.ab: vyāsena ṛtucaryāmuktvā samāsenāha- -------------------------------------------| śīte varṣāsu cādyāṃstrīn vasante'ntyān rasānbhajet svāduṃ nidāghe, śaradi svādutiktakaṣāyakān| śaradvasantayo rūkṣaṃ śītaṃ gharmaghanāntayoḥ||56|| annapānaṃ samāsena viparītamato'nyadā| -------------------------------------------|57|

ab.seg: samprati sevyatvenopadiṣṭasyāhārasyāpavādamāha------------- -------------------------------------------| nityaṃ sarvarasābhyāsaḥ svasvādhikyamṛtāvṛtau||57||

div.ab: kimanyasminnṛtau prāpte, pūrvartucaryā sahasaiva tyājyā'nyā ca sevyā ? netyāha------------------------------------ ṛtvorantyādisaptāhāvṛtusandhiriti smṛtaḥ| tatra pūrvo vidhistyājyaḥ sevanīyo'paraḥ kramāt|58| asātmyajā hi rogāḥ syuḥ sahasā tyāgaśīlanāt| 58 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne ṛtucaryā nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|3|

div.head: rogānutpādanīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto rogā|1]nutpādanīyādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
vegānna dhārayedvātaviṇmūtrakṣavatṛṭkṣudhām| nidrākāsaśramaśvāsajṛmbhāśrucchardiretasām||1||
vātasya prādhānyāttadhrodhajān rogān pūrvaṃ ni 1 darśayannāha---- adhovātasya rodhena gulmodāvartarukklamāḥ| vātamūtraśakṛtsaṅgadṛṣṭyagnivadhahṛdgadāḥ 2 ||2||

div.ab: śakṛtaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭapratiśyāyaśirorujaḥ| 3 ūrdhvavāyuḥ parīkarto hṛdayasyoparodhanam||3|| mukhena viṭpravṛttiśca pūrvoktāścāmayāḥ smṛtāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|4|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------tadauṣadham| vartyabhyaṅgāvagāhāśca svedanaṃ bastikarma ca||5||

div.ab: purīṣarodhottheṣvanyamapyasādhāraṇamupakramamāha--------- annapānaṃ ca viḍbhedi viḍrodhottheṣu yakṣmasu| ----------------------------------------------|6|
mūtrajeṣu tu pāne ca prāgbhaktaṃ śasyate ghṛtam||6|| jīrṇāntikaṃ cottamayā mātrayā yojanādvayam| avapīḍakametacca saṃjñitaṃ-----------------|7|

ab.seg: udgārasyāruciḥ kampo vibandho hṛdayorasoḥ| ādhmānakāsahidhmāśca hidhmāvattatra bheṣajam||8||

div.ab: śirortīndriyadaurbalyamanyāstambhārditaṃ kṣuteḥ| ------------------------------------------------|9|
tīkṣṇadhūmāñjanāghrāṇanāvanārkavilokanaiḥ||9|| pravartayatkṣutiṃ saktāṃ snehasvedau ca śīlayet| --------------------------------------------------|10|
śoṣāṅgasādabādhiryasammohabhramahṛdgadāḥ||10|| tṛṣṇāyā nigrahāttatra śītaḥ sarvo vidhirhitaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|11|
aṅgabhaṅgāruciglānikārśyaśūlabhramāḥ kṣudhaḥ||11|| tatra yojyaṃ laghu snigdhamuṣṇamalpaṃ ca bhojanam| -------------------------------------------------|12|
nidrāyā mohamūrdhākṣigauravālasyajṛmbhikāḥ||12|| āṅgamardaśca, tatreṣṭaḥ svapnaḥ saṃvāhanāni ca| ------------------------------------------------|13|
kāsasya rodhāttadvṛddhiḥ śvāsārucihṛdāmayāḥ||13|| śoṣe hidhmā ca, kāryo'tra kāsahā sutarāṃ vidhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|14|
gulmahṛdrogasammohāḥ śramaśvāsādvidhāritāt||14|| hitaṃ viśramaṇaṃ tatra vātaghnaśca kriyākramaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|15|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| jṛmbhāyāḥ kṣavavadrogāḥ, sarvaścānilajidvidhiḥ||15||
pīnasākṣiśirohṛdruṅmanyāstambhārucibhramāḥ| sagulmā bāṣpatastatra svapno madyaṃ priyāḥ kathāḥ||16||
visarpakoṭhakuṣṭhākṣikaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayajvarāḥ| sakāsaśvāsahṛllāsavyaṅgaśvayathavo vameḥ||17||

div.ab: gaṇḍūṣadhūmānāhārā rūkṣaṃ bhuktvā tadudvamaḥ| vyāyāmaḥ srutirasrasya śastaṃ cātra virecanam||18|| sakṣāralavaṇaṃ tailamabhyaṅgārthaṃ ca śasyate| ----------------------------------------------|19|
śukrāttatsravaṇaṃ guhyavedanāśvayathujvarāḥ||19|| hṛdvyathāmūtrasaṅgāṅgabhaṅgavṛddhyaśmaṣaṇḍhatāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|20|
tāmracūḍasurāśālibastyabhyaṅgāvagāhanam||20|| bastiśuddhikaraiḥ siddham bhajetkṣīraṃ priyāḥ striyaḥ| -------------------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: vegarodhino ye na cikitsyāḥ, tāndarśayannāha-------------- -------------------------------------------------| tṛṭśūlārtaṃ tyajet kṣīṇaṃ viḍvamaṃ vegarodhinam||21||

div.ab: atha kimeta eva rogā vegodīraṇadhāraṇādbhavanti ? netyāha----------- rogāḥ sarve'pi jāyante vegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ| ------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: nirdiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ tatra bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ye tu tān prati||22||
tataścānekadhā prāyaḥ pavano yatprakupyati| annapānauṣadhaṃ tasya yuñjītāto'nulomanam||23||

yadi vegarodhādrogā jāyante, tarhi lobhādīnāmapi narakādihetūnāṃ vegā na dhāryā iti prāpte satīdamāha----- dhārayettu sadā vegān hitaiṣī pretya ceha ca| lobherṣyādveṣamātsaryarāgādīnāṃ jitendriyaḥ||24||
anyacca hitaiśī kiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha------------- yateta ca yathākālaṃ malānāṃ śodhanaṃ prati| atyarthasañcitāste hi ṛddhāḥ syurjīvitacchidaḥ||25||
tadevaitaccetasi kṛtvā, "doṣāḥ" ityādi, granthakṛduvāca-------- doṣāḥ kadācitkupyanti jitā laṅghanapācanaiḥ| ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ||26||
yathākramaṃ yathāyogamata ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet| rasāyanāni siddhāni vṛṣyayogāṃśca kālavit||27||
bheṣajakṣapite pathyamāhārairbṛṃhaṇaṃ kramāt| śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmamudgamāṃsaghṛtādibhiḥ||28||
hṛdyadīpanabhaiṣajyasaṃyogādrucipaktidaiḥ| sābhyaṅgodvartanasnānanirūhasneha bastibhiḥ||29||
tathā sa labhate śarma sarvapāvakapāṭavam| dhīvarṇendriyavaimalyaṃ vṛṣatāṃ dairghyamāyuṣaḥ||30||
adhunā''ganturogān sopakramānnirdiśati---------------- ye bhūtaviṣavāyvagnikṣatabhaṅgādisambhavāḥ| rāgadveṣabhayādyāśca te syurāgantavo gadāḥ||31||
adhunaiṣāṃ cikitsāṃ nirdiśati--------------- tyāgaḥ prajñāparādhānāmindriyopaśamaḥ smṛtiḥ| deśakālātmavijñānaṃ sadvṛttasyānuvartanam||32||
atharvavihitā śāntiḥ pratikūlagrahārcanam| bhūtādyasparśanopāyo nirdiṣṭaśca pṛthak pṛthak||33||
anutpattyai samāsena vidhireṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ| nijāgantuvikārāṇāmutpannānāṃ ca śāntaye||34||
śītodbhavaṃ doṣacayaṃ vasante viśodhanaṃ grīṣmajamabhrakāle| ghanātyaye vārṣikamāśu samyak prāpnoti rogānṛtujānna jātu||35||

div.ab: nityaṃ hitāhāravihārasevī samīkṣyakārī viṣayeṣvasaktaḥ| dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvā- nāptopasevī ca bhavatyarogaḥ|36| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rogānu- tpādanīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|4|

div.head: dravadravyavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto dravadravyavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: prādhānyācca pānīyasya prāgupadeśaḥ| tathā cāṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe'nnapānaprakaraṇe'dhyagīṣṭa (sū.a.10) "anupāne tu salilameva śreṣṭham, sarvarasayonitvātsarvabhūtasātmyājjīvanādiguṇayogācca"| tathā, tatraivādhyaiṣṭa (saṃ.sū.a.6)_"pānīyaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇā viśvameva ca tanmayam" ityādi| tathā, cātraivāpyasaṅgrahe'pi tadeva prāgupanītam (saṃ.sū.a.13)- "śreṣṭhamudakamāśvāsanastambhanakledanānām" iti| bahuguṇatvāccāntarikṣasya jalasya prāgupanyāso yukta ityāha----------------- atha toyavargaḥ| jīvanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ hlādi buddhiprabodhanam| tanvavyaktarasaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ śītaṃ laghvamṛtopamam||1||
gaṅgāmbu nabhaso bhraṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tvarkendumārutaiḥ| hitāhitatve tadbhūyo deśakālāvapekṣate||2||

div.ab: nanvākāśātpatat lakṣaṇamantareṇa gāṅgamidamiti na jñāyata ityāha------------ yenābhivṛṣṭamamalaṃ śālyannaṃ rājate sthitam| aklinnamavivarṇaṃ ca tatpeyaṃ gāṅgam--------|3|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| aindramambu supātrasthamavipannaṃ sadā pibet||4||
tadabhāve ca bhūmiṣṭhamāntarikṣānukāri yat| śucipṛthvasitaśvete deśe'rkapavanāhatam||5||

div.ab: idānīṃ yādṛśaṃ jalaṃ na peyam, taddarśayati-------------- na pibetpaṅkaśaivālatṛṇaparṇāvilāstṛtam| sūryendupavanādṛṣṭamabhivṛṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ guru||6|| phenilaṃ jantumattaptaṃ dantagrāhyatiśaityataḥ| anārtavaṃ ca yaddivyamārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat||7|| lūtāditantuviṇmūtraviṣasaṃśleṣadūṣitam| ----------------------------------------------|8|

idānīṃ nadīrnirūpayannāha------------- ------------------------------------------------| paścimodadhigāḥ śīghravahā yāścāmalodakāḥ||8|| pathyāḥ samāsāttā nadyo viparītāstvato'nyathā| ---------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------| upalāsphālanākṣepavicchedaiḥ kheditodakāḥ||9||
himavanmalayodbhūtāḥ pathyāstā eva ca sthirāḥ| kṛmiślīpadahṛtkaṇṭhaśirorogān prakurvate||10||
prācyāvantyaparāntotthā durnāmāni, mahendrajāḥ| udaraślīpadātaṅkān, sahyavindhyodbhavā: punaḥ||11||
kuṣṭhapāṇḍuśirorogān, doṣaghnyaḥ pāriyātrajāḥ| bala pauruṣakāriṇyaḥ, sāgarāmbhastridoṣakṛt||12||

div.ab: vidyātkūpataḍāgādīn jāṅgalānūpaśailataḥ| ----------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: idānīṃ keṣāñcijjalapānaniṣedhamāha----------------- -------------------------------------------| nāmbu peyamaśaktyā vā svalpamalpāgnigulmibhiḥ||13||
pāṇḍūdarātisārārśograhaṇīśoṣaśothibhiḥ| ṛte śarannidāghābhyāṃ pibetsvastho'pi cālpaśaḥ||14||

div.ab: samasthūlakṛśā bhuktamadhyāntaprathamāmbupāḥ| --------------------------------------------|15|
---------------------------------------------| śītaṃ madātyayaglānimūrcchācchardiśramabhramān||15|| tṛṣṇoṣṇadāhapittāsraviṣāṇyambu niyacchati| --------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: adhunoṣṇāmbuguṇānāha-------------------- -------------------------------------------------| dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ laghūṣṇaṃ bastiśodhanam||16||
hidhmādhmānānilaśleṣmasadyaḥśuddhinavajvare| kāsāmapīnasaśvāsapārśvarukṣu ca śasyate||17||
adhunā kvathitaśītalaṃ nirdidikṣurāha------------- anabhiṣyandi laghu ca toyaṃ kvathitaśītalam| pittayukte hitaṃ doṣe, vyuṣitaṃ tattridoṣakṛt||18||
nārikelodakaṃ snigdhaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ himaṃ laghu| tṛṣṇāpittānilaharaṃ dīpanaṃ bastiśodhanam||19||
idānīṃ yuktyā'gryasaṅgrahaṃ nirdiśati----- varṣāsu divyanādeye paraṃ toye varāvare| -----------------------------------------|20| iti toyavargaḥ||1||

div.ab: pariśeṣebhyo vargebhyaḥ prājyajanopayogitayopakāritvenājanmasātmyena prādhānyāt payaḥ sajñāsāmānyāt payasa iva jīvanādiguṇayogācca toyavargādanu kṣīravargaḥ prakramyate| tatrāpi dadhyādīnāṃ mūlakāraṇatvāt kṣīrasya prāgupādānam| tathā, jīvanīyānāṃ rasāyanānāṃ cāgresaratvāt| tathā cāṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe (sū. a. 13)- "kṣīraṃ jīvanīyānām| kṣīraghṛtābhyāso rasāyanānām| " ityādi| ---------------------- atha kṣīravargaḥ| ------------------------------------------------| svādupākarasaṃ snigdhamojasyaṃ dhātuvardhanam||20|| vātapittaharaṃ vṛṣyaṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru śītalam| prāyaḥ payaḥ---------------------------------|21|

-----------------------------------------| ---------atra gavyaṃ tu jīvanīyaṃ rasāyanam||21|| kṣatakṣīṇahitaṃ medhyaṃ balyaṃ stanyakaraṃ saram| śramabhramamadālakṣmīśvāsakāsātitṛṭkṣudhaḥ||22|| jīrṇajvaraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ raktapittaṃ ca nāśayet| --------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| hitamatyagnyanidrebhyo garīyo māhiṣaṃ himam||23||
alpāmbupānavyāyāmakaṭutiktāśanairlaghu| ājaṃ śoṣajvaraśvāsaraktapittātisārajit||24||
īṣadrūkṣoṣṇalavaṇamauṣṭrakaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu| śastaṃ vātakaphānāhakṛmiśophodarārśasām||25||

div.ab: mānuṣaṃ vātapittāsṛgabhighātākṣirogajit| tarpaṇāścotanairnasyaiḥ-----------------|26|
---------bāḍhamuṣṇaṃ tvaikaśaphaṃ laghu||27|| śākhāvātaharaṃ sāmlalavaṇaṃ jaḍatākaram| --------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| payo'bhiṣyandi gurvāmaṃ, yuktyā śṛtamato'nyathā||28||

div.ab: bhavedgarīyo'tiśṛtaṃ, dhāroṣṇamamṛtopamam| --------------------------------------------|29|

----------------------------------------------| amlapākarasaṃ grāhi gurūṣṇaṃ dadhi vātajit||29|| medaḥśukrabalaśleṣmapittaraktāgniśophakṛt| rociṣṇu śastamarucau śītake viṣamajvare||30|| pīnase mūtrakṛcchre ca, rūkṣaṃ tu grahaṇīgade| naivādyānniśi naivoṣṇaṃ vasantoṣṇaśaratsu na||31|| nāmudgasūpaṃ nākṣaudraṃ tannāghṛtasitopalam| na cānāmalakaṃ nāpi nityaṃ no mandamanyathā||32|| jvarāsṛk pittavīsarpakuṣṭhapāṇḍubhramapradam| --------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| takraṃ laghu kaṣāyāmlaṃ dīpanaṃ kaphavātajit||33||
śophodarārśograhaṇīdoṣamūtragrahārucīḥ| plīhagulmaghṛtavyāpadgarapāṇḍvāmayān jayet||34||

div.ab: tadvanmastu saraṃ srotaḥśodhi viṣṭhambhajillaghu| ------------------------------------------------|35|
------------------------------------------------| navanītaṃ navaṃ vṛṣyaṃ śītaṃ varṇabalāgnikṛt||35|| saṅgrāhi vātapittāsṛkkṣayārśorditakāsajit| -----------------------------------------------|36|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| kṣīrodbhavaṃ tu saṅgrāhi raktapittākṣirogajit||36||
śastaṃ dhīsmṛtimedhāgnibalāyuḥśukracakṣuṣām| bālavṛddhaprajākāntisaukumāryasvarārthinām||37||
kṣatakṣīṇaparīsarpaśastrāgniglapitātmanām| vātapittaviṣonmādaśoṣālakṣmījvarāpaham||38||
snehānāmuttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ param| sahasravīryaṃ vidhibhirghṛtaṃ karmasahasrakṛt||39||
madāpasmāramūrchāyaśiraḥkarṇākṣiyonijān| purāṇaṃ jayati vyādhīn vraṇaśodhanaropaṇam||40||
balyāḥ kilāṭapīyūṣakūrcikāmoraṇādayaḥ| śukranidrākaphakarā viṣṭambhigurudoṣalāḥ||41||
gavye kṣīraghṛte śreṣṭhe nindite cāvisambhave| -----------------------------------------------|42| iti kṣīravargaḥ||2||

kṣīravargādanantaramikṣuvarga ārambhyate, guṇakriyātulyatvāt| tathā, hi-ikṣurapi kṣīravatsaragurusnigdhabṛṃhaṇādiguṇakarmā-------------------- athekṣuvargaḥ| --------------------------------------------------| ikṣoḥ saro guruḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphamūtrakṛt||42||
vṛṣyaḥ śīto'srapittaghnaḥ svādupākaraso rasaḥ| so'gre salavaṇo, dantapīḍitaḥ śarkarāsamaḥ||43||

div.ab: yāntrikastvanyaguṇa evetyāha------------------------- mūlāgrajantujagdhādipīḍanānmalasaṅkarāt| kiñcitkālaṃ vidhṛtyā ca vikṛtiṃ yāti yāntrikaḥ||44|| vidāhī guruviṣṭambhī tenāsau------------------| ----------------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: ------------------------------tatra pauṇḍrakaḥ| śaityaprasādamādhuryairvarastamanu vāṃśikaḥ||45||
śataparvakakāntāranaipālādyāstataḥ kramāt| sakṣārāḥ sakaṣāyāśca soṣṇāḥ kiñcidvidāhinaḥ||46||

div.ab: phāṇitaṃ gurvabhiṣyandi cayakṛnmūtraśodhanam| --------------------------------------------|47|
nātiśleṣmakaro dhautaḥ sṛṣṭamūtraśakṛdguḍaḥ||47|| prabhūtakṛmimajjāsṛḍmedomāṃsakapho'paraḥ| -----------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------------| hṛdyaḥ purāṇaḥ pathyaśca, navaḥ śleṣmāgnisādakṛt||48||
vṛṣyāḥ kṣīṇakṣatahitā raktapittānilāpahāḥ| matsyaṇḍikākhaṇḍasitāḥ krameṇa guṇavattamāḥ||49||

div.ab: tadguṇā tiktamadhurā kaṣāyā yāsaśarkarā| ----------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------| dāhatṛṭcchardimūrcchāsṛkpittaghnyaḥ sarvaśarkarāḥ||50||

div.ab: adhunā varāvaratvaṃ nirdhārayati----- śarkarekṣuvikārāṇāṃ phāṇitaṃ ca varāvare| ----------------------------------------|51|

śarkarāyoniprasaṅgena madhuno'pi guṇānāha----- -------------------------------------------------| cakṣuṣyaṃ chedi tṛṭśleṣmaviṣahidhmāsrapittanut||51|| mehakuṣṭhakṛmicchardiśvāsakāsātisārajit| vraṇaśodhanasandhānaropaṇaṃ vātalaṃ madhu||52|| rūkṣaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ, tattulyā madhuśarkarā| ----------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| uṣṇamuṣṇārtumuṣṇe ca yuktaṃ coṣṇairnihanti tat||53||
pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivāryate| alabdhapākamāśveva tayoryasmānnivartate||54||
itīkṣuvargaḥ||3||

sarpiṣo'nantaraṃ snehasāmānyāttailavarge vaktavye guḍasya samānarasavīryavipākakarmatvāt prāyeṇa cāhāradravyeṣu bhakṣyabhojyeṣvasyaiva tailebhyaḥ sutarāṃ bhojanopayogitvādīkṣuvargo'ntarā nirdiṣṭaḥ| bhūribhojanopayogitayā ca madyātprāk tailavargo vaktavya ityāha----- atha tailavargaḥ| tailaṃ svayonivattatra mukhyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca| tvagdoṣakṛdacakṣuṣyaṃ sūkṣmoṣṇaṃ kaphakṛnna ca||55||
kṛśānāṃ bṛṃhaṇāyālaṃ sthūlānāṃ karśanāya ca| baddhaviṭkaṃ kṛmighnaṃ ca saṃskārātsarvarogajit||56||
sattiktoṣaṇamairaṇḍaṃ tailaṃ svādu saraṃ guru| vardhmagulmānilakaphānudaraṃ viṣamajvaram||57||
rukśophau ca kaṭīguhyakoṣṭhapṛṣṭhāśrayau jayet| tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ picchilaṃ visraṃ, raktairaṇḍodbhavaṃ tvati||58||
kaṭūṣṇaṃ sārṣapaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kaphaśukrānilāpaham| laghu pittāsrakṛt koṭhakuṣṭhārśovraṇajantujit||59||

div.ab: ākṣaṃ svādu himaṃ keśyaṃ guru pittānilāpaham| ----------------------------------------|60|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------| nātyuṣṇaṃ nimbajaṃ tiktaṃ kṛmikuṣṭhakaphapraṇut||60||

div.ab: umākusumbhajaṃ coṣṇaṃ tvagdoṣakaphapittakṛt| ---------------------------------------------|61|

ab.seg: snehaprasaṅgādidamapyāha-------------- ----------------------------------------------| vasā majjā ca vātaghnau balapittakaphapradau||61||
māṃsānugasvarūpau ca, vidyānmedo'pi tāviva| ----------------------------------------------|62| iti tailavargaḥ||4||

div.ab: tīkṣṇoṣṇasūkṣmādiguṇasāmānyāttailavargādanantaraṃ madyavarga ārabhyate-----------atha madyavargaḥ| ----------------------------------------------| dīpanaṃ rocanaṃ madyaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ tuṣṭipuṣṭidam||62|| sasvādutiktakaṭukamamlapākarasaṃ saram| sakaṣāyaṃ svarārogyapratibhāvarṇakṛllaghu||63|| naṣṭanidrā'tinidrebhyo hitaṃ pittāsradūṣaṇam| kṛśasthūlahitaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ srotoviśodhanam||64|| vātaśleṣmaharaṃ yuktyā pītaṃ viṣavadanyathā| ----------------------------------------------|65|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| guru taddoṣajananaṃ navaṃ, jīrṇamato'nyathā||65||
peyaṃ noṣṇopacāreṇa na viriktakṣudhāturaiḥ| nātyarthatīkṣṇamṛdvalpasambhāraṃ kaluṣaṃ na ca||66||
gulmodarārśograhaṇīśoṣahṛt snehanī guruḥ| surā'nilaghnī medo'sṛkstanyamūtrakaphāvahā||67||
tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghustīkṣṇā nihanti ca| śūlakāsavamiśvāsavibandhādhmānapīnasān||68||

div.ab: nātitīvramadā laghvī pathyā baibhītakī surā| vraṇe pāṇḍvāmaye kuṣṭhe na cātyarthaṃ virudhyate||69|| viṣṭambhinī yavasurā gurvī rūkṣā tridoṣalā| ----------------------------------------------|70|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| yathādravyaguṇo'riṣṭaḥ sarvamadyaguṇādhikaḥ||70||
grahaṇīpāṇḍukuṣṭhārśaḥśophaśoṣodarajvarān| hanti gulmakṛmiplīhnaḥ kaṣāyakaṭuvātalaḥ||71||
mārdvīkaṃ lekhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ saram| alpapittānilaṃ pāṇḍumehārśaḥkṛmināśanam||72||
asmādalpāntaraguṇaṃ khārjūraṃ vātalaṃ guru| śārkaraḥ surabhiḥ svāduhṛdyo nātimado laghuḥ||73||

div.ab: sṛṣṭamūtraśakṛdvāto gauḍastarpaṇadīpanaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|74|
----------------------------------------------| vātapittakaraḥ sīdhuḥ snehaśleṣmavikārahā||74|| medaḥśophodarārśoghnastatra pakvaraso varaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|75|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| chedī madhvāsavastīkṣṇo mehapīnasakāsajit||75||

div.ab: raktapittakaphotkledi śuktaṃ vātānulomanam| bhṛśoṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣāmlaṃ hṛdyaṃ rucikaraṃ saram||76|| dīpanaṃ śiśirasparśaṃ pāṇḍudṛkkṛmināśanam| ----------------------------------------------|77|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| guḍekṣumadyamārdvīkaśuktaṃ laghu yathottaram||77||

div.ab: kandamūlaphalādyaṃ ca tadvadvidyāttadāsutam| ----------------------------------------------|78|

ab.seg: amlatvarocanādiguṇatulyatvādanyadapi śāṇḍākyādikamāha----- ----------------------------------------------| śāṇḍākī cāsutaṃ cānyatkālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu||78||
dhānyāmlaṃ bhedi tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ pittakṛtsparśaśītalam| śramaklamaharaṃ rucyaṃ dīpanaṃ bastiśūlanut||79||
śastamāsthāpane hṛdyaṃ laghu vātakaphāpaham| ebhireva guṇairyukte sauvīrakatuṣodake||80||
kṛmihṛdrogagulmārśaḥpāṇḍuroganibarhaṇe| te kramādvituṣairvidyātsatuṣaiśca yavaiḥ kṛte||81||
madyavattīkṣṇoṣṇādiyuktatvāt gomūtrādiguṇānapyāha----- mūtraṃ go'jāvimahiṣīgajāśvoṣṭrakharodbhavam| pittalaṃ rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ lavaṇānurasaṃ kaṭu||82||
kṛmiśophodarānāhaśūlapāṇḍukaphānilān| gulmāruciviṣaśvitrakuṣṭhārśāṃsi jayellaghu||83||

div.ab: toyakṣīrekṣutailānāṃ vargairmadyasya ca kramāt| iti dravaikadeśo'yaṃ yathāsthūlamudāhṛtaḥ|84| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dravadravyavijñānīyo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|5|

div.head: annasvarūpavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto'nnasvarūpavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasutre)|2|

ab.seg: śimbīdhānyasya tu tadvyañjanattvena svalpopayogittvāt prāyeṇāpathyāttvāccāprādhanyaṃ, ityāha- atha śūkadhānyavargaḥ| rakto mahān sakalamastūrṇakaḥ śakunāhṛtaḥ| sārāmukho dīrghaśūko rodhraśūkaḥ sugandhikaḥ||1||
puṇḍraḥ pāṇḍuḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ pramodo gaurasārivau| kāñhcano mahiṣaḥ śūko dūṣakaḥ kusumāṇḍakaḥ||2||
lāṅgalā lohavālākhyaḥ kardamāḥ śītabhīrukāḥ| pataṅgāstapanīyāśca ye cānye śālayaḥ śubhāḥ||3||
svādupākarasaḥ snigdhā vṛṣyā baddhālpavarcasaḥ| kaṣāyānurasāḥ pathya laghavo mūtrala himāḥ||4||

div.ab: śūkajeṣu varastatra raktastṛṣṇātridoṣahā| --------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| māhāṃstamanu kalamastaṃ cāpyanu tataḥ pare||5||

div.ab: yavakā hāyanāḥ pāṃsubāṣpanaiṣadhakādayaḥ| svādūṣṇā guravaḥ snigdhāḥ pāke'mlāḥ śleṣmapittalāḥ||6|| sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣāśca pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca ninditāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|7|

---------------------------------------------------| snigdho grāhī laghuḥ svādudustridoṣaghnaḥ sthiro himaḥ||7|| ṣaṣṭiko vrīhiṣu śreṣṭho gauraścāsitagaurataḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|8|

-------------------------------------------| tataḥ kramānmahāvrīhikṛṣṇavrīhijatūmukhāḥ||8|| kukkuṭāṇḍakalāvākhyapārāvatakaśūkarāḥ| varakoddālakojjvālacīnaśāradadardurāḥ||9|| gandhanāḥ kuruvindāśca guṇairalpāntarāḥ smṛtāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|10|
---------------------------------------------| svāduramlavipāko'nyo vrīhiḥ pittakaro guruḥ|10| bahumūtrapurīṣoṣmā, tridoṣastveva pāṭalaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| svāduramlavipāko'nyo vrīhiḥ pittakaro guruḥ||10||
bahumūtrapurīṣoṣmā, tridoṣastveva pāṭalaḥ| ---------------------------------------------||11||
--------------------------------------------------| bhagnasandhānakṛttatra priyaṅgurbṛṃhaṇī guruḥ||12||

div.ab: koradūṣaḥ paraṃ grāhī sparśe śīto viṣāpahaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| rūkṣaḥ śīto guruḥ svāduḥ saro viḍvātakṛdyavaḥ||13||
vṛṣyaḥ sthairyakaro mūtramedaḥpittakaphān jayet| pīnasaśvāsakāsorustambhakaṇṭhatvagāmayān||14||

div.ab: ------------------------------------------------| vṛṣyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdho jīvano vātapittahā||15|| sandhānakārī madhuro godhūmaḥ sthairyakṛtsaraḥ| ------------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pathyā nandīmukhī śītā kaṣāyamadhurā laghuḥ||16||
iti śūkadhānyavargaḥ||1||

div.ab: atha śimbīdhānyavargaḥ| mudgāḍhakīmasūrādi śimbīdhānyaṃ vibandhakṛt| kaṣāyaṃ svādu saṅgrāhi kaṭupākaṃ himaṃ laghu||17|| medaḥśleṣmāstrapitteṣu hitaṃ lepopasekayoḥ| ----------------------------------------------|18|
----------------------------------------------| varo'tra mudgo'lpacalaḥ, kalāyastvativātalaḥ||18|| rājamāṣo'nilakaro rūkṣo bahuśakṛdguruḥ| ----------------------------------------------|19|

----------------------------------------------| uṣṇāḥ kulatthāḥ pāke'mlāḥ śukrāśmaśvāsapīnasān||19|| kāsārśaḥkaphavātāṃśca ghnanti pittāsradāḥ param| ----------------------------------------------|20|
----------------------------------------------| niṣpāvo vātapittāsrastanyamūtrakaro guruḥ||20|| saro vidāhī dṛkśukrakaphaśophaviṣāpahaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|21|
----------------------------------------------| māṣaḥ snigdho balaśleṣmamalapittakaraḥ saraḥ||21|| gurūṣṇo'nilahā svāduḥ śukravṛddhivirekakṛt| ----------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| phalāni māṣavadvidyātkākāṇḍolātmaguptayoḥ||22||
uṣṇastvacyo himaḥ sparśe keśyo balyastilo guruḥ| alpamūtraḥ kaṭuḥ pāke medhā'gnikaphapittakṛt||23||
snigdhomā svādutiktoṣṇā kaphapittakarī guruḥ| dṛkśukrahṛtkaṭuḥ pāke, tadvadbījaṃ kusumbhajam||24||

div.ab: māṣo'tra sarveṣvavaro, yavakaḥ śūkajeṣu ca| ----------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: navaṃ dhānyamabhiṣyandi, laghu saṃvatsaroṣitam||25||
śīghrajanma tathā sūpyaṃ nistuṣaṃ yuktibharjitam| ----------------------------------------------|26| iti śimbīdhānyavargaḥ||1||

div.ab: atha kṛtānna(pakvānna)vargaḥ| ----------------------------------------| maṇḍapeyāvilepīnāmodanasya ca lāghavam||26|| yathāpūrvaṃ śivastatra maṇḍo vātānulomanaḥ| tṛḍglānidoṣaśeṣaghnaḥ pācano dhātusāmyakṛt||27|| srotomārdavakṛtsvedī sandhukṣayati cānalam| -----------------------------------------------|28|
-------------------------------------------------| kṣattṛṣṇāglānidaurbalyakukṣirogajvarāpahā||28|| malānulomanī pathyā peyā dīpanapācanī| -------------------------------------------------|29|
---------------------------------------------| vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāghnī dīpanī hitā||29|| vraṇākṣirogasaṃśuddhadurbalasnehapāyinām| ---------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| sudhautaḥ prasrutaḥ svinno'tyaktoṣmā caudano laghuḥ||30||
yaścāgneyauṣadhakvāthasādhito bhṛṣṭataṇḍulaḥ| viparīto guruḥ kṣīramāṃsādyairyaśca sādhitaḥ||31||

div.ab: iti dravyakriyāyogamānādyaiḥ sarvamādiśet| ---------------------------------------------|32|

tilapiṇyākavikṛtiḥ śuṣkaśākaṃ virūḍhakam| śaṇḍākīvaṭakaṃ dṛgghnaṃ doṣalaṃ glapanaṃ guru||34||

div.ab: dhānā viṣṭambhinī rūkṣā tarpaṇī lekhanī guruḥ| -----------------------------------------------|38|

-----------------------------------------------| saktavo laghavaḥ kṣuttṛṭśramanetrāmayavraṇān||38|| ghnanti santarpaṇāḥ pānātsadya eva balapradāḥ| nodakāntaritānna dvirna niśāyāṃ na kevalān||39|| na bhuktvā na dvijaiśchittvā saktūnadyānna vā bahūn| -----------------------------------------------|40|

div.ab: lāvavārtīkavartīraraktavartmakakukkubhāḥ| kapiñjalopacakrākhyacakorakurubāhavaḥ||44|| vartako vartikā caiva tittiriḥ krakaraḥ śikhī| tāmrācūḍākhyabakaragonardagirivartikāḥ||45|| tathā śārapadendrābhavaraṭādyāśca viṣkirāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|46|
---------------------------------------------| jīvañjīvakadātyūhabhṛṅgāhvaśukasārikāḥ||46|| laṭvākokilahārītakapotacaṭakādayaḥ| pratudāḥ----------------------------------|47|

gokharāśvataroṣṭrāśvadvīpisiṃharkṣavānarāḥ| mārjāramūṣakavyāghravṛkababhrutarakṣavaḥ||48|| lopākajambukaśyenacāṣavāntādavāyasāḥ śaśaghnībhāsakuraragṛdhrolūkakuliṅgakāḥ||49|| dhūmikā madhuhā ceti prasahā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------|50|
--------------------------------------------| varāhamahiṣanyaṅkurururohitavāraṇāḥ||50|| sṛmaraścamaraḥ khaḍgo gavayaśca mahāmṛgāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|51|
-------------------------------------------| haṃsasārasakādambavakakāraṇḍavaplavāḥ||51|| balākotkrośacakrāhvamadgukrauñcādayo'pcarāḥ| -------------------------------------------|52|

-----------------------------------------| matsyā rohitapāṭhīnakūrmakumbhīrakarkaṭāḥ||52|| śuktiśaṅkhodraśambūkaśapharīvarmicandrikāḥ| culūkīnakramakaraśiśumāratimiṅgilāḥ||53|| rājīcilicimādyāśca--------------------| ----------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------māṃsamityāhuraṣṭadhā| ----------------------------------------------------|54| (mṛgyaṃ vaiṣkirikaṃ kiñca prātudaṃ ca bileśayam| prāsahaṃ ca mahāmṛgyamapcaraṃ mātsyamaṣṭadhā||1||
--------------------------------------------| yoniṣvajāvī vyāmiśragocaratvādaniścite||54||

div.ab: ādyāntyā jāṅgalānūpā madhyau sādhāraṇau smṛtau| -----------------------------------------------|55|
---------------------------------------------| tatra baddhamalāḥ śītā laghavo jāṅgalā hitāḥ||55|| pittottare vātamadhye sannipāte kaphānuge| ---------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| dīpanaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke grāhī rūkṣo himaḥ śaśaḥ||56||

div.ab: īṣaduṣṇagurusnigdhā bṛṃhaṇā vartakādayaḥ| tittiristeṣvapi varo medhāgnibalaśukrakṛt||57|| grāhī varṇyo'nilodriktasannipātaharaḥ param| ---------------------------------------------|58|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| nātipathyaḥ śikhī pathyaḥ śrotrasvaravayoddaśām||58||
---------------------------------------------| medhā'nalakarā hṛdyāḥ krakarāḥ sopacakrakāḥ||59||

div.ab: guruḥ salavaṇaḥ kāṇakapotaḥ sarvadoṣakṛt| ---------------------------------------------|60|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| caṭakāḥ śleṣmalāḥ snigdhā vātaghnāḥ śukralāḥ param||60||
gurūṣṇasnigdhamadhurā vargāścāto yathottaram| mūtraśukrakṛto balyā vātaghnāḥ kaphapittalāḥ||61||

div.ab: evaṃ vargapañcakasya sāmānyaguṇānuktvā, apavādamāha- śītā mahāmṛgāsteṣu, kravyādaprasahāḥ punaḥ| lavaṇānurasāḥ pāke kaṭukā māṃsavardhanāḥ||62|| jīrṇārśograhaṇīdoṣaśoṣārtānāṃ paraṃ hitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|63|
---------------------------------------------| nātiśītagurusnigdhaṃ māṃsamājamadoṣalam||63|| śarīradhātusāmānyādanabhiṣyandi bṛṃhaṇm| ---------------------------------------------|64|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| viparītamato jñeyamāvikaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ tu tat||64||
śuṣkakāsaśramātyagniviṣamajvarapīnasān| kārśyaṃ kevalavātāṃśca gomāṃsaṃ sanniyacchati||65||

div.ab: uṣṇo garīyānmahiṣaḥ svapnadārḍhyabṛhattvakṛt| ---------------------------------------------|66|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tadvadvarāhaḥ śramahā ruciśukrabalapradaḥ||66||
---------------------------------------------| lāvarohitagodhaiṇāḥ sve sve varge varāḥ param||67||

div.ab: māṃsaṃ sadyohataṃ śuddhaṃ vayaḥsthaṃ ca bhajet-----| ---------------------------------------------|68|

puṃstriyoḥ pūrvapaścārdhe guruṇī, garbhiṇī guruḥ| laghuryoṣiccatuṣpātsu, vihaṅgeṣu punaḥ pumān||69||
śiraḥskandhorupṛṣṭhasya kaṭyāḥ sakthnośca gauravam| tathā''mapakvāśayayoryathāpūrvaṃ vinirdiśet||70||
śoṇitaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca dhātūnāmuttarottaram| māṃsādgarīyo vṛṣaṇameḍhravṛkkayakṛdgudam||71||
iti māṃsavargaḥ||3||
atha śākavargaḥ| śākaṃ pāṭhāśaṭhīsūṣāsuniṣaṇṇasatīnajam| tridoṣaghnaṃ laghu grāhi sarājakṣavavāstukam||72||

div.ab: -----------------------rājakṣavaḥ param| grahaṇyarśovikāraghnaḥ------------------|73|
hanti doṣatrayaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vṛṣyā soṣṇā rasāyanī| kākamācī sarā svaryā-----------------------------|74|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| paṭolasaptalāriṣṭaśārṅgeṣṭāvalgujā'mṛtāḥ||75||
vetrāgrabṛhatīvāsākutilītilaparṇikāḥ| maṇḍūkaparṇīkarkoṭakāravellakaparpaṭāḥ||76||
nāḍīkalāyagojihvāvārtākaṃ vanatiktakam| karīraṃ kulakaṃ nandī kucailā śakulādanī||77||
kaṭillaṃ kembukaṃ śītaṃ sakośātakakarkaśam| tiktaṃ pāke kaṭu grāhi vātalaṃ kaphapittajit||78||

vārtākaṃ kaṭu tiktoṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ kaphavātajit| sakṣāramagnijananaṃ hṛdyaṃ rucyamapittalam||81||

taṇḍulīyo himo rūkṣaḥ svādupākaraso laghuḥ| madapittaviṣāsraghnaḥ--------------------|83|

---------------------------------------------| vidārī vātapittaghnī mūtralā svāduśītalā||85|| jīvanī bṛṃhaṇī kaṇṭhyā gurvī vṛṣyā rasāyanam| ------------------------------------------------|86|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| cakṣuṣyā sarvadoṣaghnī jīvantī madhurā himā||86||

div.ab: kūṣmāṇḍatumbakāliṅgakarkārvervārutiṇḍiśam| tathā trapusacīnākacirbhaṭaṃ kaphavātakṛt||87|| bhedi viṣṭambhyabhiṣyandi svādupākarasaṃ guru| -----------------------------------------------|88|

----------------------------------------------------| tumbaṃ rūkṣataraṃ grāhi kāliṅgairvārucirbhaṭam||89|| bālaṃ pittaharaṃ śītaṃ vidyātpakvamato'nyathā| ----------------------------------------------------|90|

-------------------------------------------------| śīrṇavṛntaṃ tu sakṣāraṃ pittalaṃ kaphavātajit||90|| rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdyamaṣṭhīlā'nāhanullaghu| -------------------------------------------------|91|

ab.seg: nandīmāṣakakelūṭaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukam| krauñcādanaṃ kaloḍyaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru||92||

div.ab: kalambanālikāmārṣakuṭiñjarakutumbakam| cillīlaṭvākaloṇīkākurūṭakagavedhukam||93|| jīvantajhuñjhveḍagajayavaśākasuvarcalāḥ| ālukāni ca sarvāṇi tathā sūpyāni lakṣmaṇam||94|| svādu rūkṣaṃ salavaṇaṃ vātaśleṣmakaraṃ guru| śītalaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ prāyo viṣṭabhya jīryati||95|| svinnaṃ niṣpīḍitarasaṃ snehāḍhyaṃ nātidoṣalam| -------------------------------------------------|96|
tarkārīvaruṇaṃ svādu satiktaṃ kaphavātajit| -------------------------------------------|97|

-------------------------------------------------| varṣābhvau kālaśākaṃ ca sakṣāraṃ kaṭutiktakam||97|| dīpanaṃ bhedanaṃ hanti garaśophakaphānilān| -------------------------------------------------|98|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dīpanāḥ kaphavātaghnāściribilvāṅkurāḥ sarāḥ||98||

pattūro dīpanastiktaḥ plīhārśaḥkaphavātajit| ------------------------------------------|100|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| gurūṣṇaṃ sārṣapaṃ baddhaviṇmūtraṃ sarvadoṣakṛt||101||

div.ab: yadbālamavyaktarasaṃ kiñcitkṣāraṃ satiktakam| tanmūlakaṃ doṣaharaṃ laghu soṣṇaṃ niyacchhati||102|| gulmakāsakṣayaśvāsavraṇanetragalāmayān| svarāgnisādodāvartapīnasāṃśca---------------|103|
-------------------------------mahatpunaḥ||103|| rase pāke ca kaṭukamuṣṇavīryaṃ tridoṣakṛt| gurvabhiṣyandi ca------------------------|104|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| kaṭūṣṇo vātakaphahā piṇḍāluḥ pittavardhanaḥ||105||
kuṭheraśigrusurasasumukhāsuribhūstṛṇam| phaṇijjārjakajambīraprabhṛti grāhi śālanam||106||
vidāhi kaṭu rūkṣoṣṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ dīpanarocanam| dṛkśukrakṛmihṛttīkṣṇaṃ doṣotkleśakaraṃ laghu||107||

div.ab: hidhmākāsaviṣaśvāsapārśvarukpūtigandhahā| surasaḥ----------------------------------|108|
ārdrikā tiktamadhurā mūtralā na ca pittakṛt| ----------------------------------------------|109|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| laśuno bhṛśatīkṣṇoṣṇaḥ kaṭupākarasaḥ saraḥ||109||
hṛdyaḥ keśyo gururvṛṣyaḥ snigdho rocanadīpanaḥ| bhagnasandhānakṛdbalyo raktapittapradūṣaṇaḥ||110||
kilāsakuṣṭhagulmārśomehakrimikaphānilān| sahidhmāpīnasaśvāsakāsān hanti rasāyanam||111||

div.ab: palāṇḍustadguṇanyūnaḥ śleṣmalo nātipittalaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|112|

------------------------------------------------| kaphavātārśasāṃ pathyaḥ svede'bhyavahṛtau tathā||112|| tīkṣṇo gRañjanako grāhī pittināṃ hitakṛnna saḥ| ------------------------------------------------|113|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| patre puṣpe phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt||114||

div.ab: varā śākeṣu jīvantī sārṣapaṃ tvavaraṃ param| iti śākavargaḥ||2|| ------------------------------------------------|115|

atha phalavargaḥ| ------------------------------------------------| drākṣā phalottamā vṛṣyā cakṣuṣyā sṛṣṭamūtraviṭ||115|| svādupākarasā snigdhā sakaṣāyā himā guruḥ| nihantyanilapittāsratiktāsyatvamadātyayān||116|| tṛṣṇākāsaśramaśvāsasvarabhedakṣatakṣayān| ------------------------------------------------|117|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| udriktapittāñjayati trīndoṣānsvādu dāḍimam||117||
pittāvirodhi nātyuṣṇamamlaṃ vātakaphāpaham| sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ grāhi rocanadīpanam||118||

div.ab: mocakharjūrapanasanārikelaparūṣakam| āmrātatālakāśmaryarājādanamadhūkajam||119|| saivīrabadarāṅkollaphalguśleṣmātakodbhavam| vātāmābhiṣukākṣoḍamukūlakanikocakam||120|| urumāṇaṃ priyālaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru śītalam| dāhakṣatakṣayaharaṃ raktapittaprasādanam||121|| svādupākarasaṃ snigdhaṃ viṣṭambhi kaphaśukrakṛt| ------------------------------------------------|122|

------------------------------------------------| phalaṃ tu pittalaṃ tālaṃ saraṃ kāśmaryajaṃ himam||122|| śakṛnmūtravibandhaghnaṃ keśyaṃ medhyaṃ rasāyanam| vātāmādyuṣṇavīryaṃ tu kaphapittakaraṃ saram||123|| paraṃ vātaharaṃ snigdhamanuṣṇaṃ tu priyālajam| priyālamajjā madhuro vṛṣyaḥ pittānilāpahaḥ||124|| kolamajjā guṇaistadvattṛṭchardiḥkāsajicca saḥ| ------------------------------------------------|125|

------------------------------------------------| pakvaṃ sudurjaraṃ bilvaṃ doṣalaṃ pūtimārutam||125|| dīpanaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ bālaṃ, grāhyubhayaṃ ca tat| ------------------------------------------------|126|

------------------------------------------------| kapitthamāmaṃ kaṇṭhaghnaṃ doṣalaṃ, doṣaghāti tu||126|| pakvaṃ hidhmāvamathujit, sarvaṃ grāhi viṣāpaham| ------------------------------------------------|127|

------------------------------------------------| jāmbavaṃ guru viṣṭambhi śītalaṃ bhṛśavātalam||127|| saṅgrāhi mūtraśakṛtorakaṇṭhyaṃ kaphapittajit| ------------------------------------------------|128|

āmrasya tryavasthasyāpyupayogadarśanāttathaiva guṇānāha---- ------------------------------------------------| vātapittāsrakṛdbālaṃ, baddhāsthi kaphapittakṛt||128|| gurvāmraṃ vātajitpakvaṃ svādvamlaṃ kaphaśukrakṛt| ------------------------------------------------|129|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| vṛkṣāmlaṃ grāhi rūkṣoṣṇaṃ vātaśleṣmaharaṃ laghu||129||

div.ab: --------------------------------pīlu tu pittalam| kaphavātaharaṃ bhedi plīhārśaḥkṛmigulmanut||130|| satiktaṃ svādu yatpīlu vātyuṣṇaṃ tattridoṣajit| ------------------------------------------------|131|

ab.seg: mātuluṅgasya tvaṅmāṃsakesarāṇāṃ pṛthagupayogadarśanāt pṛthageva guṇānāha---- ------------------------------------------------| tvaktiktakaṭukā snigdhā mātuluṅgasya vātajit||131||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ madhuraṃ māṃsaṃ vātapittaharaṃ guru| laghu tatkesaraṃ kāsaśvāsahidhmāmadātyayān||132||
āsyaśoṣānilaśleṣmavibandhacchardyarocakān gulmodarārśaḥśūlāni mandāgnitvaṃ ca nāśayet||133||
bhallātakasya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ svādu śītalam| tadasthyagnisamaṃ medhyaṃ kaphavātaharaṃ param||134||

div.ab: svādvamlaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ ca dvidhā pālevataṃ guru| rucyamatyagniśamanam----------------------------|135|

------------------------------------------------| drākṣāparūṣakaṃ cārdramamlaṃ pittakaphapradam||136|| gurūṣṇavīryaṃ vātaghnaṃ saraṃ sakaramardakam| ------------------------------------------------|137|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| tathā'mlaṃ kolakarkandhulakucāmrātakārukam||137||
airāvataṃ dantaśaṭhaṃ satūdaṃ mṛgaliṇḍikam| nātipittakaraṃ pakvaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca karamardakam||138||
dīpanaṃ bhedanaṃ śuṣkamamlīkākolayoḥ phalam| tṛṣṇāśramaklamacchedi laghviṣṭaṃ kaphavātayoḥ||139||

div.ab: phalānāmavaraṃ tatra lakucaṃ sarvadoṣakṛt| -----------------------------------------------|140|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------| himānaloṣṇadurvātavyālalālādidūṣitam||140||
jantujuṣṭaṃ jale magnamabhūmijamanārtavam| anyadhānyayutaṃ hīnavīryaṃ jīrṇatayā'ti ca||141||
dhānyaṃ tyajettathā śākaṃ rūkṣasiddhamakomalam| asañjātarasaṃ tadvacchūṣkaṃ cānyatra mūlakāt||142||
prāyeṇa phalamapyevaṃ tathā''maṃ bilvavarjitam| -------------------------------------------|143| iti phalavargaḥ||3||

div.ab: athauṣadhavargaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------| viṣyandi lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sṛṣṭamalaṃ mṛdu||143|| vātaghnaṃ pāki tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ rocanaṃ kaphapittakṛt| ---------------------------------------------------|144|

--------------------------------------------------------| saindhavaṃ tatra sasvādu vṛṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ tridoṣanut||144|| laghvanuṣṇaṃ dṛśaḥ pathyamavidāhyagnidīpanam| --------------------------------------------------------|145|

--------------------------------------------------------| laghu sauvarcalaṃ hṛdyaṃ sugandhyudgāraśodhanam||145|| kaṭupākaṃ vibandhaghnaṃ dīpanīyaṃ rucipradam| --------------------------------------------------------|146|
satiktakaṭukakṣāraṃ tīkṣṇamutkledi caudbhidam| --------------------------------------------------------|148|
romakaṃ laghu, pāṃsūtthaṃ sakṣāraṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru| --------------------------------------------------------|149|

ab.seg: gulmahṛdgrahaṇīpāṇḍuplīhānāhagalāmayān| śvāsārśaḥkaphakāsāṃśca śamayedyavaśūkajaḥ||150||

div.ab: kṣāraḥ sarvaśca paramaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaḥ kṛmijillaghuḥ| pittāsṛgdūṣaṇaḥ pākī chedyahṛdyo vidāraṇaḥ||151|| apathyaḥ kaṭulāvaṇyācchukraujaḥkeśacakṣuṣām| --------------------------------------------------------|152|

ab.seg: dīpanī pācanī medhyā vayasaḥ sthāpanī param| uṣṇavīryā sarā''yuṣyā buddhīndriyabalapradā||154||
kuṣṭhavaivarṇyavaisvaryapurāṇaviṣamajvarān| śiro'kṣipāṇḍuhṛdrogakāmalāgrahaṇīgadān||155||
saśoṣaśophātīsāramedamohavamikrimīn| śvāsakāsaprasekārśaḥplīhānāhagarodaram||156||
vibandhaṃ srotasāṃ gulmamūrustambhamarocakam| harītakī jayedvyādhīṃstāṃstāṃśca kaphavātajān||157||

div.ab: tadvadāmalakaṃ śītamamlaṃ pittakaphāpaham| ---------------------------------------------|158|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kaṭu pāke himaṃ keśyamakṣamīṣacca tadguṇam||158||
iyaṃ rasāyanavarā triphalā'kṣyāmayāpahā| ropaṇī tvaggdakledamedomehakaphāstrajit||159||
sakesaraṃ caturjātaṃ tvakpatrailaṃ trijātakam| pittaprakopi tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ rocanadīpanam||160||

div.ab: rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ kaphaghnaṃ maricaṃ laghu| ---------------------------------------------|161|

---------------------------------------------| śleṣmalā svāduśītā''rdrā gurvī snigdhā ca pippalī||161|| sā śuṣkā viparītā'taḥ snigdhā vṛṣyā rase kaṭuḥ| svādupākā'nilaśleṣmaśvāsakāsāpahā sarā||162|| na tāmatyupayuñjīta rasāyanavidhiṃ vinā| ---------------------------------------------|163|

---------------------------------------------| nāgaraṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ grāhi hṛdyaṃ vibandhanut||163|| rucyaṃ laghu swādupākaṃ snigdhoṣṇaṃ kaphavātajit| ---------------------------------------------|164|
---------------------------------------------| tadvadārdrakametacca trayaṃ trikaṭukaṃ jayet||164|| sthaulyāgnisadanaśvāsakāsaślīpadapīnasān| ---------------------------------------------|165|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| cavikāpippalīmulaṃ maricālpāntaraṃ guṇaiḥ||165||

div.ab: citrako'gnisamaḥ pāke śophārśaḥkṛmikuṣṭhahā| ---------------------------------------------|166|
---------------------------------------------| pañcakolakametacca maricena vinā smṛtam||166|| gulmaplīhodarānāhaśūlaghnaṃ dīpanaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|167|
---------------------------------------------| bilvakāśmaryatarkārīpāṭalāṭiṇṭukairmahat||167|| jayetkaṣāyatiktoṣṇaṃ pañcamūlaṃ kaphanilau| ---------------------------------------------|168|
---------------------------------------------| hrasvaṃ bṛhatyaṃśumatīdvayagokṣurakaiḥ smṛtam||168|| svādupākarasaṃ nātiśītoṣṇaṃ sarvadoṣajit| ---------------------------------------------|169|
---------------------------------------------| balāpunarnavairaṇḍaśūrpaparṇīdvayena tu||169|| madhyamaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ vātipittakaraṃ saram| ---------------------------------------------|170|
---------------------------------------------| abhīruvīrājīvantījīvakarṣabhakaiḥ smṛtam||170|| jīvanākhyaṃ tu cakṣuṣyaṃ vṛṣyaṃ pittānilāpaham| ---------------------------------------------|171|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tṛṇākhyaṃ pittajiddarbhakāsekṣuśaraśālibhiḥ||171||
ityauṣadhavargaḥ||7||

div.ab: śūkaśimbījapakvānnamāṃsaśākaphalauṣadhaiḥ| vargitairannaleśo'yamukto nityopayogikaḥ|172| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci tāyamaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'nnasvarūpavijñāniyo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

div.head: annarakṣādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'nnarakṣādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
rājā rājagṛhāsanne prāṇācāryaṃ niveśayet| sarvadā sa bhavatyevaṃ sarvatra pratijāgṛviḥ||1||
nanu, kimevaṃ kriyate? ityāha- ----------- annapānaṃ viṣādrakṣedviśeṣeṇa mahīpateḥ| yogakṣemau tadāyattau dharmādyā yannibandhanāḥ||2||
samprati viṣaduṣṭasya bhaktasya lakṣaṇamāha------------- odano viṣavān sāndro yātyavistrāvyatāmiva| cireṇa pacyate pakvo bhavetparyuṣitopamaḥ||3||
mayūrakaṇṭhatulyoṣmā mohamūrchhāprasekakṛt| hīyate varṇagandhādyaiḥ klidyate candrikācitaḥ||4||
vyañjanānāṃ parīkṣāmāha----------- vyañjanānyāśu śuṣyanti dhyāmakvāthāni tatra ca| hīnā'tiriktā vikṛtā chhāyā dṛśyeta naiva vā||5||
phenordhvarājīsīmantatantubudbudasambhavaḥ| vicchinnavirasā rāgāḥ khāṇḍavāḥ śākamāmiṣam||6||

div.ab: yatra drave yādṛśī rājī sambhavati, tāṃ viśeṣato darśayannāha--------- nīlā rājī rase, tāmrā kṣīre, dadhani dṛśyate| śyāvā''pītāsitā takre, ghṛte pānīyasannibhā||7|| mastuni syātkapotābhā, rājī kṛṣṇā tuṣodake| kālī madyāmbhasoḥ, kṣaudre harittaile'ruṇopamā||8|| pākaḥ phalānāmāmānāṃ pakvānāṃ parikothanam| dravyāṇāmārdraśuṣkāṇāṃ syātāṃ mlānivivarṇate||9|| mṛdūnāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ ca bhavetsparśaviparyayaḥ| mālyasya sphuṭitāgratvaṃ mlānirgandhāntarodbhavaḥ||10|| dhyāmamaṇḍalatā vastre, śadanaṃ tantupakṣmaṇām| dhātumauktikakāṣṭhāśmaratnādiṣu malāktatā||11|| snehasparśaprabhāhāniḥ saprabhatvaṃ tu mṛṇmaye| ---------------------------------------------------|12|

idānīṃ yo viṣaṃ dadāti, tasya lakṣaṇamāha--------- ----------------------------------------------------| viṣadaḥ śyāvaśuṣkāsyo vilakṣo vīkṣate diśaḥ||12|| svedavepathumāṃstrasto bhītaḥ skhalati jṛmbhate| -----------------------------------------------|13|

idānīṃ saviṣayasyāgniprakṣepaṇādikamupadiśannāha--------- ----------------------------------------------| prāpyānnaṃ saviṣaṃ tvagnirekāvartaḥ sphuṭatyati||13|| śikhikaṇṭhābhadhūmārciranarcirvogragandhavān| ---------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: snehalavaṇayogādapyagnirevaṃ syāt, ataḥ pakṣimṛgairapi parīkṣāprakārāntaraṃ darśayannāha-------------- --------------------------------------------| mrīyante makṣikāḥ prāśya kākaḥ kṣāmasvaro bhavet|14| utkrośanti ca dṛṣṭvaitacchukadātyūhasārikāḥ| haṃsaḥ praskhalati, glānirjīvañjīvasya jāyate||15||
cakorasyā'kṣivairāgyaṃ, krauñcasya syānmadodayaḥ| kapotaparabhṛddakṣacakravākā jahatyasūn||16||
udvegaṃ yāti mārjāraḥ śakṛnmuñcati vānaraḥ| hṛṣyenmayūrastadṛṣṭyā mandatejo bhavedviṣam||17||
ityannaṃ viṣavajjñātvā tyajedevaṃ prayatnataḥ| yathā tena vipadyerannapi na kṣudrajantavaḥ||18||
idānīṃ saviṣayasyāgniprakṣepaṇādikamupadiśannāha--------- ----------------------------------------------| prāpyānnaṃ saviṣaṃ tvagnirekāvartaḥ sphuṭatyati||13||
śikhikaṇṭhābhadhūmārciranarcirvogragandhavān| ---------------------------------------------||14||

div.ab: lālā jihvoṣṭhayorjāḍyamūṣā cimicimāyanam| dantaharṣo rasājñatvaṃ hanustambhaśca vaktrage||21|| sevyādyaistatra gaṇḍūṣāḥ sarvaṃ ca viṣajiddhitam| --------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| āmāśayagate svedamūrcchhādhmānamadabhramāḥ||22||
romaharṣo vamirdāhaścakṣurhṛdayarodhanam| bindubhiścācayo'ṅgānāṃ, pakvāśayagate punaḥ||23||
anekavarṇaṃ vamati mūtrayatyatisāryate| tandrā kṛśatvaṃ pāṇḍutvamudaraṃ balasaṅkṣayaḥ||24||
tayorvāntaviriktasya haridre kaṭabhīṃ guḍam| sinduvāritaniṣpāvabāṣpikāśataparvikāḥ||25||
taṇḍulīyakamūlāni kukkuṭāṇḍamavalgujam| nāvanāñjanapāneṣu yojayedviṣaśāntaye||26||

div.ab: viṣabhuktāya dadyācca śuddhāyordhvamadhastathā| sūkṣmaṃ tāmrarajaḥ kāle sakṣaudraṃ hṛdviśodhanam||27|| śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet| --------------------------------------------|28|

hemni datte sati, yo guṇaḥ syāttamāha------- --------------------------------------------| na sajjate hemapāṅge padmapatre'mbuvadviṣam||28|| jāyate vipulaṃ cāyurgare'pyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ| --------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| viruddhamapi cāhāraṃ vidyādviṣagaropamam||29||

div.ab: tadeva viruddhabhojanamāha------------------- ānūpamāmiṣaṃ māṣakṣaudrakṣīravirūḍhakaiḥ| virudhyate saha bisairmūlakena guḍena vā||30|| viśeṣātpayasā matsyā matsyeṣvapi cilīcimaḥ| --------------------------------------------|31|
viruddhamamlaṃ payasā saha sarvaṃ phalaṃ tathā||31|| tadvatkulatthavarakakaṅguvallamakuṣṭakāḥ|32|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| bhakṣayitvā haritakaṃ mūlakādi payastyajet||32||
vārāhaṃ śvāvidhā nādyāddadhnā pṛṣatakukkuṭau| āmamāṃsāni pittena, māṣasūpena mūlakam||33||
aviṃ kusumbhaśākena, bisaiḥ, saha virūḍhakam| māṣasūpaguḍakṣīradadhyājyairlākucaṃ phalam||34||
phalaṃ kadalyāstakreṇa dadhnā tālaphalena vā| kaṇoṣaṇābhyāṃ madhunā kākamācīṃ guḍena vā||35||
siddhāṃ vā matsyapacane pacane nāgarasya vā| siddhāmanyatra vā pātre kāmāttāmuṣitāṃ niśām||36||
matsyanistalasnehe sādhitāḥ pippalīstyajet| ` kāṃsye daśāhamuṣitaṃ sarpiruṣṇaṃ tvaruṣkare||37||

div.ab: bhāso virudhyate śūlyaḥ kampillastakrasādhitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|38|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| ekadhyaṃ pāyasasurākṛśarāḥ privarjayet||38||
madhusarpirvasātailapānīyāni dviśastriśaḥ| ekatra vā samāṃśāni virudhyante parasparam||39||

div.ab: bhinnāṃśe api madhvājye divyavāryanupānataḥ| madhupuṣkarabījaṃ ca, madhumaireyaśārkaram||40|| manthānupānaḥ kṣaireyo, hāridraḥ kaṭutailavān| --------------------------------------------|41|

ab.seg: balākā vāruṇiyuktā kulmāṣaiśca virudhyate| bhṛṣṭā varāhavasayā saiva sadyo nihantyasūn||42||
tadvattittiripatrāḍhyagodhālāvakapiñjalāḥ| eraṇḍenāgninā siddhāstattailena vimūrcchitāḥ||43||
hārītamāṃsaṃ hāridraśūlakaprotapācitam| haridrāvahninā sadyo vyāpādayati jīvitam||44||

div.ab: bhasmapāṃśuparidhvastaṃ tadeva ca samākṣikam| --------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: na ca śodhanaśamanarūpa evopakramo'tretyāha- --------------------------------------------| dravyaistaireva vā pūrvaṃ śarīrasyābhisaṃskṛtiḥ||46||
vyāyāmasnigdhadīptāgnivayaḥsthabalaśālinām| virodhdyapi na pīḍāyai sātmyamalpaṃ ca bhojanam||47||
pādenāpathyamabhyastaṃ pādapādena vā tyajet| niṣeveta hitaṃ tadvadekadvitryantarīkṛtam||48||

evamanena krameṇāpathyadoṣāstyaktāḥ pīḍāyai na bhavanti, pathyaguṇāśca saṃvardhitāḥ sthiratāṃ prāpnuvanti| ityata āha--------------------- apathyamapi hi tyaktaṃ śīlitaṃ pathyameva vā| sātmyāsātmyavikārāya jāyate sahasā'nyathā||41||
krameṇa tvapathyatyāgapathyaśīlane vidhīyamāne guṇāya syātāmiti darśayati------- krameṇāpacitā doṣāḥ krameṇopacitā guṇāḥ| santo yāntyapunarbhāvamaprakampyā bhavanti ca||50||
sāmpratamahitāhārasevanaṃ sadā tyājyamiti sadyuktiṃ darśayati---------- atyantasannidhānānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ dūṣaṇātmanām| ahitairdūṣaṇaṃ bhūyo na vidvān kartumarhati||51||
etatprasaṅgena cedamāha----------------- āhāraśayanābrahmacaryeryuktyā prayojitaiḥ| śarīraṃ dhāryate nityamāgāramiva dhāraṇaiḥ||52||
āhāro varṇitastatra tatra tatra ca vakṣyate| --------------------------------------------||2||

div.ab: śayanābrahmacaryayostvihaiva vidhiṃ vaktukāma āha- -----| nidrāyattaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ puṣṭiḥ kārśyaṃ balābalam||53|| vṛṣatā klībatā jñānamajñānaṃ jīvitaṃ na ca| --------------------------------------------|54|

sāmprataṃ duṣṭanidrāṃ nirdiśati- --------------------------------------------| akāle'tiprasaṅgācca na ca nidrā niṣevitā||54|| sukhāyuṣī parākuryāt kālarātririvāparā| --------------------------------------------|55|

atha nidrāguṇaprasaṅgena tatpratipakṣabhūtasya jāgaraṇasyāpi guṇamāha----- --------------------------------------------| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ, snigdhaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā||55|| arūkṣamanabhiṣyandi tvāsīnapracalāyitam| --------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: yadi snigdhatvādabhiṣyandī divāsvapnaḥ, tatkiṃ kadācidapi na kāryaḥ? ityāha- ----- grīṣme vāyucayādānaraukṣyarātryalpabhāvataḥ||56||
divāsvapno hito'nyasmin kaphapittakaro hi saḥ| muktvā tu bhāṣyayānādhvamadyastrībhārakarmabhiḥ||57||
krodhaśokabhayaiḥ klāntān śvāsahidhmātisāriṇaḥ| vṛddhabālābalakṣīṇakṣatatṛṭśūlapīḍitān||58||
ajīrṇyabhihatonmattān divāsvapnocitānapi| dhātusāmyaṃ tathā hyeṣāṃ śleṣmā cāṅgāni puṣyati||59||
bahumedaḥkaphāḥ svapyuḥ snehanityāśca nāhani| viṣārtaḥ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu niśāsvapi||60||
akālaśayanānmohajvarastaimityapīnasāḥ| śirorukśophahṛllāsasrotorodhāgnimandatāḥ||61||
atra ca kā cikitsā? ityāha----------------- tatropavāsavamanasvedanāvanamauṣadham| yojayedatinidrāyāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pracchhardanāñjanam||62||
nāvanaṃ laṅghanaṃ cintāṃ vyavāyaṃ śokabhīkrudhaḥ| ebhireva ca nidrāyā nāśaḥ śleṣmātisaṅkṣayāt||63||
samprati nidrānāśajān vikārānācaṣṭe----------- nidrānāśādaṅgamardaśirogauravajṛmbhikāḥ| jāḍyaglānibhramāpaktitandrā rogāśca vātajāḥ||64||
yathākālamato nidrāṃ rātrau seveta sātmyataḥ| asātmyājjāgarādardhaṃ prātaḥ svapyādabhuktavān||65||
śīlayenmandanidrastu kṣīramadyarasān dadhi| abhyaṅgodvartanasnānamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇam||66||
kāntābāhulatāśleṣo nirvṛtiḥ kṛtakṛtyatā| mano'nukūlā viṣayāḥ kāmaṃ nidrāsukhapradāḥ||67||
brahmacaryaratergrāmyasukhaniḥspṛhacetasaḥ| nidrā santoṣatṛptasya svaṃ kāle nātivartate||68||
yadā tu grāmyadharmeṇa vinā na ratiḥ, apatyārthitā vā, tadā tadadhikārārthamucyate-------------------- grāmyadharme tyajennārīmanuttānāṃ rajasvalām| apriyāmapriyācārāṃ duṣṭasaṅkīrṇamehanām||69||
atisthūlakṛśāṃ sūtāṃ garbhiṇīmanyayoṣitam| varṇinīmanyayoniṃ ca gurudevanṛpālayam||70||
caityaśmaśānā''yatanacatvarāmbucatuṣpatham| parvāṇyanaṅhgaṃ divasaṃ śirohṛdayatāḍanam||71||
atyāśito'dhṛtiḥ kṣudvān duḥsthitāṅgaḥ pipāsitaḥ| bālo vṛddho'nyavegārtastyajedrogī ca maithunam||72||
samprati ṛtuviśeṣeṣu nidhuvanaṃ niyamayati--------------- seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ tṛpto vājīkṛtāṃ hime| tryahādvasantaśaradoḥ pakṣādvarṣānidāghayoḥ||73||
bhramaklamorudaurbalyabaladhātvindriyakṣayāḥ| aparvamaraṇaṃ ca syādanyathā gacchataḥ striyam||74||
smṛtimedhāyurārogyapuṣṭīndriyayaśobalaiḥ| adhikā mandajaraso bhavanti strīṣu saṃyatāḥ||75||
snānānulepanahimānilakhaṇḍakhādya śītāmbudugdharasayūṣasurāprasannāḥ| seveta cānu śayanaṃ viratau ratasya tasyaivamāśu vapuṣaḥ punareti dhāma||76||

div.ab: etañca sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ hitāhitaṃ vaidya eva vetti| tasmādvaidyasya sarvathā śarīraṃ rājñā nivedyamiti darśayannāha-------------------- śrutacaritasamṛddhe karmadakṣe dayālau bhiṣaji niranubandhaṃ deharakṣāṃ niveśya| bhavati vipulatejaḥsvāsthyakīrtiprabhāvaḥ svakuśalaphalabhogī bhūmipālaścirāyuḥ|77| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'nnarakṣā nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|7|

div.head: mātrāśitīyādhyāyo'ṣṭamaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mātrāśitīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
mātrāśī sarvakālaṃ syānmātrā hyagneḥ pravartikā| mātrāṃ dravyāṇyapekṣante gurūṇyapi laghūnyapi||1||
tatra gurūṇāṃ kā mātrā ? kā(ca) laghūnām ? ityāha---------- gurūṇāmardhasauhityaṃ laghūnāṃ nātitṛptatā| mātrāpramāṇaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ yāvadvijīryati||2||
bhojanaṃ hīnamātraṃ tu na balopacayaujase| sarveṣāṃ vātarogāṇāṃ hetutāṃ ca prapadyate||3||

div.ab: atimātraṃ tvaśanaṃ trīnapi doṣān prakopayet| ----------------------------------------------------|4|
