vātolbaṇeṣu doṣeṣu vāte vā bastiriṣyate| upakramāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ so'graṇīstrividhastu saḥ||1|| nirūho'nvāsanaṃ bastiruttaraḥ-----------------| --------------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------tena sādhayet| gulmānāhakhuḍaplīhaśuddhātīsāraśūlinaḥ||2||
jīrṇajvarapratiśyāyaśukrānilamalagrahān| vardhmāśmarīrajonāśān dāruṇāṃścānilāmayān||3||

div.ab: anāsthāpyāstvatisnigdhaḥ kṣatorasko bhṛśaṃ kṛśaḥ| āmātisārī vamimān saṃśuddho dattanāvanaḥ||4|| śvāsakāsaprasekārśohidhmādhmānālpavahnayaḥ| śūnapāyuḥ kṛtahāro baddhacchidrodakodarī||5|| kuṣṭhī ca madhumehī ca māsān sapta ca garbhiṇī| -----------------------------------------------|6|

-------------------------nānuvāsyāsta eva ca| ye'nāsthāpyāstathā pāṇḍukāmalāmehapīnasāḥ||7|| nirannaplīhaviḍbhedigurukoṣṭhakaphodarāḥ| abhiṣyandibhṛśasthūlakṛmikoṣṭhāḍhyamārutāḥ||8|| pīte viṣe gare'pacyāṃ ślīpadī galagaṇḍavān| ------------------------------------------------|9|

| nirūhānvāsanayoryantrasya lakṣaṇamāha - ] - - - ------------------------------------------------| tayostu netraṃ hemādidhātudārvasthiveṇujam||9|| gopucchākāramacchidraṃ ślakṣṇarju gulikāmukham| ------------------------------------------------|10|

athāsya pramāṇamāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| ūne'bde pañca, pūrṇe'sminnāsaptabhyo'ṅgulāni ṣaṭ||10|| saptame sapta, tānyaṣṭau dvādaśe, ṣoḍaśe nava| dvādaśaiva paraṃ viṃśādvīkṣya varṣāntareṣu ca||11|| vayobalaśarīrāṇi pramāṇamabhivarddhayet| ------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------------| svāṅguṣṭhena samaṃ mūle sthaulyenāgre kaniṣṭhayā||12||

div.ab: adhunā chidradvāreṇa netrasthaulyapramāṇamadhikamapi darśayannāha - - - - pūrṇe'bde'ṅgulamādāya tadarddhārddhapravarddhitam| tryaṅgulaṃ paramaṃ chidraṃ mūle'gre vahate tu yat||13|| mudgaṃ māṣaṃ kalāyaṃ ca klinnaṃ karkandhukaṃ kramāt| ------------------------------------------------|14|

------------------------------------------------| mūlācchidrapramāṇena prānte ghaṭitakarṇikam||14|| vartyā'gre pihitaṃ, mūle yathāsvaṃ hyaṅgulāntaram| karṇikādvitayaṃ netre kuryāt--------------------|15|

ata evāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| ----------------------------tatra ca yojayet||15|| ajāvimahiṣādīnāṃ bastiṃ sumṛditaṃ dṛḍham| kaṣāyaraktaṃ niśchidragranthigandhaśiraṃ tanum||16|| grathitaṃ sādhu sūtreṇa sukhasaṃsthāpyabheṣajam| ------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: nirūhamātrā prathame prakuñco vatsare param| prakuñcavṛddhiḥ pratyabdaṃ yāvatṣaṭprasṛtāstataḥ||18||
prasṛtaṃ varddhayedūrdhvaṃ dvādaśāṣṭādaśasya tu| āsaptateridaṃ mānaṃ, daśaiva prasṛtāḥ param||19||

div.ab: evaṃ sāṃvatsarīkādārabhya yāvadvarṣaśatikastāvannirūhamātrāmabhidhāya, anuvāsanamātrāmadhikṛtyāha - - - - yathāyathaṃ nirūhasya pādo mātrā'nuvāsane| -----------------------------------------------|20|

-----------------------------------------------| āsthāpyaṃ snehitaṃ svinnaṃ śuddhaṃ labdhabalaṃ punaḥ||20|| anvāsanārhaṃ vijñāya pūrvamevānuvāsayet| śīte vasante ca divā rātrau kecittato'nyadā||21|| abhyaktasnātamucitātpādahīnaṃ hitaṃ laghu| asnigdharūkṣamaśitaṃ sānupānaṃ dravādi ca||22|| kṛtacaṅkramaṇaṃ muktaviṇmūtraṃ śayane sukhe| nātyucchrite na cocchīrṣe saṃviṣṭaṃ vāmapārśvataḥ||23|| saṅkocya dakṣiṇaṃ sakthi prasārya ca tato'param| -----------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| athāsya netraṃ praṇayetsnigdhe snigdhamukhaṃ gude||24||
ucchvāsya bastervadane baddhe hastamakampayan| pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ prati tato nātidrutavilambitam||25||
nātivegaṃ na vā mandaṃ sakṛdeva prapīḍayet| sāvaśeṣaṃ ca kurvīta vāyuḥ śeṣe hi tiṣṭhati||26||
datte tūttānadehasya pāṇinā tāḍayetsphijau| tatpārṣṇibhyāṃ tathā śayyāṃ pādataśca trirutkṣipet||27||
tataḥ prasāritāṅhgasya sopadhānasya pārṣṇike| āhanyānmuṣṭinā'ṅhgaṃ ca snehenābhyajya mardayet||28||
vedanārtamiti sneho na hi śīghraṃ nivartate| yojyaḥ śīghraṃ nivṛtte'nyaḥ sneho'tiṣṭhannakāryakṛt||29||

div.ab: dīptāgniṃ tvāgatasnehaṃ sāyāsne bhojayellaghu| -----------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| nivṛttikālaḥ paramastrayo yāmāstataḥ param||30||
ahorātramupekṣeta, parataḥ phalavartibhiḥ| tīkṣṇairvā bastibhiḥ kuryādyatnaṃ snehanivṛttaye||31||

div.ab: atiraukṣyādanāgacchanna cejjāḍyādidoṣakṛt| upekṣetaiva hi tato'dhyuṣitaśca niśāṃ pibet||32|| prātarnāgaradhānyāmbhaḥ koṣṇaṃ, kevalameva vā| -----------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| anvāsayettṛtīye'hni pañcame vā punaśca tam||33||
yathā vā snehapaktiḥ syādato'tyulbaṇamārutān| vyāyāmanityān dīptāgnīn rūkṣāṃśca prativāsaram||34||
iti snehaistricaturaiḥ snigdhe srotoviśuddhaye| nirūhaṃ śodhanaṃ yuñjyādasnigdhe snehanaṃ tanoḥ||35||

div.ab: pañcame'tha tṛtīye vā divase sādhake śubhe| madhyāhne kiñcidāvṛtte prayukte balimaṅgale||36|| abhyaktasveditotsṛṣṭamalaṃ nātibubhukṣitam| avekṣya puruṣaṃ doṣabheṣajādīni cādarāt||37|| bastiṃ prakalpayedvaidyastadvidyairbahubhiḥ saha| -----------------------------------------------|38|

atha nirūhakalpanāmāha - - - - -----------------------------------------------| kvāthayedviṃśatipalaṃ dravyasyāṣṭau phalāni ca||38|| tataḥ kvāthāccaturthāṃśaṃ snehaṃ vāte prakalpayet| pitte svasthe ca ṣaṣṭhāṃśamaṣṭamāṃśaṃ kaphe'dhike||39|| sarvatra cāṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ kalkādbhavati vā yathā| nāsyacchasāndratā basteḥ palamātraṃ guḍasya ca||40|| madhupaṭvādiśeṣaṃ ca yuktyā----------------------| -----------------------------------------------|41|

-----------------------------sarvaṃ tadekataḥ| uṣṇāmbukumbhībāṣpeṇa taptaṃ khajasamāhatam||41|| prakṣipya bastau praṇayetpāyau nātyuṣṇaśītalam| nātisnigdhaṃ na vā rūkṣaṃ nātitīkṣṇaṃ na vā mṛdu||42|| nātyacchasāndraṃ nonātimātraṃ nāpaṭu nāti ca| lavaṇaṃ tadvadamlaṃ ca----------------------------|43|

sāmpratamanyamatamabhidhatte - - - - --------------------paṭhantyanye tu tadvidaḥ||43|| mātrāṃ tripalikāṃ kṛryātsnehamākṣikayoḥ pṛthak| karṣārddhaṃ māṇimanthasya svasthe kalkapaladvayam||44|| sarvadravāṇāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ palāni daśa kalpayet| -----------------------------------------------|45|

samprati nirūhāvayavānāṃ mākṣikādīnāṃ saṃyojanavidhimāha - - - - -----------------------------------------------------| mākṣikaṃ lavaṇaṃ snehaṃ kalkaṃ kvāthamiti kramāt||45|| āvapeta nirūhāṇāmeṣa saṃyojane vidhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|46|

-----------------------------------------------------| āgatau paramaḥ kālo muhūrto mṛtyave param||47|| tatrānulomikaṃ snehakṣāramūtrāmlakalpitam| tvaritaṃ snigdhatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ bastimanyaṃ prapīḍayet||48|| vidadyātphalavartiṃ vā svedanotrāsanādi ca| -----------------------------------------------------|49|
kāni punaḥ samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅgāni ? ityāha - - - - ----------------------------------------------------| viriktavacca yogādīnvidyāt--------------------------|50|
--------------------------------------------| vikārā ye nirūḍhasya bhavanti pracalairmalaiḥ||51|| te sukhoṣṇāmbusiktasya yānti bhuktavataḥ śamam| --------------------------------------------|52|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| atha vātārditaṃ bhūyaḥ sadya evānuvāsayet||52||

div.ab: samyagghīnātiyogāśca tasya syuḥ snehapītavat| --------------------------------------------|53|

anyadapyanuvāsanasya samyagyogalakṣaṇamāha - - - - --------------------------------------------| kiñcitkālaṃ sthito yaśca sapurīṣo nivartate||53|| sānulomānilaḥ snehastatsiddhamanuvāsanam| --------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| ekaṃ trīn vā balāse tu snehabastīn prakalpayet||54||
pañca vā sapta vā pitte, navaikādaśa vā'nile| punastato'pyayugmāṃstu punarāsthāpanaṃ tataḥ||55||

div.ab: kaphapittānileṣvannaṃ yūṣakṣīrarasaiḥ kramāt| --------------------------------------------|56|
--------------------------------------------| vātaghnauṣadhaniṣkvāthatrivṛtāsaindhavairyutaḥ||56|| bastireko'nile snigdhaḥ svādvamloṣṇo rasānvitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|57|
--------------------------------------------| nyagrodhādigaṇakvāthapadmakādisitāyutau||57|| pitte svāduhimau sājyakṣīrekṣurasamākṣikau| --------------------------------------------|58|
--------------------------------------------| āragvadhādiniṣkvāthavatsakādiyutāstrayaḥ||58|| rūkṣāḥ sakṣaudragomūtrāstīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭukāḥ kaphe| --------------------------------------------|59|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| trayaste sannipāte'pi doṣān ghnanti yataḥ kramāt||59||
tribhyaḥ paraṃ bastimato necchantyanye cikitsakāḥ| na hi doṣaścaturtho'sti punardīyeta yaṃ prati||60||
utkleśanaṃ śuddhikaraṃ doṣāṇāṃ śamanaṃ kramāt| tridhaiva kalpayedvastimityanye'pi pracakṣate||61||

div.ab: | tatra kiṃ kriyatām ? ityāha - - - -] doṣauṣadhādibalataḥ sarvametatpramāṇayet| --------------------------------------------|62|

ab.seg: atha sarvamatānugrāhi svamatamāha - - - - --------------------------------------------| samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅgaṃ tu nāsambhāvya nivartayet||62||
idānīṃ karmakālayogākhyān bastiviśeṣānāha - - - - prāksneha ekaḥ pañcānte dvādaśāsthāpanāni ca| sānvāsanāni karmaivaṃ bastayastriṃśadīritāḥ||63||

div.ab: kālaḥ pañcadaśaiko'tra prāk sneho'nte trayastathā| ṣaṭ pañcabastyantaritāḥ-------------------------|64|
--------------------------------------------| snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ vā naikamevāti śīlayet||65|| utkleśāgnivadhau snehānnirūhānmaruto bhayam| --------------------------------------------|66|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| tasmānnirūḍhaḥ snehyaḥ syānnirūhyaścānuvāsitaḥ||66||

div.ab: snehaśodhanayuktyaivaṃ bastikarma tridoṣajit| --------------------------------------------|67|

adhunā mātrābastiṃ lakṣayati - - - - --------------------------------------------| hrasvayā snehapānasya mātrayā yojitaḥ samaḥ||67|| mātrābastiḥ smṛtaḥ snehaḥ-------------------| --------------------------------------------|68|

ab.seg: ------------------------śīlanīyaḥ sadā ca saḥ| bālavṛddhādhvabhārastrīvyāyāmāsaktacintakaiḥ||68||
vātabhagnābalālpāgninṛpeśvarasukhātmabhiḥ| doṣaghno niṣparīhāro balyaḥ sṛṣṭamalaḥ sukhaḥ||69||
bastau rogeṣu nārīṇāṃ yonigarbhāśayeṣu ca| dvitrāsthāpanaśuddhebhyo vidadhyādbastimuttaram||70||
atha netrasya parimāṇamāha - - - - āturāṅgulamānena tannetraṃ dvādaśāṅgulam| vṛttaṃ gopucchavanmūlamadhyayoḥ kṛtakarṇikam||71||
siddhārthakapraveśāgraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ hemādisambhavam| kundāśvamārasumanaḥpuṣpavṛntopamaṃ dṛḍham||72||

div.ab: tasya bastirmṛdulaghurmātrā śuktirvikalpya vā| --------------------------------------------|73|

--------------------------------------------| atha snātāśitasyāsya snehabastividhānataḥ||73|| ṛjoḥ sukhopaviṣṭasya pīṭhe jānusame mṛdau| hṛṣṭe meḍhre sthite carjau śanaiḥ srotoviśuddhaye||74|| sūkṣmāṃ śalākāṃ praṇayettayā śuddhe'nusevani| āmehanāntaṃ netraṃ ca niṣkampaṃ gudavattataḥ||75|| pīḍite'ntargate snehe snehabastikramo hitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|76|

ab.seg: evam puruṣāṇāmuttarabastividhānamuktvā strīṇāṃ vakti - - - - ------------------------------------------------------| strīṇāmārtavakāle tu yonirgṛhṇātyapāvṛteḥ||77||
vidadhīta tadā tasmādanṛtāvapi cātyate| yonivibhraṃśaśūleṣu yonivyāpadyasṛgdare||78||

div.ab: athātra tu netrasya pramāṇamāha - - - - netraṃ daśāṅgulaṃ mudgapraveśaṃ caturaṅulam| apatyamārge yojyaṃ syād hyaṅgulaṃ mūtravartmani||79|| mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu, bālānāṃ tvekamaṅgulam| ------------------------------------------------------|80|

ab.seg: adhunottarabastyavasthānaṃ trividhāyā api striyā vadati - - - - uttānāyāḥ śayānāyāḥ samyak saṅkocya sakthinī| ūrdhvajānvāstricaturānahorātreṇa yojayet||81||
bastīṃstrirātramevaṃ ca snehamātrāṃ vivarddhayan| tryahameva ca viśrabhya praṇidadhyātpunastryaham||82||
yuktyoktamevāmumarthaṃ saṅkṣepasaṅgrahārthaṃ punarāha - - - - pakṣādvireko vamite tataḥ pakṣānnirūhaṇam| sadyo nirūḍhaścānvāsyaḥ saptarātrādvirecitaḥ||83||

nanu, doṣāṇāṃ dhātūnāṃ ca snehasvedābhyāmekalolībhāvāt kathaṃ bastirdoṣāneva nirharet na dhātūn ? ityetaccodyaṃ dṛṣṭāntadvāreṇa parijihīrṣuridamāha - - - - yathā kusumbhādiyutāttoyādrāgaṃ haretpaṭaḥ| tathā dravīkṛtāddehādbastirnirharate malān||84||

div.ab: adhunā vāyoḥ svarūpaṃ prathayan bastiṃ ślāghayannāha - - - - śākhāgatāḥ koṣṭhagatāśca rogā marmordhvasarvāvayavāṅgajāśca| ye santi teṣāṃ na tu kaścidanyo vāyoḥ paraṃ janmani heturasti||85|| viṭśleṣmapittādimaloccayānāṃ vikṣepasaṃhārakaraḥ sa yasmāt| tasyātivṛddhaṃsya śamāya nyāya- dbastervinā bheṣajamasti kiñcit||86|| tasmāccikitsārddha iti pradiṣṭaḥ kṛtsnā cikitsā'pi ca bastirekaiḥ| ----------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------|87|

--------------------------------------- ---------------------------------| tathā nijāgantuvikārakāri- raktauṣadhatvena śirāvyadho'pi|87| iti śrī vaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne bastividhirnāmaikonaviṃtitamo'dhyāyaḥ|19|

div.head: nasyavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: pañhcakarmoktiprastāve vamanavirekānvāsananirūhānuktvā nasyavidhimāha - - - - athāto nasyavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu viśeṣānnasyamiṣyate| nāsā hi śiraso dvāraṃ tena tadvyāpya hanti tān||1||

div.ab: virecanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca śamanaṃ ca tridhā'pi tat| -----------------------------------------------------|2|

tatra pūrvaṃ virecanākhyasyopayogamāha - - - - -----------------------------------------------------| virecanaṃ śiraḥśūlajāḍyasyandagalāmaye||2|| śophagaṇḍakṛmigranthikuṣṭhāpasmārapīnase| -----------------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: yathāsvaṃ yaugikaiḥ snehairyathāsvaṃ ca prasādhitaiḥ| kalkakvāthādibhiścādyaṃ madhupaṭvāsavairapi||5||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhanvamāṃsottharasāsṛk''kapurairapi| śamanaṃ yojayetpūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena vā||6||

div.ab: adhunā'nyānapi nasyaviśeṣānāha - - - - marśaśca pratimarśaśca dvidhā sneho'tra mātrayā| kalkādyairavapīḍastu sa tīkṣṇairmūrddharecanaḥ||7|| dhmānaṃ virecanaścūrṇo-----------------------------| -----------------------------------------------------|8|

kathaṃ punarasau nāsāyāṃ dhmāpayitavyaḥ ? ityāha - - - - -----------------------yuñjyāttaṃ mukhavāyunā| ṣaḍaṅguladvimukhayā nāḍyā bheṣajagarbhayā||8|| sa hi bhūritaraṃ doṣaṃ cūrṇatvādapakarṣati| ------------------------------------------------|9|

adhunā marśasnehasya parimāṇamadhikṛtyāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt||9|| yāvatpatyasau bindurdaśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te| marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrāstā eva ca kramāt||10|| bindudvayonāḥ kalkādeḥ-------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|11|

adhunā yeṣāṃ nasyamayuktaṃ tānāha - - - - --------------------------yojayenna tu nāvanam| toyamadyagarasnehapītānāṃ pātumicchatām||11|| bhuktabhaktaśiraḥsnātasnātukāmasrutāsṛjām| navapīnasavegārtasūtikāśvāsakāsinām||12|| śuddhānāṃ dattabastīnāṃ tathā'nārtavadurdine| anyatrātyayikādvyādheḥ-------------------|13|

sāmprataṃ yatra kāle yatra ca doṣe nasyaṃ prayojyaṃ taddarśanārthamāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| -------------------------atha nasyaṃ prayojayet||13|| prātaḥ śleṣmaṇi, madhyāhne pitte, sāyaṃniśoścale| svasthavṛtte tu pūrvāhṇe śaratkālavasantayoḥ||14|| śīte madhyaṃdine, grīṣme sāyaṃ varṣāsu sātape| vātābhibhūte śirasi hidhmāyāmapatānake||15|| manyāstambhe svarabhraṃśe sāyaṃprātardinedine| ekāhāntaramanyatra----------------------------|16|

idānīṃ yādṛśasya puruṣasya yathāsthitasya nasyaṃ deyaṃ tathā''ha - - - - snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya prākkṛtāvaśyakasya ca| nivātaśayanasthasya jatrūrdhvaṃ svedayet punaḥ||17|| athottānurjudehasya pāṇipāde prasārite| kiñcidunnatapādasya kiñcinmūrddhani nāmite||18|| nāsāpuṭaṃ pidhāyaikaṃ paryāyeṇa niṣecayet| uṣṇāmbutaptaṃ bhaiṣjyaṃ praṇāḍyā picunā'thavā||19|| datte pādatalaskandhahastakarṇādi mardayet| śanairucchidya niṣṭhīvetpārśvayorubhayostataḥ||20|| ābheṣajakṣayādevaṃ dvistrirvā nasyamācaret| ------------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: yadi ca nasye dīyamāne bheṣajavegādasātmyena vā mūrcchā syāt tadā kiṃ kāryam ? ityāha - - - - ---------------------------------------------------| mūrcchāyāṃ śītatoyena siñcetpariharan śiraḥ||21||

div.ab: snehaṃ virecanasyānte dadyāddoṣādyapekṣayā| -------------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| samyaksnigdhe sukhocchvāsasvapnabodhākṣapāṭavam||23||
rūkṣe'kṣistabdhatā śoṣo nāsāsye mūrddhaśūnyatā| snigdhe'ti kaṇḍūgurutāprasekārucipīnasāḥ||24||
suvirikte'kṣilaghutāvakkrasvaraviśuddhayaḥ| durvirikte gadodrekaḥ, kṣāmatā'tivirecite||25||

div.ab: adhunā pratimarśasya viṣayaṃ sūcayitumāha - - - - pratimarśaḥ kṣatakṣāmabālavṛddhasukhātmasu| prayojyo'kālavarṣe'pi-----------------------|26|

ab.seg: madyapīte'balaśrotre kṛmidūṣitamūrddhani| utkṛṣṭotkliṣṭadoṣe ca, hīnamātratayā hi saḥ||27||

div.ab: niśāharbhuktavāntāhaḥ svapnādhvaśramaretasām| śirobhyañjanagaṇḍūṣaprasrāvāñjanavarcasām||28|| dantakāṣṭhasya hāsasya yojyo'nte'sau dvibindukaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|29|

--------------------------------------------------| pañcasu srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ, klamanāśastriṣu kramāt||29|| dṛgbalaṃ pañcasu, tato dantadārḍhyaṃ marucchamaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: adhunā nasyasya dhūmādīnāṃ ca puruṣaviśeṣe niyamaṃ kurvannāha - - - - --------------------------------------------------| na nasyamūnasaptābde nātītāśītivatsare||30||
na conāṣṭādaśe dhūmaḥ, kavalo nonapañcame| na śuddhirūnadaśame na cātikrāntasaptatau||31||

div.ab: ājanmamaraṇaṃ śastaḥ pratimarśastu bastivat| marśavacca guṇān kuryātsa hi nityopasevanāt||32|| na cātra yantraṇā nāpi vyāpadbhyo marśavadbhayam| --------------------------------------------------|33|

--------------------------------------------------| tailameva ca nasyārthe nityābhyāsena śasyate||33|| śirasaḥ śleṣmadhāmatvātsnehāḥ svasthasya netare| --------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: marśe ca pratimarśe ca viśeṣo na bhavedyadi| ko marśaṃ saparīhāraṃ sāpadaṃ ca bhajettataḥ||35||
acchapānavicārākhyau kuṭīvātātapasthitī| anvāsamātrābastī ca tadvadeva vinirdiśet||36||

idānīṃ nasyamaṇutailaṃ nirdidikṣurāha - - - - jīvantījaladevadārujaladatvak''sevyagopīhimaṃ dārvītvaṅmadhukaplavāguruvarīpuṇḍrāhvibilvotpalam| dhāvanyau surabhiṃ sthire kṛmiharaṃ patraṃ truṭiṃ reṇukāṃ kiñjalkaṃ kamalādbalāṃ śataguṇe divye'mbhasikvāthayet||37||
tailādrasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pariśeṣya tena tailaṃ paceta salilena daśaiva vārān| pāke kṣipecca daśame samamājadugdhaṃ nasyaṃ mahāguṇamuśantyaṇutailametat||38||
ghanonnataprasannatvak''skandhagrīvāsyavakṣasaḥ| dṛḍhendriyāstapalitā bhaveyurnasyaśīlinaḥ||39||
iti śrī vaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nasyavidhārnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||20||

div.head: dhumapanavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dhūmapānavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| jatrūrdhvakaphavātotthavikārāṇāmajanmane| ucchedāya ca jātānāṃ pibeddhūmaṃ sadā''tmavān||1||

div.ab: snigdho madhyaḥ sa tīkṣṇaśca, vāte vātakaphe kaphe| yojyaḥ---------------------------------------------|2|

snigdhādīnāṃ viṣayamāha-vāta iti| krameṇeti śeṣaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------------| -------------------na raktapittārtiviriktodaramehiṣu||2|| timirordhvānilādhmānarohiṇīdattabastiṣu| matsyamadyadadhikṣīrakṣaudrasnehaviṣāśiṣu||3|| śirasyabhihate pāṇḍuroge jāgarite niśi| ----------------------------------------------------------|4|

idānīṃ trayāṇāṃ dhūmānāṃ kālaṃ pṛthak darśayannāha ---- --------------------------------------------------| kṣutajṛmbhitaviṇmūtrastrīsevāśastrakarmaṇām||5|| hāsasya dantakāṣṭhasya dhūmamante pibenmṛdum| kāleṣveṣu niśāhāranāvanānte ca madhyamam||6|| nidrānasyāñjanasnānaccharditānte virecanam| --------------------------------------------------|7|

sāmpratamatra netrasvarūpamaaha---- --------------------------------------------------| bastinetrasamadravyaṃ trikośaṃ kārayedṛju||7|| mūlāgre'ṅguṣṭhakolāsthipraveśaṃ dhūmanetrakam| --------------------------------------------------|8|

idānīṃ tīkṣṇādikasya trividhasya dhūmasya dairghyeṇa netra pramāṇamāha---- --------------------------------------------------| tīkṣṇasnehanamadhyeṣu trīṇi catvāti pañca ca||8|| aṅgulānāṃ kramātpātuḥ pramāṇenāṣṭakāni tat| --------------------------------------------------|9|

kīdṛśaḥ san dhūmaṃ pīvet? ityāha ---- --------------------------------------------------| ṛjūpaviṣṭastaccetā vivṛtāsyastriparyayam||9|| pidhāya cchidramekaikaṃ dhūmaṃ nāsikayā pibet| --------------------------------------------------|10|

---------------------------------------------------| prāk pibennāsayotkliṣṭe doṣe ghrāṇaśirogate||10|| utkleśanārthaṃ vaktreṇa, viparītaṃ tu kaṇṭhage| ---------------------------------------------------|11|
ākṣepamokṣaiḥ pātavyo dhūmastu tristribhistribhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: ---------------mṛdau tatra dravyāṇyaguruguggulu| mustasthauṇeyaśaileyanaladośīravālakam||13||
varāṅgakauntīmadhukabilvamajjailavālukam| śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjaraso dhyāmakaṃ madanaṃ plavam||14||
śallakī kuṅkumaṃ māṣā yavāḥ kundurukastilāḥ| snehaḥ phalānāṃ sārāṇāṃ medo majjā vasā ghṛtam||15||

div.ab: śamane śallakī lākṣā pṛthvīkā kamalotpalam| nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣarodhratvacaḥ sitā||16|| yaṣṭīmadhu suvarṇatvak padmakaṃ raktayaṣṭikā| gandhāścākuṣṭhatagarāḥ------------------------|17|

ab.seg: daśamūlamanohvālaṃ lākṣā śvetā phalatrayam| gandhadravyāṇi tīkṣṇāni gaṇo mūrddhavirecanaḥ||18||

div.ab: samprati dhūmavartividhānamāha---- jale sthitāmahorātramiṣīkāṃ dvādaśāṅgulām| piṣṭairdhūmauṣadhairevaṃ pañcakṛtvaḥ pralepayet||19|| vartiraṅguṣṭhakasthūlā yavamadhyā yathā bhavet| chhāyāśuṣkāṃ vigarbhāṃ tāṃ snehābhyaktāṃ yathāyatham||20|| dhūmanetrārpitāṃ pātumagnipluṣṭāṃ prayojayet| -------------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: adhunā'paramapi dhūmaprakāramāha ---- śarāvasampuṭacchidre nāḍīṃ nyasya daśāṅgulām|21| aṣṭāṅgulāṃ vā vaktreṇā kāsavān dhūmamāpibet| 21 1/2||23||

div.ab: kāsaḥ śvāsaḥ pīnaso visvaratvaṃ pūtirgandhaḥ pāṇḍutā keśadoṣaḥ| karṇāsyākṣistrāvakaṇḍvartijāḍyaṃ tandrā hidhmā dhūmapaṃ na spṛśanti| 22 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dhūmapānavidhirnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|21|

div.head: gaṇḍūṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto gaṇḍūṣādividhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: catuṣprakaro gaṇḍūṣaḥ snigdhaḥ śamanaśodhanau| ropaṇaśca----------------------------------------|1|
idānīmeṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vaktumāha ---- ------------------------snigdho'tra svādvamlapaṭusādhitaiḥ| snehaiḥ-----------------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: nanu, dravyāṇāṃ śuṣkatvādgaṇḍūṣānupapattiriti cettatrāha ---- -----------------------------------------------------| -------------------------tatra snehaḥ kṣīraṃ madhūdakam||3||
śuktaṃ madhyaṃ raso mūtraṃ dhānyāmlaṃ ca yathāyatham| kalkairyuktaṃ vipakvaṃ vā yathāsparśaṃ prayojayet||4||

div.ab: dantaharṣe dantacāle mukharoge ca vātike| sukhoṣṇamathavā śītaṃ tilakalkodakaṃ hitam||5|| gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇe---------------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|6|

-----------------------------------------------------| ūṣādāhānvite pāke kṣate cāgantusambhave||6|| viṣe kṣārāgnidagdhe ca sarpirdhāryaṃ payo'thavā| -----------------------------------------------------|7|

-----------------------------------------------------| vaiśadyaṃ janayatyāśu sandadhāti mukhe vraṇān||7|| dāhatṛṣṇāpraśamanaṃ madhugaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam| -----------------------------------------------------|8|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| dhānyāmlamāsyavairasyamaladaurgandhyanāśanam||8||
-----------------------------------------------------| āśu kṣārāmbugaṇḍūṣo bhinatti śleṣmaṇaścayam||9||

div.ab: sukhoṣṇodakagaṇḍūṣairjāyate vaktralāghavam| -----------------------------------------------------|10|

---------------------------------------------------| nivāte sātape swinnamṛditaskandhakandharaḥ||10|| gaṇḍūṣamapiban kiñcidunnatāsyo vidhārayet| ---------------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: kiyantaṃ kālaṃ ? ityāha ---- ---------------------------------------------------| kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvatsravadghrāṇākṣatā'thavā||11||

div.ab: asañcāryo mukhe pūrṇe gaṇḍūṣaḥ, kavalo'nyathā| ---------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: manyāśiraḥkarṇamukhākṣirogāḥ prasekakaṇṭhāmayavaktraśoṣāḥ| hṛllāsatandrārucipīnasāśca sādhyā viśeṣātkavalagraheṇa||12||
---------------------------------------------------| kalko rasakriyā cūrṇastrividhaṃ pratisāraṇam||13||
yuñjyāttat kapharogeṣu gaṇḍūṣavihitauṣadhaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------||1||
---------------------------------------------------| tripramāṇaścaturbhāgatribhāgārddhāṅgulonnatiḥ||15||
aśuṣkasya sthitistasya, śuṣko dūṣayati cchavim| tamārdrayitvā'panayettadante'bhyaṅgamācaret||16||

div.ab: vivarjayeddivāsvapnabhāṣyāgnyātapaśukkrudhaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: -------------------------sa tu hanti suyojitaḥ| akālapalitavyaṅgavalītimiranīlikāḥ||18||

div.ab: kolamajjā vṛṣānmūlaṃ śābaraṃ gaurasarṣapāḥ| siṃhīmūlaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇā dārvītvaṅnistuṣā yavāḥ||19|| darbhamūlahimośīraśirīṣamiśitaṇḍulāḥ| kumudotpalakahlāradūrvāmadhukacandanam||20|| kālīyakatilośīramāṃsītagarapadmakam| tālīsagundrāpuṇḍrāhvayaṣṭīkāśanatāguru||21|| ityārddhārddhoditā lepā hemantādiṣu ṣaṭ smṛtāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|22|

---------------------------------------------------| mukhālepanaśīlānāṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavati darśanam||22|| vadanaṃ cāparimlānaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ tāmarasopamam| ---------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| tatrābhyaṅgaḥ prayoktavyo raukṣyakaṇḍūmalādiṣu||24||

div.ab: arūṃṣikāśirastodadāhapākavraṇeṣu tu| pariṣekaḥ-----------------------------|25|

ab.seg: -----------------bastistu prasuptyarditajāgaje| nāsāsyaśoṣe timire śiroroge ca dāruṇe||26||

div.ab: vidhistasya niṣaṇṇasya pīṭhe jānusame mṛdau| śuddhāktasvinnadehasya dinānte gavyamāhiṣam||27|| dvādaśāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ carmapaṭṭaṃ śiraḥsamam| ākarṇabandhanasthānaṃ lalāṭe vastraveṣṭite||28|| cailaveṇikayā baddhvā māṣakalkena lepayet| tato yathāvyādhi śrutaṃ snehaṃ koṣṇaṃ niṣecayet||29|| ūrdhvaṃ keśabhuvo yāvadaṅgulam------------------------| ---------------------------------------------------|30|

sa ca snehaḥ kiyatkālaṃ dhāryaḥ ? ityāha ---- ----------------------------------dhārayecca tam| āvaktranāsikotkledāddaśāṣṭau ṣaṭ calādiṣu||30|| mātrāsahasrāṇyaruje tvekaṃ---------------------| ---------------------------------------------------|31|

ab.seg: dhārayetpūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇamūlaṃ vimardayan| rujaḥ syānmārdavaṃ yāvanmātrāśatamavedane||32||
atha mātrāyāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ? ityāha ---- yāvatparyeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam| nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā tu sā smṛtā||33||

div.ab: kacasadanasitatvapiñjaratvaṃ pariphuṭanaṃ śirasaḥ samīrarogān| jayati, janayatīndriyaprasādaṃ svarahanumūrddhabalaṃ ca mūrddhatailam|34| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne gaṇḍūṣādividhirnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|22|

div.head: āścātanāñjanavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta āścotanāñjanavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmādāvāścotanaṃ hitam| ruktodakaṇḍūgharṣāśrudāharāganivarhaṇam||1||

div.ab: uṣṇaṃ bāte, kaphe koṣṇaṃ, tacchhītaṃ raktapittayoḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: sampratyāścotanasya vidhimaaha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| nivātasthasya vāmena pāṇinonmīlya locanam||2||
śuktau pralambayā'nyena picuvartyā kanīnike| daśa dvādaśa vā bindūn dvyaṅgulādavasecayet||3||
tataḥ pramṛjya mṛdunā cailena, kaphavātayoḥ| anyena koṣṇapānīyaplutena svedayenmṛdu||4||
atyuṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ rūgrāgadṛṅnāśāyākṣisecanam| atiśītaṃ tu kurute nistodastambhavedanāḥ||5||
kāṣāyavartmatāṃ gharṣaṃ kṛcchhrādunmeṣaṇaṃ bahu| vikāravṛddhimatyalpaṃ saṃrambhamaparisrutam||6||
kayā yuktyā netre prayuktamauṣadhaṃ doṣānapayati ? ityāha ---- gatvā sandhiśitoghrāṇamukhasrotāṃsi bheṣajam| ūrdhvagānnayane nyastamapavartayate malān||7||
athāñjanaṃ śuddhatanornetramātrāśraye male| pakvaliṅge'lpaśophātikaṇḍūpaicchhilyalakṣite||8||
mandagharṣāśrurāge'kṣiṇa prayojyaṃ ghanadūṣike| ārti pittakaphāsṛgbhirmārutena viśeṣataḥ||9||

div.ab: lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanamiti tridhā| añhjanam-------------------------------------|10|

--------------------------svāduśītaiḥ prasādanam| tīkṣṇāñjanābhisantapte nayane tatprasādanam||11|| prayujyamānaṃ labhate pratyañjanasamāhvayam| ----------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: praśastā, lekhane tāmrī, ropaṇe kālalohajā| aṅgulī ca, suvarṇotthā rūpyajā ca prasādane||13||
añjanakalpanā triprakārā syāt| katham ? ityāha---- piṇḍo rasakriyā cūrṇastridhaivāñjanakalpanā| gurau madhye laghau doṣe tāṃ krameṇa prayojayet||14||

div.ab: hareṇumātrā piṇḍasya vellamātrā rasakriyā| tīkṣṇasya, dviguṇaṃ tasya mṛdunaḥ-------------|15|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| niśi svapne na madhyāhne mlāne noṣṇagabhastibhiḥ||16||
akṣirogāya doṣāḥ syurvardhitotpīḍitadgutāḥ| prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca tacchhāntyai vyābhrerke'to'ñjayetsadā||17||
vadantyanye tu na divā prayojyaṃ tīkṣṇamañjanam| virekadurbalaṃ cakṣurādityaṃ prāpya sīdati||18||
ata evāha ---- svapnena ratrau kālasya sau myatvena ca tarpitā| śītasātmyā dṛgāgneyī sthiratāṃ labhate punaḥ||19||
tadetadanyamatamavyāpakamiti dūṣayannāha ---- atyudrikte balāse tu lekhanīye'thavā gade| kāmamahynapi nātyuṣṇe tīkṣṇamakṣṇi prayojayet||20||
ata evāha ---- aśmano janma lohasya tata eva ca tīkṣṇatā| upaghāto'pi tenaiva tathā netrasya tejasaḥ||21||
api ca ---- na rātrāvapi śīte'ti netre tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ hitam| doṣamasrāvayetstabdhaṃ kaṇḍūjāḍyādikāri tat||22||
nāñjayedbhītavamitaviriktāśitavegite| kruddhajvatitatāntākṣiśirorukśokajāgare||23||
adṛṣṭe'rke śiraḥsnāte pītayordhūmamadyayoḥ| ajīrṇe'gnyarkasantapte divāsupte pipāsite||24||
sāmprataṃ yādṛśamañjanaṃ na prayojyaṃ tādṛśaṃ darśayati ---- atitīkṣṇamṛdustokabahnacchhaghanakarkaśam| atyarthaśītalaṃ taptamañjanaṃ nāvacārayet||25||
athānunmīlayan dṛṣṭimantaḥ sañcārayecchhanaiḥ| añjite vartmanī kiñciccālayeccaivamañjanam||26||
tīkṣṇaṃ vyāpnoti sahasā, na conmeṣanimeṣaṇam| niṣpīḍanaṃ ca vartmabhyāṃ kṣālanaṃ vā samācaret||27||
apetauṣadhasaṃrambhaṃ nirvṛtaṃ nayanaṃ yadā| vyādhidoṣartuyogyābhiradbhiḥ prakṣālayettadā||28||
dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakenākṣi tato vāmaṃ savāsasā| ūrdhvavartmani saṅgṛhya śodhyaṃ vāmena cetarat||29||

div.ab: kimiti śodhyam ? ityāha ---- vartmaprāpto'ñjāddoṣo rogān kuryādato'nyathā| ---------------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| kaṇḍujāḍye'ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ vā yojayet punaḥ||30||

div.ab: tīkṣṇāñjanābhitapte tu cūrṇaṃ pratyañjanaṃ himam|30.5| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāna āścotanā ñjanavidhirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|23|

div.head: tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātastarpaṇapuṭapākavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasutre|2|

nayane tāmyati stabdhe śuṣke rūkṣe'bhighātite| vātapittāture jihme śīrṇapakṣmāvilekṣaṇe||1|| kṛcchronmīlaśirāharṣaśirotpātatamorjunaiḥ| syandamanthānyatovātavātaparyāyaśukrakaiḥ||2|| āture śāntarāgāśruśūlasaṃrambhadūṣike| nivāte tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ śuddhayormūrddhakāyayoḥ||3|| kāle sādhāraṇe prātaḥ sāyaṃ vottānaśāyinaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

----------------------------------------------------| yavamāṣamayīṃ pālīṃ netrakośādbahiḥ samām||4|| dvyaṅguloccāṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yathāsvaṃ siddhamāvapet| sarpirnimīlite netre taptāmbupravilāyitam||5|| naktāndhyavātatimirakṛcchhrabodhādike vasām| āpakṣmāgrāt---------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: mātrā vigaṇayettatra vartmasandhisitāsate| dṛṣṭau ca kramaśo vyādhau śataṃ trīṇi ca pañca ca||7||
śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca, daśa manthe, daśānile| pitte ṣaṭ, svasthavṛtte ca balāse pañca dhārayet||8||
kṛtvā'pāṅge tato dvāraṃ snehaṃ pātre nigālayet| pibecca dhūmaṃ, nekṣeta vyoma rūpaṃ ca bhāsvaram||9||
itthaṃ pratidinaṃ vāyau, pitte tvekāntaraṃ, kaphe| svasthe ca hyantaraṃ dadyādātṛpteriti yojayet||10||
tṛptasya kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ? ityāha ---- prakāśakṣamatā svāsthyaṃ viśadaṃ laghu locanam| tṛpte, viparyayo'tṛpte'titṛpte śleṣmajā rūjaḥ||11||

div.ab: snehapītā tanuriva klāntā dṛṣṭirhi sīdati| tarpaṇānantaraṃ tasmādṛgbalādhānakāriṇam||12|| puṭapākaṃ prayuñjīta pūrvokteṣveva yakṣmasu| ----------------------------------------------------|13|

----------------------------------------------------| sa vāte snehanaḥ śleṣmasahite lekhano hitaḥ||13|| dṛgdaurbalye'nile pitte rakte svasthe prasādanaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|14|

idānīmeṣāṃ puṭapākānāṃ kalpanāmāha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| bhūśayaprasahānūpamedomajjavasāmiṣaiḥ||14|| snehanaṃ payasā piṣṭairjīvanīyaiśca kalpayet| ----------------------------------------------------|15|

----------------------------------------------------| mṛgapakṣiyakṛnmāṃsamuktāyastāmrasaindhavaiḥ||15|| srotojaśaṅkhaphenālairlekhanaṃ mastukalkitaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|16|

----------------------------------------------------| mṛgapakṣiyakṛnmajjavasāntrahṛdayāmiṣaiḥ||16|| madhuraiḥ saghṛtaiḥ stanyakṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ prasādanam| ----------------------------------------------------|17|

adhunā puṭapākasya kalpanāmāha ---- bilvamātraṃ pṛthak piṇḍaṃ māṃsabheṣajakalkayoḥ||17|| urubūkavaṭāmbhojapatraiḥ snehādiṣu kramāt| veṣṭayitvā mṛdā liptaṃ dhavadhanvanagomayaiḥ||18|| pacetpradīptairagnyābhaṃ pakvaṃ niṣpīḍya tadrasam| netre tarpaṇavadyuñjyāt-----------------------|19|
tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyānarhe na yojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|21|
yāvantyahāni yuñjīta dvistato hitabhāgbhavet||21|| mālatīmallikāpuṣpairbaddhākṣo nivasenniśām||21.5||

sarvātmanā netrabalāya yatnaṃ kurvīta nasyāñjanatarpaṇādyaiḥ| dṛṣṭiśca naṣṭā vividhaṃ jagacca tamomayaṃ jāyata ekarūpam|22.5| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|24|

div.head: yantravidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto yantravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti sa smādurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|

etadeva spaṣṭayannāha ---- nānāvidhānāṃ śalyānāṃ nānādeśaprabādhinām| āhartumabhyupāyo yastadyantraṃ yacca darśane||1|| arśobhagandarādīnāṃ śastrakṣārāgniyojane| śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyāṃ tathā bastyādikarmaṇi||2|| ghaṭikālābuśṛṅgaṃ ca jāmbavauṣṭhādikāni ca| ----------------------------------------------------|3|

yantrāṇāṃ kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ |ca] kāryaṃ syāt? ityāha- ----------------------------------------------------| anekarūpakāryāṇi yantrāṇi vividhānyataḥ||3|| vikalpya kalpayedbuddhyā yathāsthūlaṃ tu vakṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

atha yantrāṇyāha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| tulyāni kaṅkasiṃharkṣakākādimṛgapakṣiṇām||4|| mukhairmukhāni yantrāṇāṃ kuryāttatsaṃjñakāni ca| aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmānyāyasāni ca bhūriśaḥ||5|| masūrākāraparyantaiḥ kaṇṭhe baddhāni kīlakaiḥ| vidyātsvastikayantrāṇi mūle'ṅkuśanatāni ca||6|| tairdṛḍhairasthisaṃlagnaśalyāharaṇamiṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|7|

----------------------------------------------------| kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau sandaṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau||7|| tvakśirāsnāyupiśitalagnaśalyāpakarṣaṇau| ----------------------------------------------------|8|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| ṣaḍaṅgulo'nyo haraṇe sūkṣmaśalyopapakṣmaṇām||8||
mucuṇḍī sūkṣmadantarjurmūle rucakabhūṣaṇā| gambhīravraṇamāṃsānāmarmaṇaḥ śeṣitasya ca||9||
dve dvādaśāṅgule matsyatālavat dvyekalālake| tālayantre smṛte karṇanāḍīśalyāpahāriṇī||10||
nāḍīyantrāṇi suṣirāṇyekānekamukhāni ca| srotogatānāṃ śalyānāmāmayānāṃ ca darśane||11||
kriyāṇāṃ sukaratvāya kuryādācūṣaṇāya ca| tadvistāraparīṇāhadairghyaṃ srotonurodhataḥ||12||

div.ab: daśāṅgulā'rdhanāhā'ntaḥkaṇṭhaśalyāvalokinī| nāḍī----------------------------------------|13|

----------------------------------------------------| --------pañcamukhacchhidrā catuṣkarṇasya saṅgrahe||13|| vāraṅgasya, dvikarṇasya tricchhidrā tatpramāṇataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|14|

----------------------------------------------------| vāraṅgakarṇasaṃsthānānāhadairghyānurodhataḥ||14|| nāḍīrevaṃvidhāścānyā draṣṭuṃ śalyāni kārayet| ----------------------------------------------------|15|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| arśasāṃ gostanākāraṃ yantrakaṃ caturaṅgulam||16||
nāhe pañcāṅgulaṃ puṃsāṃ pramadānāṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam| dvicchhidraṃ darśane vyādherekacchhidraṃ tu karmaṇi||17||
madhye'sya tryaṅgulaṃ chhidramaṅguṣṭhodaravistṛtam| ardhāṅgulocchhritodvṛttakarṇikaṃ ca tadūrdhvataḥ||18||

div.ab: śamyākhyaṃ tādṛgacchhidraṃ yantramarśaḥprapīḍanam| ----------------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| sarvathā'panayedoṣṭhaṃ chhidrādūrdhvaṃ bhagandare||19||
ghrāṇārbudārśasāmekacchhidrā nāḍyaṅguladvayā| pradeśinīparīṇāhā syādbhagandarayantravat||20||
aṅhgulitrāṇakaṃ dāntaṃ vārkṣaṃ vā caturaṅgulam| dvicchhidraṃ gostanākāraṃ tadvaktravivṛtau sukham||21||

div.ab: yonivraṇekṣaṇaṃ madhye suṣiraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam| mudrābaddhaṃ caturbhittamambhojamukulānanam||22|| catuḥśalākamākrāntaṃ mūle tadvikasenmukhe| ----------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| yantre nāḍīvraṇābhyaṅgakṣālanāya ṣaḍaṅgule||23||
bastiyantrākṛtī mūle mukhe'ṅguṣṭhakalāyakhe| agrato'karṇike mūle nibaddhamṛducarmaṇī||24||
----------------------------------------------------| dhūmabastyādiyantrāṇi nirdiṣṭāni yathāyatham||25||
tryaṅgulāsyaṃ bhavecchhṛṅgaṃ cūṣaṇe'ṣṭādaśāṅgulam| agre siddhārthakacchhidraṃ sunaddhaṃ cūcukākṛti||26||
syādvādaśāṅgulo'lāburnāhe tvaṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ| catustryaṅgulavṛttāsyo dīpto'ntaḥ śleṣmaraktahṛt||27||

div.ab: ------------------------dvau daśadvādaśāṅgulau| cālane śarapuṅkhāsyau-----------------------------|31|

ab.seg: nato'gre śaṅkunā tulyo garbhaśaṅkuriti smṛtaḥ| āṣṭāṅgulāyatastena mūḍhagarbhaṃ haret striyāḥ||32||

div.ab: aśmaryāharaṇaṃ sarpaphāṇāvadvaktramagrataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|33|

----------------------------------------------------| śarapuṅkhamukhaṃ dantapātanaṃ caturaṅgulam||33|| kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣāḥ śalākāḥ ṣaṭ pramārjane| ----------------------------------------------------|34|
dve ṣaṭsaptāṅgule ghrāṇe, dve karṇe'ṣṭanavāṅule| ----------------------------------------------------|35|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| karṇaśodhanamaśvatthapatraprāntaṃ sruvānanam||35||

div.ab: śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānāṃ kṣāre'gnau ca pṛthak trayam| yuñjyāt sthūlāṇudīrghāṇāṃ-----------------------------------|36|

ab.seg: aṣṭāṅgulā nimnamukhāstisraḥ kṣārauṣadhakrame| kanīnīmadhyamānāmīnakhamānasamairmukhaiḥ||38||

div.ab: svaṃsvamuktāni yantrāṇi meḍhraśuddhyañjanādiṣu| -----------------------------------------------------|39|

-----------------------------------------------------| anuyantrāṇyayaskāntarajjuvastrāśmamudgarāḥ||39|| vadhrāntrajihvābālāśca śākhānakhamukhadvijāḥ| kālaḥ pākaḥ karaḥ pādo bhayaṃ harṣaśca, tatkriyāḥ||40|| upāyavitpravibhajedālocya nipuṇaṃ dhiyā||40.5||
tānyeva yantrāṇāṃ karmāṇyāha ---- nirghātanonmathanapūraṇamārgaśuddhi- saṃvyūhanāharaṇabandhanapīḍanāni| ācūṣaṇonnamananāmanacālabhaṅga- vyāvartanarjukaraṇāni ca yantrakarma||41.5||

vivartate sādhvavagāhate ca grāhyaṃ gṛhītvoddharate ca yasmāt| yantreṣvataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣvadhikāri yacca| 42 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhirnāma pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|25|

div.head: śastravidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ śastravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|

ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ sukarmārairghaṭitāni yathāvidhi| śastrāṇi romavāhīni bāhulyenāṅgulāni ṣaṭ||1|| surūpāṇi sudhārāṇi sugrahāṇi ca kārayet| akarālāni sudhmātasutīkṣṇāvartite'yasi||2|| samāhitamukhāgrāṇi nīlambhojacchavīni ca| nāmānugatarūpāṇi sadā sannihitāni ca||3|| svonmanārdhacaturthaaṃśaphalānyekaikaśo'pi ca| prāyo dvitrāṇi, yuñjīta tāni sthānaviśeṣataḥ||4|| (maṇḍalāgraṃ vṛddhipatramutpalādhyarddhadhārake| sarpaiṣaṇyau vetasākhyaṃ śarāryāsyatrikūrcake||1|| kuśāsyaṃ sāṭavadanamantarvakrārdhacandrake (kam)| vrīhimukhaṃ kuṭhārī ca śalākāṅguliśastrake||2|| baḍiśaṃ karapatrākhyaṃ kartarī nakhaśastrakam| dantalekhanakaṃ sūcyaḥ kūrco nāma khrajāhvayam||3|| ārā caturvidhākārā tathā syātkarṇavedhanī(nam)||3.5||

ab.seg: maṇḍalāgraṃ phale teṣāṃ tarjanyantarnakhākṛti| lekhane chedane yojyaṃ pothakīśuṇḍikādiṣu||5||

div.ab: vṛddhipatraṃ kṣurākāraṃ chedabhedanapāṭane| ṛjvagramunnate śophe gambhīre ca tadanyathā||6|| natāgraṃ pṛṣṭhato dīrghahrasvavaktraṃ yathāśrayam| -----------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| utpalādhyardhadhārākhye bhedane chedane tathā||7||

div.ab: sarpāsyaṃ ghrāṇakarṇārśaścchedane'rdhāṅgulaṃ phale| -----------------------------------------------------|8|
kuśāṭāvadane srāvye hyaṅgulaṃ syāttayoḥ phalam| -----------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: ----------------------tathādhyardhāṅgulaṃ phale| vrīhivaktraṃ prayojyaṃ ca tacchirodarayorvyadhe||11||
pṛthuḥ kuṭhārī godantasadṛśārdhāṅgulānanā| tayordhvadaṇḍayā vidhyeduparyasthāṃ sthitāṃ śirām||12||

div.ab: tāmrī śalākā dvimukhī mukhe kurubakākṛtiḥ| liṅganāśaṃ tayā vidhyet------------------|13|

ab.seg: mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ phale tvardhāṅgulāyatam| yogato vṛddhipatreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā samam||14||
tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam| sūtrabaddhaṃ galasrotorogacchedanabhedane||15||

div.ab: grahaṇe śuṇḍikārmāderbaḍiśaṃ sunatānanam| ----------------------------------------------|16|

----------------------------------------------| chede'stthnāṃ karapatraṃ tu kharadhāraṃ daśāṅgulam||16|| vistāre dvyaṅgulaṃ sūkṣmadantaṃ sutsarubandhanam| ----------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| snāyusūtrakacacchede kartarī kartarīnibhā||17||
vaktrarjudhāraṃ dvimukhaṃ nakhaśastraṃ navāṅulam| sūkṣmaśalyoddhṛticchedamedapracchānalekhane||18||
adhunā dantalekhanaśastramāha ---- ekadhāraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prabaddhākṛti caikataḥ| dantalekhanakaṃ tena śodhayedvantaśarkarām||19||

div.ab: adhunā sūcīśastramāha ---- vṛttā gūḍhadṛḍhāḥ pāśe tisraḥ sūcyo'tra sīvane| māṃsalānāṃ pradeśānāṃ tryasrā tryaṅgulamāyatā||20|| alpamāṃsāsthisandhisthavraṇānāṃ dvyaṅgulāyatā| vrīhivaktrā dhanurvaktrā pakvāmāśayamarmasu||21|| sā sārdhadvyaṅgulā-------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|22|

adhunā kūrcaṃ lilakṣayiṣurāha ---- ------------------------sarvavṛttāstāścaturaṅgulāḥ| kūrco vṛttaikapīṭhasthāḥ saptāṣṭau vā subandhanāḥ||22|| sa yojyo nīlikāvyaṅgakeśaśāteṣu kuṭṭane| ----------------------------------------------|23|

----------------------------------------------| ardhāṅgulamukhairvṛttairaṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khajaḥ||23|| pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāttena haredasṛk| ----------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| vyadhanaṃ karṇapālīnāṃ yūthikāmukulānanam||24||

div.ab: ārā'rdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā tatpraveśā tathordhvataḥ| caturasrā, tayā vidhyecchhophaṃ pakvāmasaṃśaye||25|| karṇapālīṃ ca bahalāṃ-----------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: -----------------------bahalāyaaśca śasyate| sūcī tribhāgasuṣirā tryaṅgulā karṇavedhanī||26||

div.ab: jalaukaḥkṣāradahanakācopalanakhādayaḥ| alauhānyanuśastrāṇi, tānyevaṃ ca vikalpayet||27|| aparāṇyapi yantrādīnvupayogaṃ ca yaugikam| ----------------------------------------------|28|

----------------------------------------------| utpāṭyapāṭyasīvyaiṣyalekhyapracchhānakuṭṭanam||28|| chhedyaṃ bhedyaṃ vyadho mantho graho dāhaśca tatkriyāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|29|

śastradośānaha ---- ----------------------------------------------| kuṇṭhakhaṇḍatanusthūlahrasvadīrghatvavakratāḥ||29|| śastrāṇāṃ kharadhāratvamaṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: adhunā śastrāṇāṃ grahaṇavidhiṃ darśayati ---- ----------------------------------------------| chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare||30||
tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairgṛhṇīyātsusamāhitaḥ| visrāvaṇāni vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakena ca||31||
talapracchannavṛntāgraṃ grāhyaṃ vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe| mūleṣvāharaṇārthāni kriyāsaukaryato'param||32||
śastrakośamācaṣṭate ---- syānnavāṅgulavistāraḥ sughano dvādaśāṅgulaḥ| kṣau mapatrorṇakauśeyadukūlamṛducarmajaḥ||33||
vinyastapāśaḥ susyūtaḥ sāntarorṇārsthaśastrakaḥ| śalākāpihitāsyaśca śastrakośaḥ susañcayaḥ||34||

div.ab: sukumārabālānāmasravisrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso yojayet ---- jalaukasastu sukhināṃ raktasrāvāya yojayet| ----------------------------------------------|35|

tāśca dwiprakārāḥ,- saviṣā nirviṣāśca| tatra saviṣāṇāṃ sāpāyatvāttā eva tāvallakṣayati ---- ----------------------------------------------| duṣṭāmbumatsyabhekāhiśavakothamalodbhavāḥ||35|| raktāḥ śvetā bhṛśaṃ kṛṣṇāścapalāḥ sthūlapicchhilāḥ| indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāśca tāḥ||36|| saviṣā varjayet------------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|37|
-------------------------tābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramāḥ| viṣapittāsranutkāryaṃ tatra----------------------|37|

ab.seg: nirviṣāḥ śaivalaśyāvā vṛttā nīlordhvarājayaḥ| kaṣāyapṛṣṭhāstanvaṅgyaḥ kiñcitpītodarāśca yāḥ||38||
tā apyasamyagvamanāt pratataṃ ca nipātanāt| sīdantīḥ salilaṃ prāpya raktamattā iti tyajet||39||
athetarā niśākalkayukte'mbhasi pariplutāḥ| avantisome takre vā punaścāśvāsitā jale||40||
lāgayeddṛtamṛtstanyaraktaśastranipātanaiḥ| pibantīrunnataskandhāśchādayenmṛduvāsasā||41||
sampṛktādduṣṭaśuddhāsrājjalaukā duṣṭaśoṇitam| ādatte prathamaṃ haṃsaḥ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodakādiva||42||
(gulmārśovidradhīn kuṣṭhavātaraktagalāmayān| netrarugviṣavīsarpān śamayanti jalaukasaḥ| )||1||
----------------------------------vāmayecca tām| paṭutailāktavadanāṃ ślakṣṇakaṇḍanarūṣitām||43||

div.ab: anyatra mūḍhagarbhāśmamukharogodarāturāt| ------------------------------------------------|16|

------------------------------------------------| athāhṛtopakaraṇaṃ vaidyaḥ prāṅmukhamāturam||16|| sammukho yantrayitvā''śu nyasyenmarmādi varjayan| anulomaṃ suniśitaṃ śastramāpūyadarśanāt||17|| sakṛdevāharettacca------------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|18|

---------------------------------pāke tu sumahatyapi| pāṭayet dvyaṅgulaṃ samyadvyaṅgulatryaṅgulāntaram||18|| eṣitvā samyageṣiṇyā paritaḥ sunirūpitam| aṅgulīnālavālairvā yathādeśaṃ yathāśayam||19|| yato gatāṃ gatiṃ vidyādutsaṅgo yatra yatra ca| tatra tatra vraṇaṃ kuryātsuvibhaktaṃ nirāśayam||20|| āyataṃ ca viśālaṃ ca yathā doṣo na tiṣṭhati| ------------------------------------------------|21|
------------------------------------------------| śauryamāśukriyā tīkṣṇaṃ śastramasvedavepathū||21|| asammohaśca vaidyasya śastrakarmaṇi śasyate| ------------------------------------------------|22|
------------------------------------------------| tiryakchindyāllalāṭābhrūdantaveṣṭakajatruṇi||22|| kukṣikakṣākṣikūṭauṣṭhakapolagalavaṅkṣaṇe| ------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| anyatra chedanāttiryak sirāsnāyuvipāṭanam||23||
śastre'vacārite vāgbhiḥ śītāmbhobhiśca rogiṇam| āśvāsya parito'ṅgulyā paripīḍya vraṇaṃ tataḥ||24||
kṣālayitvā kaṣāyeṇa plotenāmbho'panīya ca| guggulvagurusiddhārthahiṅgusarjarasānvitaiḥ||25||
dhūpayetpaṭuṣaḍgranthānimbapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥ| tilakalkājyamadhubhiryathāsvaṃ bheṣajena ca||26||
digdhāṃ vartiṃ tato dadyāttairevācchhādayecca tāṃ| ghṛtāktaiḥ saktubhiścordhvaṃ ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ tataḥ||27||
nidhāya yuktyā badhnīyātpaṭṭena susamāhitam| pārśve savye'pasavye vā nādhastānnaiva copari||28||
śucisūkṣmadṛḍhāḥ paṭṭāḥ kavalyaḥ savikeśikāḥ| dhūpitā mṛdavaḥ ślakṣṇā nirvalīkā vraṇe hitāḥ||29||

div.ab: kurvītānantaraṃ tasya rakṣāṃ rakṣoniṣiddhaye| baliṃ copaharettebhyaḥ---------------------------|30|

ab.seg: lakṣmīṃ guhāmatiguhāṃ jaṭilāṃ brahmacāriṇīm| vacāṃ chhatrāmaticchhatrāṃ dūrvāṃ siddhārthakānapi||31||

div.ab: tataḥ snehadinehoktaṃ tasyācāraṃ samādiśet| ------------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| divāsvapno vraṇe kaṇḍūrāgarukśophapūyakṛt||32||
strīṇāṃ tu smṛtisaṃsparśadarśanaiścalitasrute| śukre vyavāyajān doṣānasaṃsarge'pyavāpnuyāt||33||
(vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgarāt| tau ca ruk ca divāsvāpāttāśca mṛtyuśca maithunāt)||1||

div.ab: bhojanaṃ ca yathāsātmyaṃ yavagodhūmaṣaṣṭikāḥ| masūramudgatuvarījīvantīsuniṣaṇṇakāḥ||34|| bālamūlakavārtākataṇḍulīyakavāstukam| kāravellakakarkoṭapaṭolakaṭukāphalam||35|| saindhavaṃ dāḍimaṃ dhātrī ghṛtaṃ taptahimaṃ jalam| jīrṇaśālyodanaṃ snigdhamalpamuṣṇodakottaram||36|| bhuñjāno jāṅgalairmāṃsaiḥ śīghraṃ vraṇamapohati| ------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| aśitaṃ mātrayā kāle pathyaṃ yāti jarāṃ sukham||37||
ajīrṇāttvanilādīnāṃ vibhramo balavān bhavet| tataḥ śopharujāpākadāhānāhānavāpnuyāt||38||
navaṃ dhānyaṃ tilān māṣān madyaṃ māṃsamajāṅgalam| kṣīrekṣuvikṛtīramlaṃ lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ tyajet||39||
yaccānyadapi viṣṭambhi vidāhi guru śītalam| vargo'yaṃ navadhānyādirvraṇinaḥ sarvadoṣakṛt||40||

div.ab: madyaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣāmlamāśu vyāpādayedvraṇam| ------------------------------------------------|41|

------------------------------------------------| vālośīraiśca vījyeta na cainaṃ parighaṭṭayet||41|| na tudenna ca kaṇḍūyecceṣṭamānaśca pālayet| snigdhavṛddhadvijātīnāṃ kathāḥ śruṇvanmanaḥpriyāḥ||42|| āśāvān vyādhimokṣāyā kṣipraṃ vraṇamapohati| ------------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| tṛtīye'hni punaḥ kuryādvraṇakarma ca pūrvavat||43||
prakṣālanādi, divase dvitīye nācarettathā| tīvravyatho vigrathitaścirātsaṃrohati vraṇaḥ||44||

div.ab: snigdhāṃ rūkṣāṃ ślathāṃ gāḍhāṃ durnyastāṃ ca vikeśikām| vraṇe na dadyātkalkaṃ vā----------------------------------|45|

------------------------------------------------| ------------------------snehātkledo vivarddhate||45|| māṃsacchhedo'tirugraukṣyādvaraṇaṃ śoṇitāgamaḥ| ślathātigāḍhadurnyāsairvraṇavartmāvagharṣaṇam||46|| gh|47|

ab.seg: sapūtimāṃsaṃ sotsaṅgaṃ sagatiṃ pūyagarbhiṇam| vraṇaṃ viśodhayecchīghraṃ sthitā hyantarvikeśikā||47||
vyamlaṃ tu pāṭitaṃ śophaṃ pācanaiḥ samupācaret| bhojanairupanāhaiśca nātivraṇavirodhibhiḥ||48||

div.ab: sadyaḥ sadyovraṇān sīvyedvivṛtānabhighātajān| medojāllikhitān granthīn hrasvāḥ pālīśca karṇayoḥ||49|| śirokṣikūṭanāsauṣṭhagaṇḍakarṇorubāhuṣu| grīvālalāṭamuṣkasphiṅmeḍhrapāyūdarādiṣu||50|| gambhīreṣu pradeśeṣu māṃsaleṣvacaleṣu ca| ------------------------------------------------|51|
------------------------------------------------| na tu vaṅkṣaṇakakṣādāvalpamāṃse cale vraṇān||51|| vāyunirvāhiṇāḥ śalyagarbhān kṣāraviṣāgnijān| ------------------------------------------------|52|

------------------------------------------------| sīvyeccalāsthiśuṣkāsratṛṇaromāpanīya tu||52|| pralambi māṃsaṃ vicchinnaṃ niveśya svaniveśane| sandhyasthi ca sthite rakte snāyvā sūtreṇa valkalaiḥ||53|| sīvyenna dūre nāsanne gṛhṇannālpaṃ na vā bahu| ------------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| sāntvayitvā tataścārtaṃ vraṇe madhughṛtadrutaiḥ||54||
añjanakṣau majamaṣīphalinīśallakīphalaiḥ| sarodhramadhukairdigdhe yuñjyādbandhādi pūrvavat||55||
vraṇe niḥśoṇitauṣṭho yaḥ kiñcidevāvalikhya tam| sañjātarudhiraṃ sīvyetsandhānaṃ hyasya śoṇitam||56||

div.ab: bandhanāni tu deśādīn vīkṣya yuñjīta teṣu ca| āvikājinakauśeyamuṣṇam, kṣau maṃ tu śītalam||57|| śītoṣṇam tūlasantānakārpāsasnāyuvalkajam| tāmrāyastrapusīsāni vraṇe medaḥkaphādhike||58|| bhaṅge ca yuñjyātphalakaṃ carmavalkakuśādi ca| ------------------------------------------------|59|

ab.seg: svanāmānugatākārā bandhāstu daśa pañca ca||59||
kośasvastikamuttolīcīnadāmānuvellitam| khaṭvāvibandhasthagikāvitānotsaṅgatoṣphaṇāḥ||60||
yamakaṃ maṇḍalākhyaṃ ca pañcāṅgī ceti yojayet| (vidadhyātteṣu teṣveva kośamaṅguliparvasu| svastikaṃ karṇakakṣādistaneṣūktaṃ ca sandhiṣu||1||
muttolīṃ meḍhragrīvādau yuñjyāccīnamapāṅgayoḥ| sambādhe'ṅe tathā dāma, śākhāsvevānuvellitam||2||
khaṭṭāṃ gaṇḍe hanau śaṅkhe, vibandhaṃ pṛṣṭhakodare| aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgre sthagikāmantravṛddhiṣu||3||
vitānaṃ pṛthulāṅgādau tathā śirasi cerayet| vilambini tathotsaṅgaṃ, nāsauṣṭhacibukādiṣu||4||
goṣphaṇaṃ sandhiṣu tathā, yamakaṃ yamike vraṇe| vṛtte'ṅghe maṇḍalākhyaṃ, ca pañcāṅgī cordhvajatruṣu||5||
) yo yatra suniviṣṭaḥ syāttaṃ teṣāṃ tatre buddhimān||61||

div.ab: badhnīyādgāḍhamūrusphikkakṣāvaṅkṣaṇamūrdhasu| śākhāvadanakarṇāraḥpṛṣṭhapārśvagalodare||62|| samaṃ mehanamuṣke ca, netre sandhiṣu ca ślatham| badhnīyācchhithilasthāne vātaśleṣmodbhave samam||63|| gāḍhameva samasthāne, bhṛśaṃ gāḍhaṃ tadāśaye| śīte vasante'pi ca tau mokṣaṇīyau tryahātryahāt||64|| pittaraktotthayorbandho gāḍhasthāne samo mataḥ| samasthāne ślatho, naiva śithilasyāśaye tathā||65|| sāyaṃprātastayormokṣo grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate| ------------------------------------------------|66|

ab.seg: duṣṭibhavecciraṃ cātra na tiṣṭhetsnehabheṣajam| kṛcchhreṇa śuddhiṃ rūḍhiṃ vā yāti rūḍho vivarṇatām||67||

div.ab: baddhastu cūrṇito bhagno viślaṣṭaḥ pāṭito'pi vā| chhinnasnāyusiro'pyāśu sukhaṃ saṃrohati vraṇaḥ||68|| utthānaśayanādyāsu sarvehāsu na pīḍyate| udvṛttauṣṭhaḥ samutsanno viṣamaḥ kaṭhino'tiruk||69|| samo mṛduraruk śīghraṃ vraṇaḥ śudhyati rohati| ------------------------------------------------|70|

------------------------------------------------| sthirāṇāmalpamāṃsānāṃ raukṣyādanuparohatām||70|| pracchhādyamauṣadhaṃ patrairyathādoṣaṃ yathartu ca| ajīrṇataruṇācchhidraiḥ samantātsuniveśitaiḥ||71|| dhautairakarkaśaiḥ kṣīribhūrjārjunakadambajaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|72|

------------------------------------------------| kuṣṭhināmagnidagdhānāṃ piṭikāmadhumehinām||72|| karṇikāśconduruviṣe kṣāradagdhā viṣānvitāḥ| bandhanīyā na māṃspāke gudapāke ca dāruṇe||73|| śīryamāṇāḥ sarugdāhāḥ śophāvasthāvisarpiṇaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|74|

------------------------------------------------| arakṣayā vraṇe yasmin makṣikā nikṣipetkṛmīn||74|| te bhakṣayantaḥ kurvanti rujāśophāsrasaṃsravān| surasādiṃ prayuñjīta tatra dhāvanapūraṇe||75|| saptaparṇakarañjārkanimbarājādanatvacaḥ| gomūtrakalkito lepaḥ sekaḥ kṣārāmbunā hitaḥ||76|| pracchhādya māṃsapeśyā vā vraṇaṃ tānāśu nirharet| ------------------------------------------------|77|
------------------------------------------------| na cainaṃ tvaramāṇo'ntaḥ sadoṣamuparohayet||77|| so'lpenāpyapacāreṇa bhūyo vikurute yataḥ| ------------------------------------------------|78|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| rūḍhe'pyajīrṇavyāyāmavyavāyādīn vivarjayet||78||
harṣaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ cāpi yāvadāsthairyasambhavāt| ādareṇānuvartyo'yaṃ māsān ṣaṭ sapta vā vidhiḥ||79||

div.ab: utpadyamānāsu ca tāsu tāsu vārtāsu doṣādibalānusārī| taistairupāyaiḥ prayataścikitse dālocayan vistaramuttaroktam|80| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śastrakarmavidhirnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|29|

div.head: kṣārāgnikarmavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ kṣārāgnikarmavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: sarvaśastrānuśastrāṇāṃ kṣāraḥ śreṣṭho bahūni yat| chhedyabhedyādikarmāṇi kurute viṣameṣvapi||1||
duḥkhāvacāryaśastreṣu tena siddhimayātsu ca| atikṛcchhreṣu rogeṣu yacca pāne'pi yujyate||2||

div.ab: adhunā kṣārasya peyalepaviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati- sa peyo'rśognisādāśmagulmodaragarādiṣu| ------------------------------------------------|3|
------------------------------------------------| yojyaḥ sākṣānmaṣaśvitrabāhyārśaḥkuṣṭhasuptiṣu||3|| bhagandarārbudagranthiduṣṭanāḍīvraṇādiṣu| ------------------------------------------------|4|

------------------------------------------------| na tūbhayo'pi yoktavyaḥ pitte rakte cale'bale||4|| jvare'tisāre hanmūrdharoge pāṇḍvāmaye'rucau| timire kṛtasaṃśudddhau śvayathau sarvagātrage||5|| bhīrugarbhiṇyṛtumatīprodvṛttaphalayoniṣu| ajīrṇe'nne śiśau vṛddhe dhamanīsandhimarmasu||6|| taruṇāsthisirāsnāyusevanīgalanābhiṣu| deśe'lpamāṃse vṛṣaṇameḍhrasrotonakhāntare||7|| vartmarogādṛte'kṣṇośca śītavarṣoṣṇadurdine| ------------------------------------------------|8|

adhunā kṣārakriyāmāha---- ----------------------------------------------| kālamuṣkakaśamyākakadalīpāribhadrakān||8|| aśvakarṇamahāvṛkṣapalāśāsphotavṛkṣakān| indravṛkṣārkapūtīkanaktamālāśvamārakān||9|| kākajaṅghāmapāmārgamagnimanthāgnitilvakān| sārdrān samūlaśākhādīn khaṇḍaśaḥ patikalpitān||10|| kośātakīścatasraśca śūkaṃ nālaṃ yavasya ca| nivāte nicayīkṛtya pṛthak tāni śilātale||11|| prakṣipya muṣkakacaye sudhāśmāni ca dīpayet| tatastilānāṃ kutalairdagdhvā'gnau vigate pṛthak||12|| kṛtvā sudhāśmanāṃ bhasma droṇaṃ tvitarabhasmanaḥ| muṣkakottaramādāya pratyekaṃ jalamūtrayoḥ||13|| gālayedardhabhāreṇa mahatā vāsasā ca tat| yāvatpicchhilaraktācchhastīkṣṇo jātastadā ca tam||14|| gṛhītvā kṣāraniṣyandaṃ pacellauhyāṃ vighaṭṭayan| pacyamāne tatastasmiṃstāḥ sudhābhasmaśarkarāḥ||15|| śuktīḥ kṣīrapakaṃ śaṅkhānābhīścāyasabhājane| kṛtvā'gnivarṇānbahuśaḥ kṣārotthe kuḍavonmite||16|| nirvāpya piṣṭvā tenaiva pratīvāpaṃ vinikṣipet| ślakṣṇaṃ śakṛddṛkṣaśikhigṛdhrakaṅkakapotajam||17|| catuṣpātpakṣipittālamanohvālavaṇāni ca| paritaḥ sutarāṃ cāto darvyā tamavaghaṭṭayet||18|| sabāṣpaiśca yadottiṣṭhedbudbudairlehavaddhanaḥ| avatārya tadā śīto yavarāśāvayomaye||19|| sthāpyo'yaṃ madhyamaḥ kṣāro--------------------| ------------------------------------------------|20|

-------------------na tu piṣṭvā kṣipenmṛdau| nirvāpyāpanayettīkṣṇe pūrvavat prativāpanam||20|| tathā lāṅgalikādanticitrakātiviṣāvacāḥ| svarjikākanakakṣīrihiṅgupūtīkapallavāḥ||21|| tālapatrī biḍaṃ ceti, saptarātrātparaṃ tu saḥ| yojyaḥ-----------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: iti kṣāratraividhyamuktvā tadviṣayaṃ nirdidikṣurāha- --------------------------------------------------------| tīkṣṇo'nilaśleṣmamedojeṣvarbudādiṣu||22||
madhyeṣveṣveva madhyo'nyaḥ pittāsragudajanmasu| balārthaṃ kṣīṇapānīye kṣārāmbu punarāvapet||23||
adhunā kṣāraguṇānāha---- nātitīkṣṇamṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchhilaḥ śīghragaḥ sitaḥ| śikharī sukhanirvāpyo na viṣyandī na cātiruk||24||
kṣāro daśaguṇaḥ śastratejasorapi karmakṛt| ācūṣanniva saṃrambhādgātramāpīḍayanniva||25||
sarvato'nusaran doṣānunmūlayati mūlataḥ| karma kṛtvā gatarujaḥ svayamevopaśāmyati||26||

div.ab: kṣārasādhye gade chhinne likhite srāvite'thavā| kṣāraṃ śalākayā dattvā plotaprāvṛtadehayā||27|| mātrāśatamupekṣeta------------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|28|
--------------------------tatrārśaḥsvāvṛtānanam| hastena yantraṃ kurvīta--------------------------|28|

ab.seg: nirbhujya picunā''cchhādya kṛṣṇabhāgaṃ vinikṣipet| padmapatratanuḥ kṣāralepo, ghrāṇārbudeṣu ca||29||

div.ab: pratyādityaṃ niṣaṇṇasya samunnamyāgranāsikām| mātrā vidhāryaḥ pañcāśat----------------------|30|

ab.seg: kṣāraṃ pramārjanenānu parimṛjyāvagamya ca| sudagdhaṃ ghṛtamadhvaktaṃ tatpayomastukāñjikaiḥ||31||
nirvāpayettataḥ sājyaiḥ svāduśītaiḥ pradehayet| abhiṣyandīni bhojyāni kledanāya ca||32||

div.ab: yadi ca sthiramūlatvātkṣāradagdhaṃ na śīryate| dhānyāmlabījayaṣṭyāhvatilairālepayettataḥ||33|| tilakalkaḥ samadhuko ghṛtākto vraṇaropaṇaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| atidagdhe sravedraktaṃ mūrcchhādāhajvarādayaḥ||35||
gude viśeṣādviṇmūtrasaṃrodho'tipravartanam| puṃstvopaghāto mṛtyurvā gudasya śātanāddhruvam||36||

div.ab: nāsāyāṃ nāsikāvaṃśadaraṇākuñcanodbhāvaḥ| bhavecca viṣayājñānam--------------------|37|

ab.seg: viśeṣādatra seko'mlairlepo madhu ghṛtaṃ tilāḥ| vātapittaharā ceṣṭā sarvaiva śiśirā kriyā||38||
amlo hi śītaḥ sparśena kṣārastenopasaṃhitaḥ| yātyāśu svādutāṃ tasmādamlairnirvāpayettarām||39||
(viṣagniśastrāśanimṛtyutulyaḥ kṣāro bhavedalpamatiprayuktaḥ| sa dhīmatā samyaganuprayukto rogānnihanyādicireṇa ghorān)||1||
agniḥ kṣārādapi śreṣṭhastaddagdhānāmasambhavāt| bheṣajakṣāraśastraiśca na siddhānāṃ prasādhanāt||40||

div.ab: tvaci māṃse sirāsnāyusandhyasthiṣu sa yujyate| ----------------------------------------------|41|
----------------------------------------------| maṣāṅgaglānimūrdhārtimanthakīlatilādiṣu||41|| tvagdāho vartigodantasūryakāntaśarādibhiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|42|
----------------------------------------------| arśobhagandaragranthināḍīduṣṭavraṇādiṣu||42|| māṃsadāho madhusnehajāmbavauṣṭhaguḍādibhiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: --------------------------na dahetkṣāravāritān| antaḥśalyāsṛjo bhinnakoṣṭhān bhūrivraṇāturān||44||

div.ab: sudagdhaṃ ghṛtamadhvaktaṃ snigdhaśītaiḥ pradehayet| ----------------------------------------------|45|
----------------------------------------------| tasya liṅgaṃ sthite rakte śabdavallasikānvitam||45|| pakvatālakapotābhaṃ surohaṃ nātivedanam| ----------------------------------------------|46|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pramādadagdhavatsarvaṃ durdagdhātyarthadagdhayoḥ||46||
--------------------------------tuchhasya lakṣaṇam| tvagvivarṇāṣyate'tyarthaṃ na ca sphoṭasamudbhavaḥ||47||

div.ab: -------------------------------------atidāhataḥ| māṃsalambanasaṅkocadāhadhūpanavedanāḥ||48|| sirādināśastṛṇmūrcchhāvraṇagāmbhīryamṛtyavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|49|

----------------------------------------------| tucchhasyāgnipratapanaṃ kāryamuṣṇaṃ ca bheṣajam||49|| styāne'stre vedanā'tyarthaṃ vilīne mandatā rujaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| durdagdhe śītamuṣṇaṃ ca yuñjyādādau tato himam||50||
samyagdagdhe tavakṣīriplakṣacandanagairikaiḥ| limpetsājyāmṛtairūrdhvaṃ pittavidradhivatkriyā||51||

div.ab: atidagdhe drutaṃ kuryātsarvaṃ pittavisarpavat| ----------------------------------------------|52|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| snehadagdhe bhṛśataraṃ rūkṣaṃ tatra tu yojayet||52||
(śastrakṣārāgnayo yasmānmṛtyoḥ paramamāyudham| apramatto bhiṣak tasmāttān samyagavacārayet)||1||

div.ab: samāpyate sthānamidaṃ hṛdayasya rahasyavat| atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ|53| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne kṣārāgnikarma- vidhirnāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|30|

div.head: garbhāvakrāntiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto garbhāvakrānti śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||
śuddhe śukrārtave satvaḥ svakarmakleśacoditaḥ| garbhaḥ sampadyate yuktivaśādagnirivāraṇau||1||
tadevaṃ garbhasya sampattimabhidhāya yathā tasya kukṣau vṛddhiḥ syāttathā vakti----bījātmakairmahābhūtaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ satvānugaiśca saḥ| mātuścāhārarasajaiḥ kramātkukṣau vivarddhate||2||

nanu, satvaḥ kukṣau praviṣṭo garbhasya varddhane heturuktaḥ, na cāsya praveśa upalabhyate, ityāha---- tejo yathā'rkaraśmīnāṃ sphaṭikena tiraskṛtam| nendhanaṃ dṛśyate gacchatsatvo garbhāśayaṃ tathā||3||

nanu, satvo bhūtānuga ekarūpa eva| tatkathamanekajātyākṛtyā naraturagoragagajagavayādimatyā''liṅgitaḥ sampadyate ? ityasmin paryanuyoga idamāha ---- kāraṇānuvidhāyitvātkāryāṇāṃ tatsvabhāvatā| nānāyonyākṛtīḥ satvo dhatte'to drutalohavat||4||

div.ab: tathā ---- ata eva ca śukrasya bāhulyājjāyate pumān| raktasya strī, tayoḥ sāmye klībaḥ- ----------|5|
sāmprataṃ yathā'nekagarbhatvaṃ tulyakālaṃ syāttathā pratipādayitumāha---- śukrārtave punaḥ||5|| vāyunā bahuśo bhinne yathāsvaṃ bahvapatyatā| ----------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: nanu, kathaṃ viyonayo vikṛtākārāśca garbhāḥ syuḥ ? ---- viyonivikṛtākārā jāyante vikṛtairmalaiḥ||6||
māsi māsi rajaḥ strīṇāṃ rasajaṃ stravati tryaham| vatsarādvādaśādūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam||7||
pūrṇaṣoḍaśavarṣā strī pūrṇaviṃśena saṅgatā| śuddhe garbhāśaye mārge rakte śukre'nile hṛdi||8||
vīryavantaṃ sutaṃ sūte tato nyūnābdayoḥ punaḥ| rogyalpāyuradhanyo vā garbho bhavati naiva vā||9||

div.ab: nanu, dampatyoḥ śukrārtavasaṃyoge'pi sati kvacidgarbhasambhūtirna dṛśyate| tatkathametat ? ityāśaṅkyedamāha ---- vātādikuṇapagranthipūyakṣīṇamalāhvayam| bījāsamarthaṃ retosram------------------|10|

----------------------------------------------| ----------------------svaliṅgairdoṣajaṃ vadet||10|| raktena kuṇapaṃ, śleṣmavātābhyāṃ granthisannibham| pūyābhaṃ raktapittābhyāṃ, kṣīṇaṃ mārutapittataḥ||11|| kṛcchrāṇyetānyasādhyaṃ tu tridoṣaṃ mūtraviṭprabham| ----------------------------------------------|12|
idānīmupakramamāha---- ------------------------------------------| kuryādvātādibhirduṣṭe svauṣadham---------------|12|

ab.seg: dhātakīpuṣpakhadiradāḍimārjunasādhitam| pāyayetsarpirathavā vipakvamasanādibhiḥ||13||

div.ab: sāmprataṃ granthisaṃjñe retasyupakramaṃ brūte---- palāśabhasmāśmabhidā granthyābhe---------------------| ----------------------------------------------|14|
saṃśuddho viṭprabhe sarpirhiṅgusevyādi(gni)sādhitam| pibet-----------------------------------------------|15|

ab.seg: vātadyārtaveṣu "svauṣadhaṃ kuryāt" (ślo.12) ityuktam| kuṇapagranthyadyārtaveṣu viśeṣeṇa cikitsāṃ vakṣyati ---- --------------------------------------------------| ---------granthyārtave pāṭhāvyoṣavṛkṣakajaṃ jalam||15||
peyaṃ kuṇapapūyāstre candanaṃ vakṣyate tu yat| guhyaroge ca tatsarvaṃ kāryaṃ sottarabastikam||16||

div.ab: bījāsamarthaṃ retostramabhidhāya sāmprataṃ śuddhaṃ yacchukrārtavaṃ bījasamarthaṃ tallakṣāṇārthamāha---- śukraṃ śuklaṃ guru snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ bahalaṃ bahu| ghṛtamākṣikatailābhaṃ sadgarbhāya ārtavaṃ punaḥ||17|| lākṣārasaśaśāstrābhaṃ dhautaṃ yacca virajyate| ----------------------------------------------|18|

śuddhaśukrārtavalakṣaṇamuktvā, idānīṃ garbhasambhavātpūrvamiti kartavyatāmāha---- -------------------------------------------------------| śuddhaśukrārtavaṃ svasthaṃ saṃraktaṃ mithunaṃ mithaḥ||18|| snehaiḥ puṃsavanaiḥ snigdhaṃ śuddhaṃ śīlitabastikam| -----------------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------------| naraṃ viśeṣātkṣīrājyairmadhurauṣadhasaṃskṛtaiḥ||19||

div.ab: nārīṃ tailena māṣaiśca pittalaiḥ samupācaret| -------------------------------------------------------|20|

ūrvoktasakalasāmagrīyuktādapi mithunādviśiṣṭakālamantareṇa garbhasyāsambhava iti strīmadhikṛtya tadgarbhagrahaṇayogyaṃ kālaṃ darśayitumāha---- ----------------------------------------------------| kṣāmaprasannavadanāṃ sphuracchroṇipayodharām||20|| svastākṣikukṣiṃ puṃskāmāṃ vidyādṛtumatīṃ striyam| -------------------------------------------------------|21|

"sarvaṃ ca hetumadbrūyāt" ityāgamaḥ, ata āha---- ----------------------------------------------------| padmaṃ saṅkocamāyāti dine'tīte yathā, tathā||21|| ṛtāvatīte yoniḥ, sā śukraṃ nātaḥ pratīcchati| -------------------------------------------------------|22|

vivṛtāvivṛtamukhatvaṃ hi yonergarbhagrahaṇāgrahaṇahetuḥ| tacca vāyoḥ kriyāvataḥ kālasahāyasyāyattamityāha ---- -------------------------------------------------------| māsenopacitaṃ raktaṃ dhamanībhyāmṛtau punaḥ||22|| īṣatkṛṣṇaṃ vigandhaṃ ca vāyuryonimukhānnudet| -------------------------------------------------------|23|

śuddhaṃ ca raktaṃ puṣpasaṃjñam, garbhākhyasya phalasya bhaviṣyato'bhivyañjakatvāt| ata evāha---- ----------------------------------------------------| tataḥ puṣpekṣaṇādeva kalyāṇadhyāyinī tryaham||23|| mṛjālaṅkārarahitā darbhasaṃstaraśāyinī| kṣaireyaṃ yāvakaṃ stokaṃ koṣṭhaśodhanakarṣaṇam||24|| parṇe śarāve haste vā bhuñjīta brahmacāriṇī| caturthe'hni tataḥ snātā śuklamālyāmbarā śuciḥ||25|| icchantī bhartṛsadṛśaṃ putraṃ paśyetpuraḥ patim| -------------------------------------------------------|26|

tatkiṃ tryahameva ṛtuḥ, atraiva puṣpadarśanāt| athottarakālamapi ? ityāśaṅkyāha---- -------------------------------------------------| ṛtustu dvādaśa niśāḥ pūrvāstisro'tra ninditāḥ||26|| ekādaśī ca, yugmāsu syātputro'nyāsu kanyakā| ----------------------------------------------------|27|

----------------------------------------------------| upādhyāyo'tha putrīyaṃ kurvīta vidhivadvidhim||27|| namaskāraparāyāstu śūdrāyā mantravarjitam| ----------------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| avandhya evaṃ saṃyogaḥ syādapatyaṃ ca kāmataḥ||28||

div.ab: ata evāha---- santo hyāhurapatyārthaṃ dampatyoḥ saṅgatiṃ rahaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: na cāpatyamātrāyetyāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| durapatyaṃ kulāṅgāro gotre jātaṃ mahatyapi||29||
icchetāṃ yādṛśaṃ putraṃ tadrūpacaritāṃśca tau| cintayetāṃ janapadāṃstadācāraparicchadau||30||
karmānte ca pumān sarpiḥkṣīraśālyodanāśitaḥ| prāgdakṣiṇena pādena śayayāṃ mauhūrtikājñayā||31||
ārohet strī tu vāmena tasya dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ| tailamāṣottarāhārā tatra mantraṃ prayojayet||32||

tadeva mantramaaha.... aum āhirasi āyurasi sarvataḥ pratiṣṭhāsi dhātā tvāṃ dadhātu vidhātā tvāṃ dadhātu brahmavarcasā bhaveti| brahmā bṛhaspatirviṣṇuḥ somaḥ sūryastathā'śvinau| bhago'tha mitrāvaruṇau vīraṃ dadatu me sutam||33||
sāntvayitvā tato'nyonyaṃ saṃviśetāṃ mudānvitau| uttānā tanmanā yoṣittiṣṭhedaṅgaiḥ susaṃsthitaiḥ||34||

div.ab: kimevaṃsati bhavati ? ityāha---- tathā hi bījaṃ gṛhṇāti doṣaiḥ svasthānamāsthitaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|35|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| liṅgaṃ tu sadyogarbhāyā yonyā bījasya saṅgrahaḥ||35||
tṛptirgurutvaṃ sphuraṇaṃ śukrāsrānanubandhanam| hṛdayaspandanaṃ tandrā tRḍglānirlomaharṣaṇam||36||
idānīṃ garbhasyāvasthāḥ pradarśayitumāha---- avyaktaḥ prathame māsi saptāhātkalalībhavet| garbhaḥ puṃsavanānyatra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ prayojayet||37||

div.ab: nanu, "śuddheśukrārtave satvaḥ svakarmakleśacoditaḥ| garbhaḥ sampadyate"(ślo.1) ityuktam| tatra yadi prākkṛtena karmaṇā strīgarbhaḥ kukṣimākṣiptastadā puruṣaprayatne satyapi puṃgarbhaḥ kartuṃ na śakyate| tasmātpuṃsavanamanarthakamevetyāśaṅkyāha---- balī puruṣakāro hi daivamapyativartate| ----------------------------------------------------|38|

adhunā puṃsavanādiprayogamāha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| puṣye puruṣakaṃ haimaṃ rājataṃ vā'thavā''yasam||38|| kṛtvā'gnivarṇaṃ nirvāpya kṣīre tasyañjaliṃ pibet| ----------------------------------------------------|39|

----------------------------------------------------| gauradaṇḍamapāmārgaṃ jīvakarṣabhasairyakān||39|| pibetpuṣye jale piṣṭānekadvitrisamastaśaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|40|

----------------------------------------------------| kṣīreṇa śvetabṛhatīmūlaṃ nāsāpuṭe svayam||40|| putrārthaṃ dakṣiṇe siñcedvāme duhitṛvāñchayā| ----------------------------------------------------|41|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| payasā lakṣmaṇāmūlaṃ putrotpādasthitipradam||41||
nāsayā''syena vā pītaṃ vaṭaśuṅgāṣṭakaṃ tathā| oṣadhīrjīvanīyāśca bāhyāntarupayojayet||42||
upacāraḥ priyahitairbhartrā bhṛtyaiśca garbhadhṛk| navanītaghṛtakṣīraiḥ sadā caināmupācaret||43||
ativyavāyamāyāsaṃ bhāraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ guru| akālajāgarasvapnaṃ kaṭhinotkaṭakāsanam||44||
śokakrodhabhayodvegavegaśraddhāvidhāraṇam| upavāsādhvatīkṣṇoṣṇaguruviṣṭambhibhojanam||45||
raktaṃ nivasanaṃ śvabhrakūpekṣāṃ madyamāmiṣam| uttānaśayanaṃ yacca striyo necchanti tattyajet||46||
tathā raktastrutiṃ śuddhiṃ bastimāmāsato'ṣṭamāt| ebhirgarbhaḥ stravedāmaḥ kukṣau śuṣyenmriyeta vā||47||
vātalaiśca bhavedgarbhaḥ kubjāndhajaḍavāmanaḥ| pittalaiḥ khalatiḥ piṅgaḥ śvitrī pāṇḍuḥ kaphātmabhiḥ||48||

div.ab: vyādhīṃścāsyā mṛdusukhairatīkṣṇairauṣadhairjayet| ----------------------------------------------------|49|

prathame māsyavyaktaliṅgaḥ kalalāvastho garbho bhavet| dvitīye tu māsi garbhaḥ kīdṛśaḥ syāt ? ityāha---- -----------------------------------------------------| dvitīye māsi kalalāddhanaḥ peśyathavā'rbudam||49|| puṃstrīklībāḥ kramāttebhyaḥ-------------------------| ----------------------------------------------------|50|

------------------------tatra vyaktasya lakṣaṇam| kṣāmatā garimā kukṣermūrcchā cchardirarocakaḥ||50|| jṛmbhā prasekaḥ sadanaṃ romarājyāḥ prakāśanam| amleṣṭatā stanau pīnau sastanyau kṛṣṇacūcukau||51|| pādaśopho vidāho'nye śraddhāśca vividhātmikāḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|52|

garbhiṇyāśca śraddhāsūtpannāsu kimapathyaṃ tasyai deyaṃ na vā ? ityevaṃ saṃdehe tadyudāsārthamāha---- -----------------------------------------------------| mātṛjaṃ hyasya hṛdayaṃ mātuśca hṛdayena tat||52|| sambaddhaṃ tena garbhiṇyā neṣṭaṃ śraddhāvimānanam| ----------------------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: tadarthamāha---- -------------------------------------------------| deyamapyahitaṃ tasyai hitopahitamalpakam||53||

div.ab: nanu, yadyahitaṃ tatkasmāddīyate ? ityāha ---- śraddhāvighātādgarbhasya vikṛtiścyutireva vā| ----------------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: mūrddhā dve sakthinī bāhū sarvasūkṣmāṅgajanma ca| samameva hi mūrddhādyairjñānaṃ ca sukhaduḥkhayoḥ||55||
atra mātrā'bhyavahṛtābhyāmannapānābhyāṃ kathaṃ garbho varddhate ? ityāha ---- garbhasya nābhau mātuśca hṛdi nāḍī nibadhyate| yayā sa puṣṭimāpnoti kedāra iva kulyayā||56||

div.ab: caturthe vyaktatā'ṅgānāṃ, cetanāyāśca pañcame| ----------------------------------------------------|57|
sarvaiḥ sarvāṅgasampūrṇo bhāvaiḥ puṣyati saptame| ----------------------------------------------------|58|

ab.seg: garbheṇotpīḍitā doṣāstasmin hṛdayamāśritāḥ| kaṇḍūṃ vidāhaṃ kurvanti garbhiṇyāḥ kikkisāni ca||58||

div.ab: navanītaṃ hitaṃ tatra kolāmbumadhurauṣadhaiḥ| siddhamalpapaṭusnehaṃ laghu svādu ca bhojanam||59|| candanośīrakalkena limpedūrustanodaram| śreṣṭhayā vaiṇahariṇaśaśaśoṇitayuktayā||60|| aśvaghnapatrasiddhena tailenābhyajya mardayet| paṭolanimbamañjiṣṭhāsurasaiḥ secayetpunaḥ||61|| dārvīmadhukatoyena mṛjāṃ ca pariśīlayet| ----------------------------------------------------|62|

ab.seg: idānīmaṣṭame māsi garbhasvarūpaṃ tatretikartavyatāṃ cācaṣṭe---- -------------------------------------------------| ojo'ṣṭame sañcarati mātāputrau muhuḥ kramāt||62||
tena tau mlānamuditau tatra jāto na jīvati| śiśurojonavasthānānnārī saṃśayitā bhavet||63||
kṣīrapeyā ca peyā'tra saghṛtā'nvāsanaṃ ghṛtam| madhuraiḥ sādhitaṃ śuddhyai purāṇaśakṛtastathā||64||
śuṣkamūlakakolāmlakaṣāyeṇa praśasyate| śatāhvākalkito bastiḥ satailaghṛtasaindhavaḥ||65||

div.ab: tasmiṃstvekāhayāte'pi kālaḥ sūterataḥ param| ----------------------------------------------------|66|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| varṣādvikārakārī syātkukṣau vātena dhāritaḥ||66||
śastaśca navame māsi snigdho māṃsarasaudanaḥ| bahusnehā yavāgūrvā pūrvoktaṃ cānuvāsanam||67||
tata eva picuṃ cāsyā yonau nityaṃ nidhāpayet| vātaghnapatrabhaṅgāmbhaḥ śītaṃ snāne'nvahaṃ hitam||68||

div.ab: niḥsnehāṅgī na navamānmāsātprabhṛti vāsayet| ----------------------------------------------------|69|

ab.seg: idānīṃ garbhiṇyā yairlakṣaṇairavyabhicāribhiḥ putraduhitṛnapuṃsakayamakaprasavo'numīyate, tānyāha ---- ------------------------------------------------| prāgdakṣiṇastanastanyā pūrvaṃ tatpārśvaceṣṭinī||69||
punnāmadaurhṛdapraśnaratā puṃsvapnadarśinī| unnate dakṣiṇe kukṣau garbhe ca parimaṇḍale||70||
putraṃ sūte'nyathā kanyāṃ yā cecchati nṛsaṅgatim| nṛtyavāditragāndharvagandhamālyapriyā ca yā||71||

div.ab: idānīm ṣaṇḍhaprasavalakṣaṇamāha---- klībaṃ tatsaṅkare, tatra madhyaṃ kukṣeḥ samunnatam| ----------------------------------------------------|72|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| yamau pārśvadvayonnāmātkukṣau droṇyāmiva sthite||72||
prāk caiva navamānmāsāt sā sūtigṛhamāśrayet| deśe praśaste sambhāraiḥ sampannaṃ sādhake'hani||73||
idānīmāsannaprasavāyā lakṣaṇamāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| adyaśvaḥprasave glāniḥ kukṣyakṣiślathatā klamaḥ||74||
adhogurutvamaruciḥ praseko bahumūtratā| vedanorūdarakaṭīpṛṣṭhahṛdvastivaṅkṣaṇe||75||
yonibhedarujātodasphuraṇasravaṇāni ca| āvīnāmanu janmātastato garbhodakastrutiḥ||76||

div.ab: athopasthitagarbhāṃ tāṃ kṛtakautukamaṅgalām| hastasthapunnāmaphalāṃ svabhyaktoṣṇāmbusecitām||77|| pāyayetsaghṛtāṃ peyāṃ-----------------------------| ----------------------------------------------------|78|

-------------------------tanau bhūśayane sthitām| ābhugnasakthimuttānāmabhyaktāṅgīṃ punaḥ punaḥ||78|| adho nābhervimṛdnīyātkārayejjṛmbhacaṅkramam| ----------------------------------------------------|79|

kimevamanuṣṭhite sati bhavati ? ityāha---- -------------------------------------------------| garbhaḥ prayātyavāgevaṃ, talliṅgaṃ hṛdvimokṣataḥ||79|| āviśya jaṭharaṃ garbho basterupari tiṣṭhati| ----------------------------------------------------|80|

ab.seg: āvyo'bhitvarayantyenāṃ khaṭvāmāropayettataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------||80||
atha sampīḍite garbhe yonimasyāḥ prasārayet| mṛdu pūrvaṃ pravāheta bāḍhamāprasavācca sā||81||

div.ab: harṣayettāṃ muhuḥ putrajanmaśabdajalānilaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|82|

ab.seg: atha kiṃ harṣādyutpādanena syāt ? ityāha---- ------------------------------------------------| pratyāyānti tathā prāṇāḥ sūtikleśāvasāditāḥ||82||
dhūpayedgarbhasaṅge tu yoniṃ kṛṣṇāhikañcukaiḥ| hiraṇyapuṣpīmūlaṃ ca pāṇipādena dhārayet||83||
suvarcalāṃ viśalyāṃ vā jarāyvapatane'pi ca| kāryametattathotkṣipya bāhvorenāṃ vikampayet||84||
kaṭīmākoṭayetpārṣṇyā sphijau gāḍhaṃ nipīḍayet| tālukaṇṭhaṃ spṛśedveṇyā mūrdhni dadyātsnuhīpayaḥ||85||
bhūrjalāṅgalikītumbīsarpatvakkuṣṭhasarṣapaiḥ| pṛthagdvābhyāṃ samastairvā yonilepanadhūpanam||86||
kuṣṭhatālīsakalkaṃ vā surāmaṇḍena pāyayet| yūṣeṇa vā kulatthānāṃ bālvajenāsavena vā||87||
śatāhvāsarṣapājājīśigrutīkṣṇakacitrakaiḥ| sahiṅgukuṣṭhamadanairmūtre kṣīre ca sārṣapam||88||
tailaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ pāyau yonyāṃ vā'pyanuvāsanam| śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhakaṇāsarṣakalkitaḥ||89||
nirūhaḥ pātayatyāśu sasnehalavaṇo'parām| tatsaṅge hyanilo hetuḥ sā niryātyāśu tajjayāt||90||
----------------------------------------------------| muktagarbhāparāṃ yoniṃ tailenāṅgaṃ ca mardayet||91||

div.ab: makkallākhye śirobastikoṣṭhaśūle tu pāyayet| sucūrṇitaṃ yavakṣāraṃ ghṛtenoṣṇajalena vā||92|| dhānyāmbu vā guḍavyoṣatrijātakarajonvitam| ----------------------------------------------------|93|

ab.seg: sūtikā kṣudvatī tailāddhṛtādvā mahatīṃ pibet| pañcakolakinīṃ mātrāmanu coṣṇaṃ guḍodakam||94||
vātaghnauṣadhatoyaṃ vā, tathā vāyurna kupyati| viśudhyati ca duṣṭāsraṃ dvitrirātramayaṃ kramaḥ||95||
snehāyogyā tu niḥsnehamamumeva vidhiṃ bhajet| pītavatyāśca jaṭharaṃ yamakāktaṃ viveṣṭayet||96||

div.ab: jīrṇe snātā pibetpeyāṃ pūrvoktauṣadhasādhitām| tryahādūrdhvaṃ vidāryādivargakvāthena sādhitā||97|| hitā yavāgūḥ snehāḍhyā sātmyataḥ payasā'thavā| saptarātrātparaṃ cāsyai kramaśo bṛṃhaṇaṃ hitam||98|| dvādaśāhe'natikrānte piśitaṃ nopayojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|99|

----------------------------------------------------| yatnenopacaretsūtāṃ duḥsādhyo hi tadāmayaḥ||99|| garbhavṛddhiprasavarukkledāsrasrutipīḍanaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|100|

----------------------------------------------------| evaṃ ca māsādadhyardhānmuktāhārādiyantraṇā|100| gatasūtābhidhānā syātpunarārtavadarśanāt| 100 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye śārīrasthāne garbhāvakrāntirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|1|

div.head: garbhavyāpadvidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: garbhāvakrāntiśārīrādanantaraṃ garbhavyāpadaṃ śārīramārabhyate| garbhasya vyāpatpratīkāravijñānārthamāha---- athāto garbhavyāpadaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: garbhiṇyāḥ parihāryāṇāṃ sevayā rogato'tha vā| puṣpedṛṣṭe'thavā śūle bāhyāntaḥ snigdhaśītalam||1||
sevyāmbhojahimakṣīrivalkakalkājyalepitān| dhārayedyonibastibhyāmārdrārdrān picunaktakān||2||
