dvātriṃśacchroṇyā gudameḍhrāśrayāḥ| tāsāṃ dve dve vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ kaṭīkataruṇayoścetyaṣṭau śastrato rakṣet|2| caturviṃśatiḥ pṛṣṭhe| tāsāṃ pṛṣṭhavaṃśamubhayato dve dve ūrdhva- gāminyau tāścatasraḥ|2| caturviṃśatirudare| tāṃsāṃ meḍhrasyopari romarājīmubhayato dve dve tā api catasraḥ||2||
catvāriṃśadvakṣasi| tāsāṃ dve hṛdaye| dve ca stanamūlastanarohiteṣu| ekaikāpastambhāpāleṣviti| tāścaturdaśa||7||
caturviṃśatirgrīvāyām| tāsāṃ catasro'ṣṭau ca marmasaṃjñāḥ| dve kṛkāṭikayoḥ| dve vidhurayoriti ṣoḍaśa śastreṇa na spṛśet||4||
hanvoḥ ṣoḍaśa tāsāṃ sandhisambandhinyau dve||1||
ṣoḍaśa jihvāyām| tāsāmadho dve rasavedinyau| dve vāvākpravarttinyau| tāścatasraḥ||4||
ṣaṭpañcāśannetrayoḥ| tayorunmeṣanimeṣakriye dve-dve| dve cāpāṅgayoriti ṣaṭ| nāsānetragatāstu lalāṭe ṣaṣṭiḥ| tāsāṃ keśāntānugatāścatasraḥ| dve cā''vartayoḥ| ekā ca sthapanyāmiti sapta||7||
karṇayoḥ ṣoḍaśa| tāsāṃ śabdavāhinyau dve| ta eva ca śaṅkhayostāsāṃ śaṅkhasandhigate dve||3||
dvādaśa mūrdhani| tāsāmutkṣepayordve| sīmanteṣvekaikāmekāmadhipatāvityaṣṭau śastreṇa pariharet| tathākṣudrikāḥ kuṭilāḥ saṅkīrṇāḥ granthitāḥ sandhiṣu cāśastrakṛtyāḥ||4||
tāsāṃ yathāsvaṃ turyāṃśavibhāgena pañcasaptatyadhikaṃ śatamanilaraktaṃ vahati| eṣa vibhāgaḥ pittaśleṣmaśuddharakteṣvapi| sthitā hyevaṃ dehamanugṛhṇanti doṣāḥ| vyatyayena tu pīḍayanti||9||

tatra śyāvāruṇāḥ praspandinyaḥ sūkṣmāḥ kṣaṇapūrṇariktā vātaraktaṃ vahanti|1| nīlapītāsitāḥ sparśoṣṇāḥ kṣiprasrāviṇyaḥ pittaraktam|1| gauryyaḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ śītaḥ kaṇḍūmatyaḥ kapharaktam|1| lakṣaṇasaṅkare saṃsargasannipātaraktam||1||
samāgūḍhāḥ snigdhāḥ rohiṇyaḥ śuddharaktamiti||10||
dhamanyastu caturviṃśatiḥ||11||
tābhiḥ kāyo'yamārāma iva jalahāriṇībhiḥ kedāra iva kulyābhirupasnihyati||1||
tābhiśca nābhiścakranābhirārakairivāvṛtā||12||

div.ab: tasyāṃ nābhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa prāṇā vyavasthitāḥ| yataśca sā'ntaragnyadhiṣṭhānam|13|

ab.seg: tasyāṃ nābhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa prāṇā vyavasthitāḥ| yataśca sā'ntaragnyadhiṣṭhānam||13||
tāsāṃ khalu dhamanīnāṃ daśordhvaṃ prasṛtā daśādhaścatasrastiryyak| tatastābhiryathāsvamaṅgāvayavā dhāryyante āpayāyyante ca||14||

tāsāmūrdhvagā hṛdayamabhiprapannāḥ pratyekaṃ tridhā jāyante| tatastriṃśato madhye dve dve vātapittakapharaktarasān vahataḥ| aṣṭābhiḥ śabdarūparasagandhā gṛhyante| dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ bhāṣate ghoṣaṃ karoti svapiti pratibudhyate ca| dve cāśru vahataḥ| dve ca stanāśrite| nāryāḥ stanyaṃ narasya śukram||15||

adhogamāḥ pakvāśayasthā evaṃ tridhā jāyante| tatra daśādyāḥ pūrvavat| dve vahato'nnaṃ mātrāśrayeṇa| dve toyam| dve mūtram| dve śukram vahato dve ca muñcataḥ| ta eva nārīṇāmārttavam| dve varconirasinyau sthūlāntrapratibaddhe| evaṃ dvādaśa| śeṣā- stvaṣṭau dhamanyastiraścīnāḥ svedamabhitarpayanti||16||
tiryaggāminyaścatasro bhidyamānāḥ subahudhā bhavantītyuktaṃ prāk||17||
srotāṃsi puṃsāṃ nava karṇau netre nāsāpuṭau mukhaṃ pāyurmūtrapathaḥ||18||
anyāni ca trīṇi strīṇāṃ stanau raktapathaśca||19||
tathā'parāṇyantassrotāṃsi jīvitāyatanāni trayodaśa prāṇodakānnadhātumalānāmayanāni||20||
tatra prāṇavāhināṃ hṛdayaṃ mūlaṃ mahāsrotaśca||21||
tāni dhātukṣayaraukṣyapipāsākṣudvyāyāmavegadhāraṇādibhirduṣyanti||22||
tato'tisṛṣṭaṃ pratibaddhamalpālpamabhīkṣṇaṃ vā saśabdaśūlamucchvasanam| tatra śvāsavatsādhanam||23||
udakavāhināṃ tālu mūlaṃ kloma ca|1| tānyāmabhayātipānoṣṇaśuṣkānnakaṣāyatṛṇanigrahādibhirduṣyanti||1||
tato'titṛṣṇā mukhaśoṣaḥ karṇakṣveḍanaṃ tamodarśanañca| duṣṭodakavahasrotassu cikitsā||2||
tatra tṛṣṇoktamauṣadham||24||
annavāhināmāmāśayo mūlaṃ vāmapārśvañca||1||
teṣāṃ duṣṭau sarvaṃ mātrāśitīyoktamavagacchet||25||

rasavāhināṃ hṛdayaṃ mūlaṃ daśa dhamanyaśca|1| raktavāhināṃ yakṛt plīhā ca|1| māṃsavāhināṃ snāyūni tvak ca|1| medovāhināṃ vṛkkau māṃsaṃ ca|1| asthivāhināṃ jaghanaṃ medaśca|1| majjavāhināṃ parvāṇyasthīni ca|1| śukravāhināṃ stanau muṣkau majjā ca|1| mūtravāhināṃ bastirvaṅkṣaiṇā ca|1| śakṛdvāhināṃ pakvāśayaḥ sthūlāntraṃ ca|1| svedavāhināṃ medo romakūpāśca||1||
teṣāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ vividhamahitāhāravihāramupadravān pṛthakpṛthak sādhanaṃ doṣādivijñānīyādyathāsvaṃ vṛddhikṣayalakṣaṇena lakṣayet||26||
vyadhe tu srotasāṃ bhramamohakampapralāpādhmānaśūlā'rucitṛṭchardijvarātirudhirasrutimūtrapurīṣarodhā maraṇañca||27||
tasmātsrotoviddhaṃ pratyākhyāyopacaret||28||
uddhṛtaśalyaṃ ca sadyovraṇavidhānena||29||
tatra srotasāmeva viśeṣāḥ sirādhamanyaḥ||30||
anye tvanyatvamicchanti sirādhamanīsrotasām| kevalaṃ parasparasannikarṣāt sadṛśakarmatvāt saukṣmyācca vibhaktakarmaṇāmapyavibhāga iva lakṣyate||31||

apare punarāhuḥ-srotāṃsi sirādhamanyo rasavāhinyo nāḍyaḥ panthāno'yanāni mārgāḥ śarīracchidrāṇi saṃvṛ tāsaṃvṛtāni sthānānyāśayāḥ kṣayā niketāśceti śarīre dhātvavakāśānāṃ lakṣyālakṣyāṇāṃ nāmānīti||32||
te cāvakāśāḥ prakupitāḥ sthānasthān mārgasthāṃśca dhātūn prakopayanti| te'pi kupitāstāni srotāṃsi srotāṃsi ca srotāṃsi| dhātavaśca dhātūn||3||
teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva dūṣayitāro duṣṭā doṣāḥ|1| te ca prāyaśo duṣyantyagnidoṣāt|1| tasmāttannimittānyāyurārogyabalopacayavarṇaujāṃsi|1| tatpratibaddhānyeva ca rañjakādīni bhūtāgnayo dhātvagnayaśca||1||
tathā'nnamapi pittenaiva pakvamamṛtatāṃ yātyapakvaṃ ca viṣatām||33||
tatra pittaviśeṣaḥ pācakasaṃjño'gniriti prāgabhihitaḥ||1||
anye punarācakṣate-doṣadhātumalasannipātajanito'ntaruṣmā yathānirdiṣṭādhiṣṭhānakarmāgniriti||35||

sa khalu vidhivadabhyavahṛtamannajātaṃ prāṇena vāyunā koṣṭhamākṛṣṭaṃ dravairvibhinnasaṅghātaṃ snehena mṛdūkṛtamabhisandhukṣitaḥ samānenāmāśayasthaṃ sthālīsthamivāmbutaṇḍulamagnirantaragniḥ pacati||36||
tattu sarvarasamapi pacyamānamādau madhurībhūtaṃ kaphaṃ phenībhūtamudīrayati| tato vidagdhamamlībhūtamāmāśayāt cyavamānamacchaṃ pittam| prāpya ca pakvāśayaṃ kaṭukībhūtamanilam||37||

tataścaivaṃ viklinnaṃ āhāre pañca pañcātmakā mahābhūtāgnayo vāyunā vyastān yathāsvaṃ pañcaiva bhūtaguṇānāhārasthān pacanti| te pakvāḥ punaryathāsvameva dehāśritāṃśca svavikārabhūtān bhūtaguṇānāpyāyayanti||38||
evañca pakvādāhārādvividhauṣadhagarbhādiva snehādacchaḥ sārabhūto rasākhyaḥ kiṭṭākhyaśca malo'bhinirvartate||39||
tābhyāñca sāramalābhyāṃ tadātmakānāmeva śarīraguṇānāṃ dhātvākhyānāṃ yathāsvaṃ srotāṃsi pāramparyyeṇāvicchinnasantānamāpūryyante||40||
srotobhyaśca yathāvibhāgaṃ yathāyathameva dhātavaḥ puṣyanti||1||

uttarottarānupraveśe'pi ca purveṣāṃ srotasāṃ yathākālaṃ samyagāhāropayogena pariṇāmavatāpyāyyamānānāṃ nāpacayo bhavati| tataśca dhātvākhyāḥ prasādamalāḥ svaṃ svameva mānamanuvartante yathāvayaḥśarīram||42||

tatrā''hāraraso vyānavikṣipto yathāsvaṃ saptasu dhātvagniṣu kramāt pacyamānaḥ svātmabhāvapracyutisamanantarameva prāptaraktādidhātusaṃjñakaḥ kālavadaskhalitabalapramāṇo dehamūrjayitvā dhātūn dhātumalāṃśca puṣṇāti||43||
athānnakiṭṭamacchaṃ mūtraṃ ghanaṃ śakṛt||44||
rasasya sāro raktaṃ malaḥ kapho lasīkā ca||1||

raktasya sāro māṃsaṃ kaṇḍarāḥ sirāśca| malaḥ pittam|2| māṃsasya sāro medastvaco vasā ca| kiṭṭaṃ karṇākṣināsikāsyaromakūpaprajananamalāḥ|2| medasaḥ sāro'sthisnāyusandhayaḥ| kiṭṭaṃ svedaḥ|2| asthnaḥ sāro majjā| kiṭṭaṃ keśaromanakhāḥ||2||
majjñastu sāraḥ śukraṃ malo'kṣiviṭtvacāṃ snehaḥ||45||
śukrasya sāramojaḥ| atyantaśuddhatayā'sya malābhāvaḥ| anye punarata eva tasya necchanti pākam| apare punaḥ śukrasāraṃ garbhamevāmananti||46||
vāyuḥ punaragnerāhārasya ca bahvalpatayā tasmāttasmānmūrcchanāviśeṣādamūrttaḥ śabdavānīṣacchabdaḥ pracuro'lpo vā pañcātmā koṣṭhe prādurbhavati||47||

evaṃ ca kṛtvā'nnamayā eva dehe sarve bhāvāḥ| tenaiva cedamevaṃ cireṇa vyāptamantarbahiḥ śarīrayantramanavaratapravāheṇa svāsthyabalopacayayuktaṃ yāvat karmopādānaṃ yāpyate| anyathā tvannarasokṣepaṇādvibaddhasrotasā vā yathāvadana- bhisandhīyamānadhātupravāhamantarā vyavacchidyate| vyādhi bhājanaṃ vā bhavati||48||

anye tu varṇayanti-abhyavahṛtamātrasyāhā''rasya kaṇṭhanāḍīpraluṭhitasya mahānimnamavatīrṇasya yo ya evāṃśaḥ kāyāgninā'valīḍhaḥ pākamupanīyate tasya tasyaiva prasādākhyo rasaleśo'bhinirvṛttisamanantaraṃ samaṃ samastadhātuṣu saṃvṛtāsaṃvṛtaiḥ pravisṛto vivṛtamukheṣvāsanneṣu srotassu bhūyān prathamataraṃ cānveti| paryyāyeṇetareṣvapi| evamannarasa eva sākṣātsarvadhātūn kenacideva kālabhedena puṣṇāti na punardhātavo dhātvantaratāṃ svarūpopamardena pratipadyanta iti||49||
agnistu balabhedena caturvidho bhavati| samo viṣamastīkṣṇo mandaśca||2||
tatra samo yaḥ samyagevopayuktamannaṃ samyak pacati|1| viṣamo'samyagapyapayuktaṃ pacati samyagapi ca na pacati||1||
tīkṣṇo'samyagapyupayuktamāśu pacati| sa eva vardhamāno 'tyagnirbhavati||2||
mandastu samyagapyupayuktamudaragauravādhmānavibandhāṭopāntrakūjanamukhaśoṣavāyustambhādīnyāmaliṅgāni darśayitvā cirāt pacati||1||
bāhyenāpi ca jvālāṅgārātmakenāgninā naikākāraḥ sarvadā pāko bhavati| kimutāntarāśrayeṇoṣṇātmanā samenāpi| tasmāt taṃ prayatnato rakṣet||50||
tatra pravareṇa sātmyena samaṃ yathāsvamapareṇetarān kramaśaḥ sātmyamāpādya pravareṇa paripālayeddoṣopakramaṇiyoktena ca vātādisādhanena grahaṇīrogavihitaiścauṣadhavyāyāmamayogairiti||51||

bhavati cātra- svadhātusamavarṇāni vṛttasthūlānyaṇūni ca| srotāṃsi dīrghāṇyākṛtyā pratānasadṛśāni ca| srotodūṣakaḥ āhāraḥ vihāraśca āhāraśca vihāraśca yaḥ syāddoṣaguṇaiḥ samaḥ| dhātubhirviguṇo yaśca srotasāṃ sa pradūṣakaḥ| srotoduṣṭilakṣaṇam atipravṛttiḥ saṅgo vā sirāṇāṃ granthayo'pi vā| vimārgato vā gamanaṃ srotasāṃ duṣṭilakṣaṇam||52||
bisānāmiva sūkṣmāṇi dūraṃ viprasṛtāni ca| dvārāṇi srotasāṃ dehe raso yairupacīyate||53||
kecidāhurahorātrāt ṣaḍahādapare pare| māsāt prayāti śukratvamannaṃ pākakramādibhiḥ| vṛvyādīni prabhāveṇa sadyaḥ śukrādi kurvate| prāyaḥ karotyahorātrāt karmānyadapi bheṣajam||54||
kaphaḥ pittaṃ malaḥ kheṣu prasvedo nakharoma ca| sneho'kṣitvagviśāmojo dhātūnāṃ kramaśo malāḥ||55||

div.ab: śānte'gnau mriyate yukte ciraṃ jīvatyanāmayaḥ| rogī syādvikṛte tasmāttaṃ prayatnena pālayet|57|

div.head: dūtādivijñānīyodhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dūtādivijñānīyaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre||2||
pākhaṇḍāśramavarṇānāṃ savarṇāḥ karmasiddhaye| ta eva viparītāḥ syurdūtāḥ karmavipattaye||1||

div.ab: dīnaṃ bhītaṃ drutaṃ trastaṃ rūkṣāmaṅgalavādinam| śastriṇaṃ daṇḍinaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ muṇḍaśmaśrujaṭādharam||2|| amaṅgalāhvayaṃ krūrakarmāṇaṃ malinaṃ striyam| anekaṃ vyādhitaṃ vyaṅgaṃ raktamālyānulepanam||3|| tailapaṅkāṅkitaṃ jīrṇavivarṇārdraikavāsasam| kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍhaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭādimardinam||4|| nānugaccedbhiṣagdūtamāhvayantaṃ ca dūrataḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|5|

---------------------------------------------------| aśastacintāvacane nagne cindati bhindati||5|| juhvāne pāvakaṃ piṇḍān pittṛbhyo nirvapatyapi| supte muktakace'bhyakte rudatyaprayate tathā||6|| vaidye dūtā manuṣyāṇāmāgaccanti mumūrṣatām| ---------------------------------------------------|7|

---------------------------------------------------| spṛśanto nābhināsāsyakeśaromanakhadvijān||8|| guhyapṛṣṭhastanagrīvājaṭharānāmikāṅgulīḥ| kārpāsabusasīsāsthikapālamuśalopalam||9|| mārjanīśūrpacailāntabhasmāṅgāradaśātuṣān| rajjūpānattulāpāśamanyadvā bhagnavicyutam||10|| tatpūrvadarśane dūtā vyāharanti mariṣyatām| ---------------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------------| tathā'rdharātre madhyāhne sandhyayoḥ parvavāsare||11||
ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīnavamīrāhuketūdayādiṣu| bharaṇīkṛttikā''śleṣāpūrvā''rdrāpaitryanaiṝte||12||
yasmiṃśca dūte bruvati vākyamāturasaṃśrayam| paśyennimittamaśubhaṃ taṃ ca nānuvrajedbhiṣak||13||
kim tadaśubhaṃ nimittam ? ityāha ---- tadyathā vikalaḥ pretaḥ pretālaṅkāra eva vā| cinnaṃ dagdhaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā tadvādīni vacāṃsi vā||14||
raso vā kaṭukastīvro gandho vā kauṇapo mahān| sparśo vā vipulaḥ krūro yadvā'nyadapi tādṛśam||15||
tatsarvamabhito vākyaṃ vākyakāle'thavā punaḥ| dūtamabhyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nāturaṃ tamupācaret||16||

div.ab: athānyadapyaśubhaṃ nimittamāha---- hāhākranditamutkruṣṭamākruṣṭaṃ skhalanaṃ kṣutam| vastrātapatrapādatravyasanaṃ vyasanīkṣaṇam||17|| caityadhvajānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ pūrṇānāṃ ca nimajjanam| hatāniṣṭapravādāśca dūṣaṇaṃ bhasmapāṃsubhiḥ||18|| pathaḥccedo'himārjāragodhāsaraṭhavānaraiḥ| dīptāṃ prati diśaṃ vācaḥ krūrāṇāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām||19|| kṛṣṇadhānyaguḍodaśvillavaṇāsavacarmaṇām| sarṣapāṇāṃ vasātailatṛṇapaṅkendhanasya ca||20|| klībakrūraśvapākānāṃ jālavāgurayorapi| carditasya purīṣasya pūtidurdarśanasya ca||21|| niḥsārasya vyavāyasya kārpāsāderarerapi| śayanāsanayānānāmuttānānāṃ tu darśanam||22|| nyubjānāmitareṣāṃ ca pātrādīnāmaśobhanam| -----------------------------------------------|23|

-----------------------------------------------------------| puṃsaṃjñāḥ pakṣiṇo vāmāḥ strīsaṃjñā dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ||23|| pradakṣiṇaṃ khagamṛgā yanto, naivaṃ śvajambukāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: praśastāḥ kīrtane kolagodhāhiśaśajāhakāḥ| na darśane na virute, vānararkṣāvato'nyathā||26||
dhanuraindraṃ ca lālāṭamaśubhaṃ, śubhamanyataḥ| agnipūrṇāni pātrāṇi bhinnāni viśikhāni ca||27||
vaidyasyāturagṛhapraveśe śubhāśubhasūcakāni nimittānyāha---- dadhyakṣatādi nirgacchadvakṣyamāṇaṃ ca maṅgalam| vaidyo mariṣyatāṃ veśma praviśanneva paśyati||28||
dūtādyasādhu dṛṣṭvaivaṃ tyajedārtamato'nyathā| karuṇāśuddhasantāno yatnatastamupācaret||29||
atha tadeva dadhyakṣatādyāha---- dadhyakṣatekṣuniṣpāvapriyaṅgumadhusarpiṣām| yāvakāñjanabhṛṅgāraghaṇṭādīpasaroruhām||30||
dūrvārdramatsyamāṃsānāṃ lājānāṃ phalabhakṣayoḥ| ratnebhapūrṇakumbhānāṃ kanyāyāḥ syandanasya ca||31||
narasya vardhamānasya devatānāṃ nṛpasya ca| śuklānāṃ sumanovālacāmarāmbaravājinām||32||
śaṅkhasādhudvijoṣṇīṣatoraṇasvastikasya ca| bhūmeḥ samuddhatāyāśca vahneḥ prajvalitasya ca||33||
manojñasyānnapānasya pūrṇasya śakaṭasya ca| nṛbhirdhenvāḥ savatsāyā vaḍāvāYāḥ striyā api||34||
jīvañjīvakasāraṅgasārasapriyavādinām| haṃsānāṃ śatapatrāṇāṃ baddhasyaikapaśostathā||35||
rucakādarśasiddhārtharocanānāṃ ca darśanam| gandhaḥ susurabhirvarṇaḥ suśuklo madhuro rasaḥ||36||
gopateranukūlasya svanastadvadgavāmapi| mṛgapakṣinarāṇāṃ ca śobhināṃ śobhanā giraḥ||37||
chatradhvajapatākānāmutkṣepaṇamabhiṣṭutiḥ| bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāṃ śabdāḥ puṇYāhaniḥsvanāḥ||38||
vedādhyayanaśabdāśca sukho vāyuḥ pradakṣiṇaḥ| pathi veśmapraveśe ca vidyādārogyalakṣaṇam||39||

div.ab: ityuktaṃ dūtaśakunaṃ svapnānūrdhvaṃ pracakṣate| ---------------------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: -----------------------mahiṣaśvarāhoṣṭragardabhaiḥ| yaḥ prayāti diśaṃ yāmyāṃ maraṇaṃ tasya yakṣmaṇā||42||

div.ab: latā kaṇṭakinī vaṃśastālo vā hṛdi jāyate| yasya tasyāśu gulmena-----------------------|43|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| sūryācandramasoḥ pātadarśanaṃ dṛgvināśanam||48||

div.ab: mūrdhni vaṃśalatādīnāṃ sambhavo vayasāṃ tathā| nilayo muṇḍatā kākagṛdhrādyaiḥ parivāraṇam||49|| tathā pretapiśācastrīdraviḍāndhragavāśanaiḥ| saṅgo vetralatāvaṃśatṛṇakaṇṭakasaṅkaṭe||50|| śvabhraśmaśānaśayanaṃ patanaṃ pāṃsubhasmanoḥ| majjanaṃ jalapaṅkādau śīghreṇa srotasā hṛtiḥ||51|| nṛtvavāditragītāni raktasragvastradhāraṇam| vayoṅgavṛddhirabhyaṅgo vivāhaḥ śmaśrukarma ca||52|| pakvānnasnehamadyāśaḥ praccardanavirecane| hiraṇyalohayorlābhaḥ kalirbandhaparājayau||53|| upānadyuganāśaśca prapātaḥ pādacarmaṇoḥ| harṣo bhṛśaṃ prakupitaiḥ pitṛbhiścāvabhartsanam||54|| pradīpagrahanakṣatradantadaivatacakṣuṣām| patanaṃ vā vināśo vā, bhedanaṃ parvatasya ca||55|| kānane raktakusume pāpakarmaniveśane| citāndhakārasambādhe jananyāṃ ca praveśanam||56|| pātaḥ prāsādaśailādermatsyena grasanaṃ tathā| kāṣāyiṇāmasomyānāṃ nagnānāṃ daṇḍadhāriṇāṃ||57|| raktākṣāṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇānāṃ darśanaṃ jātu neṣyate| -----------------------------------------------|58|
-----------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇā pāpānanācārā dīrghakeśanakhastanī||58|| virāgamālyavasanā svapne kālaniśā matā| -----------------------------------------------|59|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| manovahānāṃ pūrṇatvātsrotasāṃ prabalairmalaiḥ||59||
dṛśyante dāruṇāḥ svapnā rogī yairyāti pañcatām| arogaḥ saṃśayaṃ prāpya kaścideva vimucyate||60||
dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'nubhūtaśca prārthitaḥ kalpitastathā| bhāviko doṣajaśceti svapnaḥ saptavidho mataḥ||61||

div.ab: teṣvādyā niṣphalāḥ pañhca yathāsvaprakṛtirdivā| vismṛto dīrghahrasvo'ti---------------------------|62|

ab.seg: -------------------------gosarge tadaharmahat| nidrayā vā'nupahataḥ pratīpairvacanaistathā||63||

div.ab: evaṃ śubhaṃ svapnaṃ pratyuktvā'śubhaṃ svapnaṃ pratyāha---- yāti pāpo'lpaphalatāṃ dānahomajapādibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|64|

-----------------------------------------------| akalyāṇamapi svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatraiva yaḥ punaḥ||64|| paśyetsaumyaṃ śubhaṃ tasya śubhameva phalaṃ bhavet| -----------------------------------------------|65|

-----------------------------------------------| devān dvijān govṛṣabhān jīvataḥ suhṛdo nṛpān||65|| sādhūn yaśasvino vahnimiddhaṃ svaccān jalāśayān| kanyāḥ kumārakān gaurān śuklavastrānsutejasaḥ||66|| narāśanaṃ dīptatanuṃ samantādrudhirokṣitam| yaḥ paśyellabhate yo vā catrādarśaviṣāmiṣam||67|| śuklāḥ sumanaso vastramamedhyālepanaṃ phalam| śailaprāsādasaphalavṛkṣasiṃhanaradvipān||68|| ārohedgośvayānaṃ ca, tarennadahadodadhīn| pūrvottareṇa gamanamagamyāgamanaṃ mṛtam||69|| sambādhānniḥsṛtirdevaiḥ pitṛbhiścābhinandanam| rodanaṃ patitotthānaṃ dviṣatāṃ cāvamardanam||70|| yasya syādāyurārogyaṃ vittaṃ bahu ca so'śnute| -----------------------------------------------|71|

"ārogyamaśnute" ityuktam| atastadevārogyaṃ lakṣayitumāha---- --------------------------------------------| maṅgalācārasampannaḥ parivārastathā''turaḥ||71|| śraddhadhāno'nukūlaśca prabhūtadravyasaṅgrahaḥ| sattvalakṣaṇasaṃyogo bhaktirvaidyadvijātiṣu||72|| cikitsāyāmanirvedastadārogyasya lakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|73|

kasmādidaṃ sthānaṃ śārīramucyate ? ityasya niruktimāha---- --------------------------------------------| ityatra janmamaraṇaṃ yataḥ samyagudāhṛtam|73| śarīrasya tataḥ sthānaṃ śārīramidamucyate| 73 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye śārīrasthāne dūtādivijñānīyo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

div.head: sarvaroganidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: teṣāṃ ca prakopakāraṇamasminnirdiśyata ityāha - athātaḥ sarvaroganidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre||2||

tatra rogāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ nidānaṃ bibhaṇiṣustāvadrogāṇāmeva paryāyān vadati| rogaparyāyaśravaṇena hi śiṣyāṇāṃ tatra tatra śāstrapradeśeṣu sammoho na bhavati---- rogaḥ pāpmā jvaro vyādhirvikāro duḥkhamāmayaḥ| yakṣmātaṅkagadābādhāḥ śabdāḥ paryāyavācinaḥ||1||
nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇyupaśayastathā| samprāptiśceti vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ pañcadhā smṛtam||2||

div.ab: nimittahetvāyatanapratyayotthānakāraṇaiḥ| nidānamāhuḥ paryāyaiḥ--------------|3|

ab.seg: ata evāha---- --------------------------------------------------| liṅgamavyaktamalpatvādvyādhīnāṃ tadyathāyatham||4||
idānīṃ rūpaṃ lakṣayitumāha---- tadeva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpamityabhidhīyate| saṃsthānaṃ vyañjanaṃ liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnamākṛtiḥ||5||

div.ab: hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇām| auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmupayogaṃ sukhāvaham||6|| vidyādupaśayaṃ vyādheḥ sa hi sātmyamiti smṛtaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: upaśayalakṣaṇakathanaprastāvādanupaśayo'pi lakṣya ityāha ---- ------------------------------------------------------| viparīto'nupaśayo vyādhyasātmyābhisaṃjñitaḥ||7||
nidānaprāgrūparūpopaśayānuktvā, samprati samprāptiṃ lakṣayitumāha---- yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvisarpatā| nirvṛttirāmayasyāsau samprāptirjātirāgatiḥ||8||
saṅkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣataḥ| sā bhidyate, yathā'traiva vakṣyante'ṣṭau jvarā iti||9||
doṣāṇāṃ samavetānāṃ vikalpoṃ'śāṃśakalpanā| svātantryapāratantryābhyāṃ vyādheḥ prādhānyamādiśet||10||
hetvādikārtsnyāvayavairbalābalaviśeṣaṇam| naktaṃdinartubhuktāṃśairvyādhikālo yathāmalam||11||

div.ab: ---------------------------------------------------| sarveṣāmeva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ||12|| tatprakopasya tu proktaṃ vividhāhitasevanam| ---------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: kiṃ tat ? ityāha- -------------------------------------------| ahitaṃ trividho yogastrayāṇāṃ prāgudāhṛtaḥ||13||
idānīṃ vātādīnāmannapānavihārasahitaṃ kopakāraṇamāha---- tiktoṣaṇakaṣāyālparūkṣapramitabhojanaiḥ| dhāraṇodīraṇaniśājāgarātyuccabhāṣaṇaiḥ||14||
kriyātiyogabhīśokacintāvyāyāmamaithunaiḥ| grīṣmāhorātribhuktānte prakupyati samīraṇaḥ||15||
pittaṃ kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇapaṭukrodhavidāhibhiḥ| śaranmadhyāhnarātryardhavidāhasamayeṣu ca||16||

div.ab: svādvamlalavaṇasnigdhagurvabhiṣyandiśītalaiḥ| āsyāsvapnasukhājīrṇadivāsvapnātibṛṃhaṇaiḥ||17|| pracchardanādyayogena bhuktamātravasantayoḥ| pūrvāhṇe pūrvarātre ca śleṣmā---------------|18|

miśrībhāvātsamastānāṃ sannipātastathā punaḥ| saṅkīrṇājīrṇaviṣamaviruddhādhyaśanādibhiḥ||19|| vyāpannamadyapānīyaśuṣkaśākāmamūlakaiḥ| piṇyākamṛdyavasurāpūtiśuṣkakṛśāmiṣaiḥ||20|| doṣatrayakaraistaistaistathā'nnaparivartanāt| ṛtorduṣṭātpurovātādgrahāveśādviṣādgarāt||21|| duṣṭānnāt parvatāśleṣādgrahairjanmarkṣapīḍanāt| mithyāyogācca vividhātpāpānāṃ ca niṣevaṇāt||22|| strīṇāṃ prasavavaiṣamyāttathā mithyopacārataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|23|

pratirogamiti kruddhā rogādhiṣṭhānagāminīḥ|23| rasāyanīḥ prapadyāśu doṣā dehe vikurvate| 23 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne sarvaroganidānaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|1|

div.head: jvaranidanādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto jvaranidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: jvaro rogapatiḥ pāpmā mṛtyurojośano'ntakaḥ| krodho dakṣādhvaradhvaṃsī rudrordhvanayanodbhavaḥ||1||
janmāntayormohamayaḥ santāpātmā'pacārajaḥ| vividhairnāmabhiḥ krūro nānāyoniṣu vartate||2||

div.ab: sa cāpacārajo jvaraḥ kimeko vā'nekavidhaḥ ? ityāha---- sa jāyate'ṣṭadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅmiśraiḥ samāgataiḥ| āgantuśca--------------------------------------------|3|

samprāptimasyādhunā vakti---- -------------------------------------------------------| ----------------malāstatra svaiḥ svairduṣṭāḥ pradūṣaṇaiḥ||3|| āmāśayaṃ praviśyāmamanugamya pidhāya ca| srotāṃsi paktisthānācca nirasya jvalanaṃ bahiḥ||4|| saha tenābhisarpantastapantaḥ sakalaṃ vapuḥ| kurvanto gātramatyuṣṇaṃ jvaraṃ nirvartayanti te||5|| srotovibandhātprāyeṇa tataḥ svedo na jāyate| ---------------------------------------------------|6|

pūrvarūpaṃ lakṣayitumāha---- -----------------------------------------| tasya prāgrūpamālasyamaratirgātragauravam||6|| āsyavairasyamarucijṛmbhā sāsrākulākṣitā| aṅgamardo'vipāko'lpaprāṇatā bahunidratā||7|| romaharṣo vinamanaṃ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ klamaḥ| hitopadeśeṣvakṣāntiḥ prītiramlapaṭūṣaṇe||8|| dveṣaḥ svāduṣu bhakṣyeṣu tathā bāleṣu tṛḍ bhṛśam| śabdāgniśītavātāmbucchāyoṣṇeṣvanimittataḥ||9|| icchā dveṣaśca----------------------------------| ---------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: vaiṣamyaṃ tatratatrāṅge tāstāḥ syurvedanāścalāḥ| pādayoḥ suptatā stambhaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ śramaḥ||11||
viśleṣa iva sandhīnāṃ sāda ūrvoḥ kaṭīgrahaḥ| pṛṣṭhaṃ kṣodamivāpnoti niṣpīḍyata ivodaram||12||
chidyanta iva cāsthīni pārśvagāni viśeṣataḥ| hṛdayasya grahastodaḥ prājaneneva vakṣasaḥ||13||
skandhayormathanaṃ bāhvorbhedaḥ pīḍanamaṃsayoḥ| aśaktirbhakṣaṇe hanvorjṛmbhaṇaṃ karṇayoḥ svanaḥ||14||
nistodaḥ śaṅkhayormūrdhni vedanā virasāsyatā| kaṣāyāsyatvamathavā malānāmapravartanam||15||
rūkṣāruṇatvagāsyākṣinakhamūtrapurīṣatā| prasekarocakāśraddhāvipākāsvedajāgarāḥ||16||
kaṇṭhauṣṭhaśoṣastṛṭ śuṣkau chardikāsau viṣāditā| harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathorgrahaḥ||17||
bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā vināmaścānilajvare| ---------------------------------------||18||
atha pittajvaralakṣaṇārthamāha---- yugapadvyāptiraṅgānāṃ pralāpaḥ kaṭuvaktratā||18||
nāsāsyapākaḥ śītecchā bhramo mūrcchā mado'ratiḥ| viṭsraṃsaḥ pittavamanaṃ raktaṣṭhīvanamamlakaḥ||19||
raktakoṭhodgamaḥ pītaharitatvaṃ tvagādiṣu| svedo niḥśvāsavaigandhyamatitṛṣṇā ca pittaje||20||
kaphajvaralakṣaṇamāha---- viśeṣādarucirjāḍyaṃ srotorodho'lpavegatā| praseko mukhamādhuryaṃ hṛllepaśvāsapīnasāḥ||21||
hṛllāsaśchardanaṃ kāsaḥ stambhaḥ śvaityaṃ tvagādiṣu| aṅgeṣu śītapiṭikāstandrodardaḥ kaphodbhave||22||

div.ab: evaṃ trayāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ pṛthak liṅgānyabhidhāya sāmānyaliṅgānyadhunā kathayati---- kāle yathāsvaṃ sarveṣāṃ pravṛttirvṛddhireva vā| ----------------------------------------------------|23|
idānīṃ sāmānyenānyadapi liṅgadvayamāha---- -----------------------------------------------| nidānoktānupaśayo viparītopaśāyitā---------|23|

ab.seg: śirortimūrcchāvamidāhamohakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣāratiparvabhedāḥ| unnidratātṛḍbhramaromaharṣā jṛmbhātivāktvaṃ ca calātsapittāt||24||
idānīṃ kaphānilasaṃsargalakṣaṇamāha---- tāpahānyaruciparvaśiroruk pīnasaśvasanakāsavibandhāḥ| śītajāḍyatimirabhramatandrāḥ śleṣmavātajanitajvaraliṅgam||25||
adhunā kaphapittasaṃsargajvaraṃ lakṣayati---- śītastambhasvedadāhāvyavasthā tṛṣṇākāsaśleṣmapittapravṛttiḥ| mohastandrāliptatiktāsyatā ca jñeyaṃ rūpaṃ śleṣmapittajvarasya||26||

div.ab: atha sannipātajvarasya lakṣaṇamāha---- sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvairdāho'tra ca muhurmuhuḥ| tadvacchītaṃ mahānidrā divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi||27|| sadā vā naiva vā nidrā mahāsvedo'ti naiva vā| gītanartanahāsyādivikṛtehāpravartanam||28|| sāśruṇī kaluṣe rakte bhugne lulitapakṣmaṇī| akṣiṇī piṇḍikāpārśvamūrddhaparvāsthirugbhramaḥ||29|| sasvanau sarujau karṇau kaṇṭhaḥ śūkairivācitaḥ| paridagdhā kharā jihvā guruḥ srastāṅgasandhitā||30|| raktapittakaphaṣṭhīvo lolanaṃ śiraso'tiruk| koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanam||31|| hṛdvyathā malasaṃsaṅgaḥ pravṛttirvā'lpaśo'ti vā| snigdhāsyatā balabhraṃśaḥ svarasādaḥ pralāpitā||32|| doṣapākaścirāttandrā pratataṃ kaṇṭhakūjanam| -----------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: athāsya sannipātasya nāmadvayamāha---- ----------------------------------------------| sannipātamabhinyāsaṃ taṃ brūyācca hṛtaujasam||33||

div.ab: doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe'gnau sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ| asādhyaḥ------------------------------------------|34|

kimeṣa eva sannipātajvaraprakāraḥ sambhavati ? utānyo'pi sambhavati ? ityāha---- anyacca sannipātottho yatra pittaṃ pṛthak sthitam| tvaci koṣṭhe'thavā dāhaṃ vidadhāti puro'nu vā||35|| tadvadvātakaphau śītaṃ, dāhādirdustarastayoḥ| ------------------------------------------------|36|

nanu, asmin śītādau dāhādau ca jvare ko viśeṣaḥ ? ityāha---- -------------------------------------------| śītādau tatra pittena kaphe syanditaśoṣite||36|| śīte śānte'mlako mūrcchā madastṛṣṇā ca jāyate| ---------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| dāhādau punarante syustandrāṣṭhīvavamiklamāḥ||37||

div.ab: āganturabhighātābhiṣaṅgaśāpābhicārataḥ| caturdhā-------------------------------|38|

ab.seg: ----------tasminpavanaḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan| savyathāśophavaivarṇyaṃ, sarujaṃ kurute jvaram||39||

div.ab: grahāveśauṣadhiviṣakrodhābhiśokakāmajaḥ| abhiṣaṅgāt-----------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: idānīṃ grahotpannasya liṅgamāha---- -------------------------------------------------| --------------------graheṇāsminnakasmāddhāsarodane||40||

div.ab: oṣadhīgandhaje mūrcchā śirorugvamathuḥ kṣavaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|41|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| viṣānmūrcchātisārāsyaśyāvatādāhahṛdgadāḥ||41||
-------------------------------------------------------| kāmādbhramo'rucirdāho hrīnidrādhīdhṛtikṣayaḥ||42||

div.ab: grahādau sannipātasya bhayādau marutastraye| kopaḥ kope'pi pittasya-------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| tatrābhicārikairmantrairhūyamānasya tapyate||44||
pūrvaṃ cetastato dehastato visphoṭatṛḍbhramaiḥ| sadāhamūrcchairgrastasya pratyahaṃ varddhate jvaraḥ||45||

div.ab: ---------------------------samāsāddvividhastu saḥ| śārīro mānasaḥ saumyastīkṣṇo'ntarbahirāśrayaḥ||46|| prākṛto vaikṛtaḥ sādhyo'sādhyaḥ sāmo nirāmakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|

ab.seg: sampratyetāneva jvarān vyācaṣṭe---- -----------------------------------------| pūrvaṃ śarīre śārīre tāpo, manasi mānase||47||

div.ab: idānīṃ saumyatīkṣṇau vyācaṣṭe- pavane yogavāhitvācchītaṃ śleṣmayute bhavet| ---------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------| bahireva bahirvarge tāpo'pi ca susādhyatā||49||
samprati prākṛtavaikṛtau lakṣayati - - - - varṣāśaradvasanteṣu vātādyaiḥ prākṛtaḥ kramāt| vaikṛto'nyaḥ sa duḥsādhyaḥ prāyaśca prākṛto'nilāt||50||
samprati varṣāsu prākṛtasya jvarasya svarūpaṃ nirūpayati - - - - - varṣāsu māruto duṣṭaḥ pittaśleṣmānvito jvaram| kuryāt pittaṃ ca śaradi tasya cānubalaṃ kaphaḥ||51||
tatprakṛtyā visargācca tatra nānaśanādbhayam| kapho vasante tamapi vātapittaṃ bhavedanu||52||

div.ab: atha sādhyāsādhyajvaralakṣaṇārthamāha - - - - balavatsvalpadoṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo'nupadravaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| sarvathā vikṛtijñāne prāgasādhya udāhṛtaḥ||53||
adhunā sāmanirāmau jvaro lakṣayati - - - - jvaropadravatīkṣṇatvamaglānirbahumūtratā| na pravṛttirna viḍjīrṇā na kṣutsāmajvarākṛtiḥ||54||
jvaravego'dhikaṃ tṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ| malapravṛttirutkleśaḥ pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam||55||

div.ab: jīrṇatā''maviparyāsātsaptarātraṃ ca laṅghanāt| ------------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| jvaraḥ pañcavidhaḥ prokto malakālabalābalāt||56||
prāyaśaḥ sannipātena bhūyasā tūpadiśyate| santataḥ satato'nyedyustṛtīyakacaturthakau||57||
atha mahārambhatvena prādhānyāt santatasamprāptimeva lakṣayati - - - - - - dhātumūtraśakṛdvāhisrotasāṃ vyāpino malāḥ| tāpayantastanuṃ sarvāṃ tulyadūṣyādivarddhitāḥ||58||
balino guravaḥ stabdhā viśeṣeṇa rasāśritāḥ| santataṃ niṣpratidvandvā jvaraṃ kuryuḥ suduḥsaham||59||
malaṃ jvaroṣmā dhātūnvā sa śīghraṃ kṣapayettataḥ| sarvākāraṃ rasādīnāṃ śuddhyā'śuddhyā'pi vā kramāt||60||
vātapittakaphaiḥ sapta daśa dvādaśa vāsarān| prāyo'nuyāti maryādāṃ mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||61||
ityagniveśasya mataṃ, hārītasya punaḥ smṛtiḥ| dviguṇā saptamī yāvannavamyekādaśī tathā||62||
eṣā tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca| śuddhyaśuddhau jvaraḥ kālaṃ dīrghamapyanuvartate||63||

div.ab: evaṃ santatasya lakṣaṇamākhyāya satatakādīnāṃ viṣamajvarasaṃjñānimittaṃ sāmānyena lakṣaṇamāha - - - - kṛśānāṃ vyādhimuktānāṃ mithyāhārādisevinām| alpo'pi doṣo dūṣyāderlabdhvā'nyatamato balam||64|| savipakṣo jvaraṃ kuryādviṣamaṃ kṣayavṛddhibhāk| -------------------------------------------------|65|

----------------------------------------------------| doṣaḥ pravartate teṣāṃ sve kāle jvarayan balī||65|| nivartate punaścaiṣa pratyanīkabalābalaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|66|

---------------------------------------------------| kṣīṇe doṣe jvaraḥ sūkṣmo rasādiṣveva līyate||66|| līnatvātkārśyavaivarṇyajāḍyādīnādadhāti saḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|67|

nanu, tulye'pi vātādidoṣaprakope santatajvara evāśusakalakāyavyāptiḥ, satatakādiṣu tu cireṇa vicchidya bhavatītyatra yuktiḥ kā ? ityāha - - - - -------------------------------------------------| āsannavivṛtāsyatvātsrotasāṃ rasavāhinām||67|| āśu sarvasya vapuṣo vyāptirdoṣeṇa jāyate| santataḥ satatastena, viparīto viparyayāt||68|| viṣamo viṣamārambhakriyākālo'nuṣaṅgavān| -------------------------------------------------|69|

ab.seg: grāhī pittānilānmūrdhnastrikasya kaphapittataḥ| sapṛṣṭhasyānilakaphātsa caikāhāntaraḥ smṛtaḥ||71||

div.ab: caturthako male medomajjāsthyanyatamasthite| majjastha evetyapare prabhāvaṃ sa tu darśayet||72|| dvidhā kaphena jaṃghābhyāṃ sa pūrvaṃ śiraso'nilāt| -----------------------------------------------|73|
------------------------------------------------| asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaḥ||73|| tridhā, hyahaṃ jvarayati dinamekaṃ tu muñcati| --------------------------------------------------|74|

idānīmeṣāṃ viṣamajvarāṇāmimaṃ śeṣabhūtaṃ granthamāha - - - - -------------------------------------------------| balābalena doṣāṇāmannaceṣṭādijanmanā||74|| jvaraḥ syānmanasastadvatkarmaṇaśca tadā tadā| doṣadūṣyartvahorātraprabhṛtīnāṃ balājjvaraḥ||75|| manaso viṣayāṇāṃ ca kālaṃ taṃ taṃ prapadyate| ------------------------------------------------|76|

ab.seg: tato naraḥ śvasan svidyan kūjan vamati ceṣṭate| vepate pralapatyuṣṇaiḥ śītaiścāṅgairhataprabhaḥ||77||
visaṃjño jvaravegārtaḥ sakrodha iva vīkṣate| sadoṣaśabdaṃ ca śakṛddravaṃ sṛjati vegavat||78||

div.ab: iti jvaramokṣakālalakṣaṇamuktvā vigatajvaralakṣaṇamabhidhitsurāha - - deho laghurvyapagataklamamohatāpaḥ pāko mukhe karaṇasauṣṭhavamavyathatvam| svedaḥ kṣavaḥ prakṛtiyogi mano'nnalipsā kaṇḍūśca mūrdhni vigatajvaralakṣaṇāni|79| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne jvaranidānaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|2|

div.head: raktapittakāsanidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto raktapittakāsanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|

ab.seg: bhṛśoṣṇatīkṣṇakaṭvamlalavaṇādividāhibhiḥ| kodravoddālakaiścānnaistadyuktairatisevitaiḥ||1||
kupitaṃ pittalaiḥ pittaṃ dravaṃ raktaṃ ca mūrcchite| te mithastulyarūpatvamāgamya vyāpnutastanum||2||
evamāśaṅkyāha - - - - pittaṃ raktasya vikṛteḥ saṃsargāddūṣaṇādapi| gandhavarṇānuvṛtteśca raktena vyapadiśyate||3||

div.ab: tatkathametat ? ityāha - - - - prabhavatyasṛjaḥ sthānātplīhato yakṛtaśca tat| -------------------------------------------------------|4|

athāsya pūrvarūpāṇyāha - -------------------------------------------------------| śirogurutvamaruciḥ śītecchā dhūmako'mlakaḥ||4|| chardiścharditabaibhatsyaṃ kāsaḥ śvāso bhramaḥ klamaḥ| lohalohitamatsyāmagandhāsyatvaṃ svarakṣayaḥ||5|| raktahāridraharitavarṇatā nayanādiṣu| nīlalohitapītānāṃ varṇānāmavivecanam||6|| svapne tadvarṇadarśitvaṃ bhavatyasmin bhaviṣyati| -------------------------------------------------------|7|

tatrordhvagamāha - -------------------------------------------------------| ūrdhvaṃ nāsākṣikarṇāsyairmeḍhrayonigudairadhaḥ||7|| kupitaṃ romakūpaiśca samastaistatpravartate| -------------------------------------------------------|8|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------------| ūrdhvaṃ sādhyaṃ kaphādyasmāttadvirecanasādhanam||8||
bahvauṣadhaṃ ca, pittasya vireko hi varauṣadham| anubandhī kapho yaśca tatra tasyāpi śuddhikṛt||9||
kaṣāyāḥ svādavo'pyasya viśuddhaśleṣmaṇo hitāḥ| kimu tiktāḥ kaṣāyā vā ye nisargātkaphāpahāḥ||10||
adho yāpyaṃ calādyasmāttatpracchardanasādhanam| alpauṣadhaṃ ca pittasya vamanaṃ na varauṣadham||11||
anubandhī calo yaśca śāntaye'pi na tasya tat| kaṣāyāśca hitāstasya madhurā eva kevalam||12||
kaphamārutasaṃsṛṣṭamasādhyamubhayāyanam| aśakyaprātilomyatvādabhāvādauṣadhasya ca||13||
na hi saṃśodhanaṃ kiñcidastyasya pratilomagam| śodhanaṃ pratilomaṃ ca raktapitte bhiṣgjitam||14||
evamevopaśamanaṃ sarvaśo vidyate| saṃsṛṣṭeṣu hi doṣeṣu sarvajicchamanaṃ hitam||15||

div.ab: tatra doṣānugamanaṃ sirāsra iva lakṣayet| --------------------------------------------|16|
--------------------------------------------| upadravāścaṃ vikṛtijñānatasteṣu cādhikam||16|| āśukārī yataḥ kāsastamevātaḥ pravakṣyati| --------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| pañca kāsāḥ smṛtā vātapittaśleṣmakṣatakṣayaiḥ||17||

div.ab: adhunā sarvakāsānāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayati - ---------------------------------tatrādho vihato'nilaḥ| ūrdhvaṃ pravṛttaḥ prāpyorastasmin kaṇṭhe ca saṃsajan||19|| śiraḥsrotāṃsi sampūrya tato'ṅgānyutkṣipanniva| kṣipannivākṣiṇī pṛṣṭhamuraḥ pārśve ca pīḍayan||20|| pravartate sa vaktreṇa bhinnakāṃsyopamadhvaniḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|21|

nanu, kathamekarūpāyāṃ kāsasamprāptau satyāmanekarūpatā kāsarugdhvanīnāṃ jāyate ? ityāha - ---------------------------------------------------| hetubhedātpratīghātabhedo vāyoḥ saraṃhasaḥ||21|| yadrujāśabdavaiṣamyaṃ kāsānāṃ jāyate tataḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|22|

adhunā vātakāsasya nidānādinirdeśārthamāha - ----------------------------------------------------| kupito vātalairvātaḥ śuṣkoraḥkaṇṭhavakkratām||22|| hṛtpārśvoraḥśiraḥśūlaṃ mohakṣobhasvarakṣayān| karoti śuṣkaṃ kāsaṃ ca mahāvegarujāsvanam||23|| so'ṅgaharṣī kaphaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛcchrānmuktvā'lpatāṃ vrajet| ---------------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| pittātpītākṣikaphatā tiktāsyatvaṃ jvaro bhramaḥ||24||
pittāsṛgvamanaṃ tṛṣṇā vaisvaryaṃ dhūmako'mlakaḥ| pratataṃ kāsavegena jyotiṣāmiva darśanam||25||

div.ab: kaphāduro'lparuḍmūrddhahṛdayaṃ stimitaṃ guru| kaṇṭhopalepaḥ sadanaṃ pīnasacchardyarocakāḥ||26|| romaharṣo ghanasnigdhaśvetaśleṣmapravartanam| ---------------------------------------------------|27|

idānīṃ kṣatakāsasya nidānādi nirūpayati - - - - ----------------------------------------------------| yuddhādyaiḥ sāhasaistaistaiḥ sevitairayathābalam||27|| urasyantaḥkṣate vāyuḥ pittenānugato balī| kupitaḥ kurute kāsaṃ kaphaṃ tena saśoṇitam||28|| pītaṃ śyāvaṃ ca śuṣkaṃ ca grathitaṃ kuthitaṃ bahu| ṣṭhīvetkaṇṭhena rujatā vibhinneneva corasā||29|| sūcībhiriva tīkṣṇābhistudyamānena śūlinā| parvabhedajvaraśvāsatṛṣṇāvaisvaryakampavān||30|| pārāvata ivākūjan pārśvaśūlī tato'sya ca| kramādvīryaṃ ruciḥ paktā balaṃ varṇaśca hīyate||31|| kṣīṇasya sāsṛṅmūtratvaṃ syācca pṛṣṭhakaṭīgrahaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: idānīṃ kṣayakāsalakṣaṇaṃ nirūpayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------------| vāyupradhānāḥ kupitā dhātavo rājayakṣmiṇaḥ||32||
kurvantiḥ yakṣmāyatanaiḥ kāsaṃ ṣṭhīvetkaphaṃ tataḥ| pūtipūyopamaṃ pītaṃ visraṃ haritalohitam||33||
lucyeta iva pārśve ca hṛdayaṃ patatīva ca| akasmāduṣṇaśītecchā bahvāśitvaṃ balakṣayaḥ||34||
snigdhaprasannavakkratvaṃ śrīmaddaśananetratā| tato'sya kṣayarūpāṇi sarvāṇyāvirbhavanti ca||35||

div.ab: ityeṣa kṣayajaḥ kāsaḥ kṣīṇānāṃ dehanāśanaḥ| yāpyo vā balināṃ, tadvat kṣatajo'bhinavau tu tau||36|| sidhyetāmapi sānāthyāt---------------------------| ------------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: idānīṃ śeṣāṇāmapi kāsānāṃ sādhyayāpyavibhāgaṃ nirūpayati - - - - ------------------------------sādhyā doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ| miśrā yāpyā dvayātsarve jarasā sthavirasya ca||37||

div.ab: kāsācchvāsakṣayacchardisvarasādādayo gadāḥ| bhavantyupekṣayā yasmāttasmāttaṃ tvarayā jayet|38| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne raktapittakāsanidānaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|3|

div.head: śvāsahidhmānidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ śvāsahidhmānidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|

atha śvāsasya nidānāni lakṣayati - - - - kāsavṛddhyā bhavecchvāsaḥ pūrvairvā doṣakopanaiḥ| āmātisāravamathuviṣapāṇḍujvarairapi||1|| rajodhūmānilairmarmaghātādatihimāmbunā| ------------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| kṣudrakastamakaśchinno mahānūrdhvaśca pañcamaḥ||2||

div.ab: adhunā śvāsasya pañcavidhasyāpi samprāptimāha - - - - kaphoparuddhagamanaḥ pavano viṣvagāsthitaḥ| prāṇodakānnavāhīni duṣṭaḥ srotāṃsi dūṣayan||3|| uraḥsthaḥ kurute śvāsamāmāśayasamudbhavam| -----------------------------------------------|4|

ab.seg: --------------------------------tatrāyāsātibhojanaiḥ| preritaḥ prerayet kṣudraṃ svayaṃ saṃśamanaṃ marut||5||
atha tamakaṃ lakṣayati - - - - pratilomaṃ sirā gacchannudīrya pavanaḥ kapham| parigṛhya śirogrīvamuraḥ pārśve ca pīḍayan||6||
kāsaṃ ghurghurakaṃ mohamaruciṃ pīnasaṃ tṛṣam| karoti tīvravegaṃ ca śvāsaṃ prāṇopatāpinam||7||
pratāmyettasya vegena niṣṭhyūtānte kṣaṇaṃ sukhī| kṛcchrācchayānaḥ śvasiti niṣaṇṇaḥ svāsthyamṛcchati||8||
ucchritākṣo lalāṭena svidyatā bhṛśamartimān| viśuṣkāsyo muhuḥśvāsī kāṅkṣatyuṣṇaṃ savepathuḥ||9||
meghāmbuśītaprāgvātaiḥ, śleṣmalaiśca vivarddhate| sa yāpyastamakaḥ, sādhyo navo vā balino bhavet||10||

div.ab: jvaramūrchāyutaḥ śītaiḥ śāmyetpratamakastu saḥ| --------------------------------------------------|11|

atha chinnaṃ lakṣayati - - - - --------------------------------------------------| chinnācchvasiti vicchinnaṃ marmacchedarujārditaḥ||11|| sasvedamūrcchaḥ sānāho bastidāhanirodhavān| adhodṛgviplutākṣaśca muhyan raktaikalocanaḥ||12|| śuṣkāsyaḥ pralapan dīno naṣṭacchāyo vicetanaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: adhunā mahadākhyaṃ śvāsaṃ lakṣayati - - - - --------------------------------------------------| mahatā mahatā dīno nādena śvasiti krathan||13||
uddhūyamānaḥ saṃrabdho mattarṣabha ivāniśam| praṇaṣṭajñānavijñāno vibhrāntanayanānanaḥ||14||
vakṣaḥ samākṣipan baddhamūtravarcā viśīrṇavāk| śuṣkakaṇṭho muhurmuhyan karṇaśaṅkhaśirotiruk||15||
athordhvalakṣaṇārthamāha - - - - dīrghamūrdhvaṃ śvasityūrdhvānna ca pratyāharatyadhaḥ| śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotāḥ kruddhagandhavahārditaḥ||16||
ūrdhvadṛgvīkṣate bhrāntamakṣiṇī paritaḥ kṣipan| marmasu cchidyamāneṣu paridevī niruddhavāk||17||
ete siddhyeyuravyaktā vyaktāḥ prāṇaharā dhruvam| -------------------------------------------------|18| iti śvāsanidānam||1||

div.ab: --------bhaktodbhavā kṣudrā yamalā mahatīti ca| gambhīrā ca------------------------------------|19|

bhaktodbhavāṃ lakṣayitumāha - - - - --------------------------------------------------| ----------------maruttatra tvarayā'yuktisevitaiḥ||19|| rūkṣatīkṣṇakharāsātmyairannapānaiḥ prapīḍitaḥ| karoti hidhmāmarujāṃ mandaśabdāṃ kṣavānugāṃ||20|| śamaṃ sātmyānnapānena yā prayāti ca sā'nnajā| --------------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: atha kṣudrākhyāṃ lakṣayitumāha - - - - ----------------------------------------------------| āyāsātpavanaḥ kṣudraḥ kṣudrāṃ hidhmāṃ pravartayet||21||
jatrumūlapravisṛtāmalpavegāṃ mṛduṃ ca sā| vṛddhimāyāsyato yāti bhuktamātre ca mārdavam||22||

div.ab: adhunā yamalāṃ vyācaṣṭe - - - - cireṇa yamalairvegairāhāre yā pravartate| pariṇāmonmukhe vṛddhiṃ pariṇāme ca gacchati||23|| kampayantī śirogrīvamādhmātasyātitṛṣyataḥ| pralāpacchardyatīsāranetraviplutijṛmbhiṇaḥ||24|| yamalā veginī hidhmā pariṇāmavatī ca sā| --------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: mahāhidhmāṃ vyācikhyāsurāha - - - - --------------------------------------------| stabdhabhrūśaṅkhayugmasya sāsraviplutacakṣuṣaḥ||25||
stambhayantī tanuṃ vācaṃ smṛtiṃ saṃjñāṃ ca muṣṇatī| rundhatī mārgamannasya kurvatī marmaghaṭṭanam||26||
pṛṣṭhato namanaṃ śoṣaṃ mahāhidhmā pravartate| mahāmūlā mahāśabdā mahāvegā mahābalā||27||

div.ab: atha gambhīrāṃ lakṣayati - - - - pakvāśayādvā nābhervā pūrvavadyā pravartate| tadrūpā sā muhuḥ kuryājjṛmbhāmaṅgaprasāraṇam||28|| gambhīreṇānunādena gambhīrā-------------------| ---------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------tāsu sādhayet| ādye dve, varjayedantye sarvaliṅgāṃ ca veginīm||29||
sarvāśca sañcitāmasya sthavirasya vyavāyinaḥ| vyādhibhiḥ kṣīṇadehasya bhaktacchedakṣatasya vā||30||
iti hidhmānidānam||2||

div.ab: adhunā hidhmāśvāsayoḥ śīghrakāritvamāha - - - sarve'pi rogā nāśāya na tvevaṃ śīghrakāriṇaḥ| hidhmāśvāsau yathā tau hi mṛtyukāle kṛtālayau|31| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne śvāsahidhmānidānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|4|

div.head: rājayakṣmādinidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto rājayakṣmādinidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre||2||
rājayakṣmā ka ucyate ? yasyedaṃ nidānam, ityāha - - - - atha rājayakṣmanidānam| anekarogānugato bahurogapurogamaḥ| rājayakṣmā kṣayaḥ śoṣo rogarāḍiti ca smṛtaḥ||1||
tatrādyāṃ saṃjñāṃ vyutpādayannāha - - - - nakṣatrāṇāṃ dvijānāṃ ca rājño'bhūdyadayaṃ purā| yacca rājā ca yakṣmā ca rājayakṣmā tato mataḥ||2||
dehauṣadhakṣayakṛteḥ kṣayastatsambhavācca saḥ| rasādiśoṣaṇācchoṣo rogarāṭ teṣu rājanāt||3||
sāhasaṃ vegasaṃrodhaḥ śukraujaḥsnehasaṅkṣayaḥ| annapānavidhityāgaścatvārastasya hetavaḥ||4||
ata evāha - - - - tairudīrṇo'nilaḥ pittaṃ kaphaṃ codīrya sarvataḥ| śarīrasandhīnāviśya tān sirāśca prapīḍayan||5||
mukhāni srotasāṃ ruddhvā tathaivātivivṛtya vā| sarpannūrdhvamadhastiryagyathāsvaṃ janayedgadān||6||

div.ab: rūpaṃ bhaviṣyatastasya pratiśyāyo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ| praseko mukhamādhuryaṃ sadanaṃ vahnidehayoḥ||7|| sthālyamatrānnapānādau śucāvapyaśucīkṣaṇam| makṣikātṛṇakeśādipātaḥ prāyo'nnapānayoḥ||8|| hṛllāsaśchardiraruciraśnato'pi balakṣayaḥ| pāṇyoravekṣā pādāsyaśopho'kṣṇoratiśuklatā||9|| bāhvoḥ pramāṇajijñāsā kāye baibhatsyadarśanam| strīmadyamāṃsapriyatā ghṛṇitvaṃ mūrddhaguṇṭhanam||10|| nakhakeśātivṛddhiśca, svapne cābhibhavo bhavet| pataṅgakṛkalāsāhikapiśvāpadapakṣibhiḥ||11|| keśasthituṣabhasmādirāśau samadhirohaṇam| śūnyānāṃ grāmadeśānāṃ darśanaṃ śuṣyato'mbhasaḥ||12|| jyotirgirīṇāṃ patatāṃ jvalatāṃ ca mahīruhām| -----------------------------------------------|13|

prāgrūpamuktvā sampratyekādaśarūpamadhikṛtyāha - - - - -------------------------------------------------------| pīnasaśvāsakāsāṃ samūrddhasvararujo'ruciḥ||13|| ūrdhvaṃ, viḍbhraṃśasaṃśoṣāvadhaḥ, cchardiśca koṣṭhage| tiryaksthe pārśvarudgoṣe, sandhige bhavati jvaraḥ||14|| rūpāṇyekādaśaitāni jāyante rājayakṣmiṇaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|15|
-----------------------------------------------| teṣāmupadravān vidyātkaṇṭhoddhvaṃsamurorujam||15|| jṛmbhāṅgamardaniṣṭhīvavahnisādāsyapūtitāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: ----------------------------pittātpādāṃsapāṇiṣu| dāho'tisārosṛk''chardirmukhagandho jvaro madaḥ||17||
kaphādarocakaśchardiḥ kāso mūrddhāṅgagauravam| prasekaḥ pīnasaḥ śvāsaḥ svarasādo'lpavahnitā||18||
yakṣmiṇo māṃsā(annā)dyabhyavahārato'pi dhātukṣayo jāyate, na dhātupuṣṭiḥ, ityatra yuktimāha - - - - doṣairmandānalatvena sopalepaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ| srotomukheṣu ruddheṣu dhātūṣmasvalpakeṣu ca||19||
vidahyamānaḥ svasthāne rasastāṃstānupadravān| kuryādagacchanmāṃsādīnasṛk cordhvaṃ pradhāvati||20||
pacyate koṣṭha evānnamannapaktraiva cāsya yat| prāyo'smānmalatāṃ yātaṃ naivālaṃ dhātupuṣṭaye||21||
raso'pyasya na raktāya māṃsāya kuta eva tu| upastabdhaḥ sa śakṛtā kevalaṃ vartate kṣayī||22||

div.ab: athāsya kṣayiṇaḥ sādhyāsādhyatām nirūpayati - - - - liṅgeṣvalpeṣvapi kṣīṇaṃ vyādhyauṣadhabalākṣamam| varjayet---------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: iti rājayakṣmanidānam||1||

div.ab: athāsya vyādherupadravabhūtānāmādiśabdagṛhītānāṃ pañcānāṃ svarabhedādīnāṃ rogāṇāṃ nidānānyāha - - - - atha svarabhedanidānam| doṣairvyastaiḥ samastaiśca kṣayāt ṣaṣṭhaśca medasā| svarabhedo bhavet-------------------------------------|24|
limpanniva kaphātkaṇṭhaṃ mandaḥ khurakhurāyate| svaro vibaddhaḥ------------------------------|26|
---------------------------medasā śleṣmalakṣaṇaḥ| kṛcchralakṣyākṣaraśca---------------------------|27|

ab.seg: iti svarabhedanidānam||2||
athārocakanidānam| arocako bhaveddoṣairjihvāhṛdayasaṃśrayaiḥ| sannipātena manasaḥ santāpena ca pañcamaḥ||28||
kaṣāyatiktamadhuraṃ vātādiṣu mukhaṃ kramāt| sarvotthe virasaṃ śokakrodhādiṣu yathāmalam||29||
ityarocakanidānam||3||

div.ab: atha chardinidānam| chardirdoṣaiḥ pṛthaksarvairdviṣṭairarthaiśca pañcamī| --------------------------------------------------------|30|

-----------------------------------------------------| nābhipṛṣṭhaṃ rujan vāyuḥ pārśve cāhāramutkṣipet||31|| tato vicchinnamalpālpaṃ kaṣāyaṃ phenilaṃ vamet| śabdodgārayutaṃ kṛṣṇamacchaṃ kṛcchreṇa vegavat||32|| kāsasyāśoṣahṛnmūrddhasvarapīḍāklamānvitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|33|

-----------------------------------------------------| pittātkṣārodakanibhaṃ dhūmraṃ haritapītakam||33|| sāsṛgamlaṃ kaṭūṣṇaṃ ca tṛṇmūrcchātāpadāhavat| -----------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| kaphāt snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ śītaṃ śleṣmatantugavākṣitam||34||
madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ bhūri prasaktaṃ lomaharṣaṇam| mukhaśvayathumādhuryatandrāhṛllāsakāsavān||35||

div.ab: sarvaliṅgā malaiḥ sarvai riṣṭoktā yā ca tāṃ tyajet| -----------------------------------------------------|36|

-----------------------------------------------------| pūtyamedhyāśucidviṣṭadarśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ||36|| tapte citte hṛdi kliṣṭe chardirdviṣṭārthayogajā| -----------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: nanu, kṛmyādijānyanyāni chardīṃṣi sambhavantyeva| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kasmānnoktam ? ityāha - - - - -----------------------------------------------------| vātādīneva vimṛśetkṛmitṛṣṇāmadauhṛde||37||
śūlavepathuhṛllāsairviśeṣāt kṛmijāṃ vadet| kṛmihṛdrogaliṅgaiśca-----------------------|38| iti chardinidānam||4||

div.ab: adhunā hṛdrogaṃ lilakṣayiṣurāha - - - - atha hṛdroganidānam| -----------------------------------------------------| ---------------------smṛtāḥ pañca tu hṛdgadāḥ||38|| teṣāṃ gulmanidānoktaiḥ samutthānaiśca sambhavaḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|39|

------------------------------------------------| vātena śūlyate'tyarthaṃ yudyate sphuṭatīva ca||39|| bhidyate śuṣyati stabdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ śūnyatā dravaḥ| akasmāddīnatā śoko bhayaṃ śabdāsahiṣṇutā||40|| vepathurveṣṭanaṃ mohaḥ śvāsarodho'lpanidratā| ------------------------------------------------|41|

------------------------------------------------| pittā ttṛṣṇā bhramo mūrcchā dāhaḥ svedo'mlakaḥ klamaḥ||41|| chardanaṃ cāmlapittasya dhūmakaḥ pītatā jvaraḥ| ------------------------------------------------|42|

----------------------------------------------------| śleṣmaṇā hṛdayaṃ stabdhaṃ bhārikaṃ sāśmagarbhavat||42|| kāsāgnisādaniṣṭhīvanidrālasyārucijvarāḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: tamaḥpraveśo hṛllāsaḥ śoṣaḥ kaṇḍūḥ kaphasrutiḥ| hṛdayaṃ pratataṃ cātra krakaceneva dāryate||44||
cikitsedāmayaṃ ghoraṃ taṃ śīghraṃ śīghrakāriṇam| -----------------------------------------------|45| iti hṛdroganidānam||5||

div.ab: uktā hṛdrogāḥ| śīghrakāritvasāmānyāt tṛṣṇā'ntaraṃ vyākhyāyate - - - - atha tṛṣṇānidānam| -----------------------------------------------| vātātpittātkaphāttṛṣṇā sannipātādrasakṣayāt||45|| ṣaṣṭhī syādupasargācca vātapitte tu kāraṇam| sarvāsu te eva vātapitte hetuḥ| kuta evam ? ityāha - - - - tatprakopo hi saumyadhātupraśoṣaṇāt||46|| sarvadehabhramotkampatāpatṛḍdāhamohakṛt| saumyadhātupraśoṣaṇapūrvakaṃ tṛṣṇānāṃ yato janma, tasmādidamāha - - - - jihvāmūlagalaklomatālutoyavahāḥ sirāḥ||47|| saṃśoṣya tṛṣṇā jāyante-------------------| -----------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: -------------------------tāsāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam| mukhaśoṣo jalātṛptirannadveṣaḥ svarakṣayaḥ||48||
kaṇṭhauṣṭhajihvākārkaśyaṃ jihvāniṣkramaṇaṃ klamaḥ| pralāpaścittavibhraṃśastṛṅgrahoktāstathā''mayāḥ||49||

div.ab: mārutāt kṣāmatā dainyaṃ śaṅkhatodaḥ śirobhramaḥ| gandhājñānāsyavairasyaśrutinidrābalakṣayāḥ||50|| śītāmbupānāddṛddhiśca------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|51|

ab.seg: -------------------------pittānmūrcchāsyatiktatā| raktekṣaṇatvaṃ pratataṃ śoṣo dāho'tidhūmakaḥ||51||

div.ab: kaphatṛṣṇāmāha - - - - kapho ruṇaddhi kupitastoyavāhiṣu mārutam| srotaḥsu sa kaphastena paṅkavacchoṣyate tataḥ||52|| śukairivācitaḥ kaṇṭho nidrā madhuravakkratā| ādhmānaṃ śiraso jāḍyaṃ staimityacchardyarocakāḥ||53|| ālasyamavipākaśca-----------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| āmodbhavā ca, bhaktasya saṃrodhādvātapittajā||54||
uṣṇaklāntasya sahasā śītāmbho bhajatastṛṣam| ūṣmā ruddho gataḥ koṣṭhaṃ yāṃ kuryātpittajaiva sā||55||
yā ca pānātipānotthā, tīkṣṇāgneḥ snehajā ca yā| snigdhagurvamlalavaṇabhojanena kaphodbhavā||56||

div.ab: tṛṣṇā rasakṣayoktena lakṣaṇena kṣayātmikā| -----------------------------------------------|57|

----------------------------------------------| śoṣamehajvarādyanyadīrgharogopasargataḥ|57| yā tṛṣṇā jāyate tīvrā sopasargātmikā smṛtā| 57 1/2| iti tṛṣṇānidānam| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye śarīrasthāne rājayakṣmādinidānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|5|

div.head: madātyayādinidanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: tasmānmadātyayanidānamucyata ityāha - - - - athāto madātyayādinidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre||2||
tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣasūkṣmāmlaṃ vyavāyyāśukaraṃ laghu| vikāṣi viśadaṃ madyamojaso'smādviparyayaḥ||1||
tīkṣṇādayo viṣe'pyuktāścittopaplāvino guṇāḥ| jīvitāntāya jāyante viṣe tūtkarṣavṛttitaḥ||2||

div.ab: kathaṃ kṛtvā madyaṃ ceto vikāraṃ nayati ? ityāha - - - - tīkṣṇādibhirguṇairmadyaṃ mandādīnojaso guṇān| daśabhirdaśa saṅkṣobhya ceto nayati vikriyām||3|| ādye made-----------------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|4|

ab.seg: -------------dvitīye tu pramādāyatane sthitaḥ| durvikalpahato mūḍhaḥ sukhamityadhimucyate||4||
madhyamottamayoḥ sandhiṃ prāpya rājasatāmasaḥ| niraṅkuśa iva vyālo na kiñcinnācarejjaḍaḥ||5||
ata evāha - - - - iyaṃ bhūmiravadyānāṃ dauḥśīlyasyedamāspadam| eko'yaṃ bahumārgāyā durgaterdeśikaḥ param||6||
niśceṣṭaḥ śavavacchete tṛtīye tu made sthitaḥ| maraṇādapi pāpātmā gataḥ pāpatarāṃ daśām||7||
dharmādharmaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhamarthānarthaṃ hitāhitam| yadāsakto na jānāti kathaṃ tacchīlayedbudhaḥ||8||

div.ab: madye moho bhayaṃ śokaḥ krodho mṛtyuśca saṃśritāḥ| sonmādamadamūrcchāyāḥ sāpasmārāpatānakāḥ||9|| yatraikaḥ smṛtivibhraṃśastatra sarvamasādhu yat| ------------------------------------------------|10|

---------------------------------------------------| ayuktiyuktamannaṃ hi vyādhaye maraṇāya vā||10|| madyaṃ trivargadhīdhairyalajjāderapi nāśanam| ---------------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: tāmeva yuktiṃ vakṣyamāṇena granthena pratipādayannāha - - - - ---------------------------------------------------| nātimādyanti balinaḥ kṛtāhārā mahāśanāḥ||11||
snigdhāḥ sattvavayoyuktā madyanityāstadanvayāḥ| medaḥkaphādhikā mandavātapittā dṛḍhāgnayaḥ||12||
viparyaye'timādyanti viśrabdhāḥ kupitāśca ye| madyena cāmlarūkṣeṇa sājīrṇe bahunā'ti ca||13||
vātātpittātkaphātsarvaiścatvāraḥ syurmadātyayāḥ| sarve'pi sarvairjāyante vyapadeśastu bhūyasā||14||
sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pramoho hṛdayavyathā| viḍbhedaḥ pratataṃ tṛṣṇā saumyāgneyo jvaro'ruciḥ||15||
śiraḥpārśvāsthirukkampo marmabhedastrikagrahaḥ| urovibandhastimiraṃ kāsaḥ śvāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ||16||
svedo'timātraṃ viṣṭambhaḥ śvayathuścittavibhramaḥ| pralāpaścardirutkleśo bhramo duḥsvapnadarśanam||17||
viśeṣājjāgaraśvāsakampamūrdharujo'nilāt| svapne bhramatyutpatati pretaiśca saha bhāṣate||18||
pittāddāhajvarasvedamohātīsāratṛḍbhramāḥ| deho haritahāridro raktanetrakapolatā||19||
śleṣmaṇā chardihṛllāsanidrodardāṅgagauravam| ---------------------------------------------------||20||
sahasā'nucitaṃ vā'nyattasya dhvaṃsakavikṣayau| bhavetāṃ mārutātkaṣṭau durbalasya viśeṣataḥ||21||

div.ab: dhvaṃsake śleṣmaniṣṭhīvaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣo'tinidratā| śabdāsahatvaṃ tandrā ca---------------------------|22|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| nivṛtto yastu madyebhyo jitātmā buddhipūrvakṛt||23||
vikāraiḥ spṛśyate jātu na sa śārīramānasaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|24| iti madātyayanidānam||1||
atha madyavaccetovihatikāraṇasāmānyānmadādīn lakṣayati - - - - ---------------------------------------------------| rajomohāhitāhāraparasya syustrayo gadāḥ||24||
rasāsṛk''cetanāvāhisrotorodhasamudbhavāḥ| madamūrcchāyasannyāsā yathottarabalottarāḥ||25||

div.ab: atha madaṃ lakṣayati - - - - atha madanidānam| mado'tra doṣaiḥ sarvaiśca raktamadyaviṣairapi| ------------------------------------------------|26|
---------------------------------------------| saktānalpadrutābhāṣaścalaḥ skhalitaceṣṭitaḥ||26|| rūkṣaśyāvāruṇatanurmade vātodbhave bhavet| ---------------------------------------------|27|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| pittena krodhano raktapītābhaḥ kalahapriyaḥ||27||
svalpasambaddhavākpāṇḍuḥ kaphāddhyānaparo'lasaḥ| -----------------------------------------------||29||
---------------------------------------------| viṣe kampo'tinidrā ca sarvebhyo'bhyadhikastu saḥ||29||
lakṣayellakṣaṇotkarṣādvātādīn śoṇitādiṣu| -------------------------------------------------|30| iti madanidānam||2||
atha mūrcchāyaṃ lakṣayati - - - - atha mūrcchāyanidānam| ------------------------------------------------| aruṇaṃ kṛṣṇanīlaṃ vā khaṃ paśyanpraviśettamaḥ||30||
śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyeta hṛtpīḍā vepathurbhramaḥ| kārśyaṃ śyāvāruṇā chāyā mūrchāye mārutātmake||31||

div.ab: pittena raktaṃ pītaṃ vā nabhaḥ paśyan viśettamaḥ| vibudhyeta ca sasvedo dāhatṛṭtāpapīḍitaḥ||32|| bhinnaviṇnīlapītābho raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ| ------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------| kaphena meghasaṃkāśaṃ paśyannākāśamāviśet||33||
tamaścirācca budhyeta sahṛllāsaḥ prasekavān| gurubhiḥ stimitairaṅgairārdracarmāvanaddhavat||34||

div.ab: sarvākṛtistribhirdoṣairapasmāra ivāparaḥ| pātayatyāśu niśceṣṭaṃ vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ||35|| iti mūrcchāyanidānam|36|

ab.seg: idānīṃ sannyāsaṃ lakṣayitumāha - - - - atha sannyāsanidānam| doṣeṣu madamūrcchāyāḥ kṛtavegeṣu dehinām| svayamevopaśāmyanti, sannyāso nauṣadhairvinā||36||
vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭāmākṣipyātibalā malāḥ| sannyāsaṃ sannipatitāḥ prāṇāyatanasaṃśrayāḥ||37||
kurvanti, tena puruṣaḥ kāṣṭhībhūto mṛtopamaḥ| mriyeta śīghraṃ śīghraṃ ceccikitsā na prayujyate||38||
śīghraṃ cikitsanājjīvet, ityatraivodāharaṇārthamāha - - - - agādhe grāhabahule salilaugha ivātaṭe| sannyāse vinimajjantaṃ naramāśu nivartayet||39||
iti sannyāsanidānam||3||
idānīṃ madātyayanidānatvānmadyasya madyenaivopasaṃhāraṃ kurvannāha - - - - madamānaroṣatoṣaprabhṛtibhiraribhirnijaiḥ pariṣvaṅgaḥ| yuktāyuktaṃ ca samaṃ yuktiviyuktena madyena||40||

div.ab: punarapi yuktiṃ pradarśayannāha - - - - balakāladeśasātmyaprakṛtisahāyāmayavayāṃsi| pravibhajya tadanurūpaṃ yadi pibati tataḥ pibatyamṛtam|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne madātyayādinidānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

div.head: arśonidanādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto'rśasāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: arivatprāṇino māṃsakīlakā viśasanti yat| arśāṃsi tasmāducyante gudamārganirodhataḥ||1||
doṣāstvaṅmāṃsamedāṃsi sandūṣya vividhākṛtīn| māṃsāṅkurānapānādau kurvantyarśāṃsi tān jaguḥ||2||

div.ab: sahajanmottarotthānabhedāddvedhā samāsataḥ| śuṣkasrāvivibhedācca----------------------|3|

ab.seg: "apānādau" ityuktam| atha tadeva gudāparaparyāyaṃ lakṣayati - - - - -------------------------------------------------| ----------------------gudaḥ sthūlāntrasaṃśrayaḥ||3||
ardhapañcāṅgulastasmiṃstisro'dhyardhāṅgulāḥ sthitāḥ| valyaḥ, pravāhiṇī tāsāmantarmadhye visarjanī||4||
bāhyā saṃvaraṇī tasyā gudauṣṭho bahiraṅgule| yavādhyardhaḥ pramāṇena romāṇyatra tataḥ param||5||
tatra hetuḥ sahotthānāṃ valībījopataptatā| arśasāṃ, bījataptistu mātāpitrapacārataḥ||6||
daivācca, tābhyāṃ kopo hi sannipātasya tānyataḥ| asādhyānvevamākhyātāḥ sarve rogāḥ kulodbhavāḥ||7||
sahajāni viśeṣeṇa rūkṣadurdarśanāni ca| antarmukhāni pāṇḍūni dāruṇopadravāṇi ca||8||

div.ab: ṣoḍhā'nyāni pṛthagdoṣasaṃsarganicayāsrataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śuṣkāṇi vātaśleṣmabhyāmārdrāṇi tvasrapittataḥ||9||

div.ab: doṣaprakopahetustu prāguktastena sādite| agnau, male'tinicite, punaścātivyavāyataḥ||10|| yānasaṅkṣobhaviṣamakaṭhinotkaṭakāsanāt| bastinetrāśmaloṣṭhorvītalacailādighaṭṭanāt||11|| bhṛśaṃ śītāmbusaṃsparśātpratatātipravāhaṇāt| vātamūtraśakṛdvegadhāraṇāttadudīraṇāt||12|| jvaragulmātisārāmagrahaṇīśophapāṇḍubhiḥ| karśanādviṣamābhyaśca ceṣṭābhyo, yoṣitāṃ punaḥ||13|| āmagarbhaprapatanādgarbhavṛddhiprapīḍanāt| īdṛśaiścāparairvāyurapānaḥ kupito malam||14|| pāyorvalīṣu taṃ dhatte tāsvabhiṣyaṇṇamūrtiṣu| jāyante'rśāṃsi-------------------------------|15|

-----------------------------------------------| -----------------tatpūrvalakṣaṇaṃ mandavahnitā||15|| viṣṭambhaḥ sakthisadanaṃ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ bhramaḥ| sādo'ṅge netrayoḥ śophaḥ śakṛdbhedo'thavā grahaḥ||16|| mārutaḥ pracuro mūḍhaḥ prāyo nābheradhaścaran| saruk saparikartaśca kṛcchrānnirgacchati svanan||17|| antrakūjanamāṭopaḥ kṣāmatodgārabhūritā| prabhūtaṃ mūtramalpā viḍaśraddhā dhūmako'mlakaḥ||18|| śiraḥpṛṣṭhorasāṃ śūlamālasyaṃ bhinnavarṇatā| tandrendriyāṇāṃ daurbalyaṃ krodho duḥkhopacāratā||19|| āśaṅkā grahaṇīdoṣapāṇḍugulmodareṣu ca| -----------------------------------------------|20|

-----------------------------------------------| etānyeva vivarddhante jāteṣu hatanāmasu||20|| nivartamāno'pāno hi tairadhomārgarodhataḥ| kṣobhayannanilānanyān sarvendriyaśarīragān||21|| tathā mūtraśakṛtpittakaphān dhātūṃśca sāśayān| mṛdgātyagniṃ tataḥ sarvo bhavati prāyaśo'rśasaḥ||22|| kṛśo bhṛśaṃ hatotsāho dīnaḥ kṣāmo'tiniṣprabhaḥ| asāro vigatacchāyo jantujuṣṭa iva drumaḥ||23|| kṛtsnairupadravairgasto yathoktairmarmapīḍanaiḥ| tathā kāsapipāsāsyavairasyaśvāsapīnasaiḥ||24|| klamāṅgabhaṅgavamathukṣavathuśvayathujvaraiḥ| klaibyabādhiryataimiryaśarkarāśmaripīḍitaḥ||25|| kṣāmabhinnasvaro dhyāyanmuhuḥ ṣṭhīvannarocakī| sarvaparvāsthihṛnnābhipāyuvaṅkṣaṇaśūlavān||26|| gudena sravatā picchāṃ pulākodakasannibhām| vibaddhamuktaṃ śuṣkārdraṃ pakkāmaṃ cāntarā'ntarā||27|| pāṇḍu pītaṃ haridraktaṃ picchilaṃ copaveśyate| -----------------------------------------------|28|

vātārśasāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - - - - gudāṅkurā bahvanilāḥ śuṣkāścimicimānvitāḥ||28|| mlānāḥ śyāvāruṇāḥ stabdhā viṣamāḥ paruṣāḥ kharāḥ| mitho visadṛśā vakrāstīkṣṇā viśphuṭitānanāḥ||29|| bimbīkarkandhukharjūrakārpāsīphalasannibhāḥ| kecitkadambapuṣpābhāḥ kecitsiddhārthakopamāḥ||30|| śiraḥpārśvāṃsakaṭyūruvaṅkṣaṇābhyadhikavyathāḥ| kṣavathūdgāraviṣṭambhahṛdgrahārocakapradāḥ||31|| kāsaśvāsāgnivaiṣamyakarṇanādabhramāvahāḥ| tairārto grathitaṃ stokaṃ saśabdaṃ sapravāhikam||32|| rukphenapicchānugataṃ vibaddhamupaveśyate| kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhaviṇmūtranetravakkraśca jāyate||33|| gulmaplīhodarāṣṭhīlāsambhavastata eva ca|34|

-----------------------------------------------| pittottarā nīlamukhā raktaptāsitaprabhāḥ||34|| tanvasrasrāviṇo visrāstanavo mṛdavaḥ ślathāh| śukajihvāyakṛt''khaṇḍajalaukovakkrasannibhāḥ||35|| dāhapākajvarasvedatṛṇmūrcchārucitamohadāḥ| soṣmāṇo dravanīloṣṇapītaraktāmavarcasaḥ||36|| yavamadhyā harītpītahāridratvaṅūnakhādayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|37|

-----------------------------------------------| śleṣmolbaṇā mahāmūlā ghanā mandarujaḥ sitāḥ||37|| ucchūnopacitāḥ snigdhāḥ stabdhavṛttagurusthirāḥ| picchilāḥ stimitāḥ ślakṣṇāḥ kaṇḍvāḍhyāḥ sparśanapriyāḥ||38|| karīrapanasāsthyābhāstathā gostanasannibhāḥ| vaṅkṣaṇānāhinaḥ pāyubastinābhivikartinaḥ||39|| sakāsaśvāsahṛllāsaprasekārucipīnasāḥ| mehakṛcchraśirojāḍyaśiśirajvarakāriṇaḥ||40|| klaibyāgnimārdavacchardirāmaprāyavikāradāḥ| vasābhasakaphaprājyapurīṣāḥ sapravāhikāḥ||41|| na sravanti na bhidyante pāṇḍusnigdhatvagādayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|42|

ab.seg: raktolbaṇā gudekīlāḥ pittākṛtisamanvitāḥ| vaṭaprarohasadṛśā guñjāvidrumasannibhāḥ||43||
te'tyarthaṃ duṣṭamuṣṇaṃ ca gāḍhaviṭpratipīḍitāḥ| sravanti sahasā raktaṃ tasya cātipravṛttitaḥ||44||
bhekābhaḥ pīḍyate duḥkhaiḥ śoṇitakṣayasambhavaiḥ| hīnavarṇabalotsāho hataujāḥ kaluṣendriyaḥ||45||
mudgakodravajūrṇāhvakarīracaṇakādibhiḥ| rūkṣaiḥ saṅgrāhibhirvāyuḥ sve sthāne kupito balī||46||
adhovahāni srotāṃsi saṃrudhyādhaḥ praśoṣayan| purīṣaṃ vātaviṇmūtrasaṅgaṃ kurvīta dāruṇam||47||
tena tīvrā rujā koṣṭhapṛṣṭhahṛtpārśvagā bhavet| ādhmānamudarāveṣṭho hṛllāsaḥ parikartanam||48||
bastau ca sutarāṃ śūlaṃ gaṇḍaśvayathusambhavaḥ| pavanasyordhvagāmitvaṃ tataścchardyarucijvarāḥ||49||
hṛdrogagrahaṇīdoṣamūtrasaṅgapravāhikāḥ| bādhiryatimiraśvāsaśirorukkāsapīnasāḥ||50||
manovikārastṛṣṇāsrapittagulmodarādayaḥ| te te ca vātajā rogā jāyante bhṛśadāruṇāḥ||51||
durnāmnāmityudāvartaḥ paramo'yamupadravaḥ| vātābhibhūtakoṣṭhānāṃ tairvinā'pi sa jāyate||52||
adhunā sādhyāsādhyavibhāgameṣāmāha - - - - sahajāni tridoṣāṇi yāni cābhyantare valau| sthitāni tānyasādhyāni, yāpyante'gnibalādibhiḥ||53||
dvandvajāni dvitīyāyāṃ valau yānyāśritāni ca| kṛcchrasādhyāni tānyāhuḥ parisaṃvatsarāṇi ca||54||
bāhyāyāṃ tu valau jātānyekadoṣolbaṇāni ca| arśāṃsi sukhasādhyāni na cirotpatitāni ca||55||
-------------------------------nābhijāni tu| gaṇḍūpadāsyarūpāṇi picchilāni mṛdūni ca||56||
carmakīlānyāha - - - - vyāno gṛhītvā śleṣmāṇaṃ karotyarśastvaco bahiḥ| kīlopamaṃ sthirakharaṃ carmakīlaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ||57||
vātena todaḥ pāruṣyaṃ, pittādasitaraktatā| śleṣmaṇā snigdhatā tasya grathitatvaṃ savarṇtā||58||

div.ab: arśasāṃ praśame yatnamāśu kurvīta buddhimān| tānyāśu hi gudaṃ baddhā kuryurbaddhagudodaram|59| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne'rśasāṃ nidānaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|7|

div.head: atīsāragrahaṇiroganidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: tasmādatīsāragrahaṇīroganidānaṃ prakramyata ityāha - - - - athāto'tīsāragrahaṇīdoṣanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

div.ab: doṣairvyastaiḥ samastaiśca bhayācchokācca ṣaḍvidhaḥ| atīsāraḥ--------------------------------------------|1|

-----------------------------------------------| ----------------sa sutarāṃ jāyate'tyambupānataḥ||1|| kṛśaśuṣkāmiṣāsātmyatilapiṣṭavirūḍhakaiḥ| madyarūkṣātimātrānnairarśobhiḥ snehavibhramāt||2|| kṛmibhyo vegarodhācca tadvidhaiḥ kupito'nilaḥ| visraṃsayatyadho'bdhātuṃ hatvā tenaiva cānalam||3|| vyāpadyānuśakṛtkoṣṭhaṃ purīṣaṃ dravatāṃ nayan| prakalpate'tisārāya-----------------------------|4|
-----------------------------------------------| -------------------------lakṣaṇaṃ tasya bhāvinaḥ||4|| todo hṛdgudakoṣṭheṣu gātrasādo malagrahaḥ| ādhmānamavipākaśca------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: alpālpaṃ śabdaśūlāḍhyaṃ vibaddhamupaveśyate| rūkṣaṃ saphenamacchaṃ ca grathitaṃ vā muhurmuhuḥ||6||
tathā dagdhaguḍābhāsaṃ sapicchāparikartikam| śuṣkāsyo bhraṣṭapāyuśca hṛṣṭaromā viniṣṭanan||7||

div.ab: pittena pītamasitaṃ hāridraṃ śādvalaprabham| saraktamatidurgandhaṃ tṛṇmūrcchāsvedadāhavān||8|| saśūlaṃ pāyusantāpapākavān------------------| -----------------------------------------------|9|

---------------------------------śleṣmaṇā ghanam| picchilaṃ tantumacchvetaṃ snigdhamāmaṃ kaphānvitam||9|| abhīkṣṇaṃ guru durgandhaṃ vibaddhamanubaddharuk| nidrāluralaso'nnadviḍalpālpaṃ sapravāhikam||10|| saromaharṣaḥ sotkleśo gurubastigudodaraḥ| kṛte'pyakṛtasaṃjñaśca------------------|11|

bhayena kṣobhite citte sapitto drāvayecchakṛt| vāyustato'tisāryeta kṣipramuṣṇaṃ dravaṃ plavam||12|| vātapittasamaṃ liṅgairāhuḥ----------------------| ------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: -------------------tatrādye gauravādapsu majjati| śakṛddurgandhamāṭopaviṣṭambhārtiprasekinaḥ||14||

div.ab: viparīto nirāmastu kaphātpakvo'pi majjati| -----------------------------------------------|15|

atha grahaṇīrogaṃ lakṣayati - - - - -----------------------------------------------| atīsāreṣu yo nātiyatnavān grahaṇīgadaḥ||15|| tasya syādagnividhvaṃsakarairanyasya sevitaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|16|

atīsāragrahaṇīrogayoḥ samānābhāsatvāt ko viśeṣaḥ ? ityāha - - - - --------------------------------------------------| sāmaṃ śakṛnnirāmaṃ vā jīrṇe yenātisāryate||16|| so'tisāro'tisaraṇādāśukārī svabhāvataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: atha grahaṇīdoṣasya svarūpaṃ varṇayannatīsārādbhūyo medamāha - - - - -----------------------------------------------| sāmaṃ sānnamajīrṇe'nne jīrṇe pakvaṃ tu naiva vā||17||
akasmādvā muhurbaddhamakasmācchithilaṃ muhuḥ| cirakṛdgrahaṇīdoṣaḥ sañcayāccopaveśayet||18||

div.ab: sa caturdhā pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sannipātācca jāyate| -------------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| prāgrūpaṃ tasya sadanaṃ cirātpacanamamlakaḥ||19||
praseko vakkravairasyamarucistṛṭ klamo bhramaḥ| ānaddhodaratā chardiḥ karṇakṣveḍo'ntrakūjanam||20||
sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kārśyaṃ dhūmakastamako jvaraḥ| mūrcchā śirorugviṣṭambhaḥ śvayathuḥ karapādayoḥ||21||

div.ab: tatrānilāttāluśoṣastimiraṃ karṇayoḥ svanaḥ| pārśvoruvaṅkṣaṇagrīvārujā'bhīkṣṇaṃ viṣūcikā||22|| raseṣu gṛddhiḥ sarveṣu kṣuttṛṣṇā parikartikā| jīrṇe jīryati cādhmānaṃ bhukte svāsthyaṃ samaśnute||23|| vātahṛdrogagulmārśaḥplīhapāṇḍutvaśaṅkitaḥ| cirādduḥkhaṃ dravaṃ śuṣkaṃ tanvāmaṃ śabdaphenavat||24|| punaḥpunaḥ sṛjedvarcaḥ pāyurukśvāsakāsavān| -----------------------------------------------|25|
-----------------------------------------------| pittena nīlapītābhaṃ pītābhaḥ sṛjati dravam||25|| pūtyamlodgārahṛtkaṇṭhadāhārucitṛḍarditaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|26|

-----------------------------------------------| śleṣmaṇā pacyate duḥkhamannaṃ chardirarocakaḥ||26|| āsyopadeheniṣṭhīvakāsahṛllāsapīnasāḥ| hṛdayaṃ manyate styānamudaraṃ stimitaṃ guru||27|| udgāro duṣṭamadhuraḥ sadanaṃ strīṣvaharṣaṇam| bhinnāmaśleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭaguruvarcaḥpravartanam||28|| akṛśasyāpi daurbalyam------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|29|

vātavyādhyaśmarīkuṣṭhamehodarabhagandarāḥ| arśāṃsi grahaṇītyaṣṭau mahārogāḥ sudustarāḥ|30| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne'tīsāragrahaṇīdoṣanidānaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|8|

div.head: mūtrāghātanidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atīsāragrahaṇīroganidanānantaraṃ mūtrāghātanidānamekasambandhanatvāducyata ityāha - - - - athāto mūtrāghātanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||
bastibastiśiromeḍhrakaṭīvṛṣaṇapāyavaḥ| ekasambandhanāḥ proktā gudāsthivivarāśrayāḥ||1||

nanu, atra mūtrāśritā doṣā avaśyaṃ bastiṃ prāpya vikurvate| basteścādhomukhatvānmūtrāntaḥpraveśo bastimukhena na sambhāvyate, tasmānmūtrāghātānutpattireva, ityāśaṅkyāha - - - - adhomukho'pi bastirhi mūtravāhisirāmukhaiḥ| pārśvebhyaḥ pūryate sūkṣmaiḥ syandamānairanāratam||2||
yaistaireva praviśyainaṃ doṣāḥ kurvanti viṃśatim| mūtrāghātān pramehāṃśca kṛcchrānmarmasamāśrayān||3||

div.ab: bastivaṅkṣaṇameḍrārtiyukto'lpālpaṃ muhurmuhuḥ| mūtrayedvātaje kṛcchre-------------------------|4|
----------------kaphaje bastimeḍragauravaśophavān| sapicchaṃ savibandhaṃ ca------------------------|5|

idānīmaśmarīṃ lakṣayati - - - - yadā vāyurmukhaṃ basterāvṛtya pariśoṣayet| mūtraṃ sapittaṃ sakaphaṃ saśukraṃ vā tadā kramāt||6|| sañjāyate'śmarī ghorā pittādgoriva rocanā| śleṣmāśrayā ca sarvā syāt---------------------|7|

ab.seg: bastyādhmānaṃ tadāsannadeśeṣu parito'tiruk| mūtre ca bastagandhatvaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ jvaro'ruciḥ||8||
sāmānyaliṅgaṃ ruḍnābhisevanībastimūrdhasu| viśīrṇadhāraṃ mūtraṃ syāttayā mārganirodhane||9||
tahyapāyātsukhaṃ mehedacchaṃ gomedakopamam| tatsaṅkṣobhātkṣate sāsramāyāsāccātirugbhavet||10||
tatra vātādbhṛśārtyārto dantān khādati vepate| mṛdgāti mehanaṃ nābhiṃ pīḍayatyaniśaṃ kvaṇan||11||
sānilaṃ muñcati śakṛnmuhurmehati binduśaḥ| śyāvā rūkṣā'śmarī cāsya syāccitā kaṇṭakairiva||12||
pittena dahyate bastiḥ pacyamāna ivoṣmavān| bhallātakāsthisaṃsthānā raktā pītā'sitā'śmarī||13||
bastirnistudyata iva śleṣmaṇā śītalo guruḥ| aśmarī mahatī ślakṣṇā madhuvarṇā'thavā sitā||14||
etā bhavanti bālānāṃ teṣāmeva ca bhūyasā| āśrayopacayālpatvādgrahaṇāharaṇe sukhāḥ||15||

div.ab: śukrāśmarī tu mahatāṃ jāyate śukradhāraṇāt| sthānāccyutamamuktaṃ hi muṣkayorantare'nilaḥ||16|| śoṣayatyupasaṅgṛhya śukraṃ tacchuṣkamaśmarī| bastirukkṛcchramūtratvamuṣkaśvayathukāriṇī||17|| tasyāmutpannamātrāyāṃ śukrameti vilīyate| pīḍite tvavakāśe'smin----------------------|18|

ab.seg: aṇuśo vāyunā bhinnā sā tvasminnanulomage| nireti saha mūtreṇa pratilome vibadhyate||19||

div.ab: atha vātabastyādīnāha - - - - mūtrasandhāriṇaḥ kuryādbuddhvā bastermukhaṃ marut| mūtrasaṅgaṃ rujaṃ kaṇḍūṃ kadācicca svadhāmataḥ||20|| pracyāvya bastimudvṛttaṃ garbhābhaṃ sthūlaviplutam| karoti tatra rugdāhaspandanodveṣṭanāni ca||21|| binduśaśca pravarteta mūtraṃ bastau tu pīḍate| dhārayā dvividho'pyeṣa vātabastiriti smṛtaḥ||22|| dustaro dustarataro dvitīyaḥ prabalānilaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| śakṛnmārgasya basteśca vāyurantaramāśritaḥ||23||
aṣṭhīlābhaṃ ghanaṃ granthiṃ karotyacalamunnatam| vātāṣṭhīleti sā''dhmānaviṇmūtrānilasaṅgakṛt||24||

div.ab: viguṇaḥ kaṇḍalībhūto bastau tīvravyatho'nilaḥ| āvidhya mūtraṃ bhramati sastambhodveṣṭagauravaḥ||25|| mūtramalpālpamathavā vimuñcati śakṛtsṛjan| vātakuṇḍaliketyeṣā--------------------------|26|

----------------------------------------------| vidhāraṇātpratihitaṃ vātodāvartitaṃ yadā||27|| nābheradhastādudaraṃ mūtramāpūrayettadā| kuryāttīvrarugādhmānamapaktiṃ malasaṅgraham||28|| tanmūtrajaṭharam-----------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: --------------------------chidravaiguṇyenānilena vā| ākṣiptamalpaṃ mūtraṃ tadbastau nāle'thavā maṇau||29||
sthitvā sravecchanaiḥ paścātsarujaṃ vā'tha nīrujam| mūtrotsaṅgaḥ sa vicchinnataccheṣaguruśephasaḥ||30||
antarbastimukhe vṛttaḥ sthiro'lpaḥ sahasā bhavet| aśmarītulyaruk granthirmūtragranthiḥ sa ucyate||31||

div.ab: mūtritasya striyaṃ yāto vāyunā śukramuddhatam| sthānāccyutaṃ mūtrayataḥ prāk paścādvā pravartate||32|| bhasmodakapratīkāśaṃ mūtraśukraṃ taducyate| --------------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| rūkṣadurbalayorvātādudāvartaṃ śakṛdyadā||33||
mūtrasroto'nuparyeti saṃsṛṣṭaṃ śakṛtā tadā| mūtraṃ viṭtulyagandhaṃ syādviḍvighātaṃ tamādiśet||34||
pittaṃ vyāyāmatīkṣṇoṣṇabhojanādhvātapādibhiḥ| pravṛddhaṃ vāyunā kṣiptaṃ bastyupasthārtidāhavat||35||
mūtraṃ pravartayetpītaṃ saraktaṃ raktameva vā| uṣṇaṃ punaḥpunaḥ kṛcchrāduṣṇavātaṃ vadanti tam||36||
rūkṣasya klāntadehasya bastisthau pittamārutau| mūtrakṣayaṃ sarugdāhaṃ janayetāṃ tadāhvayam||37||
pittaṃ kapho dvāvapi vā saṃhanyete'nilena cet| kṛcchrānmūtraṃ tadā pītaṃ raktaṃ śvetaṃ ghanaṃ sṛjet||38||
sadāhaṃ rocanāśaṅkhacūrṇavarṇaṃ bhavecca tat| śuṣkaṃ samastavarṇaṃ vā mūtrasādaṃ vadanti tam||39||

div.ab: iti vistarataḥ proktā rogā mūtrāpravṛttijāḥ| nidānalakṣaṇairūrdhvaṃ vakṣyante'tipravṛttijāḥ|40| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne mūtrāghātanidānaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|9|

div.head: pramehanidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: aśmarīnidānādanantaraṃ pramehanidānamārabhyate - - - - athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2| pramehā viṃśatistatra śleṣmato daśa, pittataḥ| ṣaṭ, catvāro'nilāt-----------------------------|1|

ab.seg: annapānakriyājātaṃ yatprāyastatpravartakam| svādvamlalavaṇasnigdhagurupicchilaśītalam||2||
navadhānyasurānūpamāṃsekṣuguḍagorasam| ekasthānāsanaratiḥ śayanaṃ vidhivarjitam||3||
bastimāśritya kurute pramehān dūṣitaḥ kaphaḥ| dūṣayitvā vapuḥkledasvedamedorasāmiṣam||4||

div.ab: pittaṃ raktamapi kṣīṇe kaphādau mūtrasaṃśrayam| ----------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| dhātūn bastimupānīya tatkṣaye'pi ca mārutaḥ||5||
atha sādhyāsādhyavibhāgamāha - - - - sādhyayāpyaparityājyā mehāstenaiva tadbhavāḥ| samāsamakriyatayā mahātyayatayā'pi ca||6||

div.ab: sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ prabhūtāvilamūtratā| ----------------------------------------------|7|

nanu, doṣasya-kaphādeḥ, dūṣyasya ca-vapuḥkledādeḥ, tulyatvāt kathaṃ pratidoṣaṃ pramehānekatvaṃ syāt ? ityāha - - - - ----------------------------------------------| doṣadūṣyāviśeṣe'pi tatsaṃyogaviśeṣataḥ||7|| mūtravarṇādibhedena bhedo meheṣu kalpyate| ----------------------------------------------|8|

athodakamehādīn lakṣayati - - - - -----------------------------------------------| acchaṃ bahu sitaṃ śītaṃ nirgandhamudakopamam||8|| mehatyudakamehena kiñciccāvilapicchilam| ----------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| ikṣo rasamivātyarthaṃ madhuraṃ cekṣumehataḥ||9||

div.ab: sāndrībhavetparyuṣitaṃ sāndramehena mehati| ----------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| surāmehī surātulyamuparyacchamadho ghanam||10||

div.ab: saṃhṛṣṭaromā piṣṭena piṣṭavadbahalaṃ sitam| ------------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| śukrābhaṃ śukramiśraṃ vā śukramehi pramehati||11||

div.ab: śanaiḥśanaiḥśanairmehī mandaṃmandaṃ pramehati| ------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| lālātantuyutaṃ mūtraṃ lālāmehena picchilam||13||

div.ab: pittajānāha - - - - gandhavarṇarasasparśaiḥ kṣāreṇa kṣāratoyavat| ------------------------------------------------|14|
hāridramehī kaṭukaṃ haridrāsannibhaṃ dahat| ------------------------------------------------|15|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| visraṃ māñjiṣṭhamehena mañjiṣṭhāsalilopamam||15||

div.ab: visramuṣṇaṃ salavaṇaṃ raktābhaṃ raktamehataḥ| ------------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: adhunā vātajān vakti - - - - ------------------------------------------------| vasāmehī vasāmiśraṃ vasāṃ vā mūtrayenmuhuḥ||16||

div.ab: majjānaṃ majjamiśraṃ vā majjamehī muhurmuhuḥ| ------------------------------------------------|17|
------------------------------------------------| hastī matta ivājasraṃ mūtraṃ vegavivarjitam||17|| salasīkaṃ vibaddhaṃ ca hastimehī pramehati| ------------------------------------------------|18|

------------------------------------------------| āvṛto doṣaliṅgāni so'nimittaṃ pradarśayet||19|| kṣīṇaḥ kṣaṇātkṣaṇāt pūrṇo bhajate kṛcchrasādhyatām| ------------------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| kālenopekṣitāḥ sarve yadyānti madhumehatām||20||
madhuraṃ yacca sarveṣu prāyo madhviva mehati| sarve'pi madhumehākhyā mādhuryācca tanorataḥ||21||
avipāko'ruciśrchardirnidrā kāsaḥ sapīnasaḥ| upadravāḥ prajāyante mehānāṃ kaphajanmanām||22||
bastimehanayostodo muṣkāvadaraṇaṃ jvaraḥ| dāhastṛṣṇā'mlako mūrcchā viḍbhedaḥ pittajanmanām||23||
vātikānāmudāvartakampahṛdgrahalolatāḥ| śūlamunnidratā śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaśca jāyate||24||
pramehiṇāṃ ca piṭikāḥ śarāvikādyāḥ prāyeṇa bhavanti, iti tā evāha - - - - śarāvikā kacchapikā jālinī vinatā'lajī| masūrikā sarṣapikā putriṇī savidārikā||25||
vidradhiśceti piṭikāḥ pramehopekṣayā daśa| sandhimarmasu jāyante māṃsaleṣu ca dhāmasu||26||
antonnatā madhyanimnā śyāvā kledarujānvitā| śarāvamānasaṃsthānā piṭikā syāccharāvikā||27||
avagāḍhārtinistodā mahāvastuparigrahā| ślakṣṇā kacchapapṛṣṭhābhā piṭikā kacchapī matā||28||
stabdhā sirājālavatī snigdhasrāvā mahāśayā| rujānistodabahulā sūkṣmacchidrā ca jālinī||29||
avagāḍharujākledā pṛṣṭhe vā jaṭhare'pi vā| mahatī piṭikā nīlā vinatā vinatā smṛtā||30||
dahati tvacamutthāne bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭā visarpiṇī| raktakṛṣṇā'titṛṭsphoṭadāhamohajvarā'lajī||31||

div.ab: mānasaṃsthānayostulyā masūreṇa masūrikā| ------------------------------------------------|32|
------------------------------------------------| sarṣapāmānasaṃsthānā kṣiprapākā mahārujā||32|| sarṣapī sarṣapātulyapiṭikāparivāritā| ------------------------------------------------|33|
vidārīkandavadvṛttā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā| ------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: putriṇī ca vidārī ca duḥsahā bahumedasaḥ| sahyāḥ pittolbaṇāstvanyāḥ sambhavantyalpamedasaḥ||35||

div.ab: tāsu mehavaśācca syāddoṣodreko yathāyatham| ------------------------------------------------|36|

ab.seg: prameheṇa vinā'pyetā jāyante duṣṭamedasaḥ| tāvacca nopalakṣyante yāvadvastuparigrahaḥ||36||
hāridravarṇaṃ raktaṃ vā mehaprāgrūpavarjitam| yo mūtrayenna taṃ mehaṃ raktapittaṃ tu tadviduḥ||37||
svedo'ṅgagandhaḥ śithilatvamaṅge śayyāsanasvapnasukhābhiṣaṅgaḥ| hṛnnetrajihvāśravaṇopadeho ghanāṅgatā keśanakhātivṛddhiḥ||38||
śītapriyatvaṃ galatāluśoṣo mādhuryamāsye karapādadāhaḥ| bhaviṣyato mehagaṇasya rūpaṃ mūtre'bhidhāvanti pipīlikāśca||39||
dṛṣṭvā pramehaṃ madhuraṃ sapicchaṃ madhūpamaṃ syāddvividho vicāraḥ| sampūraṇādvā kaphasambhavaḥ syāt kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣvanilātmako vā||40||

div.ab: adhunā yaduktaṃ sādhyayāpyaparityājyāḥ kaphādisambhavā ityasyāpavādamāha - - - - sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittemehāḥ krameṇa ye vātakṛtāśca mehāḥ| sādhyā na te, pittakṛtāstu yāpyāḥ sādhyāstu medo yadi nātiduṣṭam|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|10|

div.head: vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atastameva vidradhiṃ lakṣayitumasyādhyāyasya prasaṅga ityāha - - - - athāto vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||
bhuktaiḥ paryuṣitātyuṣṇarūkṣaśuṣkavidāhibhiḥ| jihmaśayyāviceṣṭābhistaistaiścāsṛkpradūṣaṇaiḥ||1||
duṣṭatvaṅmāṃsamedosthisnāyvasṛkkaṇḍarāśrayaḥ| yaḥ śopho bahirantarvā mahāmūlo mahārujaḥ||2||
ṣoḍhetyuktam| atha tadeva ṣoḍhatvaṃ pratipādayitumāha - - - - vṛttaḥ syādāyato yo vā smṛtaḥ ṣoḍhā sa vidradhiḥ| doṣaiḥ pṛthaksamuditaiḥ śoṇitena kṣatena ca||3||

div.ab: ṣaḍvidhasyāpi śophasya vidradhyākhyasyāntarbahīrūpatayā dvidhātvamityāha - - - - bāhyo'tra tatratatrāṅge dāruṇo grathitonnataḥ| āntaro dāruṇataro gambhīro gulmavaddhanaḥ||4|| valmīkavatsamucchrāyī śīghraghātyagniśastravat| ----------------------------------------------|5|
