--------------------------vātāttatrātitīvraruk| śyāvāruṇaścirotthānapāko viṣamasaṃsthitaḥ||6|| vyadhacchedabhramānāhaspandasarpaṇaśabdavān| --------------------------------------------------|7|
---------------------pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūyutaḥ kaphāt| sotkleśaśītakastambhajṛmbhārocakagauravaḥ||8|| cirotthānavipākaśca-----------------------| --------------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| sāmarthyāccātra vibhajedbāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇam||9||
kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvastīvradāharujājvaraḥ| pittaliṅgo'sṛjā bāhyaḥ strīṇāmeva tathā''ntaraḥ||10||

div.ab: atha kṣatavidradhiṃ lakṣayati - - - - śastrādyairabhighātena kṣate vā'pathyakāriṇaḥ| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvikṣiptaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayan||11|| pittāsṛglakṣaṇaṃ kuryādvidradhiṃ bhūryupadravam| --------------------------------------------------|12|

--------------------------------------------------| teṣūpadravabhedaśca smṛto'dhiṣṭhānabhedataḥ||12|| tamevopadravabhedaṃ darśayati - - - - nābhyāṃ hidhmā, bhavedbastau mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa pūti ca| śvāso yakṛti, rodhastu plīhnyucchvāsasya, tṛṭ punaḥ||13|| galagrahaśca klomni, syātsarvāṅgapragraho hṛdi| pramohastamakaḥ kāso hṛdaye ghaṭṭanaṃ vyathā||14|| kukṣipārśvāntarāṃsārtiḥ kukṣāvāṭopajanma ca| sakthnorgraho vaṅkṣaṇayorvṛkkayoḥ kaṭipṛṣṭhayoḥ||15|| pārśvayośca vyathā pāyau pavanasya nirodhanam| --------------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| āmapakvavidagdhatvaṃ teṣāṃ śophavadādiśet||16||

div.ab: nābherūrdhvaṃ mukhātpakvāḥ prasravantyadhare gudāt| gudāsyānnābhijo----------------------------------|17|

athaiṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārthamāha - - - - --------------------tatra vivarjyaḥ sannipātajaḥ| pakvo hṛnnābhibastistho bhinno'ntarbahireva vā||18|| pakvaścāntaḥ sravan vakkrāt kṣīṇasyopadravānvitaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|19|

idānīṃ stanavidradhiryoṣitāṃ yathā syāt tathā vakti - - - - ---------------------------------------------------------------| evameva stanasirā vivṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām||19|| sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ vā sambhavecchvayathurghanaḥ| stane sadugdhe'dugdhe vā bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ||20|| nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmavaktratvātkanyānāṃ na sa jāyate| ------------------------------------------|21| iti vidradhinidānam|21|

ab.seg: atha śvayathusāmānyādidānīṃ vṛddhiṃ-vardhmāparanāmānaṃ vyādhiṃ, vaktumupakramate - - - - atha vṛddhinidānam| ------------------------------------------------| kṛddho ruddhagatirvāyuḥ śophaśūlakaraścaran||21||
muṣkau vaṅkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phalakośābhivāhinīḥ| prapīḍya dhamanīrvṛddhiṃ karoti phalakośayoḥ||22||
adhunā'sya vyādheḥ saṅkhyāṃ kurvannāha - - - - doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ saptadhā gadaḥ| mūtrāntrajāvapyanilāddhetubhedastu kevalam||23||

div.ab: vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo rūkṣo vātādaheturuk| ------------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittāddāhoṣmapākavān||24||

div.ab: kaphācchito guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino'lparuk| ------------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaśca raktataḥ||25||

div.ab: kaphavanmedasā vṛddhirmṛdustālaphalopamaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ||26||
ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivatkṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅmṛduḥ| mūtrakṛcchramadhastācca valayaṃ phalakośayoḥ||27||
vātakopibhirāhāraiḥ śītatoyāvagāhanaiḥ| dhāraṇeraṇabhārādhvaviṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ||28||
kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣubhito'nyaiśca kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā| pavano viguṇīkṛtya svaniveśādadho nayet||29||
kuryādvaṅkṣaṇasandhistho granthyābhaṃ śvayathuṃ tadā| upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhi- mādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ| prapīḍito'ntaḥ svanavān prayāti pradhmāpayanneti punaśca muktaḥ||30||
antravṛddhirasādhyo'yaṃ vātavṛddhisamākṛtiḥ||31||
iti vṛddhinidānam||2||

div.ab: vṛdhyākhyasya vyādheranantaraṃ śophasāmānyāt gulmasyāvasaraḥ, iti taṃ lakṣayitumāha - - - - atha gulmanidānam| rūkṣakṛṣṇāruṇasirātantujālagavākṣitaḥ| gulmo'ṣṭadhā pṛthagdoṣaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭairnicayaṃ gataiḥ||32|| ārtavasya ca doṣeṇa nārīṇāṃ jāyate'ṣṭamaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| jvaracchardyatisārādyairvamanādyaiśca karmabhiḥ||33||
karśito vātalānyatti śītaṃ vā'mbu bubhukṣitaḥ| yaḥ pibatyanu cānnāni laṅghanaplavanādikam||34||
sevate dehasaṅkṣobhi chardiṃ vā samudīrayet| anudīrṇāmudīrṇānvā vātādīnna vimuñcati||35||
snehasvedāvanabhyasya śodhanaṃ vā niṣevate| śuddho vā''śuvidāhīni bhajate syandanāni vā||36||
vātolbaṇāstasya malāḥ pṛthak kruddhā dviśo'thavā| sarve vā raktayuktā vā mahāsrotonuśāyinaḥ||37||
ūrdhvādhomārgamāvṛtya kurvate śūlapūrvakam| sparśopalabhyaṃ gulmākhyamutplutaṃ granthirūpiṇam||38||

div.ab: adhunā vātagulmaṃ lakṣayati - - - - karśanātkaphaviṭpittairmārgasyāvaraṇena vā| vāyuḥ kṛtāśrayaḥ koṣṭhe raukṣyātkāṭhinyamāgataḥ||39|| svatantraḥ svāśraye duṣṭaḥ paratantraḥ parāśraye| piṇḍitatvādamūrto'pi mūrtatvamiva saṃśritaḥ||40|| gulma ityucyate bastinābhihṛtpārśvasaṃśrayaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|41|

------------------------------------------------| vātānmanyāśiraḥśūlaṃ jvaraplīhāntrakūjanam||41|| vyadhaḥ sūcyeva viṭsaṅgaḥ kṛcchrāducchvasanaṃ muhuḥ| stambho gātre mukhe śoṣaḥ kārśyaṃ viṣamavahnitā||42|| rūkṣakṛṣṇatvagāditvaṃ calatvādanilasya ca| anirūpitasaṃsthānasthānavṛddhikṣayavyathaḥ||43|| pipīlikāvyāpta iva gulmaḥ sphurati tudyate| ------------------------------------------------|44|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| pittāddāho'mlako mūrcchāviḍbhedasvedatṛḍūjvarāḥ||44||
hāridratvaṃ tvagādyeṣu gulmaśca sparśanāsahaḥ| dūyate dīpyate soṣmā svasthānaṃ dahatīva ca||45||

div.ab: kaphātstaimityamaruciḥ sadanaṃ śiśirajvaraḥ| pīnasālasyahṛllāsakāsaśuklatvagāditāḥ||46|| gulmo'vagāḍhaḥ kaṭhino guruḥ suptaḥ sthiro'lparuk| ------------------------------------------------|47|

-----------trayastu dvandvotthā gulmāḥ saṃsṛṣṭalakṣaṇāḥ| sarvajastīvrarugdāhaḥ śīghrapākī ghanonnataḥ||48|| so'sādhyo------------------------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|49|

-----------raktagulmastu striyā eva prajāyate| atraivopapattimāha - - - - ṛtau vā navasūtā vā yadi vā yonirogiṇī||49|| sevate vātalāni strī kruddhastasyāḥ samīraṇaḥ| niruṇaddhyārtavaṃ yonyāṃ pratimāsamavasthitam||50|| kukṣiṃ karoti tadgarbhaliṅgamāviṣkaroti ca| hṛllāsadauhṛdastanyadarśanakṣāmatādikam||51|| krameṇa vāyusaṃsargātpittayonitayā ca tat| śoṇitaṃ kurute tasyā vātapittotthugulmajān||52|| rukstambhadāhātīsāratṛḍjvarādīnupadravān| garbhāśaye ca sutarāṃ śūlaṃ duṣṭāsṛgāśraye||53|| yonyāśca srāvadaurgandhyatodaspandanavedanāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: garbhalakṣaṇādraktagulmasya vilakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇamāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| na cāṅgairgarbhavadgulmaḥ sphuratyapi tu śūlavān||54||
piṇḍībhūtaḥ sa evāsyāḥ kadācitspandate cirāt| na cāsyā varddhate kukṣigulma eva tu varddhate||55||
atha gulmavidradhyorlakṣaṇabhedaṃ kathayati - - - - svadoṣasaṃśrayo gulmaḥ sarvo bhavati tena saḥ| pākaṃ cireṇa bhajate naiva vā, vidradhiḥ punaḥ||56||
pacyate śīghramatyarthaṃ duṣṭaraktāśrayatvataḥ| ataḥ śīghravidāhitvādvidradhiḥ so'bhidhīyate||57||
atha gulmasya bāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇamāha - - - - gulme'ntarāśraye bastikukṣihṛtplīhavedanāḥ| agnivarṇabalabhraṃśo vegānāṃ cāpravartanam||58||
ato viparyayo bāhye koṣṭhāṅgeṣu tu nātiruk| vaivarṇyamavakāśasya bahirunnatatā'dhikam||59||
iti gulmanidānam||3||
gulmānāmānāhabhūyiṣṭhatvādānāhalakṣaṇamāha - - - - sāṭopamatyugrarujamādhmānamudare bhṛśam| ūrdhvādhovātarodhena tamānāhaṃ pracakṣate||60||
ghano'ṣṭhīlopamo granthiraṣṭhīlordhvaṃ samunnataḥ| ānāhaliṅgastiryaktu pratyaṣṭhīlā tadākṛtiḥ||61||
tūnīpratūnyau lakṣayati - - - - pakvāśayādgudopasthaṃ vāyustīvrarujaḥ prayān| tūnī, pratūnī tu bhavetsa evāto viparyaye||62||

div.ab: udgārabāhulyapurīṣabandha- tṛptyakṣamatvāntravikūjanāni| āṭopamādhmānamapaktiśakti- māsannagulmasya vadanti cihnam|63| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|11|

div.head: udaranidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: tasmādato'nantaramudaranidānamucyate ityāha - - - - athāta udaranidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| rogāḥ sarve'pi mande'gnau sutarāmudarāṇi tu| ajīrṇānmalinaiścānnairjāyante malasañcayāt||1||

div.ab: adhunā samprāptiviśeṣamāha - - - - ūrdhvādho dhātavo ruddhvā vāhinīrambuvāhinīḥ| prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya kuryastvaṅmāṃsasandhigāḥ||2|| ādhmāpya kukṣimudaram------------------------------| --------------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: -----------------------------aṣṭadhā tacca bhidyate| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca plīhabaddhakṣatodakaiḥ||3||

div.ab: tenārtāḥ śuṣkatālvoṣṭhāḥ śūnapādakarodarāḥ| naṣṭaceṣṭābalāhārāḥ kṛśāḥ pradhmātakukṣayaḥ||4|| syuḥ pretarūpāḥ puruṣāḥ------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|5|

--------------------------bhāvinastasya lakṣaṇam| kṣunnāśo'nnaṃ cirātsarvaṃ savidāhaṃ ca pacyate||5|| jīrṇājīrṇaṃ na jānāti sauhityaṃ sahate na ca| kṣīyate balataḥ śaśvacchvasityalpe'pi ceṣṭite||6|| vṛddhirviśo'pravṛttiśca kiñcicchophaśca pādayoḥ| rugbastisandhau tatatā laghvalpābhojanairapi||7|| rājījanma valīnāśo jaṭhare-----------------| ------------------------------------------------|8|
----------------------------------jaṭhareṣu tu| sarveṣu tandrā sadanaṃ malasaṅgo'lpavahnitā||8|| dāhaḥ śvayathurādhmānamante salilasambhavaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|9|

atoyamaduraṃ kiṃ lakṣaṇam ? ityāha - - - - ----------------------------------------------------| sarvaṃ tvatoyamaruṇamaśophaṃ nātibhārikam||9|| gavākṣitaṃ sirājālaiḥ sadā guḍaguḍāyate| nābhimantraṃ ca viṣṭabhya vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati||10|| māruto hṛtkaṭīnābhipāyuvaṅkṣaṇavedanāḥ| saśabdo niścaredvāyurviḍbaddhā mūtramalpakam||11|| nātimando'nalo laulpaṃ na ca syādvirasaṃ mukham| ------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| tatra vātodare śophaḥ pāṇipānmuṣkakukṣiṣu||12||
kukṣipārśvodarakaṭīpṛṣṭharuk parvabhedanam| śuṣkakāso'ṅgamardo'dhogurutā malasaṅgrahaḥ||13||
śyāvāruṇatvagāditvamakasmādvṛddhihlāsavat| satodabhedamudaraṃ tanukṛṣṇasirātatam||14||
ādhmātadṛtivacchabdamāhataṃ prakaroti ca| vāyuścātra sarukśabdo vicaretsarvatogatiḥ||15||
pittodare jvaro mūrcchā dāhastṛṭ kaṭukāsyatā| bhramo'tisāraḥ pītatvaṃ tvagādāvudaraṃ harit||16||
pītatāmrasirānaddhaṃ sasvedaṃ sośma dahyate| dhūmāyati mṛdusparśaṃ kṣiprapākaṃ pradūyate||17||
śleṣmodare'ṅgasadanaṃ svāpaḥ śvayathugauravam| nidrotkleśāruciśvāsakāsaśuklatvagāditā||18||
udaraṃ stimitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ śuklarājītataṃ mahat| cirābhivṛddhi kaṭhinaṃ śītasparśaṃ guru sthiram||19||

div.ab: adhunā sannipātodaraṃ lakṣayitumāha - - - - tridoṣakopanaistaistaiḥ strīdattaiśca rajomalaiḥ| garadūṣīviṣādyaiśca saraktāḥ sañcitā malāḥ||20|| koṣṭhaṃ prāpya vikurvāṇāḥ śoṣamūrcchābhramānvitam| kuryustriliṅgamudaraṃ śīghrapākaṃ sudāruṇam||21|| bādhate tacca sutarāṃ śītavātābhradarśane| ------------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: plīhodarādīnyadhunā lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------| atyāśitasya saṅkṣobhādyānayānādiceṣṭitaiḥ||22||
ativyavāyakarmādhvavamanavyādhikarśanaiḥ| vāmapārśvāśritaḥ plīhācyutaḥ sthānādvivarddhate||23||
śoṇitaṃ vā rasādibhyo vivṛddhaṃ taṃ vivarddhayet| so'ṣṭhīlevātikaṭhinaḥ prāk tataḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhavat||24||
krameṇa varddhamānaśca kukṣāvudaramāvahet| śvāsakāsapipāsāsyavairasyādhmānarugjvaraiḥ||25||
pāṇḍutvamūrcchāchardībhirdāhamohaiśca saṃyutam| aruṇābhaṃ vivarṇaṃ vā nīlahāridrarājimat||26||
udāvartarujānāhairmohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ| gauravārucikāṭhinyairvidyāttatra malān kramāt||27||

div.ab: atha yakṛllakṣayati - - - - plīhavaddakṣiṇātpārśvāt kuryādyakṛdapi cyutam| ------------------------------------------------|28|

atha baddhodaraṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------| pakṣmavālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktairbaddhāyane gude||28|| durnāmabhirudāvatairanyairvā'ntropalopibhiḥ| varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā karoti kupito'nilaḥ||29|| apāno jaṭharaṃ tena syurdāhajvaratṛṭkṣavāḥ| kāsaśvāsorusadanaṃ śirohṛnnābhipāyuruk||30|| malasaṅgo'ruciścchardirudaraṃ mūḍhamārutam| sthiraṃ nīlāruṇasirārājinaddhamarāji vā||31|| nābherupari ca prāyo gopucchākṛti jāyate| ------------------------------------------------|32|

adhunā chidrodaraṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------| asthyādiśalyaiḥ sānnaiścadbhuktairatyaśanena vā||32|| bhidyate pacyate vā'ntraṃ tacchidraiśca sravanbahiḥ| āma eva gudādeti tato'lpālpaṃ saviḍrasaḥ||33|| tulyaḥ kuṇapagandhena picchilaḥ pītalohitaḥ| śeṣaścāpūrya jaṭharaṃ jaṭharaṃ ghoramāvahet||34|| varddhayettadadho nābherāśu caiti jalātmatām| udriktadoṣarūpaṃ ca vyāptaṃ ca śvāsatṛḍbhramaiḥ||35|| chidrodaramidaṃ prāhuḥ parisrāvīti cāpare| ------------------------------------------------|36|

athodakodaradarśanārthamāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| pravṛttasnehapānādeḥ sahasā''māmbupāyinaḥ||36|| atyambupānānmandāgneḥ kṣīṇasyātikṛśasya vā| ruddhvā'mbumārgānanilaḥ kaphaśca jalamūrchitaḥ||37|| vardhayetāṃ tadevāmbu tatsthānādudarāśritau| tataḥ syādudaraṃ tṛṣṇāgudasrutirujānvitam||38|| kāsaśvāsāruciyutaṃ nānāvarṇasirātatam| toyapūrṇadṛtisparśaśabdaprakṣobhavepathu||39|| dakodaraṃ mahatsnigdhaṃ sthiramāvṛttanābhi tat| ------------------------------------------------|40|

adhunā jaṭhare'pyavasāne yathā jalasambhavaḥ syāttathā''ha - - - - ------------------------------------------------| upekṣayā ca sarveṣu doṣāḥ svasthānataścyutāḥ||40|| pākāddravā dravīkuryuḥ sandhisrotomukhānyapi| svadeśca bāhyasrotaḥsu vihatastiryagāsthitaḥ||41|| tadevodakamāpyāyya picchāṃ kuryāttadā bhavet| gurūdaraṃ sthiraṃ vṛttamāhataṃ ca na śabdavat||42|| mṛdu vyapetarājīkaṃ nābhyāṃ spṛṣṭaṃ ca sarpati| tadanūdakajanmāsminkukṣivṛddhistato'dhikam||43|| sirāntardhānamudakajaṭharoktaṃ ca lakṣaṇam| ------------------------------------------------|44|

ab.seg: idānīmudarāṇāṃ sukhasādhyatvābhāvāt kṛcchrasādhyāsādhyatve vedayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------| vātapittakaphaplīhasannipātodakodaram||44||
kṛcchraṃ yathottaram pakṣātparaṃ prāyo'pare hataḥ| sarvaṃ ca jātasalilaṃ riṣṭoktopadravānvitam||45||

div.ab: janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam| balinastadajātāmbu yatnasādhyaṃ navotthitam|46| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne udaranidānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|12|

div.head: pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānadhyāyaḥ
div.ab: yato yathaivodaraṃ doṣasaṅghātajaṃ tathaite'pi, ityāha - - - - athātaḥ pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2|| pittapradhānāḥ kupitā yathoktaiḥ kopanairmalāḥ| tatrānilena balinā kṣiptaṃ pittaṃ hṛdi sthitam||1|| dhamanīrdaśa samprāpya vyāpnuvatsakalāṃ tanum| śleṣmatvagraktamāṃsāni pradūṣyāntaramāśritam||2|| tvaṅmāṃsayostatkurute tvaci varṇān pṛthagvidhān| pāṇḍuhāridraharitān pāṇḍutvaṃ teṣu cādhikam||3|| yato'taḥ pāṇḍurityuktaḥ sa rogaḥ-------------| ------------------------------------------------|4|

----------------------------------tena gauravam| dhātūnāṃ syācca śaithilyamojasaśca guṇakṣayaḥ||4|| tato'lparaktamedasko niḥsāraḥ syācchlathendriyaḥ| mṛdyamānairivāṅgairnā dravatā hṛdayena ca||5|| śūnākṣikūṭaḥ sadanaḥ kopanaḥ ṣṭhīvano'lpavāk| annadviṭ śiśiradveṣī śīrṇaromā hatānalaḥ||6|| sannasaktho jvarī śvāsī karṇakṣveḍī bhramī śramī| ------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| sa pañcadhā pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastairmṛttikādanāt||7||

div.ab: prāgrūpamasya hṛdayaspandanaṃ rūkṣatā tvaci| aruciḥ pītamūtratvaṃ svedābhāvo'lpavahnitā||8|| sādaḥ śramo-------------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|9|
--------------anilāttatra gātraruktodakampanam| kṛṣṇarūkṣāruṇasirānakhaviṇmūtranetratā||9|| śophānāhāsyavairasyaviṭśoṣāḥ pārśvamūrdharuk| ------------------------------------------------|10|
------------------------------------------------| pittāddharitapītābhasirāditvaṃ jvarastamaḥ||10|| tṛṭsvedamūrcchāśītecchā daurgandhyaṃ kaṭuvakkratā| varcobhedo'mlako dāhaḥ------------|11|

mṛtkaṣāyā'nilaṃ pittamūṣarā madhurā kapham| dūṣayitvā rasādīṃśca raukṣyādbhuktaṃ virūkṣya ca||13|| srotāṃsyapakvaivāpūrya kuryādruddhvā ca pūrvavat| pāṇḍurogaṃ tataḥ śūnanābhipādāsyamehanaḥ||14|| purīṣaṃ kṛmimanmuñcedbhinnaṃ sāsṛkkaphaṃ naraḥ| ------------------------------------------------|15|

ab.seg: atha pratijñāvākye'nuktāmapi kāmalāṃ tulyahetvādikatvāt pradarśayannāha - - - - ------------------------------------------------------| yaḥ pāṇḍurogī seveta pittalaṃ tasya kāmalām||15||
koṣṭhaśākhāśrayāṃ pittaṃ dagdhvā'sṛṅmāṃsamāvahet| hāridranetramūtratvaṅnakhavaktraśakṛttayā||16||
dāhāvipākatṛṣṇāvān bhekābho durbalendriyaḥ||17||

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- kiṃ pāṇḍurogiṇa eva pittalānyāsevamānasya kāmalā bhavet, utāpāṇḍurogiṇo'pi ? ityāha - - - - bhavetpittolbaṇasyāsau pāṇḍurogādṛte'pi ca||17||

div.ab: upekṣayā ca śophāḍhyā sā kṛcchrā kumbhakāmalā| ------------------------------------------------|18|

halīmakaṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------| haritaśyāvapītatvaṃ pāṇḍuroge yadā bhavet||18|| vātapittādbhramastṛṣṇā strīṣvaharṣo mṛdurjvaraḥ| tandrābalānalabhraṃśo loḍharaṃ taṃ halīmakam||19|| alasaṃ ceti śaṃsanti----------------------| ------------------------------------------------|20|

----------------------teṣāṃ pūrvamupadravāḥ| śophapradhānāḥ kathitāḥ sa evāto nigadyate||20|| iti pāṇḍuroganidānam| ------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------ atha śophanidānam| pittaraktakaphānvāyurduṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥsirāḥ| nītvā ruddhagatistairhi kuryāttvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam||21|| utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śophaṃ tamāhurnicayādataḥ| sarvaṃ---------------------------------------|22|

nanu, evaṃ satīdaṃ virudhyate "doṣaiḥ pṛthagdvayaiḥ sarvai" iti| ata āha - - - - -----------------------------------------| ------------hetuviśeṣaistu rūpabhedānnavātmakam||22|| doṣaiḥ pṛthagdvayaiḥ sarvairabhighātādviṣādapi| ------------------------------------------------|23|

------------------------------------------------| dvidhā vā nijamāgantuṃ sarvāṅgaikāṅgajaṃ ca tam||23|| pṛthūnnatagrathitatāviśeṣaiśca tridhā viduḥ| ------------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| sāmānyahetuḥ śophānāṃ doṣajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ||24||
vyādhikarmopavāsādikṣīṇasya bhajato drutam| atimātramathānyasya gurvamlasnigdhaśītalam||25||
lavaṇakṣāratīkṣṇoṣṇaśākāmbu svapnajāgaram| mṛdgrāmyamāṃsavallūramajīrṇaśramamaithunam||26||
padātermārgagamanaṃ yānena kṣobhiṇā'pi vā| śvāsakāsātisārārśojaṭharapradarajvarāḥ||27||
viṣūcyalasakacchardigarbhavīsarpapāṇḍavaḥ| anye ca mithyopakrāntāstairdoṣā vakṣasi sthitāḥ||28||
ūrdhvaṃ śophamadho bastau madhye kurvanti madhyagāḥ| sarvāṅgagāḥ sarvagataṃ pratyaṅgeṣu tadāśrayāḥ||29||

div.ab: tatpūrvarūpaṃ davathuḥ sirāyāmo'ṅgagauravam| ------------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| vātācchophaścalo rūkṣaḥ khararomā'ruṇāsitaḥ||30||
saṅkocaspandaharṣārtitodabhedaprasuptimān| kṣiprotthānaśamaḥ śīghramunnametpīḍitastanuḥ||31||
snigdhoṣṇamardanaiḥ śāmyedrātrāvalpo divā mahān| tvak ca sarṣapalipteva tasmiṃścimicimāyate||32||
pītaraktāsitābhāsaḥ pittādātāmraromakṛt| śīghrānusārapraśamo madhye prāgjāyate tanuḥ||33||
satṛḍdāhajvarasvedadavakledamadabhramaḥ| śītābhilāṣī viḍbhedī gandhī sparśāsaho mṛduḥ||34||

div.ab: kaṇḍūmān pāṇḍuromatvakkaṭhinaḥ śītalo guruḥ| snigdhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ sthiraḥ styāno nidrācchardyagnisādakṛt||35|| ākrānto nonnametkṛcchraśamajanmā niśābalaḥ| sravennāsṛk cirātpicchāṃ kuśaśastrādivikṣataḥ||36|| sparśoṣṇakāṅkṣī ca kaphāt------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|37|
-----------------------yathāsvaṃ dvandvajāstrayaḥ| saṅkarāddhetuliṅgānām---------------------------|37|

ab.seg: abhighātena śastrādicchedabhedakṣatādibhiḥ| himānilodadhyanilairbhallātakapikacchujaiḥ||38||
rasaiḥ śūkaiśca saṃsparśācchvayathuḥ syādvisarpavān| bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaḥ prāyaśaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ||39||

div.ab: viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt| daṃṣṭrādantanakhāpātādaviṣaprāṇināmapi||40|| viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāt| viṣavṛkṣānilasparśādgarayogāvacūrṇanāt||41|| mṛduścalo'valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ| ------------------------------------------------|42|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| navo'nupadravaḥ śophaḥ sādhyo'sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ||42||
iti śophanidānam||4||

div.ab: śvayathuvaddoṣairdūṣyaiśca yato visarpo bhavati,atastannidānaṃ prakamyate - - - - ------------------------------------- atha visarpanidānam| syādvisarpo'bhighātāntairdoṣairdūṣyaiśca śophavat| ------------------------------------------------|43|
--------------------tatra doṣā yathāyatham| prakopaṇaiḥ prakupitā viśeṣeṇa vidāhibhiḥ||44|| dehe śīghraṃ visarpanti te'ntarantaḥsthitā bahiḥ| bahiḥsthā dvitaye dvisthāḥ---------------------|45|

------------------------------------------------| ------------------------vidyāttatrāntarāśrayam||45|| marmopatāpātsammohādayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt||46|| āśu cāgnibalabhraṃśādato bāhyaṃ viparyayāt| ------------------------------------------------|47|
------------------------------------------------| tatra vātātparīsarpo vātajvarasamavyathaḥ||47|| śophasphuraṇanistodabhedāyāmārtiharṣavān| ------------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| pittāddrutagatiḥ pittajvaraliṅgo'tilohitaḥ||48||

div.ab: kaphātkaṇḍūyutaḥ snigdhaḥ kaphajvarasamānaruk| ------------------------------------------------|49|

------------------------------------------------| svadoṣaliṅgaiścīyante sarve sphoṭairupekṣitāḥ||49|| te pakvabhinnāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ca bibhrati vraṇalakṣaṇam| ------------------------------------------------|50|

adhunā dvandvajaṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------| vātapittājjvaracchardimūrcchātīsāratṛḍbhramaiḥ||50|| asthibhedāgnisadanatamakārocakairyutaḥ| karoti sarvamaṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat||51|| yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaśca visarpati bhavetsa saḥ| śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vā''śu ca cīyate||52|| agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvād drutaṃ ca saḥ| marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syādvāto'tibalastataḥ||53|| vyathetāṅgaṃ haretsaṃjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsamīrayet| hidhmāṃ ca sa gato'vasthāmīdṛśīṃ labhate na nā||54|| kvaciccharmāratigrasto bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu| ceṣṭamānastataḥ kliṣṭo manodehaśramodbhavām||55|| duṣprabodho'śnute nidrāṃ so'gnivīsarpa ucyate| ------------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham||56||
raktaṃ vā vṛddharaktasya tvaksirāsnāvamāṃsagam| dūṣayitvā ca dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām||57||
granthīnāṃ kurute mālāṃ raktānāṃ tīvrarugjvarām| śvāsakāsātisārāsyaśoṣahidhmāvamibhramaiḥ||58||
mohavaivarṇyamūrchāṅgabhaṅgāgnisadanairyutām| ityayaṃ granthivīsarpaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ||59||
kaphapittājjvaraḥ stambho nidrātandrāśirorujaḥ| aṅgāvasādavikṣepapralāpārocakabhramāḥ||60||
mūrcchāgnihānirbhedo'sthnāṃ pipāsendriyagauravam| āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati||61||
prāyeṇāmāśaye gṛhṇannekadeśaṃ na cātiruk| piṭakairavakīrṇo'tipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ||62||
mecakābho'sitaḥ snigdho malinaḥ śophavān guruḥ| gambhīrapākaḥ prājyoṣmā spṛṣṭaḥ klinno'vadīryate||63||
paṅkavacchīrṇamāṃsaśca spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇaḥ| śavagandhiśca vīsarpaṃ kardamākhyamuśanti tam||64||

div.ab: sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvadhātvatisarpaṇaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|65|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| bāhyahetoḥ kṣatātkruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayan||65||
visarpaṃ mārutaḥ kuryāt kulatthasadṛśaiścitam| sphoṭaiḥ śophajvararujādāhāḍhyaṃ śyāvalohitam||66||

div.ab: pṛthagdoṣaistrayaḥ sādhyā dvandvajāścānupadravāḥ| asādhyo kṣatasarvotthau sarve cākrāntamarmakāḥ|67| śīrṇasnāyusirāmāṃsāḥ praklinnāḥ śavagandhayaḥ| 67 1/2| iti visarpanidānam| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|13|

div.head: kuṣṭhaśvitrakṛminidānādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kuṣṭhaśvitrakṛminidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||
mithyāhāravihāreṇa viśeṣeṇa virodhinā| sādhunindāvadhānyasvaharaṇādyaiśca sevitaiḥ||1||
pāpmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ sadyaḥ prāktanairvoritā malāḥ| sirāḥ prapadya tiryaggāstvaglasīkāsṛgāmiṣam||2||
dūṣayanti ślathīkṛtya niścarantastato bahiḥ| tvacaḥ kurvanti vaivarṇyaṃ duṣṭāḥ kuṣṭhamuśanti tat||3||

div.ab: kuto'sya rogasya kuṣṭhamiti saṃjñā ? ityāha - - - - kālenopekṣitaṃ yasmātsarvaṃ kuṣṇāti tadvapuḥ| prapadya dhātūnvyāpyāntaḥ sarvān saṃkledya cāvahet||4|| sasvedakledasaṅkothān kṛmīn sūkṣmān sudāruṇān| lomatvaksnāyudhamanītaruṇāsthīni yaiḥ kramāt||5|| bhakṣayecchvitramasmācca kuṣṭhabāhyamudāhṛtam| ------------------------------------------------|6|

------------------------------------------------| kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅmiśraiḥ samāgataiḥ||6|| nanu, evaṃ satyekadoṣajaṃ dvidoṣajaṃ kuṣṭham, na sarvaṃ tridoṣajaṃ syāt, ityāśaṅkyāha - - - - sarveṣvapi tridoṣeṣu vyapadeśo'dhikatvataḥ|7|

ata āha - - - - vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ, pittādaudumbaraṃ, kaphāt||7|| maṇḍalākhyaṃ vicarcī ca, ṛkṣākhyaṃ vātapittajam| carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikāḥ||8|| vātaśleṣmodbhavāḥ, śleṣmapittāddadruśatāruṣī| puṇḍarīkaṃ savisphoṭaṃ pāmā carmadalaṃ tathā||9|| sarvaiḥ syātkākaṇaṃ-------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: -------------------pūrvaṃ trikaṃ dadru sakākaṇam| puṇḍarīkarkṣajihve ca mahākuṣṭhāni sapta tu||10||

div.ab: atiślakṣṇakharasparśakhedāsvedavivarṇatāḥ| dāhaḥ kaṇḍūstvaci svāpastodaḥ koṭhonnatiḥ śramaḥ||11|| vraṇānāmadhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiścirasthitiḥ| rūḍhānāmapi rūkṣatvaṃ nimitte'lpe'pi kopanam||12|| romaharṣo'sṛjaḥ kārṣṇyaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamagrajam| ------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: adhunaiteṣāṃ lakṣaṇānyāha - - - - kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ rūkṣaṃ suptaṃ kharaṃ tanu||13||
vistṛtāsamaparyantaṃ hṛṣitairlomabhiścitam| todaḍhyamalpakaṇḍūkaṃ kāpālaṃ śīghrasarpi ca||14||

div.ab: pakvodumbaratāmratvagroma gaurasirācitam| bahalaṃ bahalakledaraktaṃ dāharujādhikam||15|| āśūtthānāvadaraṇakṛmi vidyādudumbaram| ------------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| sthiraṃ styānaṃ guru snigdhaṃ śvetaraktamanāśugam||16||
anyonyasaktamutsannaṃ bahukaṇḍūsrutikrimi| ślakṣṇapītābhaparyantaṃ maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam||17||

div.ab: sakaṇḍūpiṭikā śyāvā lasīkāḍhyā vicarcikā| ------------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| paruṣaṃ tanu raktāntamantaḥśyāvaṃ samunnatam||18||
satodadāharukkledaṃ karkaśaiḥ piṭikaiścitam| ṛkṣajihvākṛti proktamṛkṣajihvaṃ bahukrimi||19||

div.ab: -------------------------------ekākhyaṃ mahāśrayam| asvedaṃ matsyaśakalasannibham ----------------------|20|
---------------------------------------| sidhmaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahiḥ snigdhamantarghṛṣṭaṃ rajaḥ kiret||21|| ślakṣṇasparśaṃ tanu śvetatāmraṃ daugdhikapuṣpavat| prāyeṇa cordhvakāye syāt-------------------|23|

ab.seg: ----------------------pāṇipādadāryo vipādikāḥ| tīvrārtyo mandakaṇḍvaśca sarāgapiṭikācitāḥ||23||
dīrghapratānā dūrvāvadatasīkusumacchaviḥ| utsannamaṇḍalā dadrūḥ kaṇḍūmatyanuṣaṅgiṇī||24||
sthūlamūlaṃ sadāhārti raktaśyāvaṃ bahuvraṇam| śatāruḥ kledajantvāḍhyaṃ prāyaśaḥ parvajanma ca||25||

div.ab: raktāntamantarā pāṇḍu kaṇḍūdāharujānvitam| sotsedhamācitaṃ raktaiḥ padmapatramivāṃśubhiḥ||26|| ghanabhūrilasīkāsṛkprāyamāśu vibhedi ca| puṇḍarīkam----------------------------------|27|

ab.seg: ------------------piṭikāḥ pāmā kaṇḍūkledarujādhikāḥ| sūkṣmāḥ śyāvāruṇā bahvyaḥ prāyaḥ sphikpaṇikūrpare||28||

div.ab: sasphoṭamasparśasahaṃ kaṇḍūṣātodadāhavat| raktaṃ dalaccarmadalam-------------------|29|

ab.seg: pūrvaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kākaṇantīphalopamam| kuṣṭhaliṅgairyutaṃ sarvairnaikavarṇaṃ tato bhavet||30||

div.ab: kuṣṭheṣu tridoṣajeṣu satsu, idaṃ vātādhikaṃ kuṣṭhamidaṃ pittādhikaṃ kuṣṭhamidaṃ kaphādhikaṃ kuṣṭhamiti kathaṃ jñātavyam? ityāha - - - - doṣabhedīyavihitairādiśelliṅgakarmabhiḥ| kuṣṭheṣu doṣolbaṇatām----------------|31|
akṛcchraṃ kaphavātāḍhyaṃ tvaksthamekamalaṃ ca yat| --------------------------------------------------|33|

--------------------------------------------------| tatra tvaci sthite kuṣṭhe todavaivarṇyarūkṣatāḥ||33|| svedasvāpaśvayathavaḥ śoṇite, piśite punaḥ| pāṇipādāśritāḥ sphoṭāḥ kledaḥ sandhiṣu cādhikam||34|| kauṇyaṃ gatikṣayo'ṅgānāṃ dalanaṃ syācca medasi| nāsābhaṅgo'sthimajjasthe netrarāgaḥ svarakṣayaḥ||35|| kṣate ca kṛmayaḥ, śukre svadārāpatyabādhanam| --------------------------------------------------|36|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| yathāpūrvaṃ ca sarvāṇi syurliṅgānyasṛgādiṣu||36||
iti kuṣṭhanidānam||1||

kuṣṭhanidānādanantaraṃ śvitrasyocyate| kuṣṭhaśvitrayorekakāraṇatvāt| ata evāha - - - - atha śvitranidānam| kuṣṭhaikasambhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ dāruṇaṃ ca tat| nirdiṣṭamaparisrāvi tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayam||37||

div.ab: vātādrūkṣāruṇaṃ, pittāttāmraṃ kamalapatravat| sadāhaṃ romavidhvaṃsi, kaphācchvetaṃ ghanaṃ guru||38|| sakaṇḍu ca, kramādraktamāṃsamedaḥsu cādiśet| --------------------------------------------------|39|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| varṇenaivedṛgubhayaṃ kṛcchraṃ taccottarottaram||39||
adhunā sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārthamāha - - - - aśuklaromābahalamasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ mitho navam| anagnidagdhajaṃ sādhyaṃ śvitraṃ, varjyamato'nyathā||40||
guhyapāṇitalauṣṭheṣu jātamapyacirantanam| sparśaikāhāraśayyādisevanāt prāyaśo gadāḥ||41||
sarve sañcāriṇo, netratvagvikārā viśeṣataḥ| --------------------------------------------------|42| iti śvitranidānam||2||
adhunā kramaprāptān kṛmīnadhikṛtyāha - - - - atha kṛminidānam| kṛmayastu dvidhā proktā bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ||42||

div.ab: janmabhedena catuṣprakārāḥ| katham ? ityāha - - - - bahirmalakaphāsṛgviḍjanmabhedāccaturvidhāḥ| --------------------------------------------------|43|

----------------------------------------------| ------------------------bāhyāstatrāmṛjodbhavāḥ||43|| tilapramāṇasaṃsthānavarṇāḥ keśāmbarāśrayāḥ| bahupādāśca sūkṣmāśca yūkā likṣāśca nāmataḥ||44|| dvidhā te koṭhapiṭikākaṇḍūgaṇḍān prakurvate| ----------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: raktajānāṃ nidānaviśeṣo vakṣyamāṇa iti purīṣotthāṃstā(tthānāṃ tā)vadāha - - - - ---------------------------------------------------| śakṛjjā bahuviḍdhānyaparṇaśākolakādibhiḥ||46||
kaphādāmāśaye jātā vṛddhāḥ sarpanti sarvataḥ| pṛthubradhnanibhāḥ kecit kecidgaṇḍūpadopamāḥ||47||
rūḍhadhānyāṅkurākārāstanudīrghāstathā'ṇavaḥ| śvetāstāmrāvabhāsāśca nāmataḥ saptadhā tu te||48||
antrādā udarāveṣṭā hṛdayādā mahākuhāḥ| kuravo darbhakusumāḥ sugandhāste ca kurvate||49||
hṛllāsamāsyasravaṇamavipākamarocakam| mūrcchācchardijvarānāhakārśyakṣavathupīnasān||50||
adhunā raktajānāha - - - - raktavāhisirotthānā raktajā jantavo'ṇavaḥ| apādā vṛttatāmrāśca saukṣmyātkecidadarśanāḥ||51||
keśādā lomavidhvaṃsā lomadvīpā udumbarāḥ| ṣaṭ te kuṣṭhaikakarmāṇaḥ sahasaurasamātaraḥ||52||

div.ab: pakvāśaye purīṣotthā jāyante'dhovisarpiṇaḥ| vṛddhāḥ santo bhaveyuśca te yadā''māśayonmukhāḥ|53| tadā'syodgāraniḥśvāsā viḍgandhānuvidhāyinaḥ| pṛthuvṛttatanusthūlāḥ śyāvapītasitāsitāḥ|54| te pañca nāmnā kṛmayaḥ kakerukamakerukāḥ| sausurādāḥ sulūnākhyā lelihā janayanti ca|55| viḍbhedaśūlaviṣṭambhakārśyapāruṣyapāṇḍutāḥ| romaharṣāgnisadanagudakaṇḍūrvinirgamāt|56| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne kuṣṭhaśvitrakṛminidānaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|14|

div.head: vātavyādhinidānadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vātavyādhinidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| sarvārthānarthakaraṇe viśvasyāsyaikakāraṇam| aduṣṭaduṣṭaḥ pavanaḥ, śarīrasya viśeṣataḥ||1||

div.ab: kathaṃ vāyuḥ kāraṇamityavagamyate ? ityāha - - - - sa viśvakarmā viśvātmā viśvarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ| sraṣṭā dhātā vibhurviṣṇuḥ saṃhartā mṛtyurantakaḥ||2|| tadaduṣṭau prayatnena yatitavyamataḥ sadā| ----------------------------------------------|3|
----------------------------------------------| tasyoktaṃ doṣavijñāne karma prākṛtavaikṛtam||3|| samāsādvyāsato doṣabhedīye nāma dhāma ca| pratyekaṃ pañcadhā cāro vyāpāraśca------------|4|

ab.seg: tasyocyate vibhāgena sanidānaṃ salakṣaṇam| ----------------------------------------------|5| |asaṅkhyamapi saṅkhyāya yadaśītyā pureritam]||1||
vāyoścobhayathā'pi kopaḥ sambhavati| tamidānīṃ darśayannāha - - - - ----------------------------------------------| dhātukṣayakarairvāyuḥ kupyatyatiniṣevitaiḥ||5||
caran srotaḥsu rikteṣu bhṛśaṃ tānyeva pūrayan| tebhyo'nyadoṣapūrṇebhyaḥ prāpya vā''varaṇaṃ balī||6||

div.ab: tatra pakvāśaye kruddhaḥ śūlānāhāntrakūjanam| malarodhāśmavardhmārśastrikapṛṣṭhakaṭīgraham||7|| karotyadharakāye ca tāṃstān kṛcchrānupadravān| ----------------------------------------------|8|
----------------------------------------------| āmāśaye tṛḍvamathuśvāsakāsavisūcikāḥ||8|| kaṇṭhoparodhamudgārān vyādhīnūrdhvaṃ ca nābhitaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: rakte tīvrā rujaḥ svāpaṃ tāpaṃ rāgaṃ vivarṇatām| arūṃṣyannasya viṣṭambharuciṃ kṛśatāṃ bhramam||10||
māṃsamedogato granthīṃstodāḍhyān karkaśān śramam| gurvaṅgaṃ cātirukstabdhaṃ muṣṭidaṇḍahatopamam||11||

div.ab: asthisthaḥ sakthisandhyāsthiśūlaṃ tīvraṃ balakṣayam| ----------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| majjastho'sthiṣu sauṣiryamasvapnaṃ santatāṃ rujam||12||

div.ab: śukrasya śīghramutsargaṃ saṅgaṃ vikṛtimeva vā| tadvadgarbhasya śukrasthaḥ----------------------|13|
----------------------------------------------| vātapūrṇadṛtisparśaṃ śophaṃ sandhigato'nilaḥ||14|| prasāraṇākuñcanayoḥ pravṛttiṃ ca savedanām| ----------------------------------------------|15|
----------------------------------------------| sarvāṅgasaṃśrayastodabhedasphuraṇabhañjanam||15|| stambhanākṣepaṇasvāpasandhyākuñcanakampanam| ----------------------------------------------|16|

----------------------------------------------| yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kruddho'bhyeti muhurmuhuḥ||16|| tadā'ṅgamākṣipatyeṣa vyādhirākṣepakaḥ smṛtaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: athāpatantrakaṃ lakṣayati - - - - ----------------------------------------------| adhaḥ pratihato vāyurvrajannūrdhvaṃ hṛdāśritāḥ||17||
nāḍīḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayan| ākṣipetparito gātraṃ dhanurvaccāsya nāmayet||18||
kṛcchrāducchvasiti stabdhasrastamīlitadṛktataḥ| kapota iva kṛjecca niḥsaṃjñaḥ so'patantrakaḥ||19||
sa eva cāpatānākhyo mukte tu marutā hṛdi| aśrnuvīta muhuḥ svāsthyaṃ muhurasvāsthyamāvṛte||20||
garbhapātasamutpannaḥ śoṇitātisravotthitaḥ| abhighātasamutthaśca duścikitsyatamo hi saḥ||21||

div.ab: manye saṃstabhya vāto'ntarāyacchan dhamanīryadā| vyāpnoti sakalaṃ dehaṃ jatrurāyamyate tadā||22|| antardhanurivāṅgaṃ ca vegaiḥ stambhaṃ ca netrayoḥ| karoti jṛmbhāṃ daśanaṃ daśanānāṃ kaphodvamam||23|| pārśvayorvedanāṃ vākyahanupṛṣṭhaśirograham| antarāyāma ityeṣa--------------------------|24|

ab.seg: dehasya bahirāyāmāt pṛṣṭhato nīyate śiraḥ| uraścotkṣipyate tatra kandharā cāvamṛdyate||25||
danteṣvāsye ca vaivarṇyaṃ prasvedaḥ srastagātratā| bāhyāyāmaṃ dhanuṣkambhaṃ bruvate veginaṃ ca tam||26||

div.ab: adhunā vraṇāyāmamāha - - - - vraṇaṃ marmāśritaṃ prāpya samīraṇasamīraṇāt| vyāyacchanti tanuṃ doṣāḥ sarvāmāpādamastakam||27|| tṛṣyataḥ pāṇḍugātrasya vraṇāyāmaḥ sa varjitaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| gate vege bhavetsvāsthyaṃ sarveṣvākṣepakeṣu ca||28||
jihvātilekhanācchuṣkabhakṣaṇādabhighātataḥ| kupito hanumūlasthaḥ sraṃsayitvā'nilo hanū||29||
karoti vivṛtāsyatvamathavā saṃvṛtāsyatām| hanusraṃsaḥ sa tena syātkṛcchrāccarvaṇabhāṣaṇām||30||
vāgvāhinīsirāsaṃstho jihvāṃ stambhayate'nilaḥ| jihvāstambhaḥ sa tenānnapānavākyeṣvanīśatā||31||

div.ab: śirasā bhāraharaṇādatihāsyaprabhāṣaṇāt| uttrāsavaktrakṣavathoḥ kharakārmukakarṣaṇāt||32|| viṣamādupadhānācca kaṭhinānāṃ ca carvaṇāt| vāyurvivṛddhastaistaiśca vātalairūrdhvamāsthitaḥ||33|| vakrīkaroti vaktrārdhamuktaṃ hasitamīkṣitam| tato'sya kampate mūrddhā vāksaṅgaḥ stabdhanetratā||34|| dantacālaḥ svarabhraṃśaḥ śrutihāniḥ kṣavagrahaḥ| gandhājñānaṃ smṛtermohastrāsaḥ suptasya jāyate||35|| niṣṭhīvaḥ pārśvato yāyādekasyākṣṇo nimīlanam| jatrorūrdhvaṃ rujā tīvrā śarīrārdhe'dhare'pi vā||36|| tamāhurarditaṃ kecidekāyāmamathāpare| ----------------------------------------------|37|

----------------------------------------------| raktamāśritya pavanaḥ kuryānmūrddhadharāḥ sirāḥ||37|| rūkṣāḥ savedanāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ so'sādhyaḥ syātsirāgrahaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|38|

----------------------------------------------| gṛhītvā'rdhaṃ tanorvāyuḥ sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya ca||38|| pakṣamanyataraṃ hanti sandhibandhān vimokṣayan| kṛtsno'rdhakāyastasya syādakarmaṇyo vicetanaḥ||39|| ekāṅgarogaṃ taṃ kecidanye pakṣavadhaṃ viduḥ| ----------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| sarvāṅgarogaṃ tadvacca sarvakāyāśrite'nile||40||
śuddhavātahataḥ pakṣaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatamo mataḥ| kṛcchrastvanyena saṃsṛṣṭo vivarjyaḥ kṣayahetukaḥ||41||
āmabaddhāyanaḥ kuryātsaṃstabhyāṅgaṃ kaphānvitaḥ| asādhyaṃ hatasarvehaṃ daṇḍavaddaṇḍakaṃ marut||42||
aṃsamūlasthito vāyuḥ sirāḥ saṅkocya tatragāḥ| bāhupraspanditaharaṃ janayatyavabāhukam||43||
talaṃ pratyaṅgulīnāṃ yā kaṇḍarā bāhupṛṣṭhataḥ| bāhuceṣṭāpaharaṇī viśvācī nāma sā smṛtā||44||
vāyuḥ kaṭyāṃ sthitaḥ sakthnaḥ kaṇḍarāmākṣipedyadā| tadā khañjo bhavejjantuḥ paṅguḥ sakthnordvayorapi||45||
kampate gamanārambhe khañjanniva ca yāti yaḥ| kalāyakhañjaṃ taṃ vidyānmuktasandhiprabandhanam||46||
śītoṣṇadravasaṃśuṣkagurusnigdhairniṣevitaiḥ| jīrṇājīrṇe tathā''yāsasaṅkṣobhasvapnajāgaraiḥ||47||
saśleṣmamedaḥpavanamāmamatyarthasañcitam| abhibhūyetaraṃ doṣamūru cetpratipadyate||48||
sakthyasthīni prapūryāntaḥ śleṣmaṇā stimitena tat| tadā skabhnāti tenorū stabdhau śītāvacetanau||49||
parakīyāviva gurū syātāmatibhṛśavyathau| dhyānāṅgamardastaimityatandrācchardyarucijvaraiḥ||50||
saṃyutau pādasadanakṛcchroddharaṇasuptibhiḥ| tamūrustambhamityāhurāḍhyavātamathāpare||51||
vātaśoṇitajaḥ śopho jānumadhye mahārujaḥ| jñeyaḥ kroṣṭukaśīrṣaśca sthūlaḥ kroṣṭukaśīrṣavat||52||
ruk pāde viṣamanyaste śramādvā jāyate yadā| vātena gulphamāśritya tamāhurvātakaṇṭakam||53||
pārṣṇiṃ pratyaṅgulīnāṃ yā kaṇḍarā mārutārditā| sakthyutkṣepaṃ nigṛhṇāti gṛdhrasīṃ tāṃ pracakṣate||54||

div.ab: viśvācī gṛdhrasī coktā khallī tīvrarujānvite| ----------------------------------------------|55|
----------------------------------------------| hṛṣyete caraṇau yasya bhavetāṃ ca prasuptavat||55|| pādaharṣaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|56|

pādayoḥ kurute dāhaṃ pittāsṛksahito'nilaḥ|56| viśeṣataścaṅkramite pādadāhaṃ tamādiśet| 56 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne vātavyādhinidānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|15|

div.head: vātaśoṇitanidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: tasmādvātaśoṇitanidānaṃ prakramyata ityāha - - - - athāto vātaśoṇitanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2|| vidāhyannaṃ viruddhaṃ ca tattaccāsṛkpradūṣaṇam| bhajatāṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca svapnajāgaramaithunam||1|| prāyeṇa sukumārāṇāmacaṅkramaṇaśīlinām| abhighātādaśuddheśca nṛṇāmasṛji dūṣite||2|| vātalaiḥ śītalairvāyurvṛddhaḥ kṛddho vimārgagaḥ| tādṛśaivāsṛjā ruddhaḥ prāktadeva pradūṣayet||3|| āḍhyarogaṃ khuḍaṃ vātabalāsaṃ vātaśoṇitam| tadāhurnāmabhiḥ---------------------------------|4|

-----------------------------------tasya lakṣaṇam| bhaviṣyataḥ kuṣṭhasamaṃ tathā sādaḥ ślathāṅgatā||5|| jānujaṅghorukaṭyaṃsahastapādāṅgasandhiṣu| kaṇḍūsphuraṇanistodabhedagauravasuptatāḥ||6|| bhūtvā bhūtvā praṇaśyanti muhurāvirbhavanti ca| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- pādayormūlamāsthāya kadāciddhastayorapi||7|| ākhoriva viṣaṃ kruddhaṃ kṛtsnaṃ dehaṃ vidhāvati| ----------------------------------------------|8|

tacca vātaśoṇitamuttānagambhīrabhedena dvidhā syādityāha - - - - ----------------------------------------------| tvaṅmāṃsāśrayamuttānaṃ tatpūrvaṃ jāyate tataḥ||8|| kālāntareṇa gambhīraṃ sarvān dhātūnabhidravat| ----------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: ----------------------------gambhīre'dhikapūrvaruk| śvayathurgrathitaḥ pākī vāyuḥ sandhyasthimajjasu||10||
chindanniva caratyantarvakrīkurvaṃśca vegavān| karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataścaran||11||
vāte'dhike'dhikaṃ tatra śūlasphuraṇatodanam| śophasya raukṣyakṛṣṇatvaśyāvatāvṛddhihānayaḥ||12||
dhamanyaṅgulisandhīnāṃ saṅkoco'ṅgagraho'tiruk| śītadveṣānupaśayau stambhavepathusuptayaḥ||13||
vātottarasya lakṣaṇamuktvā raktottaraṃ vaktumāha - - - - rakte śopho'tirukatodastāmraścimicimāyate| snigdharūkṣaiḥ śamaṃ naiti kaṇḍūkledasamanvitaḥ||14||
pitte vidāhaḥ sammohaḥ svedo mūrcchā madaḥ satṛṭ| sparśākṣamatvaṃ rugrāgaḥ śophaḥ pāko bhṛśoṣmatā||15||

div.ab: kaphe staimityugurutāsuptisnigdhatvaśītatāḥ| kaṇḍūrmandā ca ruk-------------------------|16|

ab.seg: ekadoṣānugaṃ sādhyaṃ navaṃ, yāpyaṃ dvidoṣajam| tridoṣajaṃ tyajetsrāvi stabdhamarbudakāri ca||17||
raktamārgaṃ nihatyāśu śākhāsandhiṣu mārutaḥ| niviśyānyonyamāvārya vedanābhirharatyasūn||18||
vāyau pañcātmake prāṇo raukṣyavyāyāmalaṅghanaiḥ| atyāhārābhighātādhvavegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ||19||
kupitaścakṣurādīnāmupaghātaṃ pravartayet| pīnasārditatṛṭkāsaśvāsādīṃścāmayānbahūn||20||
udānaḥ kṣavathūdgāracchardinidrāvidhāraṇaiḥ| gurubhārātiruditahāsyādyairvikṛto gadān||21||
kaṇṭharodhamanobhraṃśacchardyarocakapīnasān| kuryācca galagaṇḍādīṃstāṃstān jatrūrdhvasaṃśrayān||22||

div.ab: vyāno'tigamanadhyānakrīḍāviṣamaceṣṭitaiḥ| virodhirūkṣabhīharṣaviṣādādyaiśca dūṣitaḥ||23|| puṃstvotsāhabalabhraṃśaśophacittoplavajvarān| sarvāṅgaroganistodaromaharṣāṅgasuptatāḥ||24|| kuṣṭhaṃ visarpamanyāṃśca kuryātsarvāṅgagān gadān| ----------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| samāno viṣamājīrnaśītasaṅkīrṇabhojanaiḥ||25||
karotyakālaśayanajāgarādyaiśca dūṣitaḥ| śūlagulmagrahaṇyādīn pakvāmāśayajān gadān||26||
apāno rūkṣagurvannavegāghātātivāhanaiḥ| yānayānāsanasthānacaṅkramaiścātisevitaiḥ||27||
kupitaḥ kurute rogān kṛcchrān pakvāśayāśrayān| mūtraśukrapradoṣārśogudabhraṃśādikān bahūn||28||
sarvaṃ ca mārutaṃ sāmaṃ tandrāstaimityagauravaiḥ| snigdhatvārocakālasyaśaityaśophāgnihānibhiḥ||29||
kaṭurūkṣābhilāṣeṇa tadvidhopaśayena ca| yuktaṃ vidyānnirāmaṃ tu tandrādīnāṃ viparyayāt||30||

div.ab: vāyorāvaraṇaṃ cāto bahubhedaṃ pravakṣyate| ----------------------------------------------|31|
----------------------------------------------| liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhastṛṣṇā śūlaṃ bhramastamaḥ||31|| kaṭukoṣṇāmlalavaṇairvidāhaḥ śītakāmatā| ----------------------------------------------|32|
----------------------------------------------| śaityagauravaśūlāni kaṭvādyupaśayo'dhikam||32|| laṅghanāyāsarūkṣoṣṇakāmatā ca kaphāvṛte| ----------------------------------------------|33|
----------------------------------------------| raktāvṛte sadāhā'rtistvaṅmāṃsāntarajā bhṛśam||33|| bhavecca rāgī śvayathurjāyante maṇḍalāni ca| ----------------------------------------------|34|
----------------------------------------------| māṃsena kaṭhinaḥ śopho vivarṇaḥ piṭikāstathā||34|| harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca sañcāra iva jāyate| ----------------------------------------------|35|

----------------------------------------------------| calaḥ snigdho mṛduḥ śītaḥ śopho gātreṣvarocakaḥ||35|| āḍhyavāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasā''vṛte| ----------------------------------------------------|36|

----------------------------------------------------| sparśamasthyāvṛte'tyuṣṇaṃ pīḍanaṃ cābhinandati||36|| sūcyeva tudyate'tyarthamaṅgaṃ sīdati śūlyate| ----------------------------------------------------|37|

----------------------------------------------------| majjāvṛte vinamanaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ pariveṣṭanam||37|| śūlaṃ ca pīḍyamānena pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham| ----------------------------------------------------|38|
bhukte kukṣau rujā jīrṇe śāmyatyannāvṛte'nile| --------------------------------------------------|39|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| mūtrāpravṛttirādhmānaṃ bastermūtrāvṛte bhavet||39||

div.ab: viḍāvṛte vibandho'dhaḥ svasthāne parikṛntati| vrajatyāśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ||40|| śakṛtpīḍitamannena duḥkhaṃ śuṣkaṃ cirātsṛjet| --------------------------------------------------|41|

--------------------------------------------------| sarvadhātvāvṛte vāyau śroṇivaṅkṣaṇapṛṣṭharuk||41|| vilomo māruto'svasthaṃ hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate'ti ca| --------------------------------------------------|42|
------------------------udāne'pi bhramādayaḥ| dāho'ntarūrjābhraṃśaśca----------------------|43|

ab.seg: ----------------apāne tu male hāridravarnatā| rajotivṛttistāpaśca yonimehanapāyuṣu||45||
śleṣmaṇā tvāvṛte prāṇe sādastandrā'rucirvamiḥ| ṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣavathūdgāraniḥśvāsocchvāsasaṅgrahaḥ||46||

div.ab: udāne gurugātratvamarucirvāksvaragrahaḥ| balavarṇapraṇāśaśca---------------------|47|
apāne sakaphaṃ mūtraśakṛtaḥ syātpravartanam| --------------------------------------------------|49|

ab.seg: prāṇādayastathā'nyonyamāvṛṇvanti yathākramam| sarve'pi viṃśatividhaṃ vidyādāvaraṇaṃ ca tat||50||

div.ab: athāsyāvaraṇasya liṅgamāha - - - - niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śirograhaḥ| hṛdrogo mukhaśoṣaśca prāṇenodāna āvṛte||51|| udānenāvṛte prāṇe varṇaujobalasaṅkṣayaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|52|

--------------------------------------------------| diśā'nayā ca vibhajetsarvamāvaraṇaṃ bhiṣak||52|| sthānānyavekṣya vātānāṃ vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca karmaṇāt| --------------------------------------------------|53|

--------------------------------------------------| prāṇādīnāṃ ca pañcānāṃ miśramāvaraṇaṃ mithaḥ||53|| pittādibhirdvādaśabhirmiśrāṇāṃ miśritaiśca taiḥ| --------------------------------------------------|54|

--------------------------------------------------| miśraiḥ pittādibhistadvanmiśraṇābhiranekadhā||54|| tāratamyavikalpācca yātyāvṛtirasaṅkhyatām| tāṃ lakṣayedavahito yathāsvaṃ lakṣaṇodayāt||55|| śanaiḥśanaiścopaśayādgūḍhāmapi mahurmuhuḥ| --------------------------------------------------|56|

--------------------------------------------------| āvṛtā vāyavo'jñātā jñātā vā vatsaraṃ sthitāḥ||57|| prayatnenāpi duḥsādhyā bhaveyurvā'nupakramāḥ| --------------------------------------------------|58|

--------------------------------------------------| vidradhiplīhahṛdrogagulmāgnisadanādayaḥ|58| bhavantyupadravāsteṣāmāvṛtānāmupekṣaṇāt| 58 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne vātaśoṇitanidānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|16|

div.head: jvaracikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto jvaracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|

ab.seg: āmāśayastho hatvā'gniṃ sāmo mārgān pidhāya yat| vidadhāti jvaraṃ doṣastasmātkurvīta laṅghanam||1||
prāgūpeṣu jvarādau vā, balaṃ yatnena pālayan| balādhiṣṭhānamārogyamārogyārthaḥ kriyākramaḥ||2||
laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte'gnau lāghave sati| svāsthyaṃ kṣuttṛḍ ruciḥ paktirbalamojaśca jāyate||3||

div.ab: tatrotkṛṣṭe samutkliṣṭe kaphaprāye cale male| sahṛllāsaprasekānnadveṣakāsaviṣūcike||4|| sadyobhuktasya sañjāte jvare sāme viśeṣataḥ| vamanaṃ vamanārhasya śastaṃ--------------|5|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| pipppalībhiryutān gālān kaliṅgairmadhukena vā||6||
uṣṇāmbhasā samadhunā pibetsalavaṇena vā| paṭolanimbakarkoṭavetrapatrodakena vā||7||
tarpaṇena rasenekṣormadyaiḥ kalpoditāni va| vamanāni prayuñjīta balakālavibhāgavit||8||
kṛte'kṛte vā vamane jvarī kuryādviśoṣaṇam| doṣāṇāṃ samudīrṇānāṃ pācanāya śamāya ca||9||
doṣeṇa bhasmanevāgnau channe'nnaṃ na vipacyate| tasmādādoṣapacanājjvaritānupavāsayet||10||
tṛṣṇagalpālpamuṣṇambu pibedvātakaphajvare| tatkaphaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā tṛṣṇāmāśu nivartayet||11||
udīrya cāgniṃ strotāṃsi mṛdūkṛtya viśodhayet| līnapittānilasvedaśakṛnmūtrānulomanam||12||
nidrājāḍyāruciharaṃ prāṇānāmavalambanam| viparītamataḥ śītaṃ doṣasaṅghātavarddhanam||13||

div.ab: uṣṇamevaṃguṇatve'pi yuñjyānnaikāntapittale| udriktapitte davathudāhamohātisāriṇi||14|| viṣamadyotthite grīṣme kṣatakṣīṇe'srapittini| --------------------------------------------|15|
--------------------------------------------| ghanacandanaśuṇṭhyambuparpaṭośīrasādhitam||15|| śītaṃ tebhyo hitaṃ toyaṃ pācanaṃ tṛḍjvarāpaham| --------------------------------------------|16|
--------------------------------------------| ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā||16|| tasmātpittaviruddhāni tyajet pittādhike'dhikam| --------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| snānābhyaṅgapradehāṃśca pariśeṣaṃ ca laṅghanam||17||

div.ab: ajīrṇa iva śūlaghnaṃ sāme tīvraruji jvare| na pibedauṣadhaṃ taddhi bhūya evāmamāvahet||18|| āmābhibhūtakoṣṭhasya kṣīraṃ viṣamaheriva| --------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| sodardapīnasaśvāse jaṅghāparvāsthiśūlini||19||
vātaśleṣmātmake svedaḥ praśastaḥ, sa pravartayet| svedamūtraśakṛdvātān kuryādagneśca pāṭavam||20||

div.ab: snehoktamācāravidhiṃ sarvaśaścānupalayet| --------------------------------------------|21|
--------------------------------------------| laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgvastiktako rasaḥ||21|| malānāṃ pācanāni syuryathāvasthaṃ krameṇa vā| --------------------------------------------|22|
--------------------------------------------| tatra sāmajvarākṛtyā jānīyādaviśoṣitam||23|| dvividhopakramajñānamavekṣeta ca laṅghane| --------------------------------------------|24|

--------------------------------------------| yuktaṃ laṅghitaliṅgaistu taṃ peyābhirupācaret||24|| yathāsvauṣadhasiddhābhirmaṇḍapūrvābhirāditaḥ| ṣaḍahaṃ vā mṛdutvaṃ vā jvaro yāvadavāpnuyāt||25|| tasyāgnirdīpyate tābhiḥ samidbhiriva pāvakaḥ| --------------------------------------------|26|
--------------------------------------------| prāglājapeyāṃ sujarāṃ saśuṇṭhīdhānyapippalīm||26|| sasaindhavāṃ, tathā'mlārthī tāṃ pibetsahadāḍimām| --------------------------------------------|27|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| sṛṣṭaviḍ bahupitto vā saśuṇṭhīmākṣikāṃ himām||27||

div.ab: bastipārśvaśiraḥśūlī vyāghrīgokṣurasādhitām| --------------------------------------------|28|
--------------------------------------------| pṛśniparṇībalābilvanāgarotpaladhānyakaiḥ||28|| siddhāṃ jvarātisāryamlāṃ peyāṃ dīpanapācanīm| --------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| hrasvena pañcamūlena hikkārukśvāsakāsavān||29||

div.ab: pañcamūlena mahatā kaphārto yavasādhitam| vibaddhavarchāḥ sayavāṃ pippalyāmalakaiḥ kṛtām||30|| yavāgūṃ sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭāṃ maladoṣānulomanīm| --------------------------------------------|31|

ab.seg: -----------------------------pibettu parikartini| kolavṛkṣāmlakalaśīdhāvanīśrīphalaiḥ kṛtām||32||

div.ab: asvedanidrastṛṣṇārtaḥ sitāmalakanāgaraiḥ| sitābadaramṛdvīkāsārivāmustacandanaiḥ||33|| tṛṣṇāchchardiparīdāhajvaraghnīṃ kṣaudrasaṃyutām| --------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| kuryātpeyauṣadhaireva rasayūṣādikānapi||34||

div.ab: madyodbhave madyanitye pittasthānagate kaphe| grīṣme tayorvā'dhikayostṛṭchardirdāhapīḍite||35|| ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte rakte ca peyāṃ necchanti-----------| --------------------------------------------|36|
-----------------------------tato jīrṇe tu tarpaṇe| yavāgvāṃ vaudanaṃ kṣudvānaśnīyādbhṛṣṭataṇḍulam||37|| dakalāvaṇikairyūṣai rasairvā mudgalāvajaiḥ| --------------------------------------------|38|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| ityayaṃ ṣaḍaho neyo balaṃ doṣaṃ ca rakṣatā||38||
tataḥ pakveṣu doṣeṣu laṅghanādyaiḥ praśasyate| kaṣāyo doṣaśeṣasya pācanaḥ śamano'thavā||39||

div.ab: tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ, kaṭukaḥ kaphe| --------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| pittaśleṣmaharatve'pi kaṣāyaḥ sa na śasyate||40||
navajvare, malastambhātkaṣāyo viṣamajvaram| kurute'rucihṛllāsahidhmādhmānādikānapi||41||
saptāhādauṣadhaṃ kecidāhuranye daśāhataḥ| kecillaghvannabhuktasya yojyamāmolbaṇe na tu||42||

div.ab: tīvrajvaraparītasya doṣavegodaye yataḥ| doṣe'thavā'tinicite tandrāstaimityakāriṇi||43|| apacyamānaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhūyo jvalayati jvaram| --------------------------------------------|44|
--------------------------------------------| mṛdurjvaro laghurdehaścalitāśca malā yadā||44|| acirajvaritasyāpi bheṣajaṃ yojayettadā| --------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| mustayā parpaṭaṃ yuktaṃ śuṇṭhyā duḥsparśayā'pi vā||45||
pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā pāṭhośīraṃ savālakam| pibettadvcchabhūnimbaguḍūcīmustanāgaram||46||
yathāyogamime yojyāḥ kaṣāyā doṣapācanāḥ| jvarārocakatṛṣṇāsyavairasyāpaktināśanāḥ||47||

div.ab: --------------------------------------------| kaliṅgakāḥ paṭolasya patraṃ kaṭukarohiṇī||48|| paṭolaṃ sārivā mustā pāṭhā kaṭukarohiṇī| paṭolanimbatriphalāmṛdvīkāmustavatsakāḥ||49|| kirātatiktamamṛtā candanaṃ viśvabheṣajam| dhātrīmustāmṛtākṣaudramardhaślokasamāpanāṇ||50|| pañcate santatādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ śamanā matāḥ| --------------------------------------------|51|
--------------------------------------------| durālabhāmṛtāmustānāgaraṃ vātaje jvare||51|| athavā pippalīmūlaguḍūcīviśvabheṣajam| kanīyaḥ pañcamūlaṃ ca-----------------|52|
--------------------------------------------| -------------------pitte śakrayavāghanam||52|| kaṭukā ceti sakṣaudraṃ mustāparpaṭakaṃ tathā| sadhanvayāsabhūnimbaṃ---------------------|53|
--------------------------------------------| rugvibandhānilaśleṣmayukte dīpanapācanam||54|| abhayāpippalīmūlaśamyākakaṭukāghanam| --------------------------------------------|55|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| drākṣāmadhūkamadhukatodhrākāśmaryasārivāḥ||55||
mustāmalakahrīberapadmakesarapadmakam| mṛṇālacandanośīranīlotpalaparūṣakam||56||
phāṇṭo himo vā drākṣādirjātīkusumavāsitaḥ| yukto madhusitālājairjayatyanilapittajam||57||
jvaraṃ madātyayaṃ chardiṃ mūrcchāṃ dāhaṃ śramaṃ bhramam| ūrdhvagaṃ raktapittaṃ ca pipāsāṃ kāmalāmapi||58||
pācayetkaṭukāṃ piṣṭvā karpare'bhinave śucau| niṣpīḍito ghṛtayutastadgaso jvaradāhajit||59||
kaphavāte vacātiktāpāṭhāragvadhavatsakāḥ| pippalīcūrṇayukto vā kvāthaścchinnodbhavodbhavaḥ||60||
vyāghrīśuṇṭhyamṛtākvāthaḥ pippalīcūrṇasaṃyutaḥ| vātaśleṣmajvaraśvāsakāsapīnasaśūlajit||61||
pathyākustumbarīmustāśuṇṭhīkaṭtṛṇaparpaṭam| sakaṭphalavacābhārṅgīdevāhvaṃ madhuhiṅgumat||62||
kaphavātajvaraṣṭhīvakukṣihṛtpārśvavedanāḥ| kaṇṭhāmayāsyaśvayathukāsaśvāsānniyacchati||63||

div.ab: āragvadhādiḥ sakṣaudgaḥ kaphapittajvaraṃ jayet| tathā tiktāvṛṣośīratrāyantītriphalāmṛtāḥ||64|| paṭolātiviṣānimbamūrvādhanvayavāsakāḥ| --------------------------------------------|65|
--------------------------------------------| sannipātajvare vyāghrīdevadāruniśāghanam||65|| paṭolapatranimbatvaktriphalākaṭukāyutam| --------------------------------------------|66|
--------------------------------------------| nāgaraṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ guḍūcī kaṇṭakārikā||66|| sakāsaśvāsapārśvārtau vātaśleṣmottare jvare| --------------------------------------------|67|

--------------------------------------------| madhūkapuṣpamṛdvīkātrāyamāṇāparūṣakam||67|| sośīratiktātriphalākāśmaryaṃ kalpayeddhimam| kaṣāyaṃ taṃ piban kāle jvarān sarvānapohati||68|| jātyāmalakamustāni tadvaddhanvayavāsakam| --------------------------------------------|69|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| baddhaviṭ kaṭukādrākṣātrāyantītriphalāguḍam||69||
---------------------------------śleṣmavānna tu| peyā kaphaṃ vardhayati paṅkaṃ pāṃsuṣu vṛṣṭivat||70||

div.ab: śleṣmābhiṣyaṇṇadehānāmataḥ prāgapi yojayet| yūṣān kulatthacaṇakakalāyādikṛtān laghūn||71|| rūkṣāṃstiktarasopetān hṛdyān rucikarān paṭūn| --------------------------------------------|72|
--------------------------------------------| raktādyāḥ śālayo jīrṇāḥ ṣaṣṭikāśca jvare hitāḥ||72|| śleṣmottare vītatuṣāstathā vāṭīkṛtā yavāḥ| --------------------------------------------|73|
--------------------------------------------| odanastaiḥ sruto dvistriḥ prayoktavyo yathāyatham||73|| doṣadūṣyādibalato jvaraghnakvāthasādhitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|74|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| mudgādyairlaghubhiryūṣāḥ kulatthaiśca jvarāpahāḥ||74||
kāravellakakarkoṭabālamūlakaparpaṭaiḥ| vārtākanimbakusumapaṭolaphalapallavaiḥ||75||
atyantalaghubhirmāṃsairjāṅgalaiśca hitā rasāḥ| vyāghrīparūṣatarkārīdgākṣāmalakadāḍimaiḥ||76||
saṃskṛtāḥ pippalīśuṇṭhīdhānyajīrakasaindhavaiḥ| sitāmadhubhyāṃ prāyeṇa saṃyutā vā kṛtākṛtāḥ||77||

div.ab: anamlatakrasiddhāni rucyāni vyañjanāni ca| acchānyanalasampannāni-----------------------|78|
--------------------------------------------| sajvaraṃ jvaramuktaṃ vā dinānte bhojayellaghu||79|| śleṣmakṣayavivṛddhoṣmā balavānanalastadā| --------------------------------------------|80|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| yathocite'thavā kāle deśasātmyānurodhataḥ||80||

div.ab: prāgalpavahnirbhuñjāno na hyajīrṇena pīḍyate| --------------------------------------------|81|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| kaṣāyapānapathyānnairdaśāha iti laṅghite||81||
sarpirdadyātkaphe mande vātapittottare jvare| pakveṣu doṣeṣvamṛtaṃ tadviṣopamamanyathā||82||
daśāhe syādatīte'pi jvaropadravavṛddhikṛt| laṅghanādikramaṃ tatra kuryādākaphasaṅkṣyāt||83||

div.ab: dehadhātvabalatvācca jvaro jīrṇo'nuvartate| --------------------------------------------|84|

--------------------------------------------| rūkṣaṃ hi tejo jvarakṛttejasā rūkṣitasya ca||84|| vamanasvedakālāmbukaṣāyalaghubhojanaiḥ| yaḥ syādatibalo dhātuḥ sahacārī sadāgatiḥ||85|| tasya saṃśamanaṃ sarpirdīptasyevāmbu veśmanaḥ| --------------------------------------------|86|
--------------------------------------------| vātapittajitāṃgryaṃ saṃskāraṃ cānurudhyate||86|| sutarāṃ taddhyato dadyādyathāsvauṣadhasādhitam| --------------------------------------------|87|
--------------------------------------------| viparītaṃ jvaroṣmāṇaṃ jayetpittaṃ ca śaityataḥ||87|| snehādvātaṃ ghṛtaṃ tulyaṃ yogasaṃskārataḥ kapham| --------------------------------------------|88|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| pūrve kaṣāyāḥ saghṛtāḥ sarve yojyā yathāmalam||88||
triphalāpicumandatvaṅmādhukaṃ bṛhatīdvayam| samasūradalaṃ kvāthaḥ saghṛto jvarakāsahā||89||
pippalīndrayavadhāvanitiktā- sārivāmalakatāmalakībhiḥ| bilvamustahimapālanisevyai- rdrākṣayā'tiviṣayā sthirayā ca||90||
ghṛtamāśu nihanti sādhitaṃ jvaramagniṃ viṣamaṃ halīmakam| aruciṃ bhṛśatāpamaṃsayo- rvamathuṃ pārśvaśirorujaṃ kṣayam||91||
tailvakaṃ pavanajanmani jvare yojayetrivṛtayā viyojitam| tiktakaṃ vṛṣaghṛtaṃ ca paittike yacca pālanikayā śṛtaṃ haviḥ||92||
viḍaṅgasauvarcalacavyapāṭhā- vyoṣāgnisindhūdbhavayāvaśūkaiḥ| palāṃśakaiḥ kṣīrasamaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ pacejjīrṇakaphajvaraghnam||93||
guḍūcyā rasakalkābhyāṃ triphalāyā vṛṣasya ca| mṛdvīkāyā balāyāśca snehāḥ siddhā jvaracchidaḥ||94||
jīrṇe ghṛte ca bhuñjīta mṛdumāṃsarasaudanam| balaṃ hyalaṃ doṣaharaṃ paraṃ tacca balapradam||95||

div.ab: kaphapittaharā mudgakāravellādijā rasāḥ| prāyeṇa tasmānna hitā jīrṇe vātottare jvare||96|| śūlodāvartaviṣṭambhajananā jvaravardhanāḥ| --------------------------------------------|97|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| na śāmyatyevamapi cejjvaraḥ kurvīta śodhanam||97||
śodhanārhasya, vamanaṃ prāguktaṃ tasya yojayet| āmāśayagate doṣe balinaḥ pālayanbalam||98||
pakve tu śithile doṣe jvare vā viṣamadyaje| modakaṃ triphalāśyāmātrivṛtpippalikesaraiḥ||99||
sasitāmadhubhirdadyāhyoṣādyaṃ vā virecanam| (lihyādvā traivṛtaṃ saṃyuktaṃ madhusarpiṣā| ) drākṣādhātrīrasaṃ tadvatsadrākṣāṃ vā harītakīm||100||
āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā| triphalāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ vā payasā jvaritaḥpibet||101||

div.ab: viriktānāṃ ca saṃsargī maṇḍapūrvā yathākramam| --------------------------------------------|102|
--------------------------------------------| cyavamānaṃ jvarotkliṣṭamupekṣeta malaṃ sadā||102|| pakvo'pi hi vikurvīta doṣaḥ koṣṭhe kṛtāspadaḥ| --------------------------------------------|103|
--------------------------------------------| atipravartamānaṃ vā pācayan saṅgrahaṃ nayet||103|| āmasaṅgrahaṇe doṣā doṣopakrama īritāḥ| --------------------------------------------|104|
--------------------------------------------| pāyayeddoṣaharaṇaṃ mohādāmajvare tu yaḥ||104|| prasuptaṃ kṛṣṇasarpaṃ sa karāgreṇa parāmṛśet| --------------------------------------------|105|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| jvarakṣīṇasya na hitaṃ vamanaṃ na virecanam||105||
kāmaṃ tu payasā tasya niruhairvā harenmalān| --------------------------------------------||2||

div.ab: --------------------------------------------| kṣīrocitasya prakṣīṇaśleṣmaṇo dāhatṛṅvataḥ||106|| kṣīraṃ pittānilārtasya pathyamapyatisāriṇaḥ| --------------------------------------------|107|
--------------------------------------------| tadvapurlaṅghanottaptaṃ pluṣṭaṃ vanamivāgninā||107|| divyāmbu jīvayettasya jvaraṃ cāśu niyacchati| --------------------------------------------|108|
--------------------------------------------| saṃskṛtaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ vā tasmāddhāroṣṇameva vā||108|| vibhajya kāle yuñjīta jvariṇaṃ hantyato'nyathā| --------------------------------------------|109|
--------------------------------------------| payaḥ saśuṇṭhīkharjūramṛdvīkāśarkarāghṛtam||109|| śṛtaśītaṃ madhuyutaṃ tuḍdāhajvaranāśanam| --------------------------------------------|110|
--------------------------------------------| tadvad drākṣābalāyaṣṭīsārivākaṇacandanaiḥ||110|| caturguṇenāmbhasā vā pippalyā vā śṛtaṃ pibet| --------------------------------------------|111|
--------------------------------------------| kāsācchvāsācchiraḥśūlātpārśvaśūlāccirajvarāt| mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā||111|| pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ| --------------------------------------------|112|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| śṛtameraṇḍamūlena bālabilvena vā jvarāt||112||
dhāroṣṇaṃ vā payaḥ pītvā vibaddhānilavarcasaḥ| saraktapicchātisṛteḥ satṛṭśūlapravāhikāt||113||
siddhaṃ śuṇṭhībalāvyāghrīgokaṇṭakaguḍaiḥ payaḥ| śophamūtraśakṛdvātavibandhajvarakāsajit||114||

div.ab: vṛścīvabilvavarṣābhūsādhitaṃ jvaraśophanut| --------------------------------------------|115|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| śiṃśipāsārasiddhaṃ ca kṣīramāśu jvarāpaham||115||
niruhastu balaṃ vahniṃ vijvaratvaṃ mudaṃ rucim| doṣe yuktaḥ karotyāśu pakve pakvāśāyaṃ gate||116||
pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pakvāśayagataṃ haret| sraṃsanaṃ trīnapi malān bastiḥ pakvāśayāśrayān||117||
prakṣīṇakaphapittasya trikapṛṣṭhakaṭigrahe| dīptāgnerbaddhaśakṛtaḥ prayuñjītānuvāsanam||118||
paṭolanimbacchadanakaṭukācaturaṅgulaiḥ| sthirābalāgokṣurakamadanośīravālakaiḥ||119||
payasyardhodake kvāthaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ vimiśritam| kalkitairmustamadanakṛṣṇāmadhukavatsakaiḥ||120||
basti madhughṛtābhyāṃ ca pīḍyejjvaranāśanam| --------------------------------------------||121||
--------------------------------------------| catasraḥ parṇinīryaṣṭīphalośīranṛpadrumān||121||
kvāthayetkalkayedyaśṭīṣatāhvāphalinīphalam| mustaṃ ca bastiḥ saguḍakṣaudrasarpirjvarāpahaḥ||122||
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ pippplīṃ madhukaṃ vacām| ṛddhiṃ rāsrāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm||123||
piṣṭvā kṣīraṃ jalaṃ sarpistailaṃ caikatra sādhitam| jvare'nuvāsanaṃ dadyādyathāsnehaṃ yathāmalam||124||

div.ab: ye ca siddhiṣu vakṣyante bastayo jvaranāśanāḥ| --------------------------------------------|125|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| śiroruggauravaśleṣmaharamindriyabodhanam||125||
jīrṇajvare rucikaraṃ dadyānnasyaṃ virecanam| snaihikaṃ śūnyaśiraso dāhārte pittanāśanam||126||
dhūmagaṇḍūṣakavalān yathādoṣaṃ ca kalpayet| pratiśyāyāsyavairasyaśiraḥ kaṇṭhāmayāpahān||127||
arucau mātuluṅgasya kesaraṃ sājyasaindhavam| dhātrīdrākṣāsitānāṃ vā kalkamāsyena dhārayet||128||

div.ab: yathopaśayasaṃsparśān śītoṣṇadravyakalpitān| abhyaṅgālepasekādīn jvare jīrṇe tvagāśrite||129|| kuryādañjanadhūmāṃśca tathaivāgantuje'pi tān| --------------------------------------------|130|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| dāhe sahasradhautena sarpiṣā'bhyaṅgamācaret||130||
sūtroktaiśca gaṇaistaistairmadhurāmlakaṣāyakaiḥ| dūrvādibhirvā pittaghnaiḥ śodhanādigaṇoditaiḥ||131||
śītavīryairhimasparśaiḥ kvāthakalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet| tailaṃ sakṣīramabhyaṅgātsadyo dāhajvarāpaham||132||
śiro gātraṃ ca taireva nātipiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet| tatkvāthena parīṣekamavagāhaṃ ca yojayet||133||
tathā''ranālasalilakṣīraśuktaghṛtādibhiḥ| --------------------------------------------||133||
--------------------------------------------| kapitthamātuluṅgāmlavidārīrodhradāḍimaiḥ||134||
badarīpallavotthena phenenāriṣṭakasya vā| lipte'ṅge dāharuṅmohāśracchardistṛṣṇā ca śāmyati||135||
yo varṇitaḥ pittaharo doṣopakramaṇe kramaḥ| taṃ ca śīlayataḥ śīghraṃ sadāho naśyati jvaraḥ||136||
vīryoṣṇairuṣṇasaṃsparśaistagarāgurukuṅkumaiḥ| kuṣṭhasthauṇeyaśaileyasaralāmaradārubhiḥ||137||
nakharāsnāpuravacācaṇḍailādvayacorakaiḥ| pṛthvīkāśigrusurasāhiṃsrādhyāmakasarṣapaiḥ||138||
daśamūlāmṛtairaṇḍadvayapattūrarohiṣaiḥ| tamālapatrabhūtīkaśallakīdhānyadīpyakaiḥ||139||
miśimāṣakulatthāgniprakīryānākulīdvayaiḥ| anyaiśca tadvidhairdravyaiḥ śīte tailaṃ jvare pacet||140||
kvathitaiḥ kalkitairyuktaiḥ surāsauvīrakādibhiḥ| tenābhyañjayātsukhoṣṇena, taiḥ supiṣṭaiśca lepayet||141||
kavoṣṇaistaiḥ parīṣekamavagāhaṃ ca kalpayet| kevalairapi tadvacca suktagomūtramastubhiḥ||142||
āragvadhādivargaṃ ca pānābhyañjanalepane| dhūpānagarujān yāṃśca vakṣyante viṣamajvare||143||
agnyanagnikṛtān svedān svedi bheṣajabhojanam| garbhabhūveśmaśayanaṃ kuthakambalarallakān||144||
nirdhūmadīptairaṅgārairhasantīśca hasantikāḥ| madyaṃ satryūṣaṇaṃ takraṃ kulatthavrīhikodgavān||145||
saṃśīlayedvepathumān yaccānyadapi pittalam| dayitāḥ stanaśālinyaḥ pīnā vibhramabhūṣaṇāḥ||146||
yauvanāsavamattāśca tamāliṅgeyuraṅganāḥ| vītaśītaṃ ca vijñāya tāstato'panayetpunaḥ||147||
vardhanenaikadoṣasya kṣapaṇenocchritasya vā| kaphasthānānupūrvyā vā tulyakakṣāñjayenmalān||148||
sannipātajvarasyānte karṇamūle sudāruṇaḥ| śophaḥ sañjāyate yena kaścideva vimucyate||149||
raktāvasecanaiḥ śīghraṃ sarpiḥpānaiśca taṃ jayet| pradehaiḥ kaphapittaghnairnāvanaiḥ kavalagrahaiḥ||150||
śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairjvaro yasya na śāmyati| śākhānusārī tasyāśu muñcedvāhvoḥ kramācchirām||151||
ayameva vidhiḥ kāryo viṣame'pi yathāyatham| jvare vibhajya vātādīn yaścānantaramucyate||152||
paṭolakaṭukāmustāprāṇadāmadhukaiḥ kṛtāḥ| tricatuḥpañcaśaḥ kvāthā viṣamajvaranāśanāḥ||153||
yojayetriphalāṃ pathyāṃ guḍūcīṃ pippalīṃ pṛthak| taistairvidhānaiḥ saguḍaṃ bhallātakamathāpi vā||154||

div.ab: laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vā''dau jvarāgamanavāsare| --------------------------------------------|155|

ab.seg: prātaḥ satailaṃ laśunaṃ prāgbhakraṃ vā tathā ghṛtam||155||
jīrṇaṃ tadvaddadhi payastakraṃ sarpiśca ṣaṭpalam| kalyāṇakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tiktākhyaṃ vṛṣasādhitam||156||
triphalākolatarkārīkvāthe dadhnā śṛtaṃ ghṛtam| tilvakatvakkṛtāvāpa viṣamajvarajitparam||157||

div.ab: surāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca yanmadyaṃ śikhitittiridakṣajam| māṃsaṃ medyoṣṇavīryaṃ ca sahānnena prakāmataḥ||158|| sevitvā tadahaḥ svapyādathavā punarullikhet| --------------------------------------------|159|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| sarpiṣo mahatīm mātrāṃ pītvā vā chhardayetpunaḥ||159||
nīlinībhajagandhāṃ ca trivṛtāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm| pibejjvarasyāgamane snehasvedopapāditaḥ||160||

div.ab: manohvā saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā tailena nayanāñjanam| yojyaṃ-------------------------------------------------|162|

--------------------------------------------| --------------hiṅgusamā vyāghrīvasā nasyaṃ sasaindhavam||161|| purāṇasarpiḥ siṃhasya vasā tadvatsasaindhavā| --------------------------------------------|162|
--------------------------------------------| palaṅkaṣā nimbapatraṃ vacā kuṣṭhaṃ harītakī||162|| sarṣapāḥ sayavāḥ sarpirdhūpo viḍvā biḍālajā| --------------------------------------------|163|
--------------------------------------------| puradhyāmavacāsarjanimbārkāgarudārubhiḥ||163|| dhūpo jvareṣu sarveṣu kāryo'yamaparājitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|164|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| dhūpanasyāñjanostrāsā ye coktāścittavaikṛte||164||
daivāśrayaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ jvarān sarvān vyapohati| viṣeṣādviṣamān prāyaste hyāgantvanubandhajāḥ||165||

div.ab: yathāsvaṃ ca sirāṃ vidhyedaśāntau viṣamajvare| --------------------------------------------|166|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| kevalānilavīsarpavisphoṭābhihatajvare||166||
sarpiḥpānahimālepasekamāṃsarasāśanam| kuryādyathāsvamuktaṃ ca raktamokṣādi sādhanam||167||

div.ab: grahotthebhūtavidyoktaṃ balimantrādi sādhanam| --------------------------------------------|168|

ab.seg: iṣṭairarthairmanojñaiśca yathādoṣaśamena ca| hitāhitavivekaiśca jvaraṃ krodhādijaṃ jayet||169||
krodhajo yāti kāmena śāntiṃ krodhena kāmajaḥ| bhayośokodbhavau tābhyāṃ bhīśokābhyaṃ tathetarau||170||
śāpātharvaṇamantrotthe vidhirdaivavyapāśrayaḥ| te jvarāḥ kevalāḥ pūrvaṃ vyāpyante'nantaraṃ malaiḥ||171||
tasmāddoṣānusāreṇa teṣvāhārādi kalpayet| na hi jvaro'nubadhnāti mārutādyairvinā kṛtaḥ||172||

div.ab: jvarakālasmṛtiṃ cāsya hāribhirviṣayairharet| --------------------------------------------|173|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| karuṇārdraṃ manaḥ śuddhaṃ sarvajvaravināśanam||173||
tyajedābalalābhācca vyāyāmasnānamaithunam| gurvasātmyavidāhyannaṃ yaccānyajjavarakāraṇam||174||
na vijvaro'pi sahasā sarvānnīno bhavettathā| nivṛtto'pi jvaraḥ śīghraṃ vyāpādayati durbalam||175||
sadyaḥ prāṇaharo yasmāttasmāttasya viśeṣataḥ| tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ tattatkuryādbhīṣagjitam||176||

div.ab: auṣadhayo maṇayaśca sumantrāḥ sādhugurudvijadaivatapūjāḥ| prītikarā manaso viṣayāśca ghnantyapi viṣṇukṛtaṃ jvaramugram|177| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cititsitasthāne jvaracikitsitaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|1| g|2|

div.head: raktapittacikitsitādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktapaittacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) ūrdhvagaṃ balino'vegamekadoṣānugaṃ navam| raktapittaṃ sukhe kāle sādhayennirupadravam||1||
adhogaṃ yāpyayedraktam yaccadoṣadvayānugam| śāntaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ kupyanmārgānmārgāntaraṃ ca yat||2||

div.ab: atipravṛttaṃ mandāgnestridoṣaṃ dvipathaṃ tyajet| -----------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| jñātvā nidānamayanaṃ malāvanubalau balam||3||
deśakālādyavasthāṃ ca raktapitte prayojayet| laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vā''dau śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ tathā||4||

div.ab: santarpaṇotthaṃ balino bahūdoṣasya sādhayet| ūrdhvabhāgaṃ virekeṇa vamanena tvadhogatam||5|| śamanairbṛṃhaṇaiścānyallaṅghya bṛṃhyānavekṣya ca| -----------------------------------------------|6|
-----------------------------------------------| ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte śamanau rasau tiktakaṣāyakau||6|| upavāsaśca niḥśuṇṭhīṣaḍaṅgodakapāyinaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| adhoge raktapitte tu bṛṃhaṇau madhuro rasaḥ||7||

div.ab: ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ prāk ca peyā tvadhogate| -----------------------------------------------|8|
-----------------------------------------------| āśnato balino'śuddhaṃ na dhāryaṃ taddhi rogakṛt||8|| dhārayedanyathā śīghramagnivacchīghrakāri tat| -----------------------------------------------|9|
----------------------------------------------| trivṛcchyāmākaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaram||9|| sādhayedvidhivallehaṃ lihyātpāṇitalaṃ tataḥ| ----------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| trivṛtā triphalā śyāmā pippalī śarkarā madhu||10||
modakaḥ sannipātordhvaraktaśophajvarāpahaḥ| trivṛtsamasitā tadvat pippalīpādasaṃyutā||11||

div.ab: vamanaṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sasitāmadhu| sasitaṃ vā jalaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā madhukodakam||12|| kṣīraṃ vā rasamikṣorvā-----------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: ------------------------śuddhasyānantaro vidhiḥ| yathāsvaṃ manthapeyādiḥ prayojyo rakṣatā balam||13||

div.ab: mantho jvarokto drākṣādiḥ, pittaghnairvā phalaiḥ kṛtaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| madhukharjūramṛdvīkāparūṣakasitāmbhasā||14||
mantho vā pañcasāreṇa saghṛtairlājasaktubhiḥ| dāḍimāmalakāmlo va mandāgnyamlābhilāṣiṇām||15||
kamalotpalakiñjalkapṛśniparṇīpriyaṅgukāḥ| uśīraṃ śābaraṃ rodhraṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ kucandanam||16||
hīveraṃ dhātakīpuṣpaṃ bilvamadhyaṃ durālabhā| ardhārdhairvihitāḥ peyā vakṣyante pādayaugikāḥ||17||
bhūnimbasevyajaladā masūrāḥ pṛśniparṇyapi| vidārigandhā mudgāśca balā sarpirhareṇukāḥ||18||
jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni śītavīryāṇi sādhayet| pṛthakapṛthagjale teṣāṃ yavāgūḥ kalpayedrase||19||
śītāḥ saśarkarākṣaudrāstadvanmāṃsarasānapi| īṣadamlānanamlān vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭān saśarkarān||20||
śūkaśimbībhavaṃ dhānyaṃ rakte śākaṃ ca śasyate| annasvarūpavijñāne yaduktaṃ laghu śītalam||21||
pūrvoktamambu pānīyaṃ pañcamūlena vā śṛtam| laghunā śṛtaśītaṃ vā madhvambho vā phalāmbu vā||22||

div.ab: ----------------------------------tittiriḥ punaḥ| udumbarasya niryūhe sādhito mārute'dhike||23|| plakṣasya barhiṇastadvannyagrodhasya ca kukkuṭaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| yatkiñcidraktapittasya nidānaṃ tacca varjayet||24||
vāsārasena phalinīmṛdgodhrāñjanamākṣīkam| pittāsṛk śamayetpītaṃ, niryāso vā'ṭarūṣakāt||25||
śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaḥ kevalo vā, śṛto'pi vā| vṛṣaḥ sadyo jayatyasraṃ, sa hyasya paramauṣadham||26||
paṭolamālatīnimbacandanadvayapadmakam| rodhro vṛṣastandulīyaḥ kṛṣṇā mṛnmadayantikā||27||
śatāvarī gopakanyā kākolyau madhuyaṣṭikā| raktapittaharāḥ kvāthāstrayaḥ samadhuśarkarāḥ||28||
palāśavalkakvātho vā suśītaḥ śarkarānvitaḥ| lihyādvā madhusarpibhyāṃ gavāśvaśakṛto rasam||29||

div.ab: sakṣaudgaṃ grathite rakte lihyātpārāvatācchakṛt| -----------------------------------------------|30|

-----------------------------------------------| atiniḥ srutaraktaśca kṣaudgeṇa rudhiraṃ pibet||30|| jāṅgalaṃ, bhakṣayedvā''jamāmaṃ pittayutaṃ yakṛt| -----------------------------------------------|31|
-----------------------------------------------| candanośīrajaladalājamudgakaṇāyavaiḥ||31|| balājale paryuṣitaiḥ kaṣāyo raktapittahā| -----------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| prasādaścandanāmbhojasevyamṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭajaḥ||32||
suśītaḥ sasitākṣaudraḥ śoṇitātipravṛttijit| āpothya vā nave kumbhe plāvayedikṣugaṇḍikāḥ||33||
sthitaṃ tadguptamākāśe rātriṃ prātaḥ srutaṃ jalam| madhumadvikacāmbhojakṛtottaṃsaṃ ca tadguṇam||34||

div.ab: ye ca pittajvare coktāḥ kaṣāyāstāṃśca yojayet| -----------------------------------------------|35|

-----------------------------------------------| kaṣāyairvividhairebhirdīpte'gnau vijite kaphe||35|| raktapittaṃ na cecchāmyettatra vātolbaṇe payaḥ| yuñjayācchāgaṃ śṛtaṃ, tadvadgavyaṃ pañcaguṇe'mbhasi||36|| pañcamūlena laghunā śṛtaṃ vā sasitāmadhu| jīvakarṣabhakadrākṣābalāgokṣuranāgaraiḥ||37|| pṛthakpṛthakśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ saghṛtaṃ sitayā'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|38|
-----------------------------------------------| gokaṇṭakābhīruśṛtaṃ parṇinībhistathā payaḥ||38|| hantyāśu raktaṃ sarujaṃ viśeṣānmūtramārgagam| -----------------------------------------------|39|
-----------------------------------------------| viṇmārgage viśeṣeṇa hitaṃ mocarasena tu||39|| vaṭaprarohaiḥ śuṅgairvā śuṇṭhyudīcyotpalairapi| -----------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| raktātisāradurnāmacikitsāṃ cātra kalpayet||40||
pītvā kaṣāyān payasā bhuñjīta payasaiva ca| kaṣāyayogairebhirvā vipakvaṃ pāyayeddhṛtam||41||

div.ab: samūlamastakaṃ kṣuṇṇaṃ vṛṣamaṣṭaguṇe'mbhasi| paktvā'ṣṭāṃśāvaśeṣeṇa ghṛtaṃ tena vipācayet||42|| tatpuṣpagarbhaṃ tacchītaṃ sakṣaudgaṃ pittaśoṇitam| pittagulmajvaraśvāsakāsahṛdrogakāmalāḥ||43|| timirabhramavīsarpasvarasādāṃśca nāśayet| -----------------------------------------------|44|

-----------------------------------------------| palāśavṛntasvarase tadgarbhaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pacet||44|| sakṣaudraṃ tacca raktaghnaṃ, tathaiva trāyamāṇayā| -----------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| rakte sapicche sakaphe grathite kaṇṭhamārgage||45||
lihyānmākṣikasarpirbhyāṃ kṣāramutpalanālajam| pṛthakpṛthak tathā'mbhojareṇuśyāmāmadhūkajam||46||

div.ab: -----------------------------------------------| ghrāṇage rudhire śuddhe nāvanaṃ cānuṣecayet||47|| kaṣāyayogān pūrvoktān kṣīrekṣvādirasāplutān| kṣīrādīnsasitāṃstoyaṃ kevalaṃ vā jalaṃ hitam||48|| raso dāḍimapuṣpāṇāmāmrāsthnaḥ śāḍvalasya vā| -----------------------------------------------|49|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kalpayecchītavargaṃ ca pradehābhyañjanādiṣu||49||

div.ab: yacca pittajvare proktaṃ bahirantaśca bheṣajam| raktapitte hitaṃ tacca kṣatakṣīṇe hitaṃ ca yat|50| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita sthāne raktapittacikitsitaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|2|

div.head: kāsacikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ kāsacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) kevalānilajaṃ kāsaṃ snehairādāvupācaret| vātaghnasiddhaiḥ snigdhaiśca peyāyūṣarasādibhiḥ||1|| lehairdhūmaistathā'bhyaṅgasvedasekāvagāhanaiḥ| bastibhirvaddhaviḍvātaṃ, sapittaṃ tūrdhvabhaktikaiḥ||2|| ghṛtaiḥ kṣīraiśca, sakaphaṃ jayetsnehavirecanaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|3|
-----------------------------------------------| guḍūcīkaṇṭakārībhyāṃ pṛthaktriṃśatpalādrase||3|| prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtādvātakāsanudvahnidīpanaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|4|

-----------------------------------------------| kṣārarāsnāvacāhiṅgupāṭhāyaṣṭyāhvadhānyakaiḥ||4|| dviśāṇaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ pañcakolayutaiḥ pacet| daśamūlasya niryūhe pīto maṇḍānupāyinā||5|| sa kāsaśvāsahratpārśvagrahaṇīrogagulmanut| -----------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| droṇe'pāṃ sādhayedrāsnādaśamūlaśatāvarīḥ||6||
palonmitā dvikuḍavaṃ kulatthaṃ badaraṃ yavam| tulārghaṃ cājamāṃsasya tena sādhyaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam||7||
samakṣīraṃ palāṃśaiśca jīvanīyaiḥ samīkṣya tat| prayuktaṃ vātarogeṣu pānanāvanabastibhiḥ||8||
pañcakāsān śiraḥkampaṃ yonivaṅkṣaṇavedanām| sarvāṅgaikāṅgarogāṃśca saplīhordhvānilān jayet||9||

div.ab: vidāryādigaṇakvāthakalkasiddhaṃ ca kāsajit| -----------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| aśokabījakṣavakajantughnāñjanapadmakaiḥ||10||
sabiḍaiśca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ taccūrṇaṃ vā ghṛtaplutam| lihyātpayaścānu pibedājaṃ kāsātipīḍitaḥ||11||

div.ab: viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnā pippalī hiṅgu saindhavam| bhārṅgī kṣāraśca taccūrṇaṃ pibedvā ghṛtamātrayā||12|| sakaphe'nilaje kāse śvāsahidhmāhatāgniṣu| -----------------------------------------------|13|
-----------------------------------------------| durālabhāṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ śaṭhīṃ drākṣāṃ sitopalām||13|| lihyātkarkaṭaśṛṅgī ca kāse tailena vātaje| -----------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| dusparśāṃ pippalīṃ mustāṃ bhārṅgī karkaṭakīṃ śaṭhīm||14||
purāṇaguḍatailābhyāṃ cūrṇitānyavalehayet| tadvatsakṛṣṇāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ ca sabhārṅgī tadvadeva ca||15||
pibecca kṛṣṇaṃ koṣṇena salilena sasaindhavām| mastunā sasitāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadhnā vā kaṇareṇukām||16||
pibedvadaramajjño vā madirādadhimastubhiḥ| athavā pippalīkalkaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam||17||
kāsī sapīnaso dhūmaṃ snaihikaṃ vidhinā pibet| hidhmāśvāsoktadhūmāṃśca kṣīramāṃsarasāśanaḥ||18||
grāmyānūpaudakaiḥ śāliyavagodhūmaṣaṣṭikān| rasairmāṣātmaguptānāṃ yūṣairvā bhojayeddhitān||19||
yavānīpippalībilvamadhyanāgaracitrakaiḥ| rāsnājājīpṛthakparṇīpalāśaśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ||20||
siddhāṃ snigdhāmlalavaṇāṃ peyāmanilaje pibet| kaṭihṛtpārśvakoṣṭhārtiśvāsahidhmāpraṇāśanīm||21||
