div.ab: daśamūlarase tadvat pañcakolaguḍānvitām| pibetpeyāṃ---------------------------------|22|
mātsyakaukkuṭavārāhairmāṃsairvā sājyasaindhavām| -----------------------------------------------|23|

-----------------------------------------------| vāstuko vāyasīśākaṃ kāsaghnaḥ suniṣaṇṇakaḥ||23|| kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalaṃ patraṃ bālaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca mūlakam| -----------------------------------------------|24|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| snehāstailādayobhakṣyāḥ kṣīrekṣurasagauḍikāḥ||24||

div.ab: dadhimastvāranālāmlaphalāmbumadirāḥ pibet| -----------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| pittakāse tu sakaphe vamanaṃ sarpiṣā hitam||25||
tathā madanakāśmaryamadhukakvathitairjalaiḥ| phalayaṣṭyāhvakalkairvā vidārīkṣurasāplutaiḥ||26||
pittakāse tanukaphe trivṛtāṃ madhurairyutām| yuñjyādvirekāya yutāṃ ghanaśleṣmaṇi tiktakaiḥ||27||
hṛtadoṣo himaṃ svādu snigdhaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ bhajet| ghane kaphe tu śiśiraṃ rūkṣaṃ tiktopasaṃhitam||28||
lehaḥ paitte sitādhātrīkṣaudradrākṣāhimotpalaiḥ| sakaphe sābdamaricaḥ saghṛtaḥ sānile hitaḥ||29||

div.ab: mṛdvīkārdhaśataṃ triṃśatpippalīḥ śarkarāpalam| lehayenmadhunā---------------------------------|30|
tvagelāvyoṣamṛdvīkāpippalīmūlapauṣkaraiḥ| lājamustāśaṭhīrāsnādhātrīphalabibhītakaiḥ||31|| śarkarākṣaudrasarpirbhirleho hṛdrogakāsahā| -----------------------------------------------|32|

-----------------------------------------------| madhurairjāṅgalarasairyavaśyāmākakodravāḥ||32|| mudgādiyūṣaiḥ śākaiśca tiktakairmātrayā hitāḥ| ghanaśleṣmaṇi lehāśca tiktakā madhusaṃyutāḥ||33|| śālayaḥ syustanukaphe ṣaṣṭikāśca rasādibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śarkarāmbho'nupānārthaṃ drākṣekṣusvarasāḥ payaḥ||34||
kākolībṛhatīmedādvayaiḥ savṛṣanāgaraiḥ| pittakāse rasakṣīrapeyāyūṣān prakalpayet||35||

div.ab: drākṣāṃ kaṇāṃ pañcamūlaṃ tṛṇākhyaṃ ca pacejjale| tena kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ pibetsamadhuśarkaram||36|| sādhitāṃ tena peyāṃ vā suśītāṃ madhunā'nvitām| -----------------------------------------------|37|
-----------------------------------------------| śaṭhīhnīberabṛhatīśarkarāviśvabheṣajam||37|| piṣṭvā rasaṃ pibetpūtaṃ vastreṇa ghṛtamūrcchitam| -----------------------------------------------|38|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| medāṃ vidārīṃ kākolīṃ svayaṃguptāphalaṃ balām||38||
śarkarāṃ jīvakaṃ mudgamāṣaparṇyau durālabhām| kalkīkṛtyapacetsarpiḥ kṣīreṇāṣṭaguṇena tat||39||
pānabhojanaleheṣu prayuktaṃ pittakāsajit| lihyādvā cūrṇameteṣāṃ kaṣāyamathavā pibet||40||
kaphakāsī pibedādau surakāṣṭhāt pradīpitāt| snehaṃ parisrutaṃ vyoṣayavakṣārāvacūrṇitam||41||

div.ab: snigdhaṃ virecayedūrdhvamadho mūrdhni ca yuktitaḥ| tīkṣṇairvirekairbalinaṃ---------------------------|42|

-----------------------------------------------| ----------------------saṃsargī cāsya yojayet||42|| yavamudgakulatthānnairuṣṇarūkṣaiḥ kaṭūtkaṭaiḥ| kāsamardakavārtākavyāghrīkṣārakaṇānvitaiḥ||43|| dhānvabailarasaiḥ snehaistilasarṣapanimbajaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|44|

ab.seg: daśamūlāmbu gharmāmbu madyaṃ madhvambu vā pibet||44||
mūlaiḥ pauṣkaraśamyākapaṭolaiḥ saṃsthitaṃ niśām| pibedvāri sahakṣaudraṃ kāleṣvannasya vā triṣu||45||
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ bibhītakam| śikhikukkuṭapicchānāṃ maṣī kṣāro yavodbhavaḥ||46||
viśālā pippalīmūlaṃ trivṛtā ca madhudravāḥ| kaphakāsaharā lehāstrayaḥ ślokārdhayojitāḥ||47||

div.ab: madhunā maricaṃ lihyānmadhunaiva ca joṅgakam| pṛthagrasāṃśca madhunā vyāghrīvārtākabhṛṅgajān||48|| kāsaghnasyāśvaśakṛtaḥ surasasyāsitasya ca| ----------------------------------------------|49|

----------------------------------------------| devadāruśaṭhīrāsnākarkaṭākhyādurālabhāḥ||49|| pippalī nāgaraṃ mustaṃ pathyā dhātrī sitopalā| lājāḥ sitopalā sarpiḥ śṛṅgī dhātrīphalodbhavā||50|| madhutailayutā lehāstrayo vātānuge kaphe| ----------------------------------------------|51|

----------------------------------------------| dve pale dāḍimādaṣṭau guḍādvyoṣātpalatrayam||51|| rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ svaryaṃ pīnasaśvāsakāsajit| guḍakṣāroṣaṇakaṇādāḍimaṃ śvāsakāsajit||52|| kramātpaladvayārdhākṣakarṣārdhākṣapalonmitam| ----------------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pibejjavaroktaṃ pathyādi saśṛṅgīkaṃ ca pācanam||53||
athavā dīpyakatrivṛdviśālāghanapauṣkaram| sakaṇaṃ kvathitaṃ mūtre kaphakāsī jale'pi vā||54||
tailabhṛṣṭaṃ ca vaidehīkalkākṣaṃ sasitopalam| pāyayetkaphakāsaghnaṃ kulatthasalilāplutam||55||

div.ab: daśamūlāḍhake prasthaṃ ghṛtasyākṣasamaiḥ pacet| puṣkarāhvaśaṭhībilvasurasāvyoṣahiṅgubhiḥ||56|| peyānupānaṃ tatsarvavātaśleṣmāmayāpaham| ----------------------------------------------|57|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| nirguṇḍīpatraniryāsasādhitaṃ kāsajiddhṛtam||57||

div.ab: ghṛtaṃ rase viḍaṅgānāṃ vyoṣagarbhaṃ ca sādhitam| 57 1/2| ----------------------------------------------|58|

ab.seg: punarnavaśivāṭikāsaralakāsamardāmṛtā- paṭolabṛhatīphaṇijjakarasaiḥ payaḥsaṃyutaiḥ| ghṛtaṃ trikaṭunā ca siddhamupayujya sañjāyate na kāsaviṣamajvarakṣayagudāṅkurebhyo bhayam||58||

div.ab: samūlaphalapatrāyāḥ kaṇṭakāryā rasāḍhake||59|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ balāvyoṣaviḍaṅgaśaṭhidāḍimaiḥ| sauvarcalayavakṣāramūlāmalakapauṣkaraiḥ||60|| vṛścīvabṛhatīpathyāyavānīcitrakardhibhiḥ| mṛdvīkācavyavarṣābhūdurālambhāmlavetasaiḥ||61|| śṛṅgītāmalakībhārṅgīrāsnāgokṣurakaiḥ pacet| kalkaistatsarvakāseṣu śvāsahidhmāsu ceṣyate||62|| kaṇṭakārīghṛtaṃ caitatkaphavyādhivināśanam| ----------------------------------------------|63|

----------------------------------------------| pacevyāghrītulāṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ vahe'pāmāḍhakasthite||63|| kṣipet pūte tu sañcūrṇya vyoṣarāsnāmṛtāgnikān| śṛṅgībhārṅgīghanagranthidhanvayāsān palārdhakān||64|| sarpiṣaḥ ṣoḍaśapalaṃ catvāriṃśatpalāni ca| matsyaṇḍikāyāḥ śuddhāyāḥ punaśca tadadhiśrayet||65|| darvīlepini śīte ca pṛthak dvikuḍavaṃ kṣipet| pippalīnāṃ tavakṣīryā mākṣikasyānavasya ca||66|| leho'yaṃ gulmahṛdrogadurnāmaśvāsakāsajit| ----------------------------------------------|67|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śamanaṃ ca pibeddhūmaṃ śodhanaṃ bahale kaphe||67||
manaḥśilālamadhukamāṃsīmusteṅgudītvacaḥ| dhūmaṃ kāsaghnavidhinā pītvā kṣīraṃ pibedanu||68||
niṣṭhyūtānte guḍayutaṃ koṣṇaṃ dhūmo nihanti saḥ| vātaśleṣmottarān kāsānacireṇa cirantanān||69||
tamakaḥ kaphakāse tu syāccetpittānubandhajaḥ| pittakāsakriyāṃ tatra yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet||70||
kaphānubandhe pavane kuryātkaphaharāṃ kriyām| pittānubandhayorvātakaphayoḥ pittanāśinīm||71||
vātaśleṣmātmake śuṣke snigdhamārdre virukṣaṇam| kāse karma sapitte tu kaphaje tiktasaṃyutam||72||

div.ab: urasyantaḥkṣate sadyo lākṣāṃ kṣaudrayutāṃ pibet| kṣīreṇa--------------------------------------|73|
pārśvabastisarukcālpapittāgnistāṃ surāyutām| ----------------------------------------------|74|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| bhinnaviṭkaḥ samustātiviṣāpāṭhāṃ savatsakām||74||
lākṣāṃ sarpirmadhūcchiṣṭaṃ jīvanīyaṃ gaṇaṃ sitām| tvakkṣīrī samitaṃ kṣīre paktvā dīptānalaḥ pibet||75||
ikṣvārikābisagranthipadmakesaracandanaiḥ| śṛtaṃ payo madhuyutaṃ sandhānārthaṃ pibetkṣatī||76||
yavānāṃ cūrṇamāmānāṃ kṣīre siddhaṃ ghṛtānvitam| jvaradāhe sitākṣaudrasaktūnvā payasā pibet||77||
kāsavāṃstu pibetsarpirmadhurauṣadhasādhitam| guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ sakṣaudramaricaṃ hitam||78||
cūrṇamāmalakānāṃ vā kṣīre pakvaṃ ghṛtānvitam| rasāyanavidhānena pippalīrvā prayojayet||79||
kāsī parvāsthiśūlī ca lihyātsaghṛtamākṣikāḥ| madhūkamadhukadrākṣātvakkṣīripippalībalāḥ||80||
trijātamardhakarṣāṃśaṃ pippalyardhapalaṃ sitā| drākṣā madhūkaṃ kharjūraṃ palāṃśaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇitam||81||
madhunā guṭikā ghnanti tā vṛṣyāḥ pittaśoṇitam| kāsaśvāsārucicchardimūrcchāhidhmāmadabhramān||82||
kṣatakṣayasvarabhraṃśaplīhaśoṣāḍhyamārutān| raktaniṣṭhīvahṛtpārśvarukpipāsājvarānapi||83||

div.ab: varṣābhūśarkarāraktaśālitaṇḍulajaṃ rajaḥ| raktaṣṭhīvī pibetsiddhaṃ drākṣārasapayoghṛtaiḥ||84|| madhūkamadhukakṣīrasiddhaṃ vā taṇḍulīyakam| ----------------------------------------------|85|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| yathāsvaṃ mārgavisṛte rakte kuryācca bheṣajam||85||

div.ab: mūḍhavātastvajāmedaḥ surābhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam| ----------------------------------------------|86|
----------------------------------------------| kṣāmaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kṣatorasko mandanidro'gnidīptimān||86|| śṛtakṣīrasareṇādyātsaghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram| ----------------------------------------------|87|
----------------------------------------------| śarkarāyavagodhūmaṃ jīvakarṣabhakau madhu||87|| śṛtakṣīrānupānaṃ vā lihyātkṣīṇaḥ kṣataḥ kṛśaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|88|
----------------------------------------------| kravyātpiśitaniryūhaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ pibecca saḥ||88|| pipppalīkṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ māṃsaśoṇitavardhanam| ----------------------------------------------|89|

----------------------------------------------| nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaśālapriyaṅgubhiḥ||89|| tālamastakajambūtvakpriyālaiśca sapadmakaiḥ| sāśvakarṇaiḥ śṛtātkṣīrādadyājjātena sarpiṣā||90|| śālyodanaṃ kṣatoraskaḥ kṣīṇaśukrabalendriyaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|91|
----------------------------------------------| vātapittārdite'bhyaṅgo gātrabhede ghṛtairmataḥ||91|| tailaiścānilarogaghnaiḥ pīḍite mātariśvanā| ----------------------------------------------|92|
----------------------------------------------| hṛtpārśvārtiṣu pānaṃ syājjīvanīyasya sarpiṣaḥ|92|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| hṛtpārśvārtiṣu pānaṃ syājjīvanīyasya sarpiṣaḥ||92||

div.ab: ----------------------------------------------| yaṣṭyāhnanāgabalayoḥ kvāthe kṣīrasame ghṛtam||93|| payasyāpippalīvāṃśīkalkaiḥ siddhaṃ kṣate hitam| ----------------------------------------------|94|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ śuṇṭhī varī vīrā punarnavā||94||
balābhārṅgīsvaguptarddhiśaṭhītāmalakīkaṇāḥ| śṛṅgāṭakaṃ payasyā ca pañcamūlaṃ ca yallaghu||95||
drākṣākṣoḍādi ca phalaṃ madhurasnigdhabṛṃhaṇam| taiḥ pacetsarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ karṣāṃśaiḥ ślakṣṇakalkitaiḥ||96||
kṣīradhātrīvidārīkṣucchāgamāṃsarasānvitam| prasthārdhaṃ madhunaḥ śīte śarkarārdhatulārajaḥ||97||
palārdhakaṃ ca maricatvagelāpatrakesaram| vinīya cūrṇitaṃ tasmāllihyānmātrāṃ yathābalam||98||
amṛtaprāśamityetannarāṇāmamṛtaṃ ghṛtam| sudhāmṛtarasaṃ prāśyaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasāśinā||99||
naṣṭaśukrakṣatakṣīṇadurbalavyādhikarśitān| strīprasaktān kṛśān varṇasvarahīnāṃśca bṛṃhayet||100||
kāsahidhmājvaraśvāsadāhatṛṣṇāsripittanut| putradaṃ chardimūrcchāhṛdyonimūtrāmayāpaham||101||
śrvadaṃṣṭrośīramañjiṣṭhābalākāśmaryakattṛṇam| darbhamūlaṃ pṛthakparṇī palāśarṣabhakau sthirām||102||
pālikāni pacetteṣāṃ rase kṣīracaturguṇe| kalkaiḥ svaguptājīvantīmedarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ||103||
śatāvaryarddhimṛdvīkāśarkarāśrāvaṇībisaiḥ| prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtādvātapittahṛdrogaśūlanut||104||
mūtrakṛcchrapramehārśaḥkāsaśoṣakṣayāpahaḥ| dhanuḥstrīmadyabhārādhvakhinnānāṃ balamāṃsadaḥ||105||
madhukāṣṭapaladrākṣāprasthakvāthe paceddhṛtam| pippalyaṣṭapale kalke prasthaṃ siddhe ca śītale||106||
pṛthagaṣṭapalaṃ kṣaudraśarkarābhyāṃ vimiśrayet| samasaktu kṣatakṣīṇaraktagulmeṣu taddhitam||107||

div.ab: dhātrīphalavidārīkṣujīvanīyarasāddhṛtāt| gavyājayośca payasoḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ vipācayet||108|| siddhaśīte sitākṣaudraṃ dviprasthaṃ vinayettataḥ| yakṣmāpasmārapittāsṛkkāsamehakṣayāpaham||109|| vayaḥsthāpanamāyuṣyaṃ māṃsaśukrabalapradam| ----------------------------------------------|110|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| ghṛtaṃ tu pitte'bhyadhike lihyādvāte'dhike pibet||110||
līḍhaṃ nirvāpayetpittamalpatvāddhanti nānalam| ākrāmatyanilaṃ pītamūṣmāṇaṃ niruṇaddhi ca||111||
kṣāmakṣīṇakṛśāṅgānāmetānyeva ghṛtāni tu| tvakkṣīrīśarkarālājacūrṇaiḥ styānāni yojayet||112||
sarpirguḍān samadhvaṃśān kṛtvā dadyātpayo'nu ca| reto vīryaṃ balaṃ puṣṭiṃ tairāśutaramāpnuyāt||113||

div.ab: vītatvagasthikūṣmāṇḍatulāṃ svinnāṃ punaḥ pacet| ghaṭṭayan sarpiṣaḥ prasthe kṣaudravarṇe'tra ca kṣipet||114|| khaṇḍācchataṃ kaṇāśuṇṭhyordvipalaṃ jīrakādapi| trijātadhānyamaricaṃ pṛthagardhapalāṃśakam||115|| avatāritaśīte ca datvā kṣaudraṃ ghṛtārdhakam| khajenāmathya ca sthāpyaṃ tannihantyupayojitam||116|| kāsahidhmājvaraśvāsaraktapittakṣatakṣayān| uraḥsandhānajananaṃ medhāsmṛtibalapradam||117|| aśvibhyāṃ vihitaṃ hṛdyaṃ kūṣmāṇḍakarasāyanam| ----------------------------------------------|118|

----------------------------------------------| pibennāgabalāmūlasyārdhakarṣābhivardhitam||118|| palaṃ kṣīrayutaṃ māsaṃ kṣīravṛttiranannabhuk| eṣa prayogaḥ puṣṭyāyurbalavarṇakaraḥ param||119|| maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ kalpo'yaṃ yaṣṭyā viśvauṣadhasya ca| ----------------------------------------------|120|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pādaśeṣaṃ jaladroṇe pacennāgabalātulām||120||
tena kvāthena tulyāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ ca sādhayet| palārdhikaiścātibalābalāyaṣṭīpunarnavaiḥ||121||
prapauṇḍarīkakāśmaryapriyālakapikacchubhiḥ| aśvagandhāsitābhīrumedāyugmatrikaṇṭakaiḥ||122||
kākolīkṣīrakākolīkṣīraśuklādvijīrakaiḥ| mṛṇālabisakharjūraśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ||123||
etannāgabalāsarpiḥ pittaraktakṣatakṣayān| jayettṛḍbhramadāhāṃśca balapuṣṭikaraṃ param||124||
varṇyamāyuṣyamojasyaṃ valīpalitanāśanam| upayujya ca ṣaṇmāsān vṛddho'pi taruṇāyate||125||
----------------------------mande dīpanapācanaḥ| yakṣmoktaḥ kṣatināṃ śasto, grāhī śakṛti tu drave||126||
daśamūlaṃ svayaṃguptāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ śaṭhīṃ balām| hastipippalyapāmārgapippalīmūlacitrakān||127||
bhārṅgī puṣkaramūlaṃ ca dvipalāṃśaṃ yavāḍhakam| harītakīśataṃ caikaṃ jalapañcāḍhake pacet||128||
yavasvede kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtaṃ taccābhayāśatam| pacedguḍatulāṃ dattvā kuḍavaṃ ca pṛthagghṛtāt||129||
tailātsapippalīcūrṇātsiddhaśīte ca mākṣikāt| lehaṃ dve cābhaye nityamataḥ khādedrasāyanāt||130||
tadvalīpalitaṃ hanyādvarṇāyurbalavardhanam| pañcakāsān kṣayaṃ śvāsaṃ sahidhmaṃ viṣamajvaram||131||
mehagulmagrahaṇyarśohṛdrogārucipīnasān| agastyavihitaṃ dhanyamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rasāyanam||132||

div.ab: daśamūlaṃ balāṃ mūrvāṃ haridre pippalīdvayam| pāṭhāśvagandhāpāmārgasvaguptātiviṣāmṛtāḥ||133|| bālabilvaṃ trivṛddantīmūlaṃ patraṃ ca citrakāt| payasyāṃ kuṭajaṃ hiṃstrāṃ puṣpaṃ sāraṃ ca bījakāt||134|| boṭasthavirabhallātavikaṅkataśatāvarīḥ| pūtīkarañjaśamyākacandralekhāsahācaram||135|| saubhāñjanakanimbatvagikṣuraṃ ca palāṃśakam| pathyāsahasraṃ saśataṃ yavānāṃ cāḍhakadvayam||136|| pacedaṣṭaguṇe toye yavasvede'vatārayet| pūte kṣipetsapathye ca tatra jīrṇaguḍāttulām||137|| tailājyadhātrīrasataḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ tataḥ punaḥ| adhiśrayenmṛdāvagnau darvīlepe'vatārya ca||138|| śīte prasthadvayaṃ kṣaudrātpippalīkuḍavaṃ kṣipet| cūrṇīkṛtaṃ trijātācca tripalaṃ nikhanettataḥ||139|| dhānye purāṇakumbhasthaṃ māsaṃ khādecca pūrvavat| rasāyanaṃ vasiṣṭhoktametatpūrvaguṇādhikam||140|| svasthānāṃ niṣparīhāraṃ sarvartuṣu ca śasyate| ----------------------------------------------|141|

----------------------------------------------| pālikaṃ saindhavaṃ śuṇṭhī dve ca sauvarcalātpale||141|| kuḍavāṃśāni vṛkṣāmlaṃ dāḍimaṃ patramārjakāt| ekaikāṃ maricājātyordhānyakād dve caturthike||142|| śarkarāyāḥ palānyatra daśa dve ca pradāyayet| kṛtvā cūrṇamato mātrāmannapāneṣu dāpayet||143|| rucyaṃ taddīpanaṃ balyaṃ pārśvārtīśvāsakāsajit| ----------------------------------------------|144|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------| ekāṃ ṣoḍaśikāṃ dhānyād dve dve cājājidīpyakāt||144||
tābhyāṃ dāḍimavṛkṣāmle dvirdviḥ saurvacalātpalam| śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ dadhitthasya madhyātpañca palāni ca||145||
taccūrṇaṃ ṣoḍaśapalaiḥ śarkarāyā vimiśrayet| ṣāḍavo'yaṃ pradeyaḥ syādannapāneṣu pūrvavat||146||

div.ab: vidhiśca yakṣmavihito yathāvasthaṃ kṣate hitaḥ| ----------------------------------------|147|
----------------------------------------| nivṛtte kṣatadoṣe tu kaphe vṛddhe uraḥ śiraḥ||147|| dālyate kāsino yasya sa nā dhūmān pibedimān| ----------------------------------------|148|
------------------------------------------------| dvimedādvibalāyaṣṭikalkaiḥ kṣaume subhāvite||148|| varti kṛtvā pibeddhūmaṃ jīvanīyaghṛtānupaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|149|

------------------------------------------------| manaḥśilāpalāśājagandhātvakkṣīrināgaraiḥ||149|| tadvadevānupānaṃ tu śarkarekṣuguḍodakam| piṣṭvā manaḥśilāṃ tulyāmārdrayā vaṭaśuṅgayā||150|| sasarpiṣkaṃ pibeddhūmaṃ tittiripratibhojanam| ------------------------------------------------|151|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| kṣayaje bṛṃhaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kuryādagneśca vardhanam||151||
bahudoṣāya sasnehaṃ mṛdu dadyādvirecanam||1||
tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa vidārīsvarasena ca| sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibedyuktyā kṣīṇadeho viśodhanam||153||
pitte kaphe dhātuṣu ca kṣīṇeṣu kṣayakāsavān| ghṛtaṃ karkaṭakīkṣīradvibalāsādhitaṃ pibet||154||

div.ab: vidārībhiḥ kadambairvā tālasasyaiśca sādhitam| ghṛtaṃ payaśca-----------------------------|155|

ab.seg: śūne savedane meḍhre pāyau saśroṇivaṅkṣaṇe| ghṛtamaṇḍena laghunā'nuvāsyo miśrikeṇa vā||156||
jāṅgalaiḥ pratibhuktasya vartakādyā bileśayāḥ| kramaśaḥ prasahāstadvatprayojyāḥ piśitāśinaḥ||157||
auṣṇyātpramāthibhāvācca srotobhyaścyāvayanti te| kaphaṃ śuddhaiśca taiḥ puṣṭiṃ kuryātsamyag vahan rasaḥ||158||
cavikātriphalābhārgīdaśamūlaiḥ sacitrakaiḥ| kulatthapippalīmūlapāṭhākolayavairjale||159||
śṛtairnāgaraduḥsparśāpippalīśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ| piṣṭaiḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgyā ca samaiḥ sarpirvipācayet||160||
siddhe'smiṃścūrṇitau kṣārau dvau pañca lavaṇāni ca| dattvā yuktyā pibenmātrāṃ kṣayakāsanipīḍitaḥ||161||
kāsamardābhayāmustāpāṭhākaṭphalanāgaraiḥ| pippalyā kaṭurohiṇyā kāśmaryā surasena ca||162||
akṣamātrairghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīradrākṣārasāḍhake| pacecchhośajvaraplīhasarvakāsaharaṃ śivam||163||
vṛṣavyāghrīguḍūcīnāṃ patramūlaphalāṅkurāt| rasakalkairghṛta pakvaṃ hanti kāsajvarārucīḥ||164||

div.ab: dviguṇe dāḍimarase siddhaṃ vā vyoṣasaṃyutam| pibedupari bhuktasya yavakṣārrayutaṃ naraḥ||165|| pippalīguḍasiddhaṃ vā chāgakṣīrayutaṃ ghṛtam| -----------------------------------------------------|166|

------------------------------------------------| etānyagnivivṛddhyarthaṃ sarpiṣi kṣayakāsinām||166|| syurdoṣabaddhakaṇṭhoraḥsrotasāṃ ca viśuddhaye| ------------------------------------------------|167|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| prasthonmite yavakvāthe viṃśati vijayāḥ pacet||167||
svinnā mṛditvā tāstasminpurāṇātṣaṭpalaṃ guḍāt| pippalyā dvipalaṃ karṣaṃ manohvāyā rasāñjanāt||138||
dattvā'rdhākṣaṃ pacedbhūyaḥ sa lehaḥ śvāsakāsajit| ------------------------------------------------||139||
------------------------------------------------| śvāvidhāṃ sūcayo dagdhāḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkarāḥ||169||
śvāsakāsaharā, barhipādau vā madhusarpiṣā| eraṇḍapatrakṣāraṃ vā vyoṣatailaguḍanvitam||170||
lehayet, kṣāramevaṃ vā surasairaṇḍapatrajam| lihyāt tryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ vā purāṇaguḍasarpiṣā||171||
padmakaṃ tripalā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca| balā rāsnā ca taccūrṇaṃ samastaṃ samaśarkaram||172||
khādenmadhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyātkāsaharaṃ param| tadvanmaricacūrṇaṃ vā saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram||173||
pathyāśuṇṭhīghanaguḍairguṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe| sarveṣu śvāsakāseṣu, kevalaṃ vā bibhītakam||174||
patrakalkaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ tilvakasya saśarkaram| peyā votkārikā charditṛṭkāsāmātisārajit||175||
kaṇṭakārīrase siddho mudgayūṣaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ| sagaurāmalakaḥ sāmlaḥ sarvakāsabhiṣagjitam||176||
vātaghnauṣadhaniḥkvāthe kṣīraṃ yūṣān rasānapi| vaiṣkirān prātudān bailān dāpayetkṣayakāsine||177||
kṣatakāse ca ye dhūmāḥ sānupānā nidarśitāḥ| kṣayakāse'pi te yojyā vakṣyate yacca yakṣmaṇi||178||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ cāgneḥ srotasāṃ ca viśodhanam| vyatyāsātkṣayakāsibhyo balyaṃ sarvaṃ praśasyate||179||

div.ab: sannipātodbhavo ghoraḥ kṣayakāso yatastataḥ| yathādoṣabalaṃ tasya sannipātahitaṃ hitam|180| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita- sthāne kāsacikitsitaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|3|

div.head: śvāsahidhmācikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ śvāsahidhmācikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| śvāsahidhmā yatastulyahetvādyāḥ, sādhanaṃ tataḥ| tulyameva----------------------------------|1|

kimevaṃ sati syāt ? ityāha---------------------- ------------------taiḥ kheṣu grathitaḥ kaphaḥ| sulīno'pi vilīno'sya koṣṭhaṃ prāptaḥ sunirharaḥ||2|| srotasāṃ syānmṛdutvaṃ ca marutaścānulomatā| ------------------------------------------------|3|

------------------------------------------------| svinnaṃ ca bhojayedannaṃ snigdhamānūpajai rasaiḥ||3|| dadhyuttareṇa vā, dadyāttato'smai vamanaṃ mṛdu| viśeṣātkāsavamathuhṛdgrahasvarasādine||4|| pippalīsaindhavakṣaudrayuktaṃ vātāvirodhi yat| ------------------------------------------------|5|
------------------------------------------------| nirhṛte sukhamāpnpoti sa kaphe duṣṭavigrahe||5|| srotaḥsu ca viśuddheṣu caratyavihato'nilaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| dhmānodāvartatamake mātuluṅgāmlavetasaiḥ||6||
hiṅgupīlubiḍairyuktamannaṃ syādanulomanam| sasaindhavaṃ phālāmlaṃ vā koṣṇaṃ dadyādvirecanam||7||
srotaḥśuddhyarthaṃ kimevaṃ kriyate ? ityāha-------------- ete hi kaphasaṃruddhagatiprāṇaprakopajāḥ| tasmāttanmārgaśuddhyarthamūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ hitam||8||
udīryate bhṛśataraṃ mārgarodhādvahajjalam| yathā tathā'nilastasya mārgamasmādviśodhayet||9||

div.ab: aśāntau kṛtasaṃśuddherdhūmairlīnaṃ malaṃ haret| ------------------------------------------------|10|

------------------------------------------------| haridrāpatrameraṇḍamūlaṃ lākṣāṃ manaḥśilām||10|| sadevadārvalaṃ māṃsīṃ piṣṭvā vartiṃ prakalpayet| tāṃ ghṛtāktāṃ pibeddhūmaṃ yavān vā ghṛtasaṃyutān||11|| madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sarjarasaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā guru vā'guru| candanaṃ vā tathā śṛṅgaṃ vālānvā snāva vā gavām||12|| ṛkṣagodhakuraṅgaiṇacarmaśṛṅgakhurāṇi vā| gugguluṃ vā manohvāṃ vā śāliniryāsameva vā||13|| śallakīṃ gugguluṃ lohaṃ padmakaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam| ------------------------------------------------|14|

------------------------------------------------| avaśyaṃ svedanīyānāmasvedyānāmapi kṣaṇam||14|| svedayetsasitākṣīrasukhoṣṇasnehasecanaiḥ| utkārikopanāhaiśca svedādhyāyoktabheṣajaiḥ||15|| uraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ ca mṛdubhiḥ----------------------| ------------------------------------------------|16|

------------------------------------------------| atiyogoddhataṃ vātaṃ dṛṣṭvā pavananāśanaiḥ||16|| snigdhai rasādyairnātyuṣṇairabhyaṅgaiśca śamaṃ nayet| ------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| anutkliṣṭakaphāsvinnadurbalānāṃ hi śodhanāt||17||
vāyurlabdhāspado marma saṃśoṣyāśu haredasūn| kaṣāyalehasnehādyaisteṣāṃ saṃśamayedataḥ||18||
kṣīṇakṣatātisārāsṛkpittadāhānubandhajān| madhurasnigdhaśītādyairhidhmāśvāsānupācaret||19||

div.ab: kulatthadaśamūlānāṃ kvāthe syurjāṅagalā rasāḥ| yūṣāśca----------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: pallavairnimbakulakabṛhatīmātuluṅgajaiḥ| vyāghrīdurālabhāśṛṅgībilvamadhyatrikaṇṭakaiḥ||21||
sāmṛtāgnikulatthaiśca yūṣaḥ syātkvathitairjale| tadvadrāsnābṛhatyādibalāmudgaiḥ sacitrakaiḥ||22||
peyā ca citrakājājīśṛṅgīsauvarcalaiḥ kṛtā| daśamūlena vā kāsaśvāsahidhmārujāpahā||23||

div.ab: daśamūlaśaṭhīrāsnābhārgībilvarddhipauṣkaraiḥ| kulīraśṛṅgīcapalātāmalakyamṛtauṣadhaiḥ||24|| pibetkaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe'smin peyāṃ taireva sādhitām| ------------------------------------------------|25|
------------------------------------------------| śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavamudgakulatthabhuk||25|| kāsahṛdgrahapārśvārtihidhmāśvāsapraśāntaye| ------------------------------------------------|26|
------------------------------------------------| saktūn vā'rkāṅkurakṣīrabhāvitānāṃ samākṣikān||26|| yavānāṃ daśamūlādiniṣkvāthalulitān pibet| ------------------------------------------------|27|
-----------------------------------------------| anne ca yojayet kṣārahiṅgvājyabiḍadāḍimān||27|| sapauṣkaraśaṭhīvyoṣamātuluṅgāmlavetasān| -----------------------------------------------|28|
------------------------------------------------| daśamūlasya vā kvāthamathavā devadāruṇaḥ||28|| pibedvā vāruṇīmaṇḍaṃ hidhmāśvāsī pipāsitaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| pippalīpippalīmūlapathyājantughnacitrakaiḥ||29||
kalkitairlepite rūḍhe niḥkṣipeddhṛtabhājane| takraṃ māsasthitaṃ taddhi dīpanaṃ śvāsakāsajit||30||
pāṭhāṃ madhurasāṃ dāru saralaṃ ca niśi sthitam| surāmaṇḍe'lpalavaṇaṃ pibetprasṛtasammitam||31||
bhārgīśuṇṭhyo sukhāmbhobhiḥ kṣāraṃ vā maricānvitam svakvāthapiṣṭāṃ lulitāṃ bāṣpikāṃ pāyayeta vā||32||
svarasaḥ saptaparṇasya puṣpāṇāṃ vā śiśīṣataḥ| hidhmāśvāse madhukaṇāyuktaḥ pittakaphānuge||33||
utkārikā tugākṛṣṇāmadhūlīghṛtanāgaraiḥ| pittānubandhe yoktavyā, pavane tvanubandhini||34||
śvāvicchaśāmiṣakaṇāghṛtaśalyakaśoṇītaiḥ| suvarcalārasavyoṣasarpirbhiḥ sahitaṃ payaḥ||35||
anu śālyodanaṃ peyaṃ vātapittānubandhini| caturguṇāmbusiddhaṃ vā chāgaṃ saguḍanāgaram||36||
pippalīmūlamadhukaguḍagośvaśakṛdrasān| hidhmābhiṣyandakāsaghnān lihyānmadhughṛtānvitān||37||

div.ab: gogajāśvavarāhoṣṭrakharameṣājaviḍrasam| samadhvekaikaśo lihyādbahuśleṣmā'thavā pibet||38|| catuṣpāccarmaromāsthikhuraśṛṅgodbhavāṃ maṣīm| tathaiva vājigandhāyā lihyācchvāsī kapholbaṇaḥ||39|| śaṭhīpauṣkaradhātrīrvā pauṣkaraṃ vā kaṇānvitam| gairikāñjanakṛṣṇā vā svarasaṃ vā kapitthajam||40|| rasena vā kapitthasya dhātrīsaindhavapippalīḥ| ghṛtakṣaudreṇa vā pathyāviḍaṅgoṣaṇapippalīḥ||41|| kolalājāmaladrākṣāpippalīnāgarāṇi vā| guḍatailaniśādrākṣākaṇārāsnoṣaṇāni vā||42|| pibedrasāmbumadyāmlairlehauṣadharajāṃsi vā| ------------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| jīvantīmustasurasatvagelādvayapauṣkaram||43||
caṇḍātāmalakīlohabhārgīnāgaravālakam| karkaṭākhyāśaṭhīkṛṣṇānāgakesaracorakam||44||
upayuktaṃ yathākāmaṃ cūrṇaṃ dviguṇaśarkaram| pārśvarugjvarakāsaghnaṃ hidhmāśvāsaharaṃ param||45||
śaṭhītāmalakībhārṅgīcaṇḍāvālakapauṣkaram| śarkarāṣṭaguṇaṃ cūrṇaṃ hidhmāśvāsaharaṃ param||46||

div.ab: tulyaṃ guḍaṃ nāgaraṃ ca bhakṣyennāvayeta vā| ------------------------------------------------|47|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| laśunasya palāṇḍorvā mūlaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā||47||
candanādvā rasaṃ dadyānnārīkṣīreṇa nāvanam| stanyena makṣikāviṣṭhāmalaktakarasena vā||48||
sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtācchaṃ vā, siddhaṃ stanyena vā ghṛtam| kalkitairmadhuradravyaistatpibennāvayeta vā||49||
sakṛduṣṇaṃ sakṛcchītaṃ vyatyāsāt sasitāmadhu| tadvatpayastathā siddhamadhobhāgauṣadhairghṛtam||50||

div.ab: kaṇāsauvarcalakṣāravayasthāhiṅgucorakaiḥ| sakāyasthairghṛtaṃ mastudaśamūlarase pacet||51|| tatpibejjīvanīyairvā lihyātsamadhu sādhitam| ------------------------------------------------|52|

------------------------------------------------| tejovatyabhayā kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī kaṭurohiṇī||52|| bhūtīkaṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ palāśaścitrakaḥ śaṭhī| paṭudvayaṃ tāmalakī jīvantī bilvapeśikā||53|| vacā patraṃ ca tālīsaṃ karṣāṃśaistairvipācayet| hiṅgupādairghṛtaprasthaṃ pītamāśu nihanti tat||54|| śākhānilārśograhaṇīhidhmāhṛtpārśvavedanāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|55|
------------------------------------------------| ardhāṃśena pibetsarpiḥ kṣāreṇa paṭunā'thavā||55|| dhānvantaraṃ vṛṣaghṛtaṃ dādhikaṃ hapuṣādi vā| ------------------------------------------------|56|
------------------------------------------------| śītāmbusekaḥ sahasā trāsavikṣepabhīśucaḥ||56|| harṣerṣyocchvāsarodhāśca hitaṃ kīṭaiśca daṃśanam| ------------------------------------------------|57|

evaṃ hidhmāśvāsānāṃ viśeṣeṇa cikitsāmuktvā sāmānyenāha--------- yatkiñcitkaphavātaghnamuṣṇaṃ vātānulomanam||57|| tatsevyaṃ prāyaśo yacca sutarāṃ mārutāpaham| ------------------------------------------------|59|

ab.seg: kimityevaṃ kriyate ? ityāha- ------------------------------------------------| sarveṣāṃ bṛṃhaṇe hyalpaḥ śakyaśca prāyaśo bhavet||58||
nātyarthaṃ śamane'pāyo bhṛśo'śakyaśca karṣaṇe| śamanairbṛṃhaṇaiścāto bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tānupācaret||59||

div.ab: adhunā kāsādīnāṃ pañcānāmapyeṣāṃ sāmānyena cikitsitaṃ vaktumāha-------- kāsaśvāsakṣayacchardihidhmāścānyonyabheṣajaiḥ| 59 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvāsahidhmācikitsitaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|4|

div.head: rājayakṣmādicikitsitādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto rājayakṣmādicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) balino bahudoṣasya snigdhasvinnasya śodhanam| ūrdhvādho yakṣmiṇaḥ kuryātsasnehaṃ yanna karśanam||1||

div.ab: tatra vamanamāha----------------------- payasā phalayuktena madhureṇa rasena vā| sarpiṣmatyā yavāgvā vā vamanadravyasiddhayā||2|| vamet-----------------------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|3|
----------virecanaṃ dadyātrivṛcchyāmānṛpadrumān| śarkarāmadhusarpirbhiḥ payasā tarpaṇena vā||3|| drākṣāvidārīkāśmaryamāṃsānāṃ vā rasairyutān| ------------------------------------------------|4|
------------------------------------------------| śuddhakoṣṭhasya yuñjīta vidhiṃ bṛṃhaṇadīpanam||4|| hṛdyāni cānnapānāni vātaghnāni laghūni ca| ------------------------------------------------|5|

tathā cāha----------------- ------------------------------------------------| śāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavamudgaṃ samoṣitam||5|| |laghuma(cā)cyutavīryaṃ ca sujaraṃ balakṛcca yat| ] ājaṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ kravyānmāṃsaṃ ca śoṣajit| ------------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: kākolūkavṛkadvīpigavāśvanakuloragam||6||
gṛdhrābhāsakharoṣṭraṃ ca hitaṃ chadmopasaṃhitam| jñātaṃ jugupsitaṃ taddhi chardiṣe na balaujase||7||

div.ab: mṛgādyāḥ pittakaphayoḥ pavane prasahādayaḥ| vesavārīkṛtāḥ pathyā rasādiṣu ca kalpitāḥ||8|| bhṛṣṭāḥ sarpaṣatailena sarpiṣā vā yathāyatham| rasikā mṛdavaḥ snigdhāḥ paṭudravyābhisaṃskṛtāḥ||9|| hitā maulakakaulatthāstadvadyūṣāśca sādhitāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| sapippalīkaṃ sayavaṃ sakulatthaṃ sanāgaram||10||
sadāḍimaṃ sāmalakaṃ snigdhamājaṃ rasaṃ pibet| tena ṣaḍvinivartante vikārāḥ pīnasādayaḥ||11||

div.ab: pibecca sutarāṃ madyaṃ jīrṇaṃ srotoviśodhanam| pittādiṣu viśeṣeṇa madhvariṣṭācchavāruṇīḥ||12|| siddhaṃ vā pañcamūlena tāmalakyā'thavā jalam| parṇinībhiścatasṛbhirdhānyanāgarakeṇa vā||13|| kalpayeccānukūlo'sya tenānnaṃ śuci yatnavān| ------------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: balāgarbhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yojyaṃ kravyānmāṃsarasena vā| sakṣaudraṃ payasā siddhaṃ sarpirdaśaguṇena vā||15||
jīvantīṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ phalāni kuṭajasya ca| puṣkarāhvaṃ śaṭhīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vyāghrīṃ gokṣurakaṃ balām||16||
nīlotpalaṃ tāmalakīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ durālabhām| kalkīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ rogarājaharaṃ param||17||
ghṛtaṃ kharjūramṛdvīkāmadhukaiḥ saparūṣakaiḥ| sapippalīkaṃ vaisvaryakāsaśvāsajvarāpaham||18||
daśamūlaśṛtātkṣīrātsarpiryadudiyānnavam| sapippalīkaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tatparaṃ svarabodhanam||19||
śiraḥpārśvāṃsaśūlaghnaṃ kāsaśvāsajvarāpaham| pañcabhiḥ pañcamūlairvā śṛtādyadudiyāddhṛtam||20||
pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ rase kṣīracaturguṇe| siddhaṃ sarpirjayatyetadyakṣmaṇaḥ saptakaṃ balam||21||
pañcakolayavakṣāraṣaṭpalena paceddhṛtam| prasthonmitaṃ tulyapayaḥ srotasāṃ tadviśodhanam||22||
gulmajvarodaraplīhagrahaṇīpāṇḍupīnasān| śvāsakāsāgnisadanaśvayathūrdhvānilañjayet||23||
rāsnābalāgokṣurakasthirāvarṣābhuvāriṇi| jīvantīpippalīgarbhaṃ sakṣīraṃ śoṣajiddhṛtam||24||

div.ab: aśvagandhāśṛtātkṣīrāddhṛtaṃ ca sasitāpayaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| sādhāraṇāmiṣatulāṃ toyadroṇadvaye pacet||25||
tenāṣṭabhāgaśeṣeṇa jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ| sādhayetsarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ vātapittāmayāpaham||26||
māṃsasarpiridaṃ pītaṃ yuktaṃ māṃsarasena vā| kāsaśvāsasvarabhraṃśaśoṣahṛtpārśvaśūlajit||27||
elājamodātriphalāsaurāṣṭrīvyoṣacitrakān| sārānariṣṭagāyatrīśālabījakasambhavān||28||
bhallātakaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca pṛthagaṣṭapalonmitam| salile ṣoḍaśaguṇe ṣoḍaśāṃśasthitaṃ pacet||29||
punastena ghṛtaprasthaṃ siddhe cāsminpalāni ṣaṭ| tavakṣīryāḥ kṣipotrniṃśatsitāyā dviguṇaṃ madhu||30||
ghṛtātrnijātātrnipalaṃ tato līḍhaṃ khajāhatam| payonupānaṃ tatprāhṇe rasāyanamayantraṇam||31||
medhyaṃ cakṣuṣyamāyuṣyaṃ dīpanaṃ hanti cācirāt| mehagulmakṣayavyādhipāṇḍurogabhagandarān||32||

div.ab: ye ca sarpirguḍāḥ proktāḥ kṣate yojyāḥ kṣaye'pi te| ------------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| tvagelāpippalīkṣīrīśarkarā dviguṇāḥ kramāt||33||
cūrṇitā bhakṣitāḥ kṣaudrasarpiṣā vā'valehitāḥ| svaryāḥ kāsakṣayaśvāsapārśvarukkaphanāśanāḥ||34||

div.ab: atha svarasādacikitsitam| viśeṣātsvarasāde'sya nasyadhūmādi yojayet| ------------------------------------------------|35|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| tatrāpi vātaje koṣṇaṃ pibedauttarabhaktikam||35||
kāsamardakavārtākīmārkavasvarasairghrutam| sādhitaṃ kāsajitsvaryaṃ siddhamārtagalena vā||36||

div.ab: badarīpatrakalkaṃ vā ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sasaindhavam| ------------------------------------------------|37|
tailaṃ vā- -----------------------------------------------| madhukadrākṣāpippalīkṛminutphalaiḥ||37|| haṃsapādyāśca mūlena pakvaṃ nasto niṣecayet| ------------------------------------------------|38|

------------------------------------------------| sukhodakānupānaṃ ca sasarpiṣkaṃ guḍaudanam||38|| aśrnīyātpāyasaṃ caivaṃ snigdhaṃ svedaṃ niyojayet| ------------------------------------------------|39|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| pittodbhave pibetsarpiḥ śṛtaśītapayonupaḥ||39||
kṣīrivṛkṣāṅkurakvāthakalkasiddhaṃ samākṣikam| aśnīyācca sasarpiṣkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasam||40||
balāvidārigandhābhyāṃ vidāryā madhukena ca| siddhaṃ salavaṇaṃ sarpirnasyaṃ svaryamanuttamam||41||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī bṛhatī balā| sādhitaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca tatsvaryaṃ nāvanaṃ param||42||

div.ab: lihyānmadhurakāṇāṃ ca cūrṇaṃ madhughṛtāplutam| ------------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| pibetkaṭūni mūtreṇa kaphaje rūkṣabhojanaḥ||43||
kaṭūphalāmalakavyoṣaṃ lihyāttailamadhuplutam| vyoṣakṣārāgnicavikābhārgīpathyāmadhūni vā||44||
yavairyavāgūṃ yamake kaṇādhātrīkṛtāṃ pibet| bhuktvā'dyātpippalīṃ śuṇṭhīṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vā vamanaṃ bhajet||2||

div.ab: śarkarākṣaudramiśrāṇi śṛtāni madhuraiḥ saha| pibetpayāṃsi yasyoccairvadato'bhihataḥ svaraḥ||46|| iti svarasādacikitsitam|47|

ab.seg: athārocakacikitsitam| vicitramannamarucau hitairupahitaṃ hitam| bahirantarmṛjā cittanirvāṇaṃ hṛdyamauṣadham||47||
dvau kālau dantapavanaṃ bhakṣayenmukhadhāvanaiḥ| kaṣāyaiḥ kṣālayedāsyaṃ dhūmaṃ prāyogikaṃ pibet||48||
tālīsacūrṇavaṭakāḥ sakarpūrasitopalāḥ| śaśāṅkakiraṇākhyāśca bhakṣyā rucikarāḥ param||49||

div.ab: sāmānyenārucau cikitsitānyuktvā viśeṣamāha------------------ vātādarocake tatra pibeccūrṇaṃ prasannayā| hareṇukṛṣṇākṛmijiddrākṣāsaindhavanāgarāt||50|| elābhārgīyavakṣārahiṅguyuktāddhṛtena vā| chardayedvā vacāmbhobhiḥ------------------------|51|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kaphādvamennimbajalairdīpyakāragvadhodakam||52||
pānaṃ samadhvariṣṭāśca tīkṣṇāḥ samadhumādhavāḥ| pibeccūrṇaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ hareṇvādyuṣṇavāriṇā||53||

div.ab: elātvaṅnāgakusumatīkṣṇakṛṣṇāmahauṣadham| bhāgavṛddhaṃ kramāccūrṇaṃ nihanti samaśarkaram||54|| prasekārucihṛtpārśvakāsaśvāsagalāmayān| ---------------------------------------------|55|

---------------------------------------------| yavānītittiḍīkāmlavetasauṣadhadāḍimam||55|| kṛtvā kolaṃ ca karṣāśaṃ sitāyāśca catuṣpalam| dhānyasauvarcalājājīvarāṅgaṃ cārdhakārṣikam||56|| pippalīnāṃ śataṃ caikaṃ dve śate maricasya ca| cūrṇametatparaṃ rucyaṃ hṛdyaṃ grāhi, hinasti ca||57|| vibandhakāsahṛtpārśvaplīhārśograhaṇīgadān| ---------------------------------------------|58|

---------------------------------------------| tālīsapatraṃ maricaṃ nāgaraṃ pippalī śubhā||58|| yathottaraṃ bhāgavṛddhyā tvagele cārdhabhāgike| tadrucyaṃ dīpanaṃ cūrṇaṃ kaṇāṣṭaguṇaśarkaram||59|| kāsaśvāsārucicchardiplīhahṛtpārśvaśūlanut| pāṇḍujvarātisāraghnaṃ mūḍhavātānulomanam||60|| ityarocakacikitsitam|61|

ab.seg: arkāmṛtākṣārajale śarvarīmuṣitairyavaiḥ| praseke kalpitānsaktūn bhakṣyāṃścādyādvalī vamet||61||
kaṭutiktaistathā śūlyaṃ bhakṣyejjāṅgalaṃ palam| śuṣkāṃśca bhakṣyān sulaghūṃścaṇakādirasānupaḥ||62||
śleṣmaṇo'tiprasekena vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇamasyati| kaphaprasekaṃ taṃ vidvānsnigdhoṣṇaireva nirjayet||63||

div.ab: pīnase'pi kramamimaṃ vamathau ca prayojayet| ---------------------------------------------|64|

ab.seg: viśeṣātpīnase'bhyaṅgān snehān svedāṃśca śīlayet||64||
snigdhānutkārikāpiṇḍaiḥ śiraḥpārśvagalādiṣu| lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇāṃśca rasān snehopasaṃhitān||65||

div.ab: śiroṃsapārśvaśūleṣu yathādoṣavidhiṃ caret| audakānūpapiśitairupanāhāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ||66|| tatreṣṭāḥ sacatuḥsnehāḥ----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|67|

ab.seg: ----------------------------doṣasaṃsarga iṣyate| pralepo natayaṣṭyāhvaśatāhvākuṣṭhacandanaiḥ||67||
balārāsnātilaistadvatsasarpirmadhukotpalaiḥ| punarnavākṛṣṇagandhābalāvīrāvidāribhiḥ||68||
nāvanaṃ dhūmapānāni snehāścauttarabhaktikāḥ| tailānyabhyaṅgayogīni bastikarma tathā param||69||

div.ab: śṛṅgādyairvā yathādoṣaṃ duṣṭameṣāṃ haredasṛk| pradehaḥ saghṛtaiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ padmakośīracandanaiḥ||70|| dūrvāmadhukamañjiṣṭhākesarairvā ghṛtāplutaiḥ| vaṭādisiddhatailena śatadhautena sarpiṣā||71|| abhyaṅgaḥ payasā sekaḥ śastaśca madhukāmbunā| ---------------------------------------------|72|
---------------------------------------------| prāyeṇopahatāgnitvātsapicchamatisāryate||72|| tasyātisāragrahaṇīvihitaṃ hitamauṣadham| ---------------------------------------------|73|
---------------------------------------------| purīṣaṃ yatnato rakṣecchuṣyato rājayakṣmiṇaḥ||73|| sarvadhātukṣayārtasya balaṃ tasya hi viḍbalam| ---------------------------------------------|74|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| māṃsamevāśnato yuktyā mārdvīkaṃ pibato'nu ca||74||
avidhāritavegasya yakṣmā na labhate'ntaram| surāṃ samaṇḍāṃ mārdvīkamariṣṭānsīdhumādhavān||75||
yathārhamanupānārthaṃ pibenmāṃsāni bhakṣayan| srotovibandhamokṣārtha balaujaḥpuṣṭaye ca tat||76||

div.ab: snehakṣīrāmbukoṣṭheṣu svabhyaktamavagāhayet| uttīrṇaṃ miśrakaiḥ snehairbhūyo'bhyaktaṃ sukhaiḥ karaiḥ||77|| mṛdgīyātsukhamāsīnaṃ sukhaṃ codvartayetparam| ---------------------------------------------|78|

---------------------------------------------| jīvantīṃ śatavīryāṃ ca vikasāṃ sapunarnavām||78|| aśvagandhāmapāmārgaṃ tarkārīṃ madhukaṃ balām| vidārīṃ sarṣapān kuṣṭhaṃ taṇḍulānatasīphalam||79|| māṣāṃstilāṃśca kiṇvaṃ ca sarvamekatra cūrṇayet| yavacūrṇaṃ triguṇitaṃ dadhnā yuktaṃ samākṣikam||80|| etadudvartanaṃ kāryaṃ puṣṭivarṇabalapradam| ---------------------------------------------|81|
------------------------------------------------| gaurasarṣapakalkena snānīyauṣadhibhiśca saḥ||81|| snāyādṛtusukhaistoyairjīvanīyopasādhitaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|82|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| gandhamālyādikāṃ bhūṣāmalakṣmīnāśanīṃ bhajet||82||

div.ab: suhṛdāṃ darśanaṃ gītavāditrotsavasaṃśrutiḥ| bastayaḥ kṣīrasarpīṣi madyamāṃsasuśīlatā|83| daivavyapāśrayaṃ tattadatharvoktaṃ ca pūjitam| 83 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne rājayakṣmādicikitsitaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|5|

div.head: cardihṛdrogatṛṣṇācikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāta-chardihṛdrogatṛṣṇācikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhuratreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) āmāśayotkleśabhavāḥ prāyaścchardyo hitaṃ tataḥ| laṅghanaṃ prāgṛte vāyorvamanaṃ tatra yojayet||1|| balino bahudoṣasya vamataḥ pratataṃ bahu| ---------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tato virekaṃ kramaśo hṛdyaṃ madyaiḥ phalāmbubhiḥ||2||
kṣīrairvā saha sa hyūrdhvaṃ gataṃ doṣaṃ nayatyadhaḥ| śamanaṃ cauṣadhaṃ rūkṣadurbalasya tadeva tu||3||
pariśuṣkaṃ priyaṃ sātmyamannaṃ laghu ca śasyate| upavāsastathā yūṣā rasāḥ kāmbalikāḥ khalāḥ||4||
śākāni lehā bhojyāni rāgaṣāḍavapānakāḥ| bhakṣyāḥ śuṣkā vicitrāśca phalāni snānagharṣaṇam||5||
gandhāḥ_ sugandhayo gandhaphalapuṣpānnapānajāḥ| bhuktamātrasya sahasā mukhe śītāmbusecanam||6||

div.ab: adhunā viśeṣeṇāha-------------------------- hanti mārutajāṃ chardiṃ sarpiḥ pītaṃ sasaindhavam| kiñciduṣṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa sakāsahṛdayadravām||7|| vyoṣatrilavaṇāḍhyaṃ vā siddhaṃ vā dāḍimāmbunā| saśuṇṭhīdadhidhānyena śṛtaṃ tulyāmbu vā payaḥ||8|| vyaktasaindhavasarpirvā phalāmlo vaiṣkiro rasaḥ| snigdhaṃ ca bhojanaṃ śuṇṭhīdadhidāḍimasādhitam||9|| koṣṇaṃ salavaṇaṃ cātra hitaṃ snehavirecanam| ---------------------------------------------|10|

---------------------------------------------| pittajāyāṃ virekārthaṃ drākṣekṣusvarasaistrivṛt||10|| sarpirvā tailvakaṃ yojyaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca śleṣmadhāmagam| ūrdhvameva haret pittaṃ svādutiktairviśuddhimān||11|| pibenmanthaṃ yavāgūṃ vā lājaiḥ samadhuśarkarām| mudgajāṅgalajairadyādvyañjanaiḥ śāliṣaṣṭikam||12|| mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭaprabhavaṃ suśītaṃ salilaṃ pibet| mudgośīrakaṇādhānyaiḥ saha vā saṃsthitaṃ niśām||13|| drākṣārasaṃ rasaṃ vekṣorguḍūcyambu payo'pi vā| jambvāmrapallavośīravaṭaśuṅgāvarohajaḥ||14|| kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ pītaḥ śīto vā viniyacchati| chardiṃ jvaramatīsāraṃ mūrcchāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca durjayām||15|| dhātrīrasena vā śītaṃ pibenmudgadalāmbu vā| kolamajjasitālājāmakṣikāviṭkaṇāñjanam||16|| lihyātkṣaudreṇa pathyāṃ vā drākṣāṃ vā badarāṇi vā| ---------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kaphajāyāṃ vamennimbakṛṣṇāpiṇḍītasarṣapaiḥ||17||
yuktena koṣṇatoyena, durbalaṃ copavāsayet| āragvadhādiniryūhaṃ śītaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibet||18||
manthān yavairvā bahuśaścchardighnauṣadhabhāvitaiḥ| kaphaghnamannaṃ hṛdyaṃ ca rāgāḥ sārjakabhūstṛṇāḥ||19||
līḍhaṃ manaḥśilākṛṣṇāmaricaṃ bījapūrakāt| svarasena kapitthasya sakṣaudreṇa vamiṃ jayet||20||
khādetkapitthaṃ savyoṣaṃ, madhunā vā durālabhām| lihyānmaricacocailāgośakṛdrasamākṣikam||21||

div.ab: anūkūlopacāreṇa yāti dviṣṭārthajā śamam| ---------------------------------------------|22|
---------------------------------------------| kṛmijā kṛmihṛdrogagaditaiśca bhiṣagjitaiḥ||22|| yathāsvaṃ pariśeṣāśca, tatkṛtāśca tathā''mayāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|

chardiprasaṅgena hi mātariśvā dhātukṣayātkopamupaityavaśyam| kuryādato'smin vamanātiyoga- proktaṃ vidhiṃ stambhanabṛṃhaṇīyam||23|| sarpirguḍā māṃsarasā ghṛtāni kalyāṇakatryūṣaṇajīvanāni| payāṃsi pathyopahitāni lehāśchardiṃ prasaktāṃ praśamaṃ nayanti||24|| iti chardicikitsitam|25|

chardicikitsitādanantaraṃ hṛdrogasādhanamucyate, hṛdrogaśabdaśravaṇasambandhāt| atha hṛdrogacikitsitam| ---------------------------------------------| hṛdroge vātaje tailaṃ mastusauvīratakravat||25|| pibetsukhoṣṇaṃ sabiḍaṃ gulmānāhārtijicca tat| ---------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tailaṃ ca lavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ samūtrāmlaṃ tathāguṇam||26||

div.ab: bilvaṃ rāsnāṃ yavān kolaṃ devadāruṃ punarnavām| kulatthān pañcamūlaṃ ca paktvā tasminpacejjale||27|| tailaṃ tannāvane pāne bastau ca viniyojayet| ---------------------------------------------|28|
---------------------------------------------| śuṇṭhīvayasthālavaṇakāyasthāhiṅgupauṣkaraiḥ||28|| pathyayā ca śṛtaṃ pārśvahṛdrujāgulmajidghṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|29|
---------------------------------------------| sauvarcalasya dvipale pathyāpañcāśadanvite||29|| ghṛtasya sādhitaḥ prastho hṛdrogaśvāsagulmajit| ---------------------------------------------|30|
---------------------------------------------| dāḍimaṃ kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhī hiṅgvamlavetasam||30|| apatantrakahṛdrogaśvāsaghnaṃ cūrṇamuttamam| ---------------------------------------------|31|
---------------------------------------------| puṣkarāhvaśaṭhīśuṇṭhībījapūrajaṭābhayāḥ||31|| pītāḥ kalkīkṛtāḥ kṣāraghṛtāmlalavaṇairyutāḥ| vikartikāśūlaharāḥ---------------------------------|32|

-----------------kvāthaḥ koṣṇaśca tadguṇaḥ||32|| yavānīlavaṇakṣāravacājājyauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ| sapūtidārubījāhvapalāśaśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ||33|| (yavakṣāro yavānī ca pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā| etena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ gulmaṃ caiva cirotthitam||1|| bhidyate saptarātreṇa pavanena yathā ghanaḥ| )||1.5||
pañcakolaśaṭhīpathyāguḍabījāhvapauṣkaram| vāruṇīkalkitaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ yamake lavaṇānvitam||34|| hṛtpārśvayoniśūleṣu khādedgulmodareṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|35|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| snigdhāśceha hitāḥ svedāḥ saṃskṛtāni ghṛtāni ca||35||
laghunā pañcamūlena śuṇṭhyā vā sādhitaṃ jalam| vāruṇīdadhimaṇḍaṃ vā dhānyāmlaṃ vā pibettṛṣi||36||

div.ab: sāyāmastambhaśūlāme hṛdi mārutadūṣite| kriyaiṣā----------------------------------|37|
---------------------------------------------| balātailaṃ sahṛdrogaḥ pibedvā sukumārakam||38|| yaṣṭyāhvaśatapākaṃ vā mahāsnehaṃ tathottamam| ---------------------------------------------|39|

tadeva cāha--------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------| rāsnājīvakajīvantībalāvyāghrīpunarnavaiḥ||39|| bhārṅgīsthirāvacāvyoṣairmahāsnehaṃ vipācayet| dadhipādaṃ tathāmlaiśca lābhataḥ sa niṣevitaḥ||40|| tarpaṇo bṛṃhaṇo balyo vātahṛdroganāśanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|41|
---------------------------------------------| dīpte'gnau sadravāyāme hṛdroge vātike hitam||41|| kṣīraṃ dadhiguḍaḥ sarpiraudakānūpamāmiṣam| ---------------------------------------------|42|
---------------------------------------------| etānyeva ca varjyāni hṛdrogeṣu caturṣvapi||42|| śeṣeṣu, stambhajāḍyāmasaṃyukte'pi ca vātike| ---------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kaphānubandhe tasmiṃstu rūkṣoṣṇāmācaretkriyām||43||
paitte drākṣekṣuniryāsasitākṣaudraparūṣakaiḥ| yukto vireko hṛdyaḥ syātkramaḥ śuddhe ca pittahā||44||
kṣatapittajvaroktaṃ ca bāhyāntaḥ parimārjanam| kaṭvīmadhukakalkaṃ ca pibetsasitamambhasā||45||

div.ab: śreyasīśarkarādrākṣājīvakarṣabhakotpalaiḥ| balākharjūrakākolīmedāyugmaiśca sādhitam||46|| sakṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ sarpiḥ pittahṛdroganāśanam| ---------------------------------------------|47|

---------------------------------------------| prapauṇḍarīkamadhukabisagranthikaserukāḥ||47|| saśuṇṭhīśaivalāstābhiḥ sakṣīraṃ vipacedghṛtam| śītaṃ samadhu tacceṣṭaṃ svāduvargakṛtaṃ ca yat||48|| bastiṃ ca dadyātsakṣaudraṃ tailaṃ madhukasādhitam| ---------------------------------------------|49|
---------------------------------------------| kaphodbhave vametsvinnaḥ picumandavacāmbhasā||49|| kulatthadhanvottharasatīkṣṇamadyayavāśanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| pibeccūrṇaṃ vacāhiṅgulavaṇadvayanāgarāt||50||
sailāyavānakakaṇāyavakṣārātsukhāmbunā| phaladhānyāmlakaulatthayūṣamūtrāsavaistathā||51||
puṣkarāhvābhayāśuṇṭhīśaṭhīrāsnāvacākaṇāt| kvāthaṃ tathā'bhayāśuṇṭhīmādrīpītadrukaṭphalāt||52||

div.ab: kvāthe rohitakāśvatthakhadirodumbarārjune| sapalāśavaṭe vyoṣatrivṛccūrṇānvite kṛtaḥ||53|| sukhodakānupānaśca lehaḥ kaphavikārahā| ---------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śleṣmagulmoditājyāni kṣārāṃśca vividhān pibet||54||
prayojayecchilāhvaṃ vā brāhmaṃ vā'tra rasāyanam| tathā''malakalehaṃ vā prāśaṃ vā'gastyanirmitam||55||

div.ab: syācchūlaṃ yasya bhukte'ti, jīryatyalpaṃ, jarāṃ gate| śāmyetsa kuṣṭhakṛmijillavaṇadvayatilvakaiḥ||56|| sadevadārvativiṣaiścūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pibet| ---------------------------------------------|57|

---------------------------------------------| yasya jīrṇe'dhikaṃ snehaiḥ sa virecyaḥ, phalaiḥpunaḥ||57|| jīryatyanne, tathā mūlaistīkṣṇaiḥ śūle sadā'dhike| ---------------------------------------------|58|
---------------------------------------------| prāyo'nilo ruddhagatiḥ kupyatyāmāśaye gataḥ||58|| tasyānulomanaṃ kāryaṃ śuddhilaṅghanapācanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|59|
---------------------------------------------| kṛmighnamauṣadhaṃ sarvaṃ kṛmije hṛdayāmaye||59|| iti hṛdrogacikitsitam|60|

ab.seg: atha tṛṣṇācikitsitam| tṛṣṇāsu vātapittaghno vidhiḥ prāyeṇa śasyate| sarvāsu śīto bāhyāntastathā śamanaśodhanaḥ||60||
divyāmbu śītaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tadvadbhomaṃ ca tadguṇam| nirvāpitaṃ taptaloṣṭakapālasikatādibhiḥ||61||
saśarkaraṃ vā kvathitaṃ pañcamūlena vā jalam| darbhaphūrveṇa manthaśca praśasto lājasaktubhiḥ||62||
vāṭyaścāmayavaiḥ śītaḥ śarkarāmākṣikānvitaḥ| yavāgūḥ śālibhistadvatkodravaiśca cirantanaiḥ||63||
śītena śītavīryaiśca dravyaiḥ siddhena bhojanam| himāmbupariṣiktasya payasā sasitāmadhu||64||
rasaiścānamlalavaṇairjāṅgalairghṛtabharjitaiḥ| mudgādīnāṃ tathā yūṣairjīvanīyarasānvitaiḥ||65||
nasyaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ śītairikṣostathā rasaḥ| nirvāpaṇāśca gaṇḍūṣāḥ sūtrasthānoditā hitāḥ||66||
dāhajvaroktā lepādyā nirīhatvaṃ manoratiḥ| mahāsariddhradādīnāṃ darśanarumaraṇāni ca||67||
iti tṛṣṇāsu sāmānyena cikitsitamuktam| viśeṣeṇāha------------ tṛṣṇāyāṃ pavanotthāyāṃ saguḍaṃ dadhi śasyate| rasāśca bṛṃhaṇāḥ śītā vidāryādigaṇāmbu ca||68||

div.ab: pittājāyāṃ sitāyuktaḥ pakvodumbarajo rasaḥ| tatkvātho vā himastadvatsārivādigaṇāmbu vā||69|| tadvidhaiśca gaṇaiḥ śītakaṣāyān sasitāmadhūn| madhurairauṣadhaistadvat kṣīrivṛkṣaiśca kalpitān||70|| bījapūrakamṛdvīkāvaṭavetasapallavān| mūlāni kuśakāśānāṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ ca jale śṛtam||71|| jvaroditaṃ vā drākṣādi pañcasārāmbu vā pibet| ---------------------------------------------|72|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kaphodbhavāyāṃ vamanaṃ nimbaprasavavāriṇā||72||
bilvāḍhakīpañcakoladarbhapañcakasādhitam| jalaṃ pibedrajanyā vā siddhaṃ sakṣaudraśarkaram||73||
mudgayūṣaṃ ca savyoṣapaṭolīnimbapallavam| yavānnaṃ tīkṣṇakavalanasyalehāṃśca śīlayet||74||
sarvairāmācca taddhantrī kriyeṣṭā vamanaṃ tathā| tryūṣaṇāruṣkaravacāphalāmloṣṇāmbumastubhiḥ||75||

div.ab: annātyayānmaṇḍamuṣṇaṃ himaṃ manthaṃ ca kālavit| ---------------------------------------------|76|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tṛṣi śramānmāṃsarasaṃ manthaṃ vā sasitaṃ pibet||76||
ātapātsasitaṃ manthaṃ yavakolajasaktubhiḥ| sarvāṇyaṅgāni limpecca tilapiṇyākakāñjikaiḥ||77||

div.ab: śītasnānācca madyāmbu pibettṛṇmān guḍāmbu vā| ---------------------------------------------|78|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| madyādardhajalaṃ madyaṃ snāto'mlalavaṇairyutam||78||

div.ab: snehatīkṣṇatarāgnistu svabhāvaśiśiraṃ jalam| ---------------------------------------------|79|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| snehāduṣṇāmbvajīrṇāttu jīrṇānmaṇḍaṃ pipāsitaḥ||79||

div.ab: pibetsnigdhānnatṛṣito himaspardhi guḍodakam| ---------------------------------------------|80|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| gurvādyannena tṛṣitaḥ pītvoṣṇāmbu tadullikhet||80||

div.ab: kṣayajāyāṃ kṣayahitaṃ sarvaṃ bṛṃhaṇamauṣadham| ---------------------------------------------|81|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kṛśadurbalarūkṣāṇāṃ kṣīraṃ chāgo raso'thavā||81||

div.ab: kṣīraṃ ca sordhvavātāyāṃ kṣayakāsaharaiḥ śṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|82|
---------------------------------------------| rogopasargājjātāyāṃ dhānyāmbu sasitāmadhu||82|| pāne praśastaṃ sarvā ca kriyā rogādyapekṣayā| ---------------------------------------------|83|

---------------------------------------------| tṛṣyan pūrvāmayakṣīṇo na labheta jalaṃ yadi|83| maraṇaṃ dīrgharogaṃ vā prāpnuyāttvaritaṃ tataḥ| sātmyānnapānabhaiṣajyaistṛṣṇāṃ tasya jayetpurā|84| tasyāṃ jitāyāmanyo'pi vyādhiḥ śakyaścikitsitum| 84 1/2| iti tṛṣṇārogacikitsitam| iti śrivaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭaṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne chardihṛdrogatṛṣṇācikitsitaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

div.head: madātyayādicikitsitādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: āthāto madātyayādicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) yaṃ doṣamadhikaṃ paśyettasyādau pratikārayet| kaphasthānānupūrvyā ca tulyadoṣe madātyaye||1||

div.ab: pittamārutaparyantaḥ prāyeṇa hi madātyayaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|2|
--------------------------------------------| hīnamithyātipītena yo vyādhirupajāyate||2|| samapītena tenaiva sa madyenopaśāmyati| --------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| tīkṣṇoṣṇenātimātreṇa pītenāmlavidāhinā||4||
madyenānnarasakledo vidagdhaḥ kṣāratāṃ gataḥ| yān kuryānmadatṛṇmohajvarāntardāhavibhramān||5||
madyotkliṣṭena doṣeṇa ruddhaḥ srotaḥsu mārutaḥ| sutīvrā vedanā yāśca śirasyasthiṣu sandhiṣu||6||
jīrṇāmamadyadoṣasya prakāṅkṣālāghave sati| yaugikaṃ vidhivadyuktaṃ madyameva nihanti tān||7||
kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghramamlopasaṃhitaḥ| madyamamleṣu ca śreṣṭhaṃ doṣaviṣyandanādalam||8||
tīkṣṇoṣṇādyaiḥ purā proktairdīpanādyaistathā guṇaiḥ| sātmyatvācca tadevāsya dhātusāmyakaraṃ param||9||
saptāhamaṣṭarātraṃ vā kuryātpānātyayauṣadham| jīryatyetāvatā pānaṃ kālena vipathāśritam||10||
paraṃ tato'nubadhnāti yo rogastasya bheṣajam| yathāyathaṃ prayuñjīta kṛtapānātyayauṣadhaḥ||11||

div.ab: tatra vātolbaṇe madyaṃ dadhātipiṣṭakṛtaṃ yutam| bījapūrakavrukṣāmlakoladāḍimadīpyakaiḥ||12|| yavānīhapuṣājājīvyoṣatrilavaṇārdrakaiḥ| śulyirmāṃsairharitakaiḥ snehavadbhiśca sakubhiḥ||13|| uṣṇasnigdhāmlalavaṇā medyamāṃsarasā hitāḥ| āmrāmrātakapeśībhiḥ saṃskṛtā rāgaṣāḍavāḥ||14|| godhūmamāṣavikṛtirmṛduścitrā mukhapriyā| ārdrikārdrakakulmāṣasuktamāṃsādigarbhiṇī||15|| surabhirlavaṇā śītā nirgadā vā'cchhavāruṇī| saraso dāḍimāt kvāthaḥ pañcamūlātkanīyasaḥ||16|| śuṇṭhīdhānyāttathā mustusuktāmbhocchhāmlakāñjikam abhyaṅgodvartanasnānamuṣṇaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ ghanam||17|| ghanaścāgurujo dhūpaḥ paṅkaścāgurukuṅkumaḥ| kucoruśroṇiśālinyo yauvanoṣṇāṅgayaṣṭayaḥ||18|| harṣeṇāliṅgane yuktāḥ priyāḥ saṃvāhaneṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|19|

---------------------------------------------| pittolbaṇe bahujalaṃ śārkaraṃ madhu vā yutam||19|| rasairdāḍimakharjūrabhavyadrākṣāparūṣajaiḥ| suśītaṃ sasitāsaktu yojyaṃ tādṛk ca pānakam||20|| svāduvargakaṣāyairvā yuktaṃ madyaṃ samākṣikam| ---------------------------------------------|21|
---------------------------------------------| śāliṣaṣṭikamaśnīyācchaśājaiṇakapiñjalaiḥ||21|| satīnamudgāmalakapaṭolīdāḍimai rasaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|22|

---------------------------------------------| kaphapittaṃ samuktliṣṭamullikhettṛḍvidāhavān||22|| pītvā'mbu śītaṃ madyaṃ vā bhūrīkṣurasasaṃyutam| drākṣārasaṃ vā saṃsargī tarpaṇādiḥ paraṃ hitaḥ||23|| tathā'gnirdīpyate tasya doṣaśeṣānnapācanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|24|

---------------------------------------------| kāse saraktaniṣṭhīve pārśvastanarujāsu ca||24|| tṛṣṇāyāṃ savidāhāyāṃ sotkleśe hṛdayorasi| guḍūcībhadramustānāṃ paṭolasyāthava rasam||25|| saśṛṅgaberaṃ yuñjīta tittiripratibhojanam| ---------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tṛṣyate cāti balavadvātapitte samuddhate||26||
dadyād drākṣārasaṃ pānaṃ śītaṃ doṣānulomanam| jīrṇe'dyānmadhurāmlena chāgamāṃsarasena ca||27||

div.ab: tṛṣyalpaśaḥ pibenmadyaṃ madaṃ rakṣan bahūdakam| mustadāḍimalājāmbu jalaṃ vā parṇinīśṛtam||28|| pāṭalyutpalakandairvā svabhāvādeva vā himam| ---------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| madyātipānādabdhātau kṣīṇe tejasi coddhate||29||
yaḥ śuṣkagalatālovṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya ceṣṭate| pāyayetkāmato'mbhastaṃ niśīthapavanāhatam||30||
koladāḍimavṛkṣāmlacukrīkācukrikārasaḥ| pañcāmlako mukhālepaḥ sadyastṛṣṇaṃ niyacchati||31||

div.ab: tvacaṃ prāptaśca pānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrcchitaḥ| dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ tatrātiśiśiro vidhiḥ||32|| aśāmyati rasaistṛpte rohiṇīṃ vyadhayecchirām| ---------------------------------------------|33|
---------------------------------------------| ullekhanopavāsābhyāṃ jayecchleṣmolbaṇaṃ pibet||33|| śītaṃ śuṇṭhīsthirodīcyaduḥsparśānyatamodakam| ---------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| nirāmaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kāle pāyayedvahumākṣikam||34||
śārkaraṃ madhu vā jīrṇamariṣṭaṃ sīdhumeva vā| rūkṣatarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yavānīnāgarānvitam||35||
yūṣeṇa yavagodhūmaṃ tanunā'lpena bhojayet| uṣṇāmlakaṭutiktena kaulatthenālpasarpiṣā||36||
śuṣkamūlakajaiścchāgai rasairvā dhanvacāriṇām| sāmlavetasavṛkṣāmlapaṭolīvyoṣadāḍimaiḥ||37||

div.ab: prabhūtaśuṇṭhīmaricaharitārdrakapeśikam| bījapūrarasādyamlabhṛṣṭanīrasarvatitam||38|| karīrakaramardādi rociṣṇu bahuśālanam| pravyaktāṣṭāṅgalavaṇaṃ vikalpitanimardakam||39|| yathāgni bhakṣayan māṃsaṃ mādhavaṃ nigadaṃ pibet| ---------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| sitāsauvarcalājājītittiḍīkāmlavetasam||40||
tvagelāmaricārdhāṃśamaṣṭāṅgalavaṇaṃ hitam| srotoviśuddhyagnikaraṃ kaphaprāye madātyaye||41||

div.ab: rūkṣoṣṇodvartanoddharṣasnānabhojanalaṅghanaiḥ| sakāmābhiḥ saha strībhiryuktyā jāgaraṇena ca||42|| madātyayaḥ kaphaprāyaḥ śīghraṃ samupaśāmyati| ---------------------------------------------|43|
---------------------------------------------| yadidaṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ pṛthagdoṣabalaṃ prati||43|| sannipāte daśavidhe tacchheṣe'pi vikalpayet| ---------------------------------------------|44|

---------------------------------------------| tvaṅnāgapuṣpamagadhāmaricājājidhānyakaiḥ||44|| paruṣakamadhūkailāsurāhvaiśca sitānvitaiḥ| sakapittharasaṃ hṛdyaṃ pānakaṃ śaśibovitam||45|| madātyayeṣu sarveṣu peyaṃ rucyagnidīpanam| ---------------------------------------------|46|
---------------------------------------------| nāvikṣobhya mano madyaṃ śarīramavihanya vā||46|| kuryānmadātyayaṃ tasmādiṣyata harṣaṇī kriyā| ---------------------------------------------|47|

---------------------------------------------| saṃśuddhiśamanādyeṣu madadoṣaḥ kṛteṣvapi||47|| na cecchāmyetkaphe kṣīṇe jāte daurvalyalāghave| tasya madyavidagdhasya vātapittādhikasya ca||48|| grīṣmopataptasya taroryathā varṣaṃ tathā payaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|49|
madyakṣīṇasya hi kṣīṇaṃ kṣīramāśveva puṣyati||49|| ojastulyaṃ guṇaiḥ sarvairviparītaṃ ca madyataḥ|50|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| payasā vihate roge bale jāte nivartayet||50||
kṣīraprayogaṃ, madyaṃ ca krameṇālpālpamācaret| na vikṣayadhvaṃsakotthaiḥ spṛśetopadravairyathā||51||
tayostu syāddhṛ kṣīraṃ bastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ śivāḥ| abhyaṅgodvartanasnānānyannapānaṃ ca vātajit||52||
yuktamadyasya madyottho na vyādhirupājāyate| ato'sya vakṣyate yogo yaḥ sukhāyaiva kevalam||53||
āśvinaṃ yā mahattejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā| dadhātyaindraṃ ca yā vīryaṃ prabhāvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yā||54||
astraṃ makaraketoryā puruṣārtho balasya yā| sautrāmaṇyāṃ dvijamukhe yā hutāśe ca hūyate||55||
yā sarvauṣadhisampūrṇānmathyamānātsurāsuraiḥ| mahodadheḥ samudbhūtā śrīśaśāṅkāmṛtaiḥ saha||56||
madhumādhavamaireyasīdhugauḍāsavādibhiḥ| madaśaktimanujjhantī yā rūpairbahubhiḥ sthitā||57||
yāmāsvādya vilāsinyo yathārthaṃ nāma bibhrati| kulāṅganā'pi yāṃ pītvā nayatyuddhatamānasā||58||
anaṅgāliṅgitairaṅgaiḥ kvāpi ceto munerapi| taraṅgabhaṅgabhrukuṭītarjanairmāninīmanaḥ||59||
ekaṃ prasādya kurute yā dvayorapi nirvṛtim| yathākāmaṃ bhaṭāvāptiparihṛṣṭāpsarogaṇe||60||
tṛṇavatpuruṣā yuddhe yāmāsvādya tyajantyasūn| yāṃ śīlayitvā'pi ciraṃ bahudhā bahuvigrahām||61||
nityaṃ harṣātivegena tatpūrvamiva sevate| śokodvegāratibhayairyāṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhibhūyate||62||
goṣṭhīmahotsavodyānaṃ na yasyāḥ śobhate vinā| smṛtvā smṛtvā ca bahuśo viyuktaḥ śocate yayā||63||
aprasannā'pi yā prītyai prasannā svarga eva yā| apīndraṃ manyate duḥsthaṃ hṛdayasthitayā yayā||64||
anirdeśyasukhāsvādā svayaṃvedyaiva yā param| iti citrāsvavasthāsu priyāmanukaroti yā||65||
priyā'tipriyatāṃ yāti yatpriyasya viśeṣataḥ| yā prītiryā ratirvā vāgyā puṣṭiriti ca stutā||66||
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasamānuṣaiḥ| pānapravṛttau satyāṃ tu tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet||67||
sambhavanti na te rogā medonilakaphodbhavāḥ| vidhiyuktādṛte madyādye na sidhyanti dāruṇāḥ||68||
asti dehasya sā'vasthā yasyāṃ pānaṃ nirvāyate| anyatra madyānnigadādvividhauṣadhasaṃskṛtāt||69||
ānūpaṃ jāṅgalaṃ māṃsaṃ vidhinā'pyupakalpitam| madyaṃ sahāyamaprāpya samyak pariṇametkatham||70||
sutīvramārutavyādhighātino laśunasya ca| madyamāṃsaviyuktasya prayoge syātkiyān guṇaḥ||71||
nigūḍhaśalyāharaṇe śastrakṣārāgnikarmaṇi| pītamadyo viṣahate sukhaṃ vaidyavikatthanām||72||
analottejanaṃ rucyaṃ śokaśramavinodakam| na cātaḥ paramastyanyadārogyabalapuṣṭikṛt||73||
rakṣatā jīvitaṃ tasmātpeyamātmabatā sadā| āśritopāśritahitaṃ paramaṃ dharmasādhanam||74||
srātaḥ praṇamya suravipragurūn yathāsvaṃ vṛttiṃ vidhāya ca samastaparigrahasya| āpānabhūmimatha gandhajalābhiṣīktā- māhāramaṇḍapasamīpagatāṃ śrayeta||75||
svāstrūte'tha śayane kamanīye mitrabhṛtyaramaṇīsamavetaḥ| svaṃ yaśaḥ kathakacāraṇasaṅghai ruddhataṃ niśamayannatilokam||76||
vilāsinīnāṃ ca vilāsaśobhi gītaṃ sanṛtyaṃ kalatūryaghoṣaiḥ| kāñcīkalāpaiścalakiṅkiṇīkaiḥ krīḍāvihaṅgaiśca kṛtānunādam||77||
maṇikanakasamutthairāvaneyairvicitraiḥ sajalavividhalekhakṣo-mavastrāvṛtāṅgaiḥ| api munijanacittakṣobhasampādinībhi- ścakitahariṇalolaprekṣaṇībhiḥ priyābhiḥ||78||
stananitambakṛtādatigauravā- dalasamākulamīśvarasambhramāt| iti gataṃ dadhatībhirasaṃsthitaṃ taruṇacittavilobhanakārmaṇam||79||
yauvanāsavamattābhirvilāsādhiṣṭhitātmabhiḥ| sañcāryamāṇaṃ yugapattanvaṅgībhiritastataḥ||80||
tālavṛntanalinīdalānilaiḥ śītalīkṛtamatība śītalaiḥ| darśane'pi vidadhadvaśānugaṃ svāditaṃ kimuta cittajanmanaḥ||81||
cūtarasendumṛgaiḥ kṛtavāsaṃ mallikayojjvalayā ca sanātham| sphāṭikaśuktigataṃ sataraṅgaṃ kāntamanaṅgamivodvahadaṅgam||82||
tālīsādyaṃ cūrṇamelādikaṃ vā hṛdyaṃ prāśya prāgvayaḥsthāpanaṃ vā| tatprārthibhyo bhūmibhāge sumṛṣṭe toyonmiśraṃ dāpayitvā tataśca||83||
ghṛtimān smṛtimānnityamanūnādhikamācaran| ucitenopacāreṇa sarvamevopapādayan||84||
jitavikasitāsitasaro janayanasaṅkrāntivardhitaśrīkam| kānṭamukhamiva saurabha- hṛtamadhupagaṇaṃ pibenmadyam||85||

pītvaivaṃ caṣakadvayaṃ parijanaṃ sanmānya sarvaṃ tato gatvā''hārabhuvaṃ puraḥ subhiṣajo bhuñjīta bhūyo'tra ca| māṃsāpūpaghṛtārdrakādiharitairyuktaṃ sasauvarcalai- rdvistrirvā niśi cālpameva vanitāsaṃvalganārthaṃ pibet||86||
rahasi dayitāmaṅke kṛtvā bhujāntarapīḍanā- tpulakitatanuṃ jātasvedāṃ sakampapayodharām| yadi sarabhasaṃ śīdhorvāraṃ na pāyayate kṛtī kimanubhavati kleśapRyaṃ tato gṛhatantratām||87||
varatanuvakrasaṅgatisugandhitaraṃ sarakaṃ drutamiva padmarāgamaṇimāsavarūpadharam| bhavati ratiśrameṇa ca madaḥ pibato'lpamapi kṣayamata ojasaḥ pariharan sa śayīta param||88||

div.ab: itthaṃ yuktyā pibanmadyaṃ na trivargādvihīyate| asārasaṃsārasukhaṃ paramaṃ cādhigacchati||89|| eśvaryasyopabhogo'yaṃ spṛhaṇīyaḥ surairapi| ---------------------------------------------|90|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| anyathā hi vipatsu syātpaścāttāpendhanaṃ dhanam||90||
upabhogena rahito bhogāvāniti nindyate| nirmito'tikadaryo'yaṃ vidhinā nidhipālakaḥ||91||
tasmāhyavasthayā pānaṃ pānasya satataṃ hitam| jitvā viṣayalubdhānāmindriyāṇāṃ svatantratām||92||
vidhirvasumatāmeṣa bhaviṣyadvasavastu ye| yathopapatti tairmadyaṃ pātavyaṃ mātrayā hitam||93||
yāvad dṛṣṭerna sambhrāntiryāvanna kṣobhate manaḥ| tāvadeva virantavyaṃ madyādātmavatā sadā||14||
abhyaṅgodvartanasnānavāsadhūpānulepanaiḥ| snigdhoṣṇairbhāvitaścānnaiḥ pānaṃ vātottaraḥ pibet||15||
śītopacārairvividhairmadhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ| paittiko bhavitaścānnaiḥ pibanmadyaṃ na sīdati||16||
upacārairaśiśirairyavagodhūmabhuk pibet| ṣlaiṣmiko dhanvajairmāṃsairmadyaṃ māricikaiḥ saha||17||
tatra vāte hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyaḥ paiṣṭikagauḍikam| pitte sāmbhomadhu, kāphe mārdvīkāriṣṭamadhavam||98||
prāk pibecchlaiṣmiko madyaṃ, bhuktasyopari paittikaḥ| vātikastu pibenmadhye, samadoṣo yathecchayā||19||
iti madātyayacikitsitam||2||
atha madamūrcchāyacikitsitam| madeṣu vātapittaghnaṃ prāyo mūrcchāsu ceṣyate| sarvatrāpi viśeṣeṇa pittamevopalakṣayet||100||

div.ab: śītāḥ pradehā maṇayaḥ sekā vyajanamārutāḥ| sitā drākṣekṣukharjūrakāśmaryasvarasāḥ payaḥ||101|| siddhaṃ madhuravargeṇa rasā yūṣāḥ sadāḍimāḥ| ṣaṣṭikāḥ śālayo raktā yavāḥ sarpiśca jīvanam||102|| kalyāṇakaṃ mahātiktaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ payasā'gnikaḥ| pippalyo vā śilāhvaṃ vā rasāyanavidhānataḥ||103|| triphalā vā prayoktavyā saṛtakṣaudraśarkarā| ---------------------------------------------|104|

---------------------------------------------| prasaktavegeṣu hitaṃ mukhanāsāvarodhanam||104|| pibedvā mānuṣīkṣīraṃ tena dadyācca nāvanam| mṛṇālabisakṛṣṇā vā lihyātkhaudreṇa sābhayāḥ||105|| durālabhāṃ vā mustaṃ vā śītena salilena vā| pibenmaricakolāsthimajjośīrāhikesaram||106|| dhātrīphalarase siddhaṃ pathyākvāthena vā ghṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|107|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kuryātkriyāṃ yathoktāṃ ca yathādoṣabalodayam||107||

div.ab: pañcakarmāṇi ceṣṭāni secanaṃ śoṇitasya ca| ---------------------------------------------|108|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| sattvasyālambanaṃ jñānamagṛddhirviṣayeṣu ca||108||

div.ab: madeṣvatipravṛddheṣu mūrcchāyeṣu ca yojayet| tīkṣṇaṃ sannyāsavihitaṃ-------------------------|109|

ab.seg: iti madamūrcchāyacikitsitam||3||

div.ab: atha sannyāsacikitsitam| āśu prayojyaṃ sannyāse sutīkṣṇaṃ nasyamañjanam| dhūmaḥ pradhamanaṃ todaḥ sūcībhiśca nakhāntare||110|| keśānāṃ luñcanaṃ dāho daṃśo daśanavṛścikaiḥ| kaṭvamlagālanaṃ vakre kapikacchvavagharṣaṇam||111|| utthito labdhasaṃjñaśca laśunasvarasaṃ pibet| khādetsavyoṣalavaṇaṃ bījapūrakakesaram||112|| laghvannaprati tīkṣṇoṣṇamadyātsrotoviśuddhaye| ---------------------------------------------|113|

vismāpanaiḥ saṃsmaraṇaiḥ priyaśravaṇadarśanaiḥ|113| paṭubhirgītavāditraśabdairvyāyāmaśīlanaiḥ| sraṃsanollekhanairdhūmaiḥ śoṇitasyāvasecanaiḥ|114| upācarettaṃ pratatamanubandhabhayātpunaḥ| tasya saṃrakṣitavyaṃ ca manaḥ pralayahetutaḥ|115| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaīhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita- sthāne madātyayādicikitsitaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|7|

div.head: arśaścikitsitādhyayaḥ
div.ab: athato'rśasāṃ cikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) kāle sādhāraṇe vyābhre nātidurbalamarśasam| viśuddhakoṣṭhaṃ laghvalpamanulomanamāśitam||1|| śuci kṛtasvastyayanaṃ muktaviṇmūtramavyatham| śayane phalake vā'nyanarotsaṅge vyapāśritam||2|| pūrveṇa kāyenottānaṃ pratyādityagudaṃ samam| samunnatakaṭīdeśamatha yantraṇavāsasā||3|| sakthnoḥ śirodharāyāṃ ca parikṣiptamṛju sthitam| ālambitaṃ paricaraiḥ sarpiṣā'bhyaktapāyave||4|| tato'smai sarpiṣā'yaktaṃ nidaghyādṛju yantrakam| śanairanusukhaṃ pāyau, tato dṛṣṭvā pravāhaṇāt||5|| yantre praviṣṭaṃ durnāma plotaguṇṭhitayā'nu ca| śalākayotpīḍya bhiṣak yathoktavidhinā dahet||6|| kṣāreṇaivārdramitaratkṣāreṇa jvalanena vā| mahadvā valinaśchattvā vītayantramathāturam||7|| svabhyaktapāyujaghanamavagāhe nidhāpayet| nirvātamandirasthasya tato'syācāramadiśet||8|| ekaikamiti saptāhātsaptāhātsamupācaret| ---------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: -----------------sudagdhasya syādvāyoranulomatā| ruciranne'gnipaṭutā svāsthyaṃ varṇabalodayaḥ||10||
bastiśūle tvadho nābherlepayechlakṣṇakalkitaiḥ| varṣābhūkuṣṭhasurabhimiśilohāmarāhvayaiḥ||11||

div.ab: śakṛnmūtrapratīghāte pariṣekāvagāhayoḥ| varaṇālambuṣairaṇḍagokaṇṭakapunarnavaiḥ||12|| suṣavīsurabhībhyāṃ ca kvāthamuṣṇaṃ prayojayet| sasnehamathavā kṣīraṃ tailaṃ vā vātanāśanam||13|| yuñjītānnaṃ śakṛdbhedi snehān vātaghnadīpanān| ---------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| athāprayojyadāhasya nirgatān kaphavātajān||14||
sastambhakaṇḍūrukśophānabhyajya gudakīlakān| bilvamūlāgnikakṣārakuṣṭhaiḥ siddhena secayet||15||
tailenāhibiḍāloṣtravarāhavasayā'thavā| |kāsīsaṃ saindhavaṃ rāsnā śuṇṭhī kuṣṭhaṃ ca lāṅgalī| śilābhrakāśvamāraṃ ca jantuhṛddanticitrakau||1||
haritālaṃ tathā svarṇakṣīrī taiśca pacetsamaiḥ| tailaṃ sudhārkapayasī gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe||2||
etadabhyaṅgato'rśāṃsi kṣāravatpātayeddrutam| kṣārakarmakaraṃ hyetanna ca dūṣayate valim||3||
] svedayedanu piṇḍena dravasvedena vā punaḥ||16||
saktūnāṃ piṇḍikābhirvā snigdhānāṃ tailasarpiṣā| rāsnāyā hapuṣāyā vā piṇḍairvā kārṣṇyagandhikaiḥ||17||

div.ab: arkamūlaṃ śamīpatraṃ nṛkeśāḥ sarpakañcukam| mārjāracarma sarpiśca dhūpanaṃ hitamarśasām||18|| tathā'śvagandhā surasā bṛhatī pippalī ghṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|19|
---------------------------------------------| dhānyāmlapiṣṭairjīmūtabījaistajjālakaṃ mṛdu||19|| lepitaṃ chāyayā śuṣkaṃ vartirgudajaśātanī| ---------------------------------------------|20|
--------------------------------------------| sajālamūlajīmūtalehe vā kṣārasaṃyute||20|| guñjāsūraṇakūṣmāṇḍabījairvartistathāguṇā| --------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: snukkṣīrārdraniśālepastathā, gomūtrakalkitaiḥ||21||
kṛkavākuśakṛtkṛṣṇāniśāguñjāphalaistathā| snukkṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ ṣaḍgranthāhalinīvāraṇāsthibhiḥ||22||
kulīraśṛṅgivijayākuṣṭhāruṣkaratutthakaiḥ| śigrumūlakajairbījaiḥ patrairaśvaghnanimbajaiḥ||23||
pīlumūlena bilvena hiṅgunā ca samanvitaiḥ| kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣabījāni pippalyaḥ saindhavaṃ guḍaḥ||24||
arkakṣīraṃ sudhākṣīraṃ triphalā ca pralepanam| ārkaṃ payaḥ sudhākāṇḍam kaṭukālābupallavāḥ||25||
karañjo bastamūtraṃ ca lepanaṃ śreṣṭhamarśasām| ānuvāsanikairlepaḥ pippalyādyaiśca pūjitaḥ||26||

div.ab: ebhirevauṣadhaiḥ kuryāttailānyabhyañjanāya ca| ---------------------------------------------|27|
---------------------------------------------| dhūpanālepanābhyaṅgaiḥ prasravanti gudāṅkarāḥ||27|| sañcitaṃ duṣṭarudhiraṃ, tataḥ sampadyate sukhī| ---------------------------------------------|28|
---------------------------------------------| avartamānamucchūnakaṭhinebhyo haredasṛk||28|| arśobhyo jalajāśastrasūcīkūrcaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|29|
---------------------------------------------| śīṣṇasnigdharūkṣairhi na vyādhirupaśāmyati||29|| rakte duṣṭe bhiṣak tasmādraktamevāvasecayet| ---------------------------------------------|30|
---------------------------------------------| yo jāto gorasaḥ kṣīrādvahnicūrṇāvacūrṇitāt||30|| pibaṃstameva tenaiva bhuñjāno gudajān jayet| ---------------------------------------------|31|
kovidārasya mūlānāṃ mathitena rajaḥ piban||31|| aśvan jīrṇe ca pathyāni mucyate hatanāmabhiḥ|32|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| gudaśvayathuśūlārtho mandāgnirgaulmikān pibet||32||
hiṅgvādīnanutakraṃ vā khādeṅguḍaharītakīm| takreṇa vā pibetpathyāvellāgnikuṭajatvacaḥ||33||
kaliṅgamagadhājyotiḥsūraṇān vāṃ'śavardhitān| koṣṇāmbunā vā tripaṭuvyoṣahiṅgvamlavetasam||34||

div.ab: yuktaṃ bilvakapitthābhyāṃ mahauṣadhabiḍena vā| aruṣkarairyavānyā vā pradadyāttakratarpaṇam||35|| dadyādvā hapuṣāhiṅgucitrakaṃ takrasaṃyutam| māsaṃ takrānupānāni khādetpīluphalāni vā||36|| pibedaharahastakraṃ niranno vā prakāmataḥ| ---------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| atyarthaṃ mandakāyāgnestakramevāvacārayet||37||
saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā māsārdhaṃ māsameva vā| balakālavikārajño bhiṣak takraṃ prayojayet||38||
sāyaṃ vā lājasaktūnāṃ dadyāttakrāvalehikām| jīrṇe takre pradadyādvā takrapeyāṃ sasaindhavam||39||
takrānupānaṃ sasnehaṃ takraudanamataḥ param| yūśai rasairvā takrāḍyaiḥ śālīn bhuñjīta mātrayā||40||
rūkṣamardhoddhṛtasnehaṃ yataścānuddhṛtaṃ ghṛtam| takraṃ doṣāgnibalavitrivistrividhaṃ tatprayojayet||41||
na virohanti gudajāḥ punastakrasamāhatāḥ| niṣiktaṃ taddhi dahati bhūmāvapi tṛṇolupam||42||

div.ab: srotaḥsu takraśuddheṣu raso dhātūnupaiti yaḥ| tena puṣṭirbalaṃ varṇaḥ paraṃ tuṣṭiśca jāyate||43|| vātaśleṣmavikārāṇāṃ śataṃ ca vinivartate| --------------------------------------------|45|
--------------------------------------------| mathitaṃ bhājane kṣudrabṛhatīphalalepite||44|| niśāṃ paryuṣitaṃ peyamicchadbhirgudajakṣayam| --------------------------------------------|45|

---------------------------------------------| dhānyopakuñcikājājīhapuṣāpippalīdvayaiḥ||45|| kāravīgranthikaśaṭhīyavānyagniyavānakaiḥ| cūrṇitairghṛtapātrasthaṃ nātyamlaṃ takramāsutam||46|| takrāriṣṭaṃ pibejjātaṃ vyaktāmlakaṭu kāmitaḥ| dīpanaṃ rocanaṃ varṇyaṃkaphavātānulomanam||47|| gudaśvayathukaṇḍvartināśanaṃ balavardhanam| ---------------------------------------------|48|
---------------------------------------------| tvacaṃ citrakamūlasya piṣṭvā kumbhaṃ pralepayet||48|| takraṃ vā dadhi vā tatra jātamarśoharaṃ pibet| ---------------------------------------------|49|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| bhārṅgyāsphotāmṛtāpañcakoleṣvapyeṣa saṃvidhiḥ||49||
piṣṭairgajakaṇāpāṭhākāravīpañcakolakaiḥ| tumbarvajājīdhanikābilvamadhyaiśca kalpayet||50||
phalāmlān yamakasnehān peyāyūṣarasādikān| ebhirevauṣadhaiḥ sādhyaṃ vāri sarpiśca dīpanam||51||

div.ab: ---------------------------------------------| snehāḍyaiḥ saktubhiryuktāṃ lavaṇāṃ vāruṇīṃ pibet||52|| lavaṇā eva vā takrasīdhudhānyāmlavāruṇīḥ| ---------------------------------------------|53|
---------------------------------------------| prāgbhaktān yamake bhṛṣṭān saktubhiścāvacūrṇitān||53|| karañjapallavān khādedvātavarconulomanān| ---------------------------------------------|54|
--------------------------------------------| saguḍaṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ guḍakṣāraghṛtāni vā||54|| gomūtrādhyuṣitāmadyātsaguḍāṃ vā harītakīm| --------------------------------------------|55|

---------------------------------------------| pathyāśatadvayānmūtradroṇenāmūtrasaṅkṣyāt||55|| pakvāt khādetsamadhunī dve dve hanti kaphodbhavān| durnāmakuṣṭhaśvayathugulmamehodarakṛmīn||56|| granthyarbudāpacīsthaulyapāṇḍurogāḍyamārutān| ---------------------------------------------|57|
--------------------------------------------| ajaśṛṅgījaṭākalkamajāmūtreṇa yaḥ pibet||57|| guḍavārtākabhuk tasya naśyantyāśu gudāṅkurāḥ| --------------------------------------------|58|

---------------------------------------------| śreṣṭhārasena trivṛtāṃ pathyāṃ takreṇa vā saha||58|| pathyāṃ vā pippalīyuktāṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭāṃ guḍānvitām| athavā satrivṛddantīṃ bhakṣayedanulomanīm||59|| hate gudāśraye doṣe gudajā yānti saṅkṣyam| ---------------------------------------------|60|

---------------------------------------------| dāḍimasvarasājājīyavānīguḍanāgaraiḥ||60|| pāṭhayā vā yutaṃ takraṃ vātavarconulomanam| sidhuṃ vā gauḍamathavā sacitrakamahauṣadham||61|| pibetsurāṃ vā hapuṣāpāṭhāsauvarcalānvitām| ---------------------------------------------|62|
---------------------------------------------| daśādidaśakairvṛddhāḥ pippalīrdvipicuṃ tilān||62|| pītvā kṣīreṇa labhate balaṃ dehahutāśayoḥ| ---------------------------------------------|63|
---------------------------------------------| duḥsparśakena bilvena yavānyā nāgareṇa vā||63|| ekaikenāpi saṃyuktā pāṭhā hantyarśasāṃ rujam| ---------------------------------------------|64|

---------------------------------------------| salilasya vahe paktvā prasthārdhamabhayātvacām||64|| prasthaṃ dhātryā daśapalaṃ kapitthānāṃ tato'rdhataḥ| viśālāṃ rodhramaricakṛṣṇāvellailavālukam||65|| dvipalāṃśaṃ pṛthkapādaśeṣe pūte guḍāttule| dattvā prasthaṃ ca dhātakyāḥ sthāpayeddhṛtabhājane||66|| pakṣātsa śīlito'riṣṭaḥ karotyagniṃ, nihanti ca| gudajagrahaṇīpāṇḍukuṣṭhodaragarajvarān||67|| śvayathuplīhahṛdrogagulmayakṣmavamikṛmīn| ---------------------------------------------|68|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| jaladroṇe paceddantīdaśamūlavarāgnikān||68||
pālikān pādaśeṣe tu kṣipeṅguḍatulāṃ param| pūrvavatsarvamasya syādanulomitarastvayam||69||
pacehurālabhāprasthaṃ droṇe'pāṃ prāsṛtaiḥ saha| dantīpāṭhāgnivijayāvāsāmalakanāgaraiḥ||70||
tasmin sitāśataṃ dadyātpādasthe'nyacca pūrvavat| limpetkumbhaṃ tu phalinīkṛṣṇācavyājyamākṣikaiḥ||71||

div.ab: prāgbhaktamānulomyāya phalāmlaṃ vā pibeddhṛtam| cavyacitrakasiddhaṃ vā yavakṣāraguḍānvitam||72|| pippalīmūlasiddhaṃ vā saguḍakṣāranāgaram| ---------------------------------------------|73|
---------------------------------------------| pippalīpippalīmūladhānakādāḍimairghṛtam||73|| daghnā ca sādhitaṃ vātaśakṛnmūtravibandhanut| ---------------------------------------------|74|
---------------------------------------------| palāśakṣāratoyena triguṇena paceddhṛtam||74|| vatsakādipratīvāpamarśoghnaṃ dīpanaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|75|

---------------------------------------------| pañcakolābhayākṣārayavānībiḍasaindhavaiḥ||75|| sapāṭhādhānyamaricaiḥ savilvairdadhimaddhṛtam| sādhayet tajjayatyāśu gudavaṅkṣṇavedanām||76|| pravāhikāṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ parisravam| ---------------------------------------------|77|

---------------------------------------------| pāṭhājamodadhanikāśvadaṃṣtrāpañcakolakaiḥ||77|| savilvairdani cāṅgerīsvarase ca caturguṇe| hantyājyaṃ siddhamānāhaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām||78|| gudabhraṃśārtigudajagrahaṇīgadamārutān| ---------------------------------------------|79|
---------------------------------------------| śikhitittirilāvānāṃ rasānamlān susaṃskṛtān||79|| dakṣāṇāṃ vartakānāṃ vā dadyādviṅvātasaṅgrahe| ---------------------------------------------|80|

---------------------------------------------| vastukāgnitrivṛddantīpāṭhāmlīkādipallavān||80|| anyacca kaphavātaghnaṃ śākaṃ ca laghumedi ca| sahiṅgaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ dadhisaraiḥ saha||81|| dahnikāpañcakolābhyāṃ piṣṭābhyāṃ dāḍimāmbunā| āRdrikāyāḥ kisalayaiḥ śakalairādrakasya ca||82|| yuktamaṅgāradhūpena hṛdyena surabhīkṛtam| sajīrakaṃ samaricaṃ biḍasauvarcalotkaṭam||83|| vātottarasya rūkṣasya mandāgnervaddhavarcasaḥ| kalpayedraktaśālyannavyañjanaṃ śākavadrasān||84|| gogodhāchagaroṣṭrāṇāṃ viśeṣātkravyabhojinām| ---------------------------------------------|85|

---------------------------------------------| madirāṃ śāRkaraṃ gauḍaṃ sīdhuṃ takraṃ tuṣodakam||85|| ariṣṭaṃ mastu pānīyaṃ, pānīyaṃ vā'lpakaṃ śṛtam| dhānyena dhānyaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ kaṇṭakārikayā'thavā||86|| ante bhaktasya madhye vā vātavarconulomanam| ---------------------------------------------|87|
---------------------------------------------| viḍvātakaphapittānāmānulomye hi nirmale||87|| gude śāmyanti gudajāḥ pāvakaścābhivardhate| ---------------------------------------------|88|
---------------------------------------------| udābartaparītā ye ye cātyarthaṃ virūkṣitāḥ||88|| vilomavātāḥ śūlārtāsteṣviṣṭamanuvāsanam| ---------------------------------------------|89|

---------------------------------------------| pippalīṃ madanaṃ bilvaṃ śatāhvāṃ madhukaṃ vacām||89|| kuṣṭhaṃ śaṭhīṃ puṣkarākhyaṃ citrakaṃ devadāru ca| piṣṭvātailaṃ vipaktavyaṃ dviguṇakṣīrasaṃyutam||90|| arśasāṃ mūḍhavātānāṃ tacchreṣṭhamanuvāsanam| gudaniḥsaraṇaṃ śūlaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām||91|| kaṭyūrupṛṣṭhadaurvalyamānāhaṃ vaṅkṣaṇāśrayam| picchāsrāvaṃ gude śophaṃ vātavarcovinigraham||92|| utthānaṃ bahuśo yacca jayettaccānuvāsanāt| ---------------------------------------------|93|
---------------------------------------------| niruhaṃ vā prayuñjīta sakṣīraṃ pāñcamūlikam||93|| samūtrasnehalavaṇaṃ kalkairyukraṃ phalādibhiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|94|
---------------------------------------------| atha raktārśasāṃ vīkṣya mārutasya kaphasya vā||94|| anubandhaṃ tataḥ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ vā yojayeddhimam| ---------------------------------------------|95|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śakṛcchayāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣamadho niryāti nānilaḥ||95||
kaṭyūrugudaśūlaṃ ca heturyadi ca rūkṣaṇam| tatrānubandho vātasya śleṣmaṇo yadi viṭ ślathā||96||
śvetā pītā guruḥsnigdhā, sapicchaḥ stimito gudaḥ| hetuḥ snigdhagururvidyādyathāsvaṃ cāsralakṣaṇāt||97||

div.ab: duṣṭe'sre śodhanaṃ kāryaṃ laṅghanaṃ ca yathābalam| ---------------------------------------------|98|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| yāvacca doṣaiḥ kālupyaṃ srutestāvadupekṣaṇam||98||
doṣāṇāṃ pācanarthaṃ ca vahnisandhukṣaṇāya ca| saṅgrahāya ca raktasya paraṃ tiktairupācaret||99||
yattu prakṣīṇadoṣasya raktaṃ vātolbaṇasya vā| snehaistatsādhayedyuktaiḥ pānābhyañjanabastiṣu||100||
yattu pittolbaṇaṃ raktaṃ gharmakāle pravartate| stambhanīyaṃ tadekāntānna cedvātakaphānugam||101||

div.ab: sakaphe'sre pibetpākyaṃ śuṇṭhīkuṭajavalkam| kirātatiktakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dhanvayāsaṃ kucandanam||102|| dārvītvaṅkṣimbasevyāni tvacaṃ vā dāḍimodbhavām| ---------------------------------------------|103|
---------------------------------------------| kuṭajatvakphalaṃ tārkṣyaṃ mākṣikaṃ ghuṇavallabhām||103|| pibettaṇḍulatoyena kalkitaṃ vā mayūrakam| ---------------------------------------------|104|

---------------------------------------------| tulāṃ divyāmbhasi pacedārdrāyāḥ kuṭajatvacaḥ||104|| nīrasāyāṃ tvaci kvāthe dadyātsūkṣmarajīkṛtān| samaṅgāphalinīmocarasān muṣṭyaṃśakānsamān||105|| taiśca śakrayavān pūte tato darvīpralepanam| paktvā'valehaṃ līḍhvā ca taṃ yathāgnivalaṃ pibet||106|| peyāṃ maṇḍaṃ payaschāgaṃ gabyaṃ vā chāgadugdhabhuk| leho'yaṃ śamayatyāśu raktātīsārapāyujān||107|| balavadraktapittaṃ ca sravadūrdhvamadho'pi vā| ---------------------------------------------|108|
