div.ab: ajīrṇinaḥ śleṣmavato vrajatyūrdhvaṃ virecanam| atitīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇamahṛdyamatibhūri vā||3|| tatra pūrvoditā vyāpatsiddhiśca, na tathā'pi cet| āśaye tiṣṭhati tatastṛtīyaṃ nāvacārayet||4|| anyatra sātmyāddhṛdyādvā bheṣajānnirapāyataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| asnigdhasvinnadehasya purāṇaṃ rūkṣamauṣadham||5||
doṣānutkleśya nirhartumaśaktaṃ janayedgadān| vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hidhmāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ tṛṣam||6||
piṇḍīkodveṣṭanaṃ kaṇḍūmūrvoḥ sādaṃ vivarṇatām| snigdhasvinnasya vā'tyalpaṃ dīptāgnerjīrṇamauṣadham||7||
śītairvā stabdhamāme vā samutkleśyāharanmalān| tāneva janayedrogānayogaḥ sarva eva saḥ||8||
taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ prastarasaṅkaraiḥ| nirūḍhaṃ jāṅgalarasairbhojayitvā'nuvāsayet||9||
phalamāgadhikādārusiddhatailena mātrayā| snigdhaṃ vātaharaiḥ snehaiḥ punastīkṣṇena śodhayet||10||
bahudoṣasya rūkṣasya mandāgneralpamauṣadham| sodāvartasya cotkleśya doṣān mārgān nirudhya taiḥ||11||
bhṛśamādhmāpayennābhiṃ pṛṣṭhapārśvaśirorujam| śvāsaṃ viṇmūtravātanāṃ saṅgaṃ kuryācca dāruṇam||12||
abhyaṅgasvedavartyādi sanirūhānuvāsanam| udāvartaharaṃ sarvaṃ karmādhmātasya śasyate||13||
pañcamūlayavakṣāravacābhūtikasaindhavaiḥ| yavāgūḥ sukṛtā śūlavibandhānāhanāśanī||14||

div.ab: pipalīdāḍimakṣārahiṅguśuṇṭhyamlavetasān| sasaindhavān pibenmadyaiḥ sarpiṣoṣṇodakena vā||15|| pravāhikāparisrāvavedanāparikartane| -------------------------------------|16|

----------------------------------------------------| pītauṣadhasya vegānāṃ nigrahānmārutādayaḥ||16|| kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham| hidhmāpārśvarujākāsadainyalālākṣivibhramaiḥ||17|| jihvāṃ khādati niḥsaṃjño dantān kaṭakaṭāyayan| na gacchedvibhramaṃ tatra vāmayedāśu taṃ bhiṣak||18|| madhuraiḥ pittamūrcchārtaṃ kaṭubhiḥ kaphamūrcchitam| pācanīyaistataśvāsya doṣaśeṣaṃ vipācayet||19|| kāyāgniṃ ca balaṃ cāsya krameṇābhipravardhayet| ---------------------------------------------------|20| gh|21|

----------------------------------------------------| pavanenātivamato hṛdayaṃ yasya pīḍyate||20|| tasmai snigdhāmlalavaṇān dadyātpittakaphe'nyathā| ----------------------------------------------------|21|

---------------------------------------------------| pītauṣadhasya vegānāṃ nigraheṇa kaphena vā||21|| ruddho'ti vā viśuddhasya gṛhṇātyaṅgāni mārutaḥ| stambhavepathunistodasādodveṣṭārtibhedanaiḥ||22|| tatra vātaharaṃ sarvaṃ snehasvedādi śasyate| ---------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| bahutīkṣṇaṃ kṣudhārtasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya bheṣajam||23||
hṛtvā''śu viṭpittakaphān dhātūnāsrāvayeddravān| tatrātiyoge madhuraiḥ śeṣamauṣadhamullikhet||24||
yojyo'ti vamane reko vireke vamanaṃ mṛdu| pariṣekāvagāhādyaiḥ suśītaiḥ stambhayecca tam||25||
añjanaṃ candanośīramajāsṛkśarkarodakam| lājacūrṇaiḥ pibenmanthamatiyogaharaṃ param||26||
vamanasyātiyoge tu śītāmbupariṣecitaḥ| pibetphalarasairmanthaṃ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram||27||
sodgārāyāṃ bhṛśaṃ chardyāṃ mūrvāyā dhānyamustayoḥ| samadhūkāñjanaṃ cūrṇaṃ lehayenmadhusaṃyutam||28||
vamato'ntaḥ praviṣṭāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ kavalagrahāḥ| snigdhāmlalavaṇā hṛdyā yūṣamāṃsarasā hitāḥ||29||
phalānyamlāni khādeyustasya cānye'grato narāḥ| niḥsṛtāṃ tu tiladrākṣākalkaliptāṃ praveśayet||30||
vāggrahānilarogeṣu ghṛtamāṃsopasādhitām| yavāgūṃ tanukāṃ dadyātsnehasvedau ca kālavit||31||
atiyogācca bhaiṣajyaṃ jīvaṃ harati śoṇitam| tajjīvādānamityuktamādatte jīvitaṃ yataḥ||32||
śune kākāya vā dadyāttenānnamasṛjā saha| bhukte'bhukte vadejjīvaṃ pittaṃ vā bheṣajeritam||33||
śuklaṃ vā bhāvitaṃ vastramāvānaṃ koṣṇavāriṇā| prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syātpitte śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite||34||
tṛṣṇāmūrcchāmadārtasya kuryādāmaraṇātkriyām| raktapittātisāraghnīṃ tasyāśu prāṇarakṣaṇīm||35||
mṛgagomahiṣājānāṃ sadyaskaṃ jīvatāmasṛk| pibejjīvābhisandhānaṃ jīvaṃ taddhyāśu gacchati||36||
tadeva darbhamṛditaṃ raktaṃ bastau niṣecayet| śyāmākāśmaryamadhukadūrvośīraiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ||37||
ghṛtamaṇḍāñjanayutaṃ bastiṃ vā yojayeddhimam| picchābastiṃ suśītaṃ vā ghṛtamaṇḍānuvāsanam||38||

div.ab: asyāmapyatiyogodbhavāyāmavasthāyāṃ gudabhraṃśaḥ sambhāvyata ityāha- gudaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ kaṣāyaiśca stambhayitvā praveśayet| ----------------------------------------------------|39|

------------------------------------------------| visaṃjñaṃ śrāvayetsāmaveṇugītādinisvanam|39| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhi- sthāne vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhirnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|3|

div.head: bastikalpādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bastikalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|

ab.seg: balāṃ guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ sarāsnāṃ dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palonmitāni| aṣṭau phalānyardhatulāṃ ca māṃsā- cchāgātpacedapsu caturthaśeṣam||1||
pūto yavānīphalabilvakuṣṭha- vacāśatāhvāghanapippalīnām| kalkairguḍakṣaudraghṛtaiḥ satailai- ryuktaḥ sukhoṣṇo lavaṇānvitaśca||2||
bastiḥ paraṃ sarvagadapramāthī svasthe hito jīvanabṛṃhaṇaśca| bastau ca yasmin paṭhito na kalkaḥ sarvatra dadyādamumeva tatra||3||
dvipañcamūlasya raso'mlayuktaḥ sacchāgamāṃsasya sapūrvapeṣyaḥ| trisnehayuktaḥ pravaro nirūhaḥ sarvānilavyādhiharaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ||4||
balāpaṭolīlaghupañcamūla- trāyantikairaṇḍayavātsusiddhāt| prastho rasācchāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamaḥ sa yāvat||5||
priyaṅgukṛṣṇāghanakalkayuktaḥ satailasarpirmadhusaindhavaśca| syāddīpano māṃsabalapradaśca cakṣurbalaṃ copadadhāti sadyaḥ||6||
eraṇḍamūlāttripalaṃ palāśā ttathā palāṃśaṃ laghupañcamūlam| rāsnābalāchinnaruhāśvagandhā- punarnavāragvadhadevadāru||7||
phalāni cāṣṭau salilāḍhakābhyāṃ vipācayedaṣṭamaśeṣite'smin| vacāśatāhvāhapuṣāpriyaṅgu- yaṣṭīkaṇāvatsakabījamustam||8||
dadyātsupiṣṭaṃ sahatārkṣyaśaila- makṣapramāṇaṃ lavaṇāṃśayuktam| samākṣikastailayutaḥ samūtro bastirjayellekhanadīpano'sau||9||
jaṅghorupādatrikapṛṣṭhakoṣṭha- hṛdguhyaśūlaṃ gurutāṃ vibandham| gulmāśmavardhmagrahaṇīgudotthāṃ- stāstāṃśca rogān kaphavātajātān||10||
yaṣṭyāhvarodhrābhayacandanaiśca śṛtaṃ payo'gryaṃ kamalotpalaiśca| saśarkarākṣaudraghṛtaṃ suśītaṃ pittāmayān hanti sajīvanīyam||11||
rāsnāṃ vṛṣaṃ lohitikāmanantāṃ balāṃ kanīyastṛṇapañcamūlyau| gopāṅganācandanapadmakarddhi- yaṣṭyāhvarodhrāṇi palārdhakāni||12||
niḥkvāthya toyena rasena tena śṛtaṃ payo'rdhāḍhakamambuhīnam| jīvantimedardhdivarīvidārī- vīrādvikākolikaserukābhiḥ||13||
sitopalājīvakapadmareṇu- prapauṇḍarīkotpalapuṇḍarīkaiḥ| rodhrātmaguptāmadhuyaṣṭikābhi- rnāgāhvamuñjātakacandanaiśca||14||
piṣṭairghṛtakṣaudrayutairnirūhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ śītalameva dadyāt| pratyāgate dhanvarasena śālīn kṣīreṇa vā'dyātpariṣiktagātraḥ||15||
dāhātisārapradarāsrapitta- hṛtpāṇḍurogān viṣamajvaraṃ ca| sagulmamūtragrahakāmalādīn sarvāmayān pittakṛtānnihanti||16||

div.ab: kośātakāragvadhadevadāru- mūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrākuṭajārkapāṭhāḥ| paktvā kulatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ||17|| tān sarṣapailāmadanaiḥ sakuṣṭhai- rakṣapramāṇaiḥ prasṛtaiśca yuktān| kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya||18|| dadyānnirūhaṃ kapharogitāya mandāgnaye cāśanavidviṣe ca| --------------------------- - ------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: --------------------------- - ------------------------------| vakṣye mṛdūn snehakṛto nirūhān sukhocitānāṃ prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak tu||19||

div.ab: athemān sukumārāṇāṃ nirūhān snehanān mṛdūn| karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak||20|| kṣīrād dvau prasṛtau kāryau madhutailaghṛtāttrayaḥ| khajena mathito bastirvātaghno balavarṇakṛt||21|| ekaikaḥ prasṛtastailaprasannākṣaudrasarpiṣām| bilvādimūlakvāthāddvau kaulatthāddvau sa vātajit||22|| paṭolanimbabhūtīkarāsnāsaptacchadāmbhasaḥ| prasṛtaḥ pṛthagājyācca bastiḥ sarṣapakalkavān||23|| sa pañcatikto'bhiṣyandakṛmikuṣṭhapramehahā| catvārastailagomūtradadhimaṇḍāmlakāñjikāt||24|| prasṛtāḥ sarṣapaiḥ piṣṭairviṭsaṅgānāhabhedanaḥ| payasyekṣusthirārāsnāvidārīkṣaudrasarpiṣām||25|| ekaikaḥ prasṛto bastiḥ kṛṣṇākalko vṛṣatvakṛt| ---------------------------------------------------|26|

---------------------------------------------------| siddhabastīnato vakṣye sarvadā yān prayojayet||26|| nirvyāpado bahuphalān balapuṣṭikarān sukhān| ---------------------------------------------------|27|

---------------------------------------------------| madhutaile same karṣaḥ saindhavāddvipicurmisiḥ||27|| eraṇḍamūlakvāthena nirūho mādhutailikaḥ| rasāyanaṃ pramehārśaḥkṛmigulmāntravṛddhinut||28|| sayaṣṭimadhukaścaiṣa cakṣuṣyo raktapittajit| ---------------------------------------------------|29|

---------------------------------------------------| prasṛtāṃśairghṛtakṣaudravasātailaiḥ prakalpayet||30|| yāpanaṃ saindhavārdhākṣahapuṣārdhapalānvitam| ---------------------------------------------------|31|
----------------------------------------------| eraṇḍamūlaniḥkvātho madhutailaṃ sasaindhavam||31|| eṣa yuktaratho bastiḥ savacāpippalīphalaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|32|
----------------------------------------------| sa kvātho madhuṣaḍgranthāśatāhvāhiṅgusaindhavam||32|| suradāru ca rāsnā ca bastirdoṣaharaḥ śivaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|33|

-------------------------------------------------| pañcamūlasya niḥkvāthastailaṃ māgadhikā madhu||33|| sasaindhavaḥ samadhukaḥ siddhabastiriti smṛtaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| dvipañcamūlatriphalāphalabilvāni pācayet||34||
gomūtre, tena piṣṭaiśca pāṭhāvatsakatoyadaiḥ| saphalaiḥ kṣaudratailābhyāṃ kṣāreṇa lavaṇena ca||35||
yukto bastiḥ kaphavyādhipāṇḍurogaviṣūciṣu| śukrānilavibandheṣu bastyāṭope ca pūjitaḥ||36||

div.ab: mustāpāṭhāmṛtairaṇḍabalārāsnāpunarnavāḥ| mañjiṣṭhāragvadhośīratrāyamāṇākṣarohiṇīḥ||37|| kanīyaḥ pañcamūlaṃ ca pālikaṃ, madanāṣṭakam| jalāḍhake pacettacca pādaśeṣaṃ parisrutam||38|| kṣīradviprasthasaṃyuktaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ punaḥ pacet| sapādajāṅgalarasaḥ sasarpirmadhusaindhavaḥ||39|| piṣṭairyaṣṭimisiśyāmākaliṅgakarasāñjanaiḥ| bastiḥ sukhoṣṇo māṃsāgnibalaśukravivarddhanaḥ||40|| vātāsṛṅmohamehārśogulmaviṇmūtrasaṅgrahān| viṣamajvaravīsarpavardhmādhmānapravāhikāḥ||41|| vaṅkṣaṇorukaṭīkukṣimanyāśrotraśirorujaḥ| hanyādasṛgdaronmādaśophakāsāśmakuṇḍalān||42|| cakṣuṣyaḥ putrado rājā yāpanānāṃ rasāyanam| -----------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| mṛgāṇāṃ laghuvadrā(ḍrā)ṇāṃ daśamūlasya cāmbhasā||43||
hapuṣāmisigāṅgeyīkalkairvātaharaḥ param| niruho'tyarthavṛṣyaśca mahāsnehasamanvitaḥ||44||

div.ab: mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrapādaviṭtuṇḍavarjitam| laghunā pañcamūlena pālikena samanvitam||45|| paktvā kṣīrajale kṣīraśeṣaṃ saghṛtamākṣikam| tadvidārīkaṇāyaṣṭiśatāhvāphalakalkavat||46|| bastirīṣatpaṭuyutaḥ paramaṃ balaśukrakṛt| ---------------------------------------------|47|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| kalpaneyaṃ pṛthak kāryā tittiriprabhṛtiṣvapi||47||
viṣkireṣu samasteṣu pratudaprasaheṣu ca| jalacāriṣu tadvacca matsyeṣu kṣīravarjitā||48||
godhānakulamārjāraśalyakondurajaṃ palam| pṛthak daśapalaṃ kṣīre pañcamūlaṃ ca sādhayet||49||
tatpayaḥ phalavaidehīkalkadvilavaṇānvitam| sasitātailamadhvājyo bastiryojyo rasāyanam||50||
vyāyāmamathitoraskakṣīṇendriyabalaujasām| vibaddhaśukraviṇmūtrakhuḍavātavikāriṇām||51||
gajavājirathakṣobhabhagnajarjaritātmanām| punarnavatvaṃ kurute vājīkaraṇamuttamam||52||

div.ab: siddhena payasā bhojyamātmaguptoccaṭekṣuraiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: snehāṃścāyantraṇān siddhān siddhadravyaiḥ prakalpayet| --------------------------------------------------------||53||

div.ab: doṣaghnāḥ saparīhārā vakṣyante snehabastayaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| daśamūlaṃ balāṃ rāsnāmaśvagandhāṃ punarnavām||54||
guḍucyairaṇḍabūtīkabhārgīvṛṣakarohiṣam| śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palāṃśakam||55||
yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthān prasṛtonmitān| vahe vipācya toyasya droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca||56||
pacettailāḍhakaṃ peṣyairjīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ| anuvāsanamityetatsarvavātavikāranut||57||

div.ab: ānūpānāṃ vasā tadvajjīvanīyopasādhitā| --------------------------------------|58|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śatāhvāciribilvāmlaistailaṃ siddhaṃ samīraṇe||58||

div.ab: saindhavenāgnivarṇena taptaṃ cānilajid ghṛtam| -------------------------------------------------|59|

-------------------------------------------------| jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām||59|| śatāhvarṣabhakau kṛṣṇāṃ kākanāsāṃ śatāvarīm| svaguptāṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ śaṭhīṃ vacām||60|| piṣṭvā tailaghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayettaccaturguṇe| bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātapittaghnaṃ balaśukrāgnivardhanam||61|| rajaḥśukrāmayaharaṃ putrīyaṃ cānuvāsanam| -------------------------------------------------|62|

-----------------------------------------------| saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā||62|| hrīberaṃ madhukaṃ bhārṅgī devadāru sakaṭphalam| nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī||63|| viḍaṅgātiviṣe śyāmā hareṇurnīlinī sthirā| bilvājamodacapalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ samaiḥ||64|| sādhyameraṇḍatailaṃ vā tailaṃ vā kapharoganut| vardhmodāvartagulmārśaḥplīhamehāḍhyamārutān||65|| ānāhamaśmarīṃ cāśu hanyāttadanuvāsanam| -----------------------------------------------|66|

ab.seg: -----------kalpayettailaṃ dravyairvā kaphaghātibhiḥ| phalairaṣṭaguṇaiścāmlaiḥ siddhamanvāsanaṃ kaphe||67||
mṛdubastijaḍībhūte tīkṣṇo'nyo bastiriṣyate| tīkṣṇairvikarṣite snigdho madhuraḥ śiśiro mṛduḥ||68||
tīkṣṇatvaṃ mūtrapīlvagnilavaṇakṣārasarṣapaiḥ| prāptakālaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kṣīrājyādyaistu mārdavam||69||
balakālarogadoṣaprakṛtīḥ pravibhajya yojito bastiḥ| svaiḥ svairauṣadhavargaiḥ svān svān rogānnivartayati||70||
uṣṇārtānāṃ śītāñchītārtānāṃ tathā sukhoṣṇāṃśca| tadyogyauṣadhayuktān bastīn saṃtarkya yuñjīta||71||

div.ab: bastīnna bṛṃhaṇīyān dadyādvyādhiṣu viśodhanīyeṣu|72|

ab.seg: medasvino viśodhyā ye ca narāḥ kuṣṭhamehārtāḥ||72||

div.ab: na kṣīṇakṣatadurbalamūrcchitakṛśaśuṣkaśuddhadehānām| dadyādviśodhanīyān doṣanibaddhāyuṣo ye ca|73| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhisthāna bastikalpo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|4|

div.head: vastivyāpatsiddhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: asmādanantaraṃ bastivyāpatsiddhirvyākhyāyate----||1|| athāto bastivyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|

asnigdhasvinnadehasya gurukoṣṭhasya yojitaḥ| śīto'lpasnehalavaṇadravyamātro ghano'pi vā||1|| bastiḥ saṅkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvādanirharan| karotyayogaṃ tena syādvātamūtraśakṛdagrahaḥ||2|| nābhibastirujā dāho hṛllepaḥ śvayathurgude| kaṇḍūrgaṇḍāni vaivarṇyamaratirvahnimārdavam||3|| kvāthadvayaṃ prāgvihitaṃ madhyadoṣe'tisāriṇi| uṣṇasya tasmādekasya tatra pānaṃ praśasyate||4|| phalavartyastathā svedāḥ kālaṃ jñātvā virecanam| bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān||5|| surādimūtravān bastiḥ saprākpeṣyastamānayet| ---------------------------------------------|6|

-----------------------------------------------| yukto'lpavīryo doṣāḍhye rūkṣe krūrāśaye'thavā||6|| bastirdoṣāvṛto rūddhamārgo rundhyātsamīraṇam| sa vimārgo'nilaḥ kuryādādhmānaṃ marmapīḍanam||7|| vidāhaṃ gudakoṣṭhasya muṣkavaṅkṣaṇavedanām| ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlairitaścetaśca dhāvati||8|| svabhyaktasvinnagātrasya tatra vartiṃ prayojayet| bilvādiśca nirūhaḥ syātpīlusarṣapamūtravān||9|| saralāmaradārubhyāṃ sādhitaṃ cānuvāsanam| -----------------------------------------------|10|

-----------------------------------------------| kurvato vegasaṃrodhaṃ pīḍito vā'timātrayā||10|| asnigdhalavaṇoṣṇo vā bastiralpo'lpabheṣajaḥ| mṛdurvā mārutenordhvaṃ vikṣipto mukhanāsikāt||11|| nireti mūrcchāhṛllāsatṛḍdāhādīn pravartayan| mūrcchāvikāraṃ dṛṣṭvā'sya siñcecchītāmbunā mukham||12|| vyejadāklamanāśācca prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kārayet| pṛṣṭhapārśvodaraṃ mṛjyāt karairuṣṇairadhomukham||13|| keśeṣūtkṣipya dhunvīta bhīṣayedvyāladaṃṣṭribhiḥ| śastrolkārājapuruṣairbastireti tathā hyadhaḥ||14|| pāṇivastrairgalāpīḍaṃ kuryānna mriyate tathā| prāṇodānanirodhāddhi suprasiddhatarāyanaḥ||15|| apānaḥ pavano bastiṃ tamāśvevāpakarṣati| kuṣṭhakramukakalkaṃ ca pāyetāmlasaṃyutam||16|| oṣṇyāttaikṣṇyātsaratvācca bastiṃ so'syānulomayet gomūtreṇa trivṛtpathyākalkaṃ vā'dhonulomanam||17|| pakvāśayasthite svinne nirūho dāśamūlikaḥ| yavakolakulatthaiśca vidheyo mūtrasādhitaiḥ||18|| bastirgomūtrasiddhairvā sāmṛtāvaṃśapallavaiḥ| pūtīkarañjatvakpatraśaṭhīdevāhvarohiṣaiḥ||19|| satailaguḍasindhūttho virekauṣadhakalkavān| bilvādipañcamūlena siddho bastiruraḥsthite||20|| śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ| -----------------------------------------------|21|

-----------------------------------------------| bastiratyuṣṇatīkṣṇāmlaghano'tisveditasya vā||21|| alpe doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥpunaḥ| atiyogatvamāpanno bhavetkukṣirujākaraḥ||22|| virecanātiyogena sa tulyākṛtisādhanaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|23|

---------------------------------------------------| bastiḥ kṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇaḥ paittikasya vā||23|| gudaṃ dahan likhan kṣiṇvan karotyasya parisravam| sa vidagdhaṃ sravatyasraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ||24|| bahuśaścātivegena mohaṃ gacchati so'sakṛt| raktapittātisāraghnī kriyā tatra praśasyate||25|| dāhādiṣu trivṛtkalkaṃ mṛdvīkāvāriṇā pibet| taddhi pittaśakṛdvātān hṛtvā dāhādikān jayet||26|| viśuddhaśca pibecchītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarāyutām| yuñyādvā'tiviriktasya kṣīṇaviṭkasya bhojanam||27|| māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pānaṃ dadhyathavā surām| siddhirvastyāpadāmevaṃ------------------------|28|
śīto'lpo vā'dhike vāte pitte'tyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ| atibhukte gururvarcaḥsañcaye'lpabalastathā||29|| dattastairāvṛtaḥ sneho nāyātyabhibhavādapi| -----------------------------------------------|30|

-----------------------------------------------| stambhorusadanādhmānajvaraśūlāṅgamardanaiḥ||30|| pārśvarugveṣṭanairvidyādvāyunā snehamāvṛtam| snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇaistaṃ rāsnāpītadrutailikaiḥ||31|| sauvīrakasurākolakulatthayavasādhitaiḥ| nirūhairnirharetsamyak samūtraiḥ pāñcamūlikaiḥ||32|| tābhyāmeva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte'nuvāsayet| -----------------------------------------------|33|
-----------------------------------------------| tṛḍdāharāgasammohavaivarṇyatamakajvaraiḥ||33|| vidyātpittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktaistaṃ bastibhirharet| -----------------------------------------------|34|

-----------------------------------------------| tandrāśītajvarālasyaprasekārucigauravaiḥ||34|| sammūrcchāglānibhirvidyācchleṣmaṇā snehamāvṛtam| kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaiḥ surāmūtropasādhitaiḥ||35|| phalatailayutaiḥ sāmlairbastibhistaṃ vinirharet| -----------------------------------------------|36|

-----------------------------------------------| chardimūrcchāruciglāniśūlanidrāṅgamardanaiḥ||36|| āmaliṅgaiḥ sadāhaistaṃ vidyādatyaśanāvṛtam| kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiścūrṇaiśca pācanam||37|| mṛdurvirekaḥ sarvaṃ ca tatrāmavihitaṃ hitam| -----------------------------------------------|38|

--------------------------------------------------| viṇmūtrānilasaṅgārtigurutvādhmānahṛdgrahaiḥ||38|| snehaṃ viḍāvṛtaṃ jñātvā snehasvedaiḥ savartibhiḥ| śyāmābilvādisiddhaiśca niruhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ||39|| nirharedvidhinā samyagudāvartahareṇa ca| --------------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: gude praṇihitaḥ sneho vegāddhāvatyanāvṛtaḥ| ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhādūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya etyapi||41||
mūtraśyāmātrivṛtsiddho yavakolakulatthavān| tatsiddhatailo deyaḥ syānnirūhaḥ sānuvāsanaḥ||42||
kaṇṭhādāgacchataḥ stambhakaṇṭhagrahavirecanaiḥ| chardighnībhiḥ kriyābhiśca tasya kuryānnibarhaṇam||43||

div.ab: nāpakvaṃ praṇayetsnehaṃ gudaṃ sa hyupalimpati| tataḥ kuryātsaruṅmohakaṇḍūśophān, kriyā'tra ca||44|| tīkṣṇo bastistathā tailamarkapatrarase śṛtam| --------------------------------------------------|45|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| anucchvāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā||45||
praviśya kṣubhito vāyuḥ śūlatodakaro bhavet| tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vātaghnānyaśanāni ca||46||

div.ab: drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā| syāt kaṭīgudajaṅghorubastistambhārtibhedanam||47|| bhojanaṃ tatra vātaghnaṃ svedābhyaṅgāḥ sabastayaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------| pīḍyamāne'ntarā mukte gude pratihato'nilaḥ||48||
uraḥśirorujaṃ sādamūrvośca janayedbalī| bastiḥ syāttatra bilvādiphalaśyāmādimūtravān||49||
atiprapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhatyāyāti vā galam| tatra bastirvirekaśca galapīḍādi karma ca||50||

div.ab: vamanādyairviśuddhaṃ ca kṣāmadehabalānalam| yathā'ṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ yathā tathā||51|| bhiṣak prayatnato rakṣetsarvasmādapacārataḥ| ----------------------------------------------|52|

----------------------------------------------| dadyānmadhurahṛdyāni tato'mlalavaṇau rasau|52| svādutiktau tato bhūyaḥ kaṣāyakaṭukau tataḥ| anyonyapratyanīkānāṃ rasānāṃ snigdharūkṣayoḥ|53| vyatyāsādupayogena kramāttaṃ prakṛtiṃ nayet| sarvaṃsahaḥ sthirabalo vijñeyaḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ|54| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhisthāne bastivyāpatsiddhirnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|5|

div.head: dravyakalpādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: api ca sarveṣāṃ rogāṇaṃ yā siddhiḥ-praśamopāyaḥ, so'pi sadbheṣajaprayogādeva| ityāha---- athāto dravyakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|

ab.seg: dhanve sādhāraṇe deśe same sanmṛttike śucau| śmaśānacaityāyatanaśvabhravalmīkavarjite|1| mṛdau pradakṣiṇajale kuśarohiṣasaṃstṛte| aphālakṛṣṭe'nākrānte pādapairbalavattaraiḥ||2||
śasyate bheṣajaṃ jātaṃ, yuktaṃ varṇarasādibhiḥ| jantvajagdhaṃ davādagdhamavidagdhaṃ ca vaikṛtaiḥ||3||
bhūtaiśchāyāyātapāmbvādyairyathākālaṃ ca sevitam| avagāḍhamahāmūlamudīcīṃ diśamāśritam||4||
|mahendrarāmakṛṣṇānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi| tapasā tejasā vā'pi praśāmyadhvaṃ śivāya vai||1||
mantreṇānena matimān sarvamapyauṣadhaṃ nayet| ] atha kalyāṇacaritaḥ śrāddhaḥ śucirupoṣitaḥ| gṛhṇīyādauṣadhaṃ susthaṃ sthitaṃ kāle ca kalpayet||5||
sakṣīraṃ tadasampattāvanatikrāntavatsaram| ṛte guḍaghṛtakṣaudradhānyakṛṣṇāviḍaṅgataḥ||6||
payo bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ tacca nīrujām| vayobalavatāṃ dhātupicchaśṛṅgakhurādikam||7||

div.ab: kaṣāyayonayaḥ pañca rasā lavaṇavarjitāḥ| rasaḥ kalkaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaśceti prakalpanā||8|| pañcadhaiva kaṣāyāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ purvaṃ balādhikā| -------------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------tanmānakalpane| yuñjyādvyādhyādibalatastathā ca vacanaṃ muneḥ||11||
mātrāyā na vyavasthā'sti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ| ālocya deśakālau ca yojyā tadvacca kalpanā||12||

div.ab: madhyaṃ tu mānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ svarasasya catuṣpalam| -----------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| peṣyasya karṣamāloḍyaṃ tad dravasya palatraye||13||

div.ab: kvāthaṃ dravyapale kuryātprasthārdhaṃ pādaśeṣitam| -----------------------------------------------------|14|
snehapāke tvamānoktau caturguṇavivardhitam| kalkasnehadravaṃ yojyam-------------------|15|

ab.seg: snehesidhdyati śuddhāmbuniḥkvāthasvarasaiḥ kramāt| kalkasya yojayedaṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṣṭamam||16||

div.ab: pṛthak snehasamaṃ dadyātpañcaprabhṛti tu dravam| ---------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| nāṅguligrāhitā kalke na snehe'gnau saśabdatā||17||
varṇādisampacca yadā tadainaṃ śīghramāharet| ghṛtasya phenopaśamastailasya tu tadudbhavaḥ||18||

div.ab: lehasya tantumattā'psu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca| ----------------------------------------------|19|

----------------------------------------------| pākastu trividho mandaścikkaṇaḥ kharacikkaṇaḥ||19|| mandaḥ kalkasame kiṭṭe cikkaṇo madanopame| kiñcitsīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartya(rti)māne ca paścimaḥ||20|| dagdho'ta ūrdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syādāmastvagnisādakṛt| ----------------------------------------------|21|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| mṛdurnasye, kharo'bhyaṅge, pāne bastau ca cikkaṇaḥ||21||
adhunā mānasaṅkhyāyāḥ yathāsvaṃ saṃjñāsaṃvidhānārthamāha---- śāṇaṃ pāṇitalaṃ muṣṭiṃ kuḍavaṃ prasthamāḍhakam| droṇaṃ vahaṃ ca kramaśo vijānīyāccaturguṇam||22||

div.ab: dviguṇaṃ yojayedārdraṃ kuḍavādi tathā dravam| ----------------------------------------------|23|

----------------------------------------------| peṣaṇāloḍane vāri snehapāke ca nirdrave||23|| kalpayetsadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam| kalkīkuryācca bhaiṣajyamanirūpitakalpanam||24|| aṅgānuktau tu mūlaṃ syādaprasiddhau tadeva tu| ----------------------------------------------|25|

| ṣaḍvaṃśyastu marīcī syāt, ṣaṇmarīcyastu sarṣapaḥ| taṇḍulaḥ sarṣapāstvaṣṭau, dhānyamāṣastu tau, yavaḥ||1|| tāvaṇḍikā caturbhistairmāṣakaḥ śāṇakastathā| ] dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṃkṣaṇaśca, tau||25|| akṣam picuḥ pāṇitalaṃ suvarṇaṃ kavalagrahaḥ| karṣo biḍālapadakaṃ tindukaḥ pāṇimānikā||26|| śabdānyatvamabhinne'rthe śuktiraṣṭamikā picū| palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭirāmraṃ caturthikā||27|| dve pale prasṛtastau dvāvañjalistau tu mānikā| āḍhakaṃ bhājanaṃ kaṃso, droṇaḥ kumbho ghaṭo'rmaṇam||28|| tulā palaśataṃ, tāni viṃśatirbhāra ucyate| -------------------------------------------------|29|

himavadvindhyaśailābhyāṃ prāyo vyāptā vasundharā|29| saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca tatrādyamāgneyaṃ vaindhyamauṣadham| 29 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhisthāne dravyakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

div.head: bālopacaraṇīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bālopacaraṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: jātamātraṃ viśodhyolbādbālaṃ saindhavasarpiṣā| prasūtikleśitaṃ cānu balātailena secayet||1||
aśmanorvādanaṃ cāsya karṇamūle samācaret| athāsya dakṣiṇe karṇe mantramuccārayedimam||2||
tameva mantramāha ---- "aṅgādaṅgātsambhavasi hṛdayādabhijāyase| ātmā vai putranāmāsi sañjīva śaradāṃ śatam||3||
śatāyuḥ śatavarṣo'si dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi| nakṣatrāṇi diśo rātrirahaśca tvā'bhirakṣatu"||4||

div.ab: svasthībhūtasya nābhiṃ ca sūtreṇa caturaṅgulāt| badhdvordhvaṃ vardhayitvā ca grīvāyāmavasañjayet||5|| nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭatailena secayetsnāpayedanu| kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa sarvagandhodakena vā||6|| koṣṇena taptarajatatapanīyanimajjanaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|7|

-------------------------------------------------| tato dakṣiṇatarjanyā tālūnnamyāvaguṇṭhayet||7|| śirasi snehapicunā, prāśyaṃ cāsya prayojayet| hareṇumātraṃ medhāyurbalārthamabhimantritam||8|| aindrībrāhmīvacāśaṅkhapuṣpīkalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu| -------------------------------------------------|9|
-------------------------------------------------| cāmīkaravacābrāhmītāpyapathyā rajīkṛtāḥ||9|| lihyānmadhughṛtopetā hemadhātrīrajo'thavā| -------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| garbhāmbhaḥ saindhavavatā sarpiṣā vāmayettataḥ||10||

div.ab: prājāpatyena vidhinā jātakarmāṇi kārayet| -------------------------------------------------|11|

stanyapravartanahetumāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| sirāṇāṃ hṛdayasthānāṃ vivṛtatvāt prasūtitaḥ||11|| tṛtīye'hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate| -------------------------------------------------|12|
-------------------------------------------------| prathame divase tasmāttrikālaṃ madhusarpiṣī||12|| anantāmiśrite mantrapāvite prāśayecchiśum| -------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ tṛtīye ca ghṛtaṃ, tataḥ||13||
prāṅniṣiddhastanasyāsya tatpāṇitalasammitam| stanyānupānaṃ dvau kālau navanītaṃ prayojayet||14||

div.ab: mātureva pibetstanyaṃ tadhdyalaṃ dehavṛddhaye| stanyadhātryāvubhe kārye tadasampadi vatsale||15|| avyaṅge brahmacāriṇyau varṇaprakṛtitaḥ same| nīruje madhyavayasau jīvadvatse na lolupe||16|| hitāhāravihāreṇa yatnādupacarecca te| -------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śukkrodhalaṅghanāyāsāḥ stanyanāśasya hetavaḥ||17||
stanyasya sīdhuvarjyāni madyānyānūpajā rasāḥ| kṣīraṃ kṣīriṇya oṣadhyaḥ śokādeśca viparyayaḥ||18||
viruddhāhārabhuktāyāḥ kṣudhitāyā vicetasaḥ| praduṣṭadhātorgarbhiṇyāḥ stanyaṃ rogakaraṃ śiśoḥ||19||
stanyābhāve payaśchāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet| hrasvena pañcamūlena sthirābhyāṃ vā sitāyutam||20||
ṣaṣṭhīṃ niśāṃ viśeṣeṇa kṛtarakṣābalikriyāḥ| jāgṛyurbāndhavāstasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam||21||
daśame divase pūrṇe vidhibhiḥ svakulocitaiḥ| kārayetsūtikotthānaṃ nāma bālasya cārcitam||22||
bibhrato'ṅgairmanohlālarocanāgurucandanam| nakṣatradevatāyuktaṃ bāndhavaṃ vā samākṣaram||23||
tataḥ prakṛtibhedoktarūpairāyuḥparīkṣaṇam| prāgudakśirasaḥ kuryāt bālasya jñānavān bhiṣak||24||
śucidhautopadhānāni nirvalīni mṛdūni ca| śayyāstaraṇavāsāṃsi rakṣoghnairdhūpitāni ca||25||

div.ab: kāko viśastaḥ śastaśca dhūpane trivṛtānvitaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|26|

-------------------------------------------------| jīvatkhaṅgādiśṛṅgotthān sadā bālaḥ śubhān maṇīn||26|| dhārayedauṣadhīḥ śreṣṭhā brāhmayaindrījīvakādikāḥ| hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣātsatataṃ vacām||27|| āyurmedhāsmṛtisvāsthyakarīṃ rakṣobhirakṣiṇīm| -------------------------------------------------|28|

-------------------------------------------------| ṣaṭsaptāṣṭamamāseṣu nīrujasya śubhe'hani||28|| karṇau himāgame vidhyeddhātryaṅkasthasya sāntvayan| -------------------------------------------------|29|

kuta ityāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| prāgdakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣagvāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ||29|| dakṣiṇena dadhatsūcīṃ pālimanyena pāṇinā| madhyataḥ karṇapīṭhasya kiñcidgaṇḍāśrayaṃ prati||30|| jarāyumātrapracchanne raviraśmyavabhāsite| dhṛtasya niścalaṃ samyagalaktakarasāṅkite||31|| vidhyeddaivakṛte chidre sakṛdevarju lāghavāt| nordhvaṃ na pārśvato nādhaḥ-----------------|32|

ab.seg: kālikāmarmarīraktāḥ tadvyadhādrāgarugjvarāḥ| saśophadāhasaṃrambhamanyāstambhāpatānakāḥ||33||

div.ab: teṣāṃ yathāmayaṃ kuryādvibhajyāśu cikitsitam| -------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sthāne vyadhānna rudhiraṃ na rugrāgādisambhavaḥ||34||
snehāktaṃ sūcyanusyūtaṃ sūtraṃ cānu nidhāpayet| āmatailena siñcecca bahalāṃ tadvadārayā||35||
vidhyetpālīṃ hitabhujaḥ sañcāryā'tha sthavīyasī| vartistryahāttato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||36||
athainaṃ jātadaśanaṃ krameṇāpanayetstanāt| pūrvoktaṃ yojayetkṣīramannaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam||37||
priyālamajjamadhukamadhulājasitopalaiḥ| apastanasya saṃyojyaḥ prīṇano modakaḥ śiśoḥ||38||
dīpano bālabilvailāśarkarālājasaktubhiḥ| saṅgrāhī dhātukīpuṣpaśarkarālājatarpaṇaiḥ||39||
rogāṃścāsya jayetsomyairbheṣajairaviṣādakaiḥ| anyatrātyayikādvyāghervirekaṃ sutarāṃ tyajet||40||

div.ab: trāsayennāvidheyaṃ taṃ trastaṃ gṛhṇanti hi grahāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|41|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| vastravātāt parasparśāt pālayellaṅghanācca tam||41||

div.ab: brāhmīsiddhārthakavacāsārivākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ| sakaṇaiḥ sādhitaṃ pītaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtikṛd ghṛtam||42|| āyuṣyaṃ pāpmarakṣoghnaṃ bhūtonmādanibarhaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|43|

-------------------------------------------------| vacendulekhāmaṇḍūkīśaṅkhapuṣpīśatāvarīḥ||43|| brahmasomāmṛtābrāhmīḥ kalkīkṛtya palāṃśikāḥ| aṣṭāṅgaṃ vipacetsarpiḥ prasthaṃ kṣīracaturguṇam||44|| tatpītaṃ dhanyamāyuṣyaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtibuddhikṛt| -------------------------------------------------|45|

-------------------------------------------------| ajākṣīrābhayāvyoṣapāṭhogrāśigrusaindhavaiḥ||45|| siddhaṃ sārasvataṃ sarpirvāṅmodhāsmṛtivahnikṛt| -------------------------------------------------|46|
-------------------------------------------------| vacāmṛtāśaṭhīpathyāśaṅkhinīvellanāgaraiḥ||46|| apāmārgeṇa ca ghrutaṃ sādhitaṃ pūrvavadguṇaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|

-------------------------------------------------| hema śvetavacā kuṣṭhamarkapuṣpī sakāñcanā||47|| hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā| catvāra ete pādoktāḥ prāśā madhughṛtaplutāḥ||48|| varṣaṃ līḍhā vapurmedhābalavarṇakarāḥ śubhāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|

-------------------------------------------------| vacāyaṣṭyāhvasindhūtthapathyānāgaradīpyakaiḥ|49| śudhdyate vāgghavirlīḍhaiḥ sakuṣṭhakaṇajīrakaiḥ| 49 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālo- pacaraṇīyo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|1|

div.head: bālāmayapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2| trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ| svāsthyaṃ tābhyāmaduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasambhavaḥ|1|

ab.seg: śuddhaṃ kṣīraṃ lakṣayati ---- athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2| trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ| svāsthyaṃ tābhyāmaduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasambhavaḥ||1||
-------------------------------------------------| pittāduṣṇāmlakaṭukaṃ pītarājyapsu dāhakṛt||3||

div.ab: kaphātsalavaṇaṃ sāndraṃ jale majjati picchilam| -------------------------------------------------|4|

-------------------------------------------------| saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ saṃsargāttriliṅgaṃ sānnipātikam||4|| yathāsvaliṅgāṃstadvyādhīn janayatyupayojitam| -------------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śiśostīkṣṇamabhīkṣṇaṃ ca rodanāllakṣayedrujam||5||

div.ab: sa yaṃ spṛśedbhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ| tatra vidyādrujaṃ----------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: hṛdi jihvauṣṭhadaśanaśvāsamuṣṭinipīḍanaiḥ| koṣṭhe vibandhavamathustanadaṃśāntrakūjanaiḥ||7||
ādhmānapṛṣṭhanamanajaṭharonnamanairapi| bastau guhye ca viṇmūtrasaṅgottrāsadigīkṣaṇaiḥ||8||

div.ab: atha dhātryāḥ kriyāṃ kuryādyathādoṣaṃ yathāmayam| -------------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| tatra vātātmake stanye daśamūlaṃ tryahaṃ pibet||9||
athavā'gnivacāpāṭhākaṭukākuṣṭhadīpyakam| sabhārgīdārusaralavṛścikālīkaṇoṣaṇam||10||

div.ab: tataḥ pibedanyatamaṃ vātavyādhiharaṃ ghṛtam| anu cācchasurāmevaṃ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecayet||11|| bastikarma tataḥ kuryātsvedādīṃścānilāpahān| -------------------------------------------------|12|
-------------------------------------------------| rāsnājamodāsaraladevadārurajonvitam||12|| bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tairvā vipakvaṃ sasitopalam| -------------------------------------------------|13|

-------------------------------------------------| pittaduṣṭe'mṛtābhīrupaṭolīnimbacandanam||13|| dhātrī kumāraśca pibet kvāthayitvā sasārivam| athavā triphalāmustabhūnimbakaṭurohiṇīḥ||14|| sārivādiṃ paṭolādiṃ padmakādiṃ tathā gaṇam| ghṛtānyebhiśca siddhāni pittaghnaṃ ca virecanam||15|| śītāṃścābhyaṅgalepādīn yuñjyāt--------------| -------------------------------------------------|16|

--------------------------------śleṣmātmake punaḥ| yaṣṭyāhvasaindhavayutaṃ kumāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam||16|| sindhūtthapippalīmadvā, piṣṭaiḥ, kṣaudrayutairatha| rāṭhapuṣpaiḥ stanau limpecchiśośca daśanacchadau||17|| sukhamevaṃ vamedbālaḥ-------------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| athācaritasaṃsargī mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet||18||
tadvattagarapṛthvīkāsuradārukaliṅgakān| athavā'tiviṣāmustaṣaḍgranthāpañcakolakam||19||
stanye tridoṣamaline durgandhyāmaṃ jalopamam| vibaddhamacchaṃ vicchinnaṃ phenilaṃ copaveśyate||20||
śakṛnnānāvyathāvarṇaṃ, mūtraṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanam| jvarārocakatṛṭchardiśuṣkodgāravijṛmbhikāḥ||21||
aṅgabhaṅgo'ṅgavikṣepaḥ kūjanaṃ vepathurbhramaḥ| ghrāṇākṣimukhapākādyā jāyante'nye'pi taṃ gadam||22||
kṣīrālasakamityāhuratyayaṃ cātidāruṇam tatrāśu dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopapādayet||23||
vihitāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ vacādiṃ yojayedgaṇam| niśādiṃ vā'thavā mādrīpāṭhātiktāghanāmayān||24||
pāṭhāśuṇṭhyamṛtātiktatiktādevāhvasārivāḥ| samustamūrvendrayavāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param||25||

div.ab: anubandhe yathāvyādhi pratikurvīta kālavit| -------------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dantodbhedaśca rogāṇāṃ sarveṣāmapi kāraṇam||26||
viśeṣājjavaraviḍbhedakāsacchardiśirorujām| abhiṣyandasya pothakyā visarpasya ca jāyate||27||
pṛṣṭhabhaṅge biḍālānāṃ barhiṇāṃ ca śikhodgame| dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcinna dūyate||28||
yathādoṣaṃ yathārogaṃ yathodrekaṃ yathābhayam| vibhajya deśakālādīṃstatra yojyaṃ bhiṣagjitam||29||

div.ab: ta eva doṣā dūṣyāśca jvarādyā vyādhayaśca yat| atastadeva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tvasya kanīyasī||30|| saukumāryālpakāyatvāt sarvānnānupasevanāt| --------------------------------------------|31|
-----------------------------------------------| snigdhā eva sadā bālā ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt||31|| sadyastān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayenmatimān mṛdu| -----------------------------------------------|32|
---------------------------------------------| stanyasya tṛptaṃ vamayet kṣīrakṣīrānnasevinam||32|| pītavantaṃ tanuṃ peyāmannādaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutām| ---------------------------------------------|33|
---------------------------------------------| bastiṃ sādhye virekeṇa, marśena pratimarśanam||33|| yuñjayādvirecanādīṃstu dhātryā eva yathoditān| ---------------------------------------------|34|
---------------------------------------------| mūrvāvyoṣavarākolajambūtvakdārusarṣapāḥ||34|| sapāṭhā madhunā līḍhāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param| ---------------------------------------------|35|
---------------------------------------------| dantapālīṃ samadhunā cūrṇena pratisārayet||35|| pippalyā dhātakīpuṣpadhātrīphalakṛtena vā| ---------------------------------------------|36|
---------------------------------------------| lāvatittirivallūrarajaḥ puṣparasadrutam||36|| drutaṃ karoti bālānāṃ dantakesaravanmukham| ---------------------------------------------|37|
---------------------------------------------| vacādvibṛhatīpāṭhākaṭukātiviṣāghanaiḥ||37|| madhuraiśca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśanajanmani| ---------------------------------------------|38|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| rajanīdārusaralaśreyasībṛhatīdvayam||38||
pṛśniparṇī śatāhvā ca līḍhaṃ mākṣikasarpiṣā| grahaṇīdīpanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mārutasyānulomanam||39||
atīsārajvaraśvāsakāmalāpāṇḍukāsanut| bālasya sarvarogeṣu pūjitaṃ balavarṇadaṃ||40||

div.ab: samaṅgādhātakīrodhrakuṭannaṭabalādvayaiḥ| mahāsahākṣudrasahāmudgabilvaśalāṭubhiḥ||41|| sakārpāsīphalaistoye sādhitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam| kṣīramastuyutaṃ hanti śīghraṃ dantodbhavodbhavān||42|| vividhānāmayānetadvṛddhakāśyapanirmitam| ---------------------------------------------|43|
---------------------------------------------| dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu na bālamatiyantrayet||43|| svayamapyupaśāmyanti jātadantasya yadgadāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|44|

-----------------------------------------------| atyahaḥsvapnaśītāmbuślaiṣmikastanyasevinaḥ||44|| śiśoḥ kaphena ruddheṣu srotaḥsu rasavāhiṣu| arocakaḥ pratiśyāyo jvaraḥ kāsaśca jāyate||45|| kumāraḥ śuṣyati tataḥ snigdhaśuklamukhekṣaṇaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|46|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| saindhavavyoṣaśārṅgeṣṭāpāṭhāgirikadambakān||46||
śuṣyato madhusarpirbhyāmarucyādiṣu yojayet| -----------------------------------------------||47||

div.ab: -----------------------------------------------| aśokarohiṇīyuktaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca cūrṇitam||47|| badarīdhātakīdhātrīcūrṇaṃ vā sarpiṣā drutam| -----------------------------------------------|48|

-----------------------------------------------| sthirāvacādvibṛhatīkākolīpippalīnataiḥ||48|| niculotpalavarṣābhūbhārgīmustaiśca kārṣikaiḥ| siddhaṃ prasthārdhamājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param||49|| simhyaśvagandhāsurasākaṇāgarbhaṃ ca tadguṇam| -----------------------------------------------|50|
-----------------------------------------------| yaṣṭyāhvapippalīrodhrapadmakotpalacandanaiḥ||50|| tālīsasārivābhyāṃ ca sādhitaṃ śoṣajidghṛtam| -----------------------------------------------|51|

-----------------------------------------------| śṛṅgīmadhūlikābhārgīpippalīdevadārubhiḥ||51|| aśvagandhādvikākolīrāsnarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ| śūrpaparṇīviḍaṅgaiśca kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam||52|| śaśottamāṅganiryūhe śuṣyataḥ puṣṭikṛtparam| -----------------------------------------------|53|
-----------------------------------------------| vacāvayaḥsthātagarakāyasthācorakaiḥ śṛtam||53|| bastamūtrasurābhyāṃ ca tailamabhyañjane hitam| -----------------------------------------------|54|

-----------------------------------------------| lākṣārasasamaṃ tailaprasthaṃ mastu caturguṇam||54|| aśvagandhāniśādārukauntīkuṣṭhābdacandanaiḥ| samūrvārohiṇīrāsnāśatāhvāmadhukaiḥ samaiḥ||55|| siddhaṃ lākṣādikaṃ nāma tailamabhyañjanādidam| balyaṃ jvarakṣayonmādaśvāsāpasmāravātanut||56|| yakṣarākṣasabhūtaghnaṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca śasyate| -----------------------------------------------|57|
-----------------------------------------------| madhunā'tiviṣāśṛṅgīpippalīrlehayecchiśum||57|| ekāṃ vā'tiviṣāṃ kāsajvaracchardirupadrutam| -----------------------------------------------|58|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā||58||
dvivārtākīphalarasaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca lehayet| pippalīpañcalavaṇaṃ kṛmijitpāribhadrakam||59||
tadvallihyāttathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā romacarmaṇām| lābhataḥ śalyakaśvāvidgodharkṣaśikhijanmanām||60||
khadirārjunatālīsakuṣṭhacandanaje rase| sakṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ sarpirvamathuṃ viniyacchati||61||

div.ab: -----------------------------------------------| tālumāṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam||63|| tena tālupradeśasya nimnatā mūrdhni jāyate| tālupātaḥ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchrātpānaṃ śakṛddravam||64|| tṛḍāsyakaṇḍvakṣirujā grīvādurdharatā vamiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|65|
-----------------------------------------------| tatrotkṣipya yavakṣārakṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet||65|| tālu tadvatkaṇāśuṇṭhīgośakṛdrasasaindhavaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|66|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śṛṅgaveraniśābhṛṅgaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭapallavaiḥ||66||
badhvā gośakṛtā liptaṃ kukūle svedayettataḥ| rasena limpettālvāsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet||67||
harītakīvacākuṣṭhakalkaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam| pītvā kumāraḥ stanyena mucyate tālukaṇṭakāt||68||
malopalepātsvedādvā gude raktakaphodbhavaḥ| tāmro vraṇo'ntaḥ kaṇḍūmān jāyate bhūryupadravaḥ||69||
kecittaṃ mātṛkādoṣaṃ vadantyanye'hipūtanam| pṛṣṭārurgudakuṭṭaṃ ca kecicca tamanāmikam||70||

div.ab: tatra dhātryāḥ payaḥ śodhyaṃ pittaśleṣmaharauṣadhaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|71|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śṛtaśītaṃ ca śītāmbuyuktamantarapānakam||71||
sakṣaudratārkṣyaśailena vraṇaṃ tena ca lepayet| triphalābadarīplakṣatvakkvāthapariṣecitam||72||
kāsīsarocanātutthamanohvālarasāñjanaiḥ| lepayedamlapiṣṭairvā cūrṇitairvā'vacūrṇayet||73||
suślakṣṇairathavā yaṣṭīśaṅkhasauvīrakāñjanaiḥ| sārivāśaṅkhanābhibhyāmasanasya tvacā'thavā||74||
rāgakaṇḍūtkaṭe kuryādraktasrāvaṃ jalaukasā| sarvaṃ ca pittavraṇajicchasyate gudakuṭṭake||75||

div.ab: pāṭhāvelladvirajanīmustabhārgīpunarnavaiḥ| sabilvatryūṣaṇaiḥ sarpivṛścikālīyutaiḥ śṛtam||76|| lihāno mātrayā rogairmucyate mṛttikodbhavaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|77|

vyādheryadyasya bhaiṣajyaṃ stanastena pralepitaḥ| sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto'nu pītastaṃ taṃ jayedgadam|77| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālā- mayapratiṣedho nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|2|

div.head: balagrahapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bālagrahapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|

purā guhasya rakṣārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śūlapāṇinā| manuṣyavigrahāḥ pañca sapta strīvigrahā grahāḥ||1|| skando viśākho meṣākhyaḥ śvagrahaḥ pitṛsaṃjñitaḥ| śakuniḥ pūtanā śītapūtanā'dṛṣṭipūtanā||2|| mukhamaṇḍitikā tadvadrevatī śuṣkarevatī| -------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------------| teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||3||
sāmānyaṃ rūpamuttrāsajṛmbhābhrūkṣepadīnatāḥ| phenasrāvordhvadṛṣṭyoṣṭhadantadaṃśaprajāgarāḥ||4||
rodanaṃ kūjanaṃ stanyavidveṣaḥ svaravaikṛtam| nakhairakasmātparitaḥ svadhātryaṅgavilekhanam||5||

div.ab: tatraikanayanasrāvī śiro vikṣipate muhuḥ| hataikapakṣaḥ stabdhāṅgaḥ sasvedo natakandharaḥ||6|| dantakhādī stanadveṣī trasyan roditi visvaram| vakravaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśamūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate||7|| vasāsṛggandhirudvigno baddhamuṣṭiśakṛcchiśuḥ| calitaikākṣigaṇḍabhrūḥ saṃraktobhayalocanaḥ||8|| skandārtastena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam| --------------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: samprati viśākhasya skandāpasmārāparasaṃjñasya lakṣaṇamāha ---- --------------------------------------------------| saṃjñānāśo muhuḥ keśaluñcanaṃ kandharānatiḥ||9||
vinamya jṛmbhamāṇasya śakṛvmūtrapravartanam| phenodvamanamūrdhvekṣā hastabhrūpādanartanam||10||
stanasvajihvāsandaṃśasaṃrambhajvarajāgarāḥ| pūyaśoṇitagandhaśca skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam||11||
ādhmānaṃ pāṇipādasya spandanaṃ phenanirvamaḥ| tṛṇmuṣṭibandhātīsārasvaradainyavivarṇatāḥ||12||
kūjanaṃ stananaṃ chardiḥ kāsahidhmāprajāgarāḥ| oṣṭhadaṃśāṅgasaṅkocastambhabastābhagandhatāḥ||13||
ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ, madhye vinamanaṃ, jvaraḥ| mūrcchaikanetraśophaśca naigameṣagrahākṛtiḥ||14||

div.ab: kampo hṛṣitaromatvaṃ svedaścakṣurnimīlanam| bahirāyāmanaṃ jihvādaṃśo'ntaḥkaṇṭhakūjanam||15|| dhāvanaṃ viṭsagandhatvaṃ krośanaṃ ca śvavacchuni| --------------------------------------------------|16|

--------------------------------------------------| romaharṣo muhustrāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||16|| kāsātisāravamathujṛmbhātṛṭśavagandatāḥ| aṅgeṣvākṣepavikṣepaśoṣastambhavivarṇatāḥ||17|| muṣṭibandhaḥ srutiścākṣṇorbālasya syuḥ pitṛgrahe| --------------------------------------------------|18|

--------------------------------------------------| srastāṅgatvamatīsāro jihvātālugale vraṇāḥ||18|| sphoṭāḥ sadāharukpākāḥ sandhiṣu syuḥ punaḥpunaḥ| niśyahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude'pi vā||19|| bhayaṃ śakunigandhatvaṃ jvaraśca śakunigrahe| --------------------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampastandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ||20||
hidhmā''dhmānaṃ śakṛdbhedaḥ pipāsā mūtranigrahaḥ| srastahṛṣṭāṅgaromatvaṃ kākavatpūtigandhitā||21||

div.ab: śītapūtanayā kampo rodanaṃ tiryagīkṣaṇam| tṛṣṇā'ntrakūjo'tīsāro vasāvadvisragandhatā||22|| pārśvasyaikasya śītatvamuṣṇatvamaparasya ca| --------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| andhapūtanayā chardirjvaraḥ kāso'lpanidratā||23||
varcaso bhedavaivarṇyadaurgandhyānyaṅgaśoṣaṇam| dṛṣṭeḥ sādātirukkaṇḍūpothakījanmaśūnatāḥ||24||
hidhmodvegastanadveṣavaivarṇyasvaratīkṣṇatāḥ| vepathurmatsyagandhatvamathavā sāmlagandhatā||25||

div.ab: mukhamaṇḍitayā pāṇipādāsyaramaṇīyatā| sirābhirasitābhābhirācitodaratā jvaraḥ||26|| arocako'ṅgaglapanaṃ gomūtrasamagandhatā| --------------------------------------------------|27|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| revatyāṃ śyāvanīlatvaṃ karṇanāsākṣimardanam||27||
kāsahidhmākṣivikṣepavakravaktratvaraktatāḥ| bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam||28||

div.ab: adhunā'sādhyalakṣaṇaṃ vakti ---- jāyate śuṣkarevatyāṃ kramātsarvāṅgasaṅkṣayaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|29|

--------------------------------------------------| keśaśāto'nnavidveṣaḥ svaradainyaṃ vivarṇatā||29|| rodanaṃ gṛdhragandhatvaṃ dīrghakālānuvartanam| udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt||30|| jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet| --------------------------------------------------|31|

-------------------------------------------------| bhuñjāno'nnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yo bālaḥ parihīyate||31|| tṛṣṇāgṛhītaḥ kṣāmākṣo hanti taṃ śuṣkarevatī| -------------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: tribhiḥ kāraṇairgrahā gṛhṇantītyāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| hiṃsāratyarcanākāṅkṣā grahagrahaṇakāraṇam||32||

div.ab: tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ| kṣatajihvaḥ kvaṇedbāḍhamasukhī sāśrulocanaḥ||33|| durvarṇo hīnavacanaḥ pūtigandhiśca jāyate| kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdgāti na jugupsate||34|| hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hantyātmānaṃ tathā param| tadvacca śastrakāṣṭhādyairagniṃ vā dīptamāviśet||35|| apsu majjetpatetkūpe kuryādanyacca tadvidham| tṛḍdāhamohān pūyasya chardanaṃ ca pravartayet||36|| raktaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet| -------------------------------------------------|37|

sampratyarcanākāmaṃ brūte ---- -------------------------------------------------| rahaḥstrīratisaṃlāpagandhasragbhūṣaṇapriyaḥ||37|| hṛṣṭaḥ śāntaśca duḥsādhyo ratikāmena pīḍitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|38|

adhunaiṣāṃ cikitsitamāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| dīnaḥ parimṛśan vaktraṃ śuṣkauṣṭhagalatālukaḥ||38|| śaṅkitaṃ vīkṣate rauti dhyāyatyāyāti dīnatām| annamannābhilāṣe'pi dattaṃ nāti bubhukṣate||39|| gṛhītaṃ balikāmena taṃ vidyātsukhasādhanam| -------------------------------------------------|40|

-------------------------------------------------| hantukāmaṃ jayeddhomaiḥ siddhamantrapravartitaiḥ||40|| itarau tu yathākāmaṃ ratibalyādidānataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|41|

-------------------------------------------------| atha sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam||41|| trirahnaḥ siktasaṃmṛṣṭe sadā sannihitānale| vikīrṇabhūtikusumapatrabījānnasarṣape||42|| rakṣoghnatailajvalitapradīpahatapāpmani| vyavāyamadyapiśitanivṛttaparicārake||43|| purāṇasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ pariṣiktaṃ sukhāmbunā| sādhitena balānimbavaijayantīnṛpadrumaiḥ||44|| pāribhadrakakaṭvaṅgajambūvaruṇakaṭūtṛṇaiḥ| kapotavaṅkāpāmārgapāṭalāmadhuśigrubhiḥ||45|| kākajaṅghāmahāśvetākapitthakṣīripādapaiḥ| sakadambakarañjaiśca, dhūpaṃ snātasya cācaret||46|| dvīpivyāghrāhisiṃharkṣacarmabhirghṛtamiśritaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|

-------------------------------------------------| pūtīdaśāṅgasiddhārthavacābhallātadīpyakaiḥ||47|| sakuṣṭhaiḥ saghṛtairdhūpaḥ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|48|
-------------------------------------------------| sarṣapā nimbapatrāṇi mūlamaśvakhurā vacā||48|| bhūrjapatraṃ ghṛtaṃ dhūpaḥ sarvagrahanivāraṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| anantāmrāsthitagaraṃ maricaṃ madhuro gaṇaḥ||49||
śṛgālavinnā mustā ca kalkitaistairghṛtaṃ pacet| daśamūlarasakṣīrayuktaṃ tad grahajitparam||50||

div.ab: rāsnāhyaṃśumatīvṛddhapañcamūlabalāghanāt| kvāthe sarpiḥ pacetpiṣṭaiḥ sārivāvyoṣacitrakaiḥ||51|| pāṭhāviḍaṅgamadhukapayasyāhiṅgudārubhiḥ| sagranthikaiḥ sendrayavaiḥ śiśostatsatataṃ hitam||52|| sarvarogagrahaharaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇadam| -------------------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sārivāsurabhibrāhmīśaṅkhinīkuṣṭhasarṣapaiḥ||53||
vacāśvagandhāsurasayuktaiḥ sarpirvipācayet| tannāśayedgrahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca||54||
gośṛṅgacarmavālāhinirmokaṃ vṛṣadaṃśaviṭ| nimbapatrājyakaṭukāmadanaṃ bṛhatīdvayam||55||
kārpāsāsthiyavacchāgaromadevāhvasarṣapam| mayūrapatraśrīvāsaṃ tuṣakeśaṃ sarāmaṭham||56||
mṛdbhāṇḍe bastamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇitam| dhūpanaṃ ca hitaṃ sarvabhūteṣu viṣamajvare||57||
ghṛtāni bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca| yuñjyāttathā baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ mantratantravit||58||

div.ab: pūtīkarañja(ñjāt)tvakpatraṃ kṣīribhyo barbarādapi| tumbīviśālāralukaśamībilvakapitthataḥ||59|| utkvāthya toyaṃ tadrātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam| -------------------------------------------------|60|

-------------------------------------------------| anubandhān yathākṛcchraṃ grahāpāye'pyupadravān|60| bālāmayaniṣedhoktabheṣajaiḥ samupācaret| 60 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bālagrahapratiṣedho nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|3|

div.head: bhūtavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bhūtavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
athāto bhūtavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|

ab.seg: bhūtasya rūpaprakṛtibhāṣāgatyādiceṣṭitaiḥ| yasyānukāraṃ kurute tenāviṣṭaṃ tamādiśet||2||

div.ab: so'ṣṭādaśavidho devadānavādivibhedataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| hetustadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto'thavā||3||
prajñāparādhaḥ, sutarāṃ tena kāmādijanmanā| luptadharmavratācāraḥ pūjyānapyativartate||4||
taṃ tathā bhinnamaryādaṃ pāpamātmopaghātinam| devādayo'pyanughnanti grahāśchidraprahāriṇaḥ||5||
chidraṃ pāpakriyārambhaḥ pāko'niṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ| ekasya śūnye'vasthānaṃ śmaśānādiṣu vā niśi||6||
digvāsastvaṃ gurornindā rateravidhisevanam| aśucerdevatārcādi parasūtakasaṅkaraḥ||7||
homamantrabalījyānāṃ viguṇaṃ parikarma ca| samāsāddinacaryādiproktācāravyatikramaḥ||8||
grūhṇanti śuklapratipattrayodaśyoḥ surā naram| śuklatrayodaśīkṛṣṇadvādaśyordānavā grahāḥ||9||
gandharvāstu carturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ coragāḥ punaḥ| pañcamyāṃ, śuklasaptamyekādaśyostu dhaneśvarāḥ||10||
śuklāṣṭapañcamīpaurṇamāsīṣu brahmarākṣasāḥ| kṛṣṇe rakṣaḥ piśācādyā navadvādaśaparvasu||11||
daśāmāvāsyayoraṣṭanavamyoḥ pitaro'pare| guruvṛddhādayaḥ prāyaḥ kālaṃ sandhyāsu lakṣayet||12||
phullapadmopamamukhaṃ saumyadṛṣṭimakopanam| alpavāksvedaviṇmūtraṃ bhojanānabhilāṣiṇam||13||
devadvijātiparamaṃ śuciṃ saṃskṛtavādinam| mīlayantaṃ cirānnetre surabhiṃ varadāyinam||14||
śuklamālyāmbarasaricchailoccabhavanapriyam| anidramapradhṛṣyaṃ ca vidyāddevavaśīkṛtam||15||
jihmadṛṣṭiṃ durātmānaṃ gurudevadvijadviṣam| nirbhayaṃ māninaṃ śūraṃ krodhanaṃ vyavasāyinam||16||
rudraḥ skando viśākho'hamindro'hamiti vādinam| surāmāṃsaruciṃ vidyāt daityagrahagṛhītakam||17||

div.ab: svācāraṃ surabhiṃ hṛṣṭaṃ gītanartanakāriṇam| snānodyānaruciṃ raktavastramālyānulepanam||18|| śṛṅgāralīlābhirataṃ gandharvādhyuṣitaṃ vadet| -------------------------------------------------|19|

-------------------------------------------------| raktākṣaṃ krodhanaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭiṃ vakragatiṃ calam||19|| śvasantamaniśaṃ hihvālolinaṃ sṛkkiṇīliham| priyadugdhaguḍasnānamadhovadanaśāyinam||20|| uragādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāttrasyāntaṃ cātapatrataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|21|

-------------------------------------------------| viplutatrastaraktāṃkṣaṃ śubhagandhaṃ sutejasam||21|| priyanṛtyakathāgītasnānamālyānulepanam| matsyamāṃsaruciṃ hṛṣṭaṃ tuṣṭaṃ balinamavyatham||22|| calitāgrakaraṃ kasmai kiṃ dadāmīti vādinam| rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ vaidyadvijātiparibhāvinam||23|| alparoṣaṃ drutagatiṃ vidyādyakṣagṛhītakam| -------------------------------------------------|24|

-------------------------------------------------| hāsyanṛtyapriyaṃ raudraceṣṭaṃ chidraprahāriṇam||24|| ākrośinaṃ śīghragatiṃ devadvijabhiṣagdviṣam| ātmānaṃ kāṣṭhaśastrādyairghnantaṃ bhoḥśabdavādinam||25|| śāstravedapaṭhaṃ vidyād gṛhītaṃ brahmarākṣasaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sakrodhadṛṣṭiṃ bhṛkuṭimudvahantaṃ sasaṃbhramam||26||
praharantaṃ pradhāvantaṃ śabdantaṃ bhairavānanam| annādvinā'pi balinaṃ naṣṭanidraṃ niśācaram||27||
nirlajjamaśuciṃ śūraṃ krūraṃ paruṣabhāṣiṇam| roṣaṇaṃ raktamālyastrīraktamadyāmiṣapriyam||28||
dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vā''lihānaṃ daśanacchadau| hasantamannakāle ca rākṣasādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet||29||

div.ab: avasthacittaṃ naikatra tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinam| ucchiṣṭanṛtyagāndharvahāsamadyāmiṣapriyam||30|| nirbhartsanāddīnamukhaṃ rudantamanimittataḥ| nakhairlikhantamātmānaṃ rūkṣadhvastavapuḥsvaram||31|| āvedayantaṃ duḥkhāni sambaddhābaddhabhāṣiṇam| naṣṭasmṛtiṃ śūnyaratiṃ lolaṃ nagnaṃ malīmasam||32|| rathyācailaparīdhānaṃ tṛṇamālāvibhūṣaṇam| ārohantaṃ ca kāṣṭhāśvaṃ tathā saṅkarakūṭakam||33|| bahvāśinaṃ piśācena vijānīyādadhiṣṭhitam| -------------------------------------------------|34|
-------------------------------------------------| pretākṛtikriyāgandhaṃ bhītamāhāravidviṣam||34|| tṛṇacchidaṃ ca pretena gṛhītaṃ naramādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|35|
-------------------------------------------------| bahupralāpaṃ kṛṣṇāsyaṃ pravilambitayāyinam||35|| śūnapralambavṛṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet| -------------------------------------------------|36|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| gṛhītvā kāṣṭhaloṣṭādi bhramantaṃ cīravāsasam||36||
nagnaṃ dhāvantamuttrastadṛṣṭiṃ tṛṇavibhūṣaṇam| śmaśānaśūnyāyatanarathyaikadrumasevinam||37||
tilānnamadyamāṃseṣu satataṃ saktalocanam| niṣādādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyād vadantaṃ paruṣāṇi ca||38||
yācantamudakaṃ cānnaṃ trastalohitalocanam| ugravākyaṃ ca jānīyānnaramaukiraṇārditam||39||
gandhamālyaratiṃ satyavādinaṃ parivepinam| bahunidraṃ ca jānīyādvetālena vaśīkṛtam||40||
aprasannadṛśaṃ dīnavadanaṃ śuṣkatālukam| calannayanapakṣmāṇaṃ nidrāluṃ mandapāvakam||41||
apasavyaparīdhānaṃ tilamāṃsaguḍapriyam| skhaladvācaṃ ca jānīyāt pitṛgrahavaśīkṛtam||42||
guruvṛddharṣisiddhābhiśāpacintānurūpataḥ| vyāhārāhāraceṣṭābhiryathāsvaṃ tadgrahaṃ vadet||43||

div.ab: kumāravṛdānugataṃ nagnamuddhatamūrdhajam| asvasthamanasaṃ dairghyakālikaṃ sagrahaṃ tyajet|44| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūta vijñānīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|4|

div.head: bhūtapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto bhūtapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
bhūtaṃ jayedahiṃsecchaṃ japahomabalivrataiḥ| tapaḥśīlasamādhānadānajñānadayādibhiḥ||1||

div.ab: hiṅguvyoṣālanepālīlaśunārkajaṭājaṭāḥ| ajalomī sagolomī bhūtakeśī vacā latā||2|| kukkuṭī sarpagandhākhyā tilāḥ kāṇavikāṇike| vajraproktā vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavallyapi||3|| srotojāñjanarakṣoghnaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ cānyadauṣadham| kharāśvaśvāviduṣṭrarkṣagodhānakulaśalyakāt||4|| dvīpimārjāragosiṃhavyāghrasāmudrasattvataḥ| carmapittadvijanakhā varge'smin sādhayedghṛtam||5|| purāṇamathavā tailaṃ navaṃ tatpānanasyayoḥ| abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyameṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane||6|| ebhiśca guṭikāṃ yuñjyādañjane sāvapīḍane| pralepe kalkameteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane||7|| prayogo'yaṃ grahonmādān sāpasmārāñśamaṃ nayet| --------------------------------------------------|8|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| gajāhvāpippalīmūlavyoṣāmalakasarṣapān||8||
godhānakulamārjārajhaṣapittaprapeṣitān| nāvanābhyaṅgasekeṣu vidadhīta grahāpahān||9||

div.ab: siddhārthakavacāhiṅgupriyaṅgurajanīdvayam| mañjiṣṭhā śvetakaṭabhī varā śvetā'drikarṇikā||10|| nimbasya patraṃ bījaṃ tu naktamālaśirīṣayoḥ| surāhvaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ sarpirgomūtre taiścaturguṇe||11|| siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam| grahān sarvānnihantyāśu viśeṣādāsurān grahān||12|| kṛtyālakṣmīviṣonmādajvarāpasmārapāpma ca| -----------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| ebhirevauṣadhairbastavāriṇā kalpito'gadaḥ||13||
pānanasyāñjanālepasnānoddharṣaṇayojitaḥ| guṇaiḥ pūrvavaduddiṣṭo rājadvāre ca siddhikṛt||14||
siddhārthakavyoṣavacāśvagandhā- niśādvayaṃ hiṅgupalāṇḍukandaḥ| bījaṃ karañjāt, kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt||15||
samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ syonākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca| bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt||16||
duṣṭavraṇonmādatamoniśāndhā- nudbandhakān vārinimagnadehān| digdhāhatān darpitasarpadaṣṭāṃ- ste sādhayantyañjananasyalepaiḥ||17||

kārpāsāsthimayūrapatrabṛhatīnirmālyapiṇḍītaka- tvaṅmāṃsīvṛṣadaṃśaviṭtuṣavacākeśāhinirmokakaiḥ| nāgendradvijaśṛṅgahiṅgumaricaistulyaiḥ kṛtaṃ dhūpanaṃ skandonmādapiśācarākṣasasurāveśajvaraghnaṃ param||18||

trikaṭukadalakuṅkumagranthikakṣārasiṃhī- niśādārusiddhārthayugmāmbuśakrāhvayaiḥ sitalaśunaphalatrayośīratiktāvacā- tutthayaṣṭībalālohitailāśilāpadmakaiḥ| dadhitagaramadhūkasārapriyāhvāviṣākhyā- viṣātārkṣyaśailaiḥ sacavyāmayaiḥ kalkitairghṛtamanavamaśeṣamūtrāṃśasiddhaṃ mataṃ bhūtarāvāhvayaṃ pānatastad grahaghnaṃ param||19||

natamadhukarañjalākṣāpaṭolīsamaṅgāvacā- pāṭalīhiṅgusiddhārthasiṃhīniśāyuglatārohiṇī- badarakaṭuphalatrikākāṇḍadārukṛmighnājagandhā- marāṅkollakośātakīśigrunimbāmbudendrāhvayaiḥ| gadaśukatarupuṣpabījograyaṣṭyadrikarṇīnikumbhā- gnibilvaiḥ samaiḥkalkitairmūtravargeṇa siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidhivinihitamāśu sarvaiḥ kramairyojitaṃ hanti sarvagrahonmādakuṣṭhajvarāṃstanmahābhūtarāvaṃ smṛtam||20||
grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ| dineṣu balihomādīn prayuñjīta cikitsakaḥ||21||
snānavastravasāmāṃsamadyakṣīraguḍādi ca| rocate yadyadā yebhyastatteṣāmāharettadā||22||
ratnāni gandhamālyāni bījāni madhusarpiṣī| bhakṣyāśca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhirityayam||23||

div.ab: surarṣiguruvṛddhebhyaḥ siddhebhyaśca surālaye| diśyuttarasyāṃ tatrāpi devāyopaharedbalim||24|| paścimāyāṃ yathākālaṃ daityabhūtāya catvare| gandharvāya gavāṃ mārge savastrābharaṇaṃ balim||25|| pitṛnāgagrahe nadyāṃ nāgebhyaḥ pūrvadakṣiṇe| yakṣāya yakṣāyatane saritorvā samāgame||26|| catuṣpathe rākṣasāya bhīmeṣu gahaneṣu ca| rakṣasāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ brahmarakṣasām||27|| śūnyālaye piśācāya paścimāṃ diśamāsthite| -----------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śuciśuklāni mālyāni gandhāḥ kṣaireyamodanam||28||
dadhi chatraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ baliriṣyate| hiṅgusarṣapaṣaḍgranthāvyoṣairardhapalonmitaiḥ||29||
caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tatpānanāvanābhyaṅgairdevagrahavimokṣaṇam||30||

div.ab: nasyāñjanaṃ vacāhiṅgulaśunaṃ bastavāriṇā| -----------------------------------------------|31|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| daitye balirbahuphalaḥ sośīrakamalotpalaḥ||31||

div.ab: nāgānāṃ sumanolājaguḍāpūpaguḍaudanaiḥ| paramānnamadhukṣīrakṛṣṇamṛnnāgakesaraiḥ||32|| vacāpadmapurośīraraktotpaladalairbaliḥ| śvetapatraṃ ca rodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ||33|| śītena vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjanayorhitam| -----------------------------------------------|34|
-----------------------------------------------| yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīradadhyājyamiśrakaudanaguggulu||34|| devadārūtpalaṃ padmamuśīraṃ vastrakāñcanam| hiraṇyaṃ ca baliryojyo------------------------|35|

---------------------------------------------------| haritakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā||36|| nimbapatram ca bastāmbukalkitaṃ nāvanāñjanam| ---------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| brahmarakṣobaliḥ siddhaṃ yavānāṃ pūrṇamāḍhakam||37||
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ vilepanam| ---------------------------------------------------||38||

div.ab: ---------------------------------------------------| naktamālaśirīṣatvaṅmūlapuṣpaphalāni ca||41|| tadvacca kṛṣṇapāṭalyā bilvamūlaṃ kaṭutrikam| hiṃgvindrayavasiddhārthalaśunāmalakīphalam||42|| nāvanāñjanayoryojyo bastamūtrayuto'gadaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|43|

---------------------------------------------------| ebhireva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe||43|| rakṣograhān vārayate pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|44|

---------------------------------------------------| piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi||44|| mūlakaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarpiḥ sabhūtaudanayāvakam| ---------------------------------------------------|45|

---------------------------------------------------| haridrādvayamañjiṣṭhāmiśisaindhavanāgaram||45|| hiṅgupriyaṅgutrikaṭurasonatriphalā vacā| pāṭalīśvetakaṭabhīśirīṣakusumairghṛtam||46|| gomūtrapādikaṃ siddhaṃ pānābhyañjanayorhitam| ---------------------------------------------------|47|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| bastāmbupiṣṭaistaireva yojyamañjananāvanam||47||
devarṣipitṛgandharve tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi varjayet| sarpiṣpānādi mṛdvasmin bhaiṣajyamavacārayet||48||
ṛte piśācātsarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret| savaidyamāturaṃ ghnanti kruddhāste hi mahaujasaḥ||49||

div.ab: īśvaraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ nāthamāryāvalokitam| sarvavyādhicikitsāṃ ca japan sarvagrahān jayet||50|| tathonmādānapasmārānanyaṃ vā cittaviplavam| ---------------------------------------------------|51|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayetsadā||51||
bhūteśaṃ pūjayet sthāṇuṃ pramathākhyāṃśca tadgaṇān| japan siddhāṃśca tanmantrān grahān sarvānapohati||52||
yaccānantarayoḥ kiñcidvakṣyate'dhyāyayorhitam| yaccoktamiha tatsarvaṃ prayuñjīta parasparam||53||
iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhūtapratiṣedho nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: unmādapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta unmādapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: unmādāḥ ṣaṭ pṛthagdoṣanicayādhiviṣodbhavāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|1|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| unmādo nāma manaso doṣairunmārgagairmadaḥ||1||

div.ab: adhunā vistareṇotpattikramamunmādānāmāha ---- śārīramānasairduṣṭairahitādannapānataḥ| vikṛtāsātmyasamalādviṣamādupayogataḥ||2|| viṣaṇṇasyālpasattvasya vyādhivegasamudgamāt| kṣīṇasya ceṣṭāvaiṣamyāt pūjyapūjāvyatikramāt||3|| ādhibhiścittavibhraṃśād viṣeṇopaviṣeṇa ca| ebhirhi hīnasattvasya hṛdi doṣāḥ pradūṣitāḥ||4|| dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hatva mārgān manovahān| unmādaṃ kurvate, tena dhīvijñānasmṛtibhramāt||5|| deho duḥkhasukhabhraṣṭo bhraṣṭasārathivadrathaḥ| bhramatyacintitārambhaḥ-------------------------|6|

iti sāmānyalakṣaṇamunmādasyoktvā pavanādijasya viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha ---- ----------------------------------------------| ----------------------tatra vātātkṛśāṅgatā||6|| asthāne rodanākrośahasitasmitanartanam| gītavāditravāgaṅgavikṣepāsphoṭanāni ca||7|| asāmnā veṇuvīṇādiśabdānukaraṇaṃ muhuḥ| āsyātphenāgamo'jasramaṭanaṃ bahubhāṣitā||8|| alaṅkāro'nalaṅkārairayānairgamanodyamaḥ| gṛddhirabhyavahāryeṣu tallābhe cāvamānatā||9|| utpiṇḍitāruṇākṣitvaṃ jīrṇe cānne gadodbhavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pittātsantarjanaṃ krodho muṣṭiloṣṭādyabhidravaḥ||10||
śītacchāyodakākāṅkṣā nagnatvaṃ pītavarṇatā| asatyajvalanajvālātārakādīpadarśanam||11||
kaphādarocakaśchardiralpehāhāravākyatā| strīkāmatā rahaḥprītirlālāsiṅghāṇakasrutiḥ||12||
baibhatsyaṃ śaucavidveṣo nidrā śvayathurānane| unmādo balavān rātrau bhuktamātre ca jāyate||13||
sarvāyatanasaṃsthānasannipāte tadātmakam| unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet||14||
atha cittajamunmādaṃ vakti ---- dhanakāntādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavān| pāṇḍurdīno muhurmuhyan hāheti paridevate||15||
rodityakasmānmriyate tadguṇān bahu manyate| śokakliṣṭamanā dhyāyan jāgarūko viceṣṭate||16||
viṣeṇa śyāvavadano naṣṭacchāyābalendriyaḥ| vegāntare'pi sambhrānto raktākṣastaṃ vivarjayet||17||
athānilaja unmāde snehapānaṃ prayojayet| pūrvamāvṛtamārge tu sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam||18||

div.ab: kaphapittabhave'pyādau vamanaṃ savirecanam| sasnigdhasvinnasya bastiṃ ca śirasaḥ savirecanam||19|| tathā'sya śuddhadehasya prasādaṃ labhate manaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|20|

----------------------------------------------| itthamapyanuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanamañjanam||20|| harṣaṇāśvāsanottrāsabhayatāḍanatarjanam| abhyaṅgodvartanālepadhūpān pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ||21|| yuñjyāttāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|22|
----------------------------------------------| hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣairdvipalāṃśairghṛtāḍhakam||22|| siddhaṃ samūtramunmādabhūtāpasmāranutparam| ----------------------------------------------|23|

----------------------------------------------| dvau prasthau svarasād brāhayā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam||23|| vyoṣaśyāmātrivṛddantīśaṅkhapuṣpīnṛpadrumaiḥ| sasaptalākṛmiharaiḥ kalkitairakṣasammitaiḥ||24|| palavṛddhyā prayuñjīta paraṃ mātrā catuṣpalam| unmādakuṣṭhāpasmāraharaṃ vandhyāsutapradam||25|| vāksvarasmṛtimedhākṛd dhanyaṃ brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam| ----------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| varāviśālābhadrailādevadārvelavālukaiḥ||26||
dvisārivādvirajanīdvisthirāphalinīnataiḥ| bṛhatīkuṣṭhamañjiṣṭhānāgakesaradāḍimaiḥ||27||
vellatālīsapatrailāmālatīmukulotpalaiḥ| sadantīpadmakahimaiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet||28||
prasthaṃ bhūtagrahonmādakāsāpasmārapāpmasu| pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare||29||
aretasyaprajasi vā daivopahatacetasi| amedhasi skhaladvāci smṛtikāme'lpapāvake||30||
balyaṃ maṅgalyamāyuṣyaṃ kāntisaubhāgyapuṣṭidam| kalyāṇakamidaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavaneṣu ca||31||

div.ab: ebhyo dvisārivādīni jale paktvaikaviṃśatim| rase tasmin pacetsarpirgṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇam||32|| vīrādvimedākākolīkapikacchūviṣāṇibhiḥ| śūrpaparṇīyutairetanmahākalyāṇakaṃ param||33|| bṛṃhaṇaṃ sannipātaghnaṃ pūrvasmādadhikaṃ guṇaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|34|

----------------------------------------------| jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā||34|| trāyamāṇā jayā vīrā corakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī| vayaḥsthā śūkarī chatrā sāticchatrā palaṅkaṣā||35|| mahāpuruṣadantā ca kāyasthā nākulīdvayam| kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tairghṛtam||36|| siddhaṃ cāturthikonmādagrahāpasmāranāśanam| mahāpaiśācakaṃ nāma ghṛtametadyathā'mṛtam||37|| buddhimedhāsmṛtikaraṃ bālānaṃ cāṅgavardhanam| ----------------------------------------------|38|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| brāhmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām||38||
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām| jyotiṣmatīṃ nāgavinnāmanantāṃ saharītakīm||39||
kāṅkṣīṃ ca hastimūtreṇa piṣṭvā chāyāviśoṣitā| vartirnasyāñjanālepadhūpairunmādasūdanī||40||

div.ab: avapīḍāśca vividhāḥ sarṣāpāḥ snehasaṃyutāḥ| kaṭutailena cābhyaṅgo dhmāpayeccāsya tadrajaḥ||41|| sahiṅgustīkṣṇadhūmaśca sūtrasthānodito hitaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|42|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| śṛgālaśalyakolūkajalaukāvṛṣabastajaiḥ||42||
mūtrapittaśakṛllomanakhacarmabhirācaret| dhūpadhūmāñjanābhyaṅgapradehapariṣecanam||43||

div.ab: dhūpayetsatataṃ cainaṃ śvagomatsyaiḥ supūtibhiḥ| vātaśleṣmātmake prāyaḥ------------------------|44|

ab.seg: tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaśca miśrakaḥ| śītāni cānnapānāni madhurāṇi laghūni ca||45||
vidhyecchirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā| nivāte śāyayedevaṃ mucyate mativibhramāt||46||
prakṣipyāsalile kūpe śoṣayedvā bubhukṣayā| āśvāsayetsuhṛttaṃ vā vākyairdharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ||47||
bṛyādiṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayedadbhutāni vā| baddhaṃ sarṣapatailāktaṃ nyasedvottānamātape||48||
kapikacchvā'thavā taptairlohatailajalaiḥ spṛśet| kaśābhistāḍayitvā vā baddhaṃ śvabhre viniḥkṣipet||49||
athavā vītaśastrāśmajane saṃtamase gṛhe| sarpeṇoddhṛtadaṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhairgajaiśca tam||50||
(trāsayecchastrahastairvā kirātārātitaskaraiḥ| ) athavā rājapuruṣā bahirnītvā susaṃyatam| bhāpayeyurvadhenainaṃ tarjayanto nṛpājñayā||51||
dehaduḥkhabhayebhyo hi paraṃ prāṇabhayaṃ matam| tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ||52||

div.ab: siddhā kriyā prayojyeyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā| ----------------------------------------------|53|
----------------------------------------------| iṣṭadravyavināśāttu mano yasyopahanyate||53|| tasya tatsadṛśaprāptisāntvāśvāsaiḥ śamaṃ nayet| ----------------------------------------------|54|
----------------------------------------------| kāmaśokabhayakrodhaharṣerṣyālobhasambhavān||54|| parasparapratidvandvairebhireva śamaṃ nayet| ----------------------------------------------|55|
----------------------------------------------| bhūtānubandhamīkṣeta proktaliṅgādhikākṛtim||55|| yadyunmāde tataḥ kuryādbhūtanirdiṣṭamauṣadham| ----------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| baliṃ ca dadyātpalalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām||56||
snigdhaṃ madhuramāhāraṃ taṇḍulān rudhirokṣitān| pakvāmakāni māṃsāni surāṃ maireyamāsavam||57||
atimuktasya puṣpāṇi jātyāḥ sahacarasya ca| catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca||58||
nivṛttāmiṣamadyo yo hitāśī prayataḥ śuciḥ| nijāgantubhirunmādaiḥ satvavānna sa yujyate||59||

div.ab: prasāda indriyārthānāṃ buddhyātmamanasāṃ tathā| dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ vigatonmādalakṣaṇam|60| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne unmādapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

div.head: apasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto'pasmārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|

smṛtyapāyo hyaposmāraḥ sa dhīsattvābhisaṃplavāt| jāyate'bhihate citte cintāśokabhayādibhiḥ||1|| unmādavatprakupitaiścittadehagatairmalaiḥ| hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca||2|| tamo viśan mūḍhamatirbībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ| dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan||3|| paśyannasanti rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau| vijihyakṣibhruvo doṣavege'tīte vibudhyate||4|| kālāntareṇa sa punaścaivameva viceṣṭate| --------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: rūpamutpatsyamāne'smin hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā bhramaḥ| tamaso darśanaṃ dhyānaṃ bhrūvyudāso'kṣivaikṛtam||6||
aśabdaśravaṇaṃ svedo lālāsiṅghāṇakasrutiḥ| avipāko'rucirmūrcchā kukṣyāṭopo balakṣayaḥ||7||
nidrānāśo'ṅgamardastṛṭ svapne gānaṃ sanartanam| pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayoreva ca mehanam||8||

div.ab: tatra vātātsphuratsakthiḥ prapataṃśca muhurmuhuḥ| apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan||9|| utpiṇḍitākṣaḥ śvasiti phenaṃ vamati kampate| āvidhyati śirodantān daśatyādhmātakandharaḥ||10|| parito vikṣipatyaṅgaṃ viṣamaṃ vinatāṅguliḥ| rūkṣśyāvāruṇākṣitvaṅnakhāsyaḥ kṛṣṇamīkṣate||11|| capalaṃ paruṣaṃ rūpaṃ virūpaṃ vikṛtānanam| --------------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: pītaphenākṣivaktratvagāspālayati medinīm| bhairavādīptaruṣitarūpadarśī tṛṣānvitaḥ||13||

div.ab: kaphāccireṇa grahaṇaṃ cireṇaiva vibodhanam| ceṣṭā'lpā bhūyasī lālā śuklanetranakhāsyatā||14|| śuklābharūpadarśitvaṃ----------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|15|

--------------------------------------------------------| athā''vṛtānāṃ dhīcittahṛtkhānāṃ prākprabodhanam||15|| tīkṣṇaiḥ kuryādiapasmāre karmabhirvamanādibhiḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|16|

--------------------------------------------------------| vātikaṃ bastibhūyiṣṭhaiḥ, paittaṃ prāyo virecanaiḥ||16|| ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyairapasmāramupācaret| --------------------------------------------------------|17|

--------------------------------------------------------| dvipañcamūlatriphalādviniśākuṭajatvacaḥ||19|| saptaparṇamapāmārgaṃ nīlinīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm| śamyākapuṣkarajaṭāphalgumūladurālabhāḥ||20|| dvipalāḥ saliladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite| bhārgīpāṭhāḍhakīkumbhanikumbhavyoṣarohiṣaiḥ||21|| mūrvābhūtīkabhūnimbaśreyasīsārivādvayaiḥ| madayantyagniniculairakṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet||22|| prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcaganyamidaṃ mahat| jvarāpasmārajaṭharabhagandaraharaṃ param||23|| śophārśaḥkāmalāpāṇḍugulmakāsagrahāpaham| --------------------------------------------------------|24|

--------------------------------------------------------| brāhmīrasavacākuṣṭhaśaṅkhapuṣpīśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||24|| purāṇaṃ medhyamunmādālakṣmyapasmārapāomajit| --------------------------------------------------------|25|

--------------------------------------------------------| tailaprasthaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||25|| kṣīradroṇe pacetsiddhamapasmāravimokṣaṇam| --------------------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: kāRṣikairjīvanīyaiśca sarpiḥprasthaṃ vipācayet| vātapittodbhavaṃ kṣipramapasmāraṃ nihanti tat||27||
śryāhvāpāmārgakārañjabījaistailaṃ vipācitam| bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayedbhiṣak||32||
nakulolūkamārjāragṛdhrakīṭāhikākajaiḥ| tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiśca dhūpamasya prayojayet||33||
śīlayettailalaśunaṃ payasa vā śatāvarīm| brāhmīrasaṃ kuṣṭharasaṃ vacāṃ vā madhusaṃyutām||34||
samaṃ kruddhairapasmāro doṣaiḥ śārīramānasaiḥ| yajjāyate yataścaiṣa mahāmarmasamāśrayaḥ||35||
tasmādrasāyanairenaṃ duścikitsyamupācaren| tadārtaṃ cāgnitoyāderviṣamātpālayetsadā||36||

div.ab: muktaṃ mano vikāreṇa tvamitthaṃ kṛtavāniti| na brūyādviṣayairiṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto'sya bṛṃhayet|37| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne'pasmārapratiṣedho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|7|

div.head: vartmarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: prādhānyāt pūrvamupanyāsa ityāha ---- athāto vartmarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|

sarvaroganidānoktairahitaiḥ kupitā malāḥ| acakṣuṣyairviśeṣeṇa prāyaḥ pittānusāriṇaḥ||1|| śirābhirūrdhvaṃ prasṛtā netrāvayavamāśritāḥ| vartma sandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvamakṣi vā||2|| rogān kuryuḥ--------------------------------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: ----------calastatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ| suptotthitasya kurute vartmastambhaṃ savedanam||3||
pāṃśupūrṇābhanetratvaṃ kṛcchronmīlanamaśru ca| vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tat||4||

div.ab: cālayan vartmanī vāyurnimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ| karotyaruṅ nimeṣo'sau---------------------|5|

---------------------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇāḥ pittena bahvyo'ntarvartma kumbhīkabījavat||6|| ādhmāyante punarbhinnāḥ piṭikāḥ kumbhisaṃjñitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|7|

---------------------------------------------------------| sadāhakledanistodaṃ raktābhaṃ sparśanākṣamam||7|| pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭamuśanti tat| ---------------------------------------------------------|8|

---------------------------------------------------------| karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāsthitam||8|| pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam| ---------------------------------------------------------|9|

---------------------------------------------------------| pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapabhā ghanāḥ kaphāt||9|| śophopadeharukkaṇḍūpicchilāśrusamanvitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------------| kaphotkliṣṭaṃ bhavedvartma stambhakledopadehavat||10||
granthiḥ pāṇḍurarukpākaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ kaphāt| kolamātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiñcidalpastato'tha vā||11||

div.ab: raktā raktena piṭikā tattulyapiṭikācitā| utsaṅgākhyā------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: arśo'dhimāṃsaṃ vartmāntaḥ stabdhaṃ snigdhaṃ sadāharuk| raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate||13||
madhye vā vartmano'nte vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā| mudgamātrā'sṛjā tāmrā piṭikā'ñjananāmikā||14||
doṣairvartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yadantaḥ sūkṣmakhācitam| sasrāvamantarudakaṃ bisābhaṃ bisavartma tat||15||
yadvartmotkliṣṭamutkliṣṭamakasmānmlānatāmiyāt| raktadoṣatrayotkleśādbhavatyutkliṣṭavartma tat||16||

div.ab: śyāvavartma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ śyāvaṃ rukkledaśophavat| ---------------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------------| śliṣṭākhyaṃ vartmanī śliṣṭe kaṇḍūśvayathurāgiṇī||17||

div.ab: vartmano'ntaḥ kharā rūkṣāḥ piṭikāḥ sikatopamāḥ| sikatāvartma-----------------------------------|18|
bahalaṃ bahalairmāṃsaiḥ savarṇaiścīyate samaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: syāttena śiśurucchranatāmrākṣo vīkṣaṇākṣamaḥ| savartmaśūlapaicchilyaḥ karṇanāsākṣimardanaḥ||20||
pakṣmoparodhe saṅkoco vartmanāṃ jāyate tathā| kharatā'ntarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇāmanyāni vā punaḥ||21||
kaṇṭakairiva tīkṣṇāgrairghṛṣṭaṃ tairakṣi śūyate| uṣyate cānilādidviḍalpāhaḥ śāntiruddhṛtaiḥ||22||
kanīnake bahirvartma kaṭhino granthirunnataḥ| tāmraḥ pakvo'srapūyasrudalajyādhmāyate muhuḥ||23||
vartmāntarmāṃsapiṇḍābhaḥ śvayathurgrathito'rujaḥ| srāsraiḥ syādarbudo doṣairviṣamo bāhyataścalaḥ||24||

div.ab: caturviṃśatirityete vyādhayo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|25|

---------------------------------------------------------| ādyo'tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato'rśaśca varjayet||25|| pakṣmoparodho yāpyaḥ syāccheṣāñchastreṇa sādhayet| ---------------------------------------------------------|26|

---------------------------------------------------------| kuṭṭayetpakṣmasadanaṃ chindyātteṣvapi cārbudam|26| bhindyāllagaṇakumbhīkābisotsaṅgāñjanālajīḥ| pothakīśyāvasikatāśliṣṭotkliṣṭacatuṣṭayam|27| sakardamaṃ sabahalaṃ vilikhetsakukūṇakam| 27 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhagupasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vartmarogavijñānīyo nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|8|

div.head: vartmarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: vartmarogavijñānādanantaraṃ vartmarogapratiṣedha ārabhyata ityāha ---- athāto vartmarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
kṛcchronmīle purāṇājyaṃ drākṣākalkāmbusādhitam| sasiraṃ yojayetsnigdhaṃ nasyadhūmāñjanādi ca||1||
