kumbhīkāvartmopakramamāha ---- kumbhīkāvartma likhitaṃ saindhavapratisāritam| yaṣṭīdhātrīpaṭolīnāṃ kvāthena pariṣecayet||2||

div.ab: kathaṃ vartma lekhanīyam ? ityāha ---- nivāte'dhiṣṭhitasyāptaiḥ śuddhasyottānaśāyinaḥ| bahiḥ koṣṇāmbutaptena sveditaṃ vartma vāsasā||3|| nirbhujya vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulīdhṛtam| na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatastataḥ||4|| maṇḍalāgreṇa tattiryak kṛtvā śastrapadāṅkitam| likhettenaiva patrairvā śākaśophālikādijaiḥ||5|| phenena toyarāśervā picunā pramṛjannasṛk| sthite rakte sulikhitaṃ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||6|| yathāsvamuktairanu ca prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā| ghṛtena siktamabhyaktaṃ badhnīyānmadhusarpiṣā||7|| ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayordattvā piṇḍīṃ ca yavasaktubhiḥ| dvitīye'hani muktasya pariṣekaṃ yathāyatham||8|| kuryāccaturthe nasyādīn muñcedevāhni pañcame| ---------------------------------------------------------|9|

---------------------------------------------------------| samaṃ nakhanibhaṃ śophakaṇḍūghārṣādyapīḍitam||9|| vidyātsulikhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye| ---------------------------------------------------------|10|

---------------------------------------------------------| abhyajya navanītena śvetarodhraṃ pralepayet||11|| eraṇḍamūlakalkena puṭapāke pacettataḥ| svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtam||12|| striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam| ---------------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: kuryānnetre'tilikhite mṛditaṃ dadhimastunā| kevalenāpi vā sekaṃ mastunā jāṅgalāśinaḥ||14||
piṭikā vrīhivakreṇa bhittvā tu kaṭhinonnatāḥ| niṣpīḍayedanu vidhiḥ pariśeṣastu pūrvavat||15||

div.ab: ---------------------------------------------------------| pittāsrotkliṣṭayoḥ svāduskandhasiddhena sarpiṣā||16|| sirāvimokṣaḥ snigdhasya trivṛcchreṣṭhaṃ virecanam| likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam||17|| yaṣṭīkaṣāyaḥ, sekastu kṣīraṃ candanasādhitam| ---------------------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: grāhayedvā jalaukobhiḥ payasekṣurasena vā| vamanaṃ, nāvanaṃ sarpiḥ śṛtaṃ madhuraśītalaiḥ||19||
sañcūrṇya puṣpakāsīsaṃ bhāvayetsurasārasaiḥ| tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣmaśāte tadañjanam||20||

div.ab: pothakīrlikhitāḥ śuṇṭhīsaindhavapratisāritāḥ| uṣṇāmbukṣālitāḥ siñcet khadirāḍhakiśigrubhiḥ||21|| apsiddhairdviniśāśreṣṭhāmadhukairvā samākṣikaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------------| kaphotkliṣṭe vilikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam||22||
sūkṣmaiḥ saindhavakāsīsamanohvākaṇatārkṣyajaiḥ| vamanāñjananasyādi sarvaṃ ca kaphajiddhitam||23||

div.ab: |svinnāṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhiṣaga(ḍyotsaṅgāṃ cā)_ ñjananāmikām| śilailāsaindhavanataiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||1|| ---------------------------------------------------------| kukūṇe khadiraśreṣṭhānimbapatraśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||24|| pītvā dhātrī vametkṛṣṇāyaṣṭīsarṣapasaindhavaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|25|
mustādvirajanīkṛṣṇākalkenālepayetstanau| dhūpayetsarṣapaiḥ sājyaiḥ----------------|26|

---------------------------------------------------------| śiśostu likhitaṃ vartma srutāsṛgvā'mbujanmabhiḥ||27|| dhātryaśmantakajambūtthapatrakvāthena secayet| ---------------------------------------------------------|28|

tadeha vamanamāha ---- ---------------------------------------------------------| sindhūtthakṛṣṇāpāmārgabījājyastanyamākṣikam||29|| cūrṇo vacāyāḥ sakṣaudro madanaṃ madhukānvitam| kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnamannaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ||30|| vamanaṃ sarvarogeṣu viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake| ---------------------------------------------------------|31|

dviniśārodhrayaṣṭyāhvarohiṇīnimbapallavaiḥ| kukūṇake hitā vartiḥ piṣṭaistāmrarajonvitaiḥ||32|| kṣīrakṣaudraghṛtopetaṃ dagdhaṃ vā lohajaṃ rajaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: utsṛjya dvau bhruvo'dhastādbhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ| yavamātraṃ yavākāraṃ tiryak chitvā''rdravāsasā||35||
apaneyamasṛk tasminnalpībhavati śoṇite| sīvyetkuṭilayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ||36||
badhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam| nātigāḍhaślathaṃ sūcyā nikṣipedatha yojayet||37||
madhusarpiḥkavalikāṃ na cāsmin bandhamācaret| nyagrodhādikaṣāyaiśca sakṣīraiḥ secayedruji||38||
pañcame divase sūtramapanīyāvacūrṇayet| gairikeṇa vraṇaṃ yuñjyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyāñjanādi ca||39||

div.ab: dahedaśāntau nirbhujya vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīm| saṃdaṃśonādhikaṃ pakṣma hṛtvā tasyāśrayaṃ dahet|40| sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena, dāho bāhyālajeḥ punaḥ| bhinnasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ succhinnasyārbudasya ca|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vartmarogapratiṣedho nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|9|

div.head: sandhisitāsitarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: yathoddeśastathā nirdeśa iti tāneva tāvatsandhiroganāha ---- athātaḥ sandhisitāsitarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )||3||

div.ab: vāyuḥkruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ| aśru srāvayate vartmaśuklasandheḥ kanīnakāt||1|| tena netraṃ sarugrāgaśophaṃ syātsa jalāsravaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet||2||

div.ab: kaphena śophastīkṣṇāgraḥ kṣārabudbudakopamaḥ| pṛthumūlabalaḥ snigdhaḥ savarṇo mṛdupicchilaḥ||3|| mahānapākaḥ kaṇḍūmānupanāhaḥ sa nīrujaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|4|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| raktād raktāsrave tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet||4||
vartmasandhyāśrayā śukle piṭikā dāhaśūlinī| tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī||5||
pūyāsrave malāḥ sāsrā vartmasandheḥ kanīnakāt| srāvayanti muhuḥ pūyaṃ sāsraṃ tvaṅmāṃsapākataḥ||6||
pūyālaso vraṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śophasaṃrambhapūrvakaḥ| kanīnasandhāvādhmāyī pūyāsrāvī savedanaḥ||7||

div.ab: kanīnasyāntaralajī śopho ruktodadāhavān| -----------------------------------------------|8|
-----------------------------------------------| apāṅge vā kanīne vā kaṇḍūṣāpakṣmapoṭavān||8|| pūyāsrāvī kṛmigranthirgranthiḥ kṛmiyuto'rtimān| -----------------------------------------------|9|
-----------------------------------------------| upanāhakṛmigranthipūyālasakaparvaṇīḥ||9|| śastreṇa sādhayetpañca sālajīnāsravāṃstyajet| -----------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: evaṃ sandhigatānnava rogānākhyāya sitabhāgasthān rogānāha ---- -----------------------------------------------| pittaṃ kuryātsite bindūnasitaśyāvapītakān||10||
malāktādarśatulyaṃ vā sarvaṃ śuklaṃ sadāharuk| rogo'yaṃ śuktikasaṃjñaḥ saśakṛdbhedatṛḍjvaraḥ||11||

div.ab: kaphācchukle samaṃ śvetaṃ ciravṛddhyadhimāṃsakam| śuklārma-----------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| bindubhiḥ piṣṭadhavalairutsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ vadet||13||
raktarājītataṃ śuklamuṣyate yatsavedanam| aśophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpā taḥ sa śoṇitāt||14||
upekṣitaḥ sirotpāto rājīstā eva vardhayan| kuryātsāsraṃ sirāharṣaṃ tenākṣyudvīkṣaṇākṣamam||15||

div.ab: sirājāle sirājālaṃ būhadraktaṃ ghanonnatam| -----------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śoṇitārma samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ padmābhamadhimāṃsakam||16||

div.ab: nīruk ślakṣṇo'rjunaṃ binduḥ śaśalohitalohitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: ----------------------dāhagharṣavatyaḥ sirāvṛtāḥ| kṛṣṇāsannāḥ sirāsaṃjñāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapopamāḥ||19||

div.ab: sitabhāgotthānāmeṣāṃ trayodaśānāṃ sādhanaṃ sūtrayati ---- śuktiharṣasirotpātapiṣṭakagrathitārjunam| sādhayaidauṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam||20|| navotthaṃ tadapi dravyaiḥ-----------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|21|
---------------------armoktaṃ yacca pañcadhā| tacchedyamasitaprāptaṃ māṃsasnavasirāvṛtam||21|| carmoddālavaducchrāyi dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ ca varjayet| -----------------------------------------------|22|

atha kṛṣṇarogānāha ---- -----------------------------------------------| pittaṃ kṛṣṇe'thava dṛṣṭau śukraṃ todāśrurāgavat||22|| chitvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syātkṛṣṇamaṇḍalam| pakvajambūnibhaṃ kiñcinnimnaṃ ca kṣataśukrakam||23|| tatkṛcchrasādhyaṃ, yāpyaṃ tu dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāt| tatra todādibāhulyaṃ sūcīviddhābhakṛṣṇatā||24|| tṛtīyapaṭalacchedādasādhyaṃ nicitaṃ vraṇaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śaṅkhaśuklaṃ kaphātsādhyaṃ nātiruk śuddhaśukrakam||25||
ātāmrapicchilāsrasrudātāmrapiṭikā'tiruk| ajāviṭsadṛśocchrāyakārṣṇyā varjyā'sṛjā'jakā||26||

div.ab: sirāśukraṃ malaiḥ sāsraistajjuṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam| satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ sirābhiravatanyate||27|| animittoṣṇaśītācchaghanāsrasrucca tattyajet| -----------------------------------------------|28|

-----------------------------------------------| doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sakṛtkṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śuklarūpatām||28|| dhavalābhropaliptābhaṃ niṣpāvardhadalākṛti| atitīvrarujārāgadāhaśvayathupīḍitam||29|| pākātyayena tacchukraṃ varjayettīvravedanam| -----------------------------------------------|30|

-----------------------------------------------| yasya vā liṅganāśo'ntaḥ śyāvaṃ yadvā salohitam|30| atyutsedhāvagāḍhaṃ vā sāśru nāḍīvraṇāvṛtam| purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakam|31| pañcetyuktā gadāḥ kṛṣṇe sādhyāsādhyavibhāgataḥ| 31 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitāsitarogavijñhānīyo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|10|

div.head: sandhisitasitarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: asmādanantaraṃ sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedha ucyate ---- athātaḥ sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyadayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )||3||
jalāsrāvakaphāsrāvayorasādhyatvādupanāhacikitsāmāha ---- upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca| lekhayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa tataśca pratisārayet||1||
pippalīkṣaudrasindhūtthairbadhnīyātpūrvavattataḥ| paṭolapatrāmalakakvāthenāścyotayecca tam||2||

div.ab: parvaṇī baḍiśenāttā bāhyasandhitribhāgataḥ| vṛddhipatreṇa vardhyā'rdhe syādaśrugatiranyathā||3|| cikitsā cārmavatkṣaudrasaindhavapratisāritā| -----------------------------------------------|4|
-----------------------------------------------| pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyettatastamupanāhayet||4|| kurvīta cākṣipākoktaṃ sarvaṃ karma yathāvidhi| -----------------------------------------------|5|
-----------------------------------------------| saindhavārdrakakāsīsalohatāmraiḥ sucūrṇitaiḥ||5|| cūrṇañjanaṃ prayuñjīta sakṣaudrairvā rasakriyām| -----------------------------------------------|6|

-----------------------------------------------| kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca||6|| triphalākṣaudrakāsīsasaindhavaiḥ pratisārayet| -----------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: kaphābhiṣyandavanmuktvā sirāvyadhamupācaret| bījapūrarasāktaṃ ca vyoṣakaṭphalamañjanam||8||
jātīmukulasindhūtthadevadārumahauṣadhaiḥ| piṣṭaiḥ prasannayā vartiḥ śophakaṇḍūghnamañjanam||9||

div.ab: raktasyandavadutpātaharṣajālārjunukriyā| -----------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikamañjanam||10||
sirāharṣe tu madhunā ślakṣṇaghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam| arjune śarkarāmastukṣaudrairāścayotanaṃ hitam||11||
sphaṭikaḥ kuṅkumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhunā'ñjanam| madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha||12||
armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat| raktaṃ dadhinibhaṃ yacca śukravattasya bheṣajam||13||
athārmaṇaḥ śastracikitsāmāha ---- uttānasyetarat svinnaṃ sasindhūtthena cāñjitam| rasena bījapūrasya nimīlyākṣi vimardayet||14||
itthaṃ saṃroṣitākṣāsya pracale'rmādhimāṃsake| dhṛtasya niścalaṃ mūrdhni vartmanośca viśeṣataḥ||15||
apāṅgamīkṣamāṇasya vṛddh'rmaṇi kanīnakāt| valī syādyatra tatrārma baḍiśenāvalambitam||16||
nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ| samantānmaṇḍalāgreṇa mocayedatha mokṣitam||17||
kanīnakamupānīya caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam| chindyātkanīnakaṃ rakṣedvāhinīścāśruvāhinīḥ||18||
kanīnakavyadhādaśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate| vṛddhe'rmaṇi tathā'pāṅgātpaśyato'sya kanīnakam||19||
samyak chinnaṃ madhuvyoṣasaindhavapratisāritam| uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktamabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā||20||
badhnīyātsecayenmuktvā tṛtīyādidineṣu ca| karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇa kvathitaistathā||21||
sakṣaudrairdviniśārodhrapaṭolīyaṣṭikiṃśukaiḥ| kuraṇṭamukulopetairmuñcedevāhni saptame||22||
samyak chinne bhavetsvāsthyaṃ hīnāticchedajān gadān| sekāñjanaprabhṛtibhirjayellekhanabṛṃhaṇaiḥ||23||

div.ab: sitāmanaḥśilaileyalavaṇottamanāgaram| ardhakarṣonmitaṃ tārkṣyaṃ palārdhaṃ ca madhudrutam||24|| añjanaṃ śleṣmatimirapillaśukrārmaśeṣajit| -----------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| triphalaikatamadravyatvacaṃ pānīyakalkitām||25||
śarāvapihitāṃ dagdhvā kapāle cūrṇayettataḥ| pṛthakśeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthageva ca bhāvitā||26||
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā| triṇyetānyañjanānyāha lekhanāni paraṃ nimiḥ||27||
sirājāle sirā yāstu kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhaiḥ| na siddhyantyarmavattāsāṃ piṭikānāṃ ca sādhanam||28||
doṣānurodhācchukreṣu snigdharūkṣā varā ghṛtam| tiktamūrdhvamasṛksrāvo rekasekādi ceṣyate||29||

div.ab: tristrivṛdvāriṇā pakvaṃ kṣataśukre ghṛtaṃ pibet| sirāyāν haredraktaṃ jalaukobhiśca locanāt||30|| siddhenotpalakākolīdrākṣāyaṣṭividāribhiḥ| sasitenājapayasā secanaṃ salilena vā||31|| rāgāśruvedanāśāntau paraṃ lekhanamañjanam| -----------------------------------------------|32|
-----------------------------------------------| vartayo jātimukulalākṣāgairikacandanaiḥ||32|| prasādayanti pittāsraṃ ghnanti ca kṣataśukrakam| -----------------------------------------------|33|

-----------------------------------------------| dantairdantivarāhoṣṭragavāśvājakharodbhavaiḥ||33|| saśaṅkhamauktikāmbhodhiphenairmaricapādikaiḥ| kṣataśukramapi vyāpi dantavartirnivatayet||34|| tamālapatraṃ godantaśaṅkhapheno'sthi gārdabham| tāmraṃ ca vartirmūtreṇa sarvaśukrakanāśinī||35|| ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi dhātavastryūṣaṇaṃ truṭiḥ| karañjabījaṃ laśuno vraṇasādi ca bheṣajam||36|| savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraghnamañjanam| nimnamunnamayetsnehapānanasyarasāñjanaiḥ||37|| sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tṛptipuṭapākena śukrakam| -----------------------------------------------|38|
-----------------------------------------------| śuddhaśukre niśāyaṣṭīsārivāśābarāmbhasā||38|| secanaṃ rodhrapoṭalyā koṣṇāmbhomagnayā'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|39|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| bṛhatīmūlayaṣṭyāhvatāmrasaindhavanāgaraiḥ||39||
dhātrīphalāmbunā piṣṭairlepitaṃ tāmrabhājanam| yavājyāmalakīpatrairbahuśo dhūpayettataḥ||40||
tatra kurvīta guṭikāstā jalakṣaudrapeṣitāḥ| mahānīlā iti khyātāḥ śuddhaśukraharāḥ param||41||
sthire śure ghane cāsya bahuśo'paharedrasṛk| śiraḥkāyavirekāṃśca puṭapākāṃśca bhūriśaḥ||42||
kuryānmaricavaidehīśirīṣaphalasaindhavaiḥ| harṣaṇaṃ triphalākvāthapītena lavaṇena vā||43||

div.ab: kuryādañjanayogau vā ślokārdhagaditāvimau| śaṅkhakolāsthikatakadrākṣāmadhukamākṣikaiḥ||44|| surādantārṇavamalaiḥ śirīṣakusumānvitaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|45|
-----------------------------------------------| dhātrīphaṇijjakarase kṣāro lāṅgalikodbhavaḥ||45|| uṣitaḥ śoṣitataścūrṇaḥ śukraharṣaṇamañjanam| -----------------------------------------------|46|

-----------------------------------------------| mudgā vā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭāḥ śaṅkhakṣaudrasamāyutāḥ||46|| sāro madhūkānmadhumān majjā vā'kṣātsamākṣikā| gokharāśvoṣṭradaśanāḥ śaṅkhaḥ phenaḥ samudrajaḥ||47|| vartirarjunatoyena hṛṣṭaśukrakanāśinī| -----------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālādibhirlikhet||48||

div.ab: sirāśukre tvadṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukravat| -----------------------------------------------|49|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| puṇḍrayaṣṭyāhvakākolīsiṃhīlohaniśāñjanam||49||
kalkitaṃ chāgadugdhena saghṛtairdhūpitaṃ yavaiḥ| dhātrīpatraiśca paryāyādvartiratrāñjanaṃ param||50||

div.ab: aśāntāvarmavacchastramajakākhye ca yojayet| -----------------------------------------------|51|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| ajakāyāmasādhyāyāṃ śukre'nyatra ca tadvidhe||51||
vedanopaśamaṃ snehapānāsṛksrāvaṇādibhiḥ| kuryādbībhatsatāṃ jetuṃ śukrasyotsedhasādhanam||52||
nālikerāsthibhallātatālavaṃśakarīrajam| bhasmādbhiḥ srāvayettābhirbhāvayetkarabhāsthijam||53||
cūrṇaṃ śukreṣvasādhyeṣu tadvaivarṇyaghnamañjanam| sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālamidameva ca śīlitam||54||

div.ab: ajakāṃ pāRśvato vidhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam| samaṃ prapīḍyāṅguṣṭhena vasārdreṇānu pūrayet|55| vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca| saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire|56| snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā| tathā'pi punarādhmāne bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyām|57| yuktyā kuryādyathā nāticchedena syānnimajjanam| 57 1/2| nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt| na hīyate labdhabalā tathā'nta- stīkṣṇāñjanairdṛk satataṃ prayuktaiḥ| 58 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|11|

div.head: dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) sirānusāriṇi male prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ śrite| avyaktamīkṣate rūpaṃ vyaktamapyanimittataḥ||1||
prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalamabhūtamapi paśyati| bhūtaṃ tu yatnādāsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate||2||
dūrāntikasthaṃ rūpaṃ ca viparyāsena manyate| doṣe maṇḍalasaṃsthāne maṇḍalānīva paśyati||3||
dvidhaikaṃ dṛṣṭimadhyasthe bahudhā bahudhāsthite| dṛṣṭerabhyantaragate hnasvavṛddhaviparyayam||4||
māntikasthamadhaḥsaṃsthe dūragaṃ nopari sthite| pārśve paśyennapārśvasthe timirākhyo'yamāmayaḥ||5||

div.ab: prāpnoti kācatāṃ doṣe tṛtīyapaṭalāśrite| tenordhvamīkṣate nādhastanucailāvṛtopamam||6|| yathā varṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭirhīyeta ca kramāt| -----------------------------------------------|7|
-----------------------------------------------| tathā'pyupekṣamāṇasya caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ||7|| liṅganāśaṃ malaḥ kurvan chādayeddṛṣṭimaṇḍalam| -----------------------------------------------|8|

iti sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktva viśeṣamāha ---- -----------------------------------------------| tatra vātena timire vyāviddhamiva paśyati||8|| calāvilāruṇābhāsaṃ prasannaṃ cekṣate muhuḥ| jalāni keśān maśakān raśmīṃścopekṣite'tra ca||9|| kācībhūte dṛgaruṇā paśyatyāsyamanāsikam| candradīpādyanekatvaṃ vakramṛjvapi manyate||10|| vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryādrajodhūmāvṛtāmiva| spaṣṭāruṇābhāṃ vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā hatadarśanām||11|| sa liṅganāśo------------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: adhunā vāyusāmānyāṃ gambhīrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- -------------------vāte tu saṅkocayati dṛksirāḥ| dṛgmaṇḍalaṃ viśatyantargambhīrā dṛgasou smṛtā||12||
pittaje timire vidyutkhadyotadyotadīpitam| śikhitittiripatrābhaṃ prāyo nīlaṃ ca paśyati||13||
kāce dṛk kācanīlābhā tādṛgeva ca paśyati| arkendupativeṣāgnimaricīndradhanūṃṣi ca||14||
bhṛṅganīlā nirālokā dṛk snigdhā liṅganāśataḥ| dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hṛsva hrasvadarśinī||15||

div.ab: bhavetpittavidagdhākhyā pītā pītābhadarśanā| -----------------------------------------------|16|

-----------------------------------------------| kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati||16|| śaṅkhedukundakusumaiḥ kumudairiva cācitam| kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkapradīpādyairivācitam||17|| sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syālliṅganāśe tu lakṣyate| mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ snigdho darśananāśanaḥ||18|| bindurjalasyeva calaḥ padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ| uṣṇe saṅkocamāyāti chāyāyāṃ parisarpati||19|| śaṅkhakundendukumudasphaṭikopamaśuklimā| -----------------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati||20||
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭistadṛk ca paśyati| liṅganāśe'pi tādṛg dṛṅ niṣprabhā hatadarśanā||21||

div.ab: saṃsargasannipāteṣu vidyātsaṅkīrṇalakṣaṇān| timirādīnakasmācca taiḥ syādvyaktākulekṣaṇaḥ||22|| timire, śeṣayordṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate| -----------------------------------------------|23|
-----------------------------------------------| dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ||23|| nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi| -----------------------------------------------|24|

-----------------------------------------------| arke'stamastakanyastagabhastau stambhamāgatāḥ||24|| sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado'paraḥ| divākarakaraspṛṣṭā bhraṣṭā dṛṣṭipathānmalāḥ||25|| vilīnalīnā yacchanti vyaktamatrāhni darśanam| -----------------------------------------------|26|

-----------------------------------------------| uṣṇataptasya sahasā śītavārinimajjanāt||26|| tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkto yātyūṣmordhvaṃ tato'kṣiṇi| dāhoṣe malinaṃ śuklamahanyāviladarśanam||27|| rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā| -----------------------------------------------|28|
-----------------------------------------------| bhṛśamamlāśanāddoṣaiḥ sāsrairyā dṛṣṭirācitā||28|| sakledakaṇḍūkaluṣā vidagdhā'mlena sā smṛtā| -----------------------------------------------|29|
-----------------------------------------------| śokajvaraśirorogasantaptasyānilādayaḥ||29|| dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ| -----------------------------------------------|30|

-----------------------------------------------| sahasaivālpasattvasya paśyato rūpamadbhutam||30|| bhāsvaraṃ bhāśkarādiṃ vā vātādyā nayanāśritāḥ| kurvanti tejaḥ saṃśoṣya dṛṣṭiṃ muṣitadarśanām||31|| vaidūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthāmivāvyathām| oupasargika ityeṣa liṅganāśo--------------------|32|

-----------------------------------------------| -------------------------------'tra varjayet|32| vinā kaphālliṅganāśān gambhīrāṃ hRasvajāmapi| ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaśca yāpyāḥ, śeṣāṃstu sādhayet|33| dvādaśeti gadā dṛṣṭou nirdiṣṭāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ| 33 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|12|

div.head: timirapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: asmādanantaraṃ timiripratiṣedha ucyate ----- athātastimirapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
timiraṃ kācatāṃ yāti kāco'pyāndhyamupekṣayā| netrarogeṣvato ghoraṃ timiraṃ sādhayed drutam||1||

div.ab: tulāṃ pacet jīvantyā droṇe'pāṃ pādaśeṣite| tatkvāthe dviguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||2|| prapauṇḍarīkakākolīpippalīrodhrasaindhavaiḥ| śatahvāmadhukadrākṣāsirādāruphalatrayaiḥ||3|| karṣikairniśi tatpītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|4|

----------------------------------------------| drākṣācandanamañjiṣṭhākākolīdvayajīvakaiḥ||4|| sitāśatāvarīmedāpuṇḍrāhvamadhukotpalaiḥ| pacejjīrṇaghṛtaprasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ picūnmitaiḥ||5|| hanti tatkācatimiraraktarājīśirorujaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|6|

----------------------------------------------| paṭolanimbakaṭukādārvīsevyavarāvṛṣam||6|| sadhanvayāsatrāyantīparpaṭaṃ pālikaṃ pṛthak| prasthamāmalakānaṃ ca kvāthayennalvaṇe'mbhasi||7|| tadāḍhake'rdhapalikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtātpacet| mustabhūnimbayaṣṭyāhvakuṭajodīcyacandanaiḥ||8|| sapippalīkaistatsarpighrāṇakarṇāsyarogajit| vidradhijvaraduṣṭārurvisarpāpacikuṣṭhanut||9|| viśeṣācchukratimiranaktāndhyoṣṇāmladāhahṛt| ----------------------------------------------|10|

----------------------------------------------| triphalāṣṭapalaṃ kvāthyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ jalāḍhake||10|| tena tulyapayaskena triphalāpalakalkavān| ardhaprastho ghrutātsiddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā||11|| yuktaṃ pibettattimirī tadyuktaṃ vā varārasam| ----------------------------------------------|12|

----------------------------------------------| yaṣṭīmadhudvikākolīvyāghrīkṛṣṇāmṛtotpalaiḥ||12|| pālikaiḥ sasirādrākṣairghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetsamaiḥ| ajākṣīravarāvāsāmārkavasvarasaiḥ pṛthak||13|| mahātraiphalamityetatparaṃ dṛṣṭivikārajit| ----------------------------------------------|14|

----------------------------------------------| traiphalenātha haviṣā lihānastriphalāṃ niśi||14|| yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyuktāṃ madhunā ca pariplutām| māsamekaṃ hitāhāraḥ pibannāmalakodakam||15|| sauparṇaṃ labhate cakṣurityāha bhagavānnimiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|16|
----------------------------------------------| tāpyāyohemayaṣṭyāhvasitājīrṇājyamākṣikaiḥ||16|| saṃyojitā yathākāmaṃ timiraghnī varā varā| ----------------------------------------------|17|
----------------------------------------------| saghṛtaṃ vā varākvāthaṃ śīlayettimirāmayī||17|| apūpasūpasaktūn vā triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān| ----------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pāyasaṃ vā varāyuktaṃ śītaṃ samadhuśarkaram||18||
prātarbhaktasya vā pūrvamadyātpathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak| mṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudraiḥ satataṃ timirāturaḥ||19||
srotojāṃśāṃścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tāmrāyorūpyakāñcanaiḥ| yuktān pratyekamekāṃśairandhamūṣodarasthitān||20||
dhmāpayitvā samāvṛttaṃ tatastacca niṣecayet| rasaskandhakaṣāyeṣu saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||21||
vaiḍūryamuktāśaṅkhānāṃ tribhirbhāgairyutaṃ tataḥ| cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta tatsarvatimirāpaham||22||
māṃsītrijātakāyaḥkuṅkumanīlotpalābhayātutthaiḥ| sitakācaśaṅkhaphenakamaricāñjanapippalīmadhukaiḥ||23||
candre'śvanīsanāthe sucūrṇitairañjayedyugulamakṣṇoḥ| timirārmaraktarājīkaṇḍūkācādiśamamicchan||24||
maricavaralavaṇabhāgau bhāgau dvau kaṇasamudraphenābhyām| sauvīrabhāganavakaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphamayajit||25||
| manohvātutthakastūrīmāṃsīmalayarocanāḥ| daśakarpūrasaṃyuktamaśītiguṇamañjanam||1||
piṣṭaṃ citrāśvinīpuṣye ṣaḍvidhe timire hitam| prasādanaṃ ca dṛṣṭeḥ syāccakṣuṣeṇāvabhāṣitam]||2||
drākṣāmṛṇālīsvarase kṣīramadyavasāsu ca| pṛthak divyāpsu srotojaṃ saptakṛtvo niṣecayet||26||
taccūrṇitaṃ sthitaṃ śaṅkhe dṛkprasādanamañjanam| śastaṃ sarvākṣirogeṣu videhapatinirmitam||27||

div.ab: nirdagdhaṃ bādarāṅgāraistutthaṃ cetthaṃ niṣecitam| kramādajāpayaḥ sarpiḥkṣaudre tasmāt paladvayam||28|| kārṣikaistāpyamaricasrotojakaṭukānataiḥ| paṭurodhnaśilāpathyākaṇailāñjanaphenakaiḥ||29|| yuktaṃ palena yaṣṭyāśca mūṣāntardhmātacūrṇitam| hanti kācārmanaktāndhyaraktarājīḥ suśīlataḥ||30|| cūrṇo viśeṣāttimiraṃ bhāskaro bhāskaro yathā| ----------------------------------------------|31|

----------------------------------------------| triṃśadbhāgā bhujaṅgasya gandhapāṣāṇapañcakam||31|| śulbatālakayordvau dvau vaṅgasyaiko'ñjanāttrayam| andhamūṣīkṛtaṃ dhmātaṃ pakvaṃ vimalamañjanam||32|| timirāntakaraṃ loke dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ| ----------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: gomūtre chagaṇarase'mlakāñjike ca strīstanye haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca| yattutthaṃ jvalitamanekaśo niṣiktaṃ tatkuryādgaruḍasamaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ||33||
śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyamajāpayaḥ| yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yatsīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||34||
taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā'nañjanā vā| taimiryārmasrāpapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti||35||
rasendrabhujagau tulyau tayostulyamathāñjanam| īṣātkarpūrasaṃyuktamañjanaṃ timirāpaham||36||
yo gṛdhrastaruṇaraviprakāśagalla- stasyāsyaṃ samayamṛtasya gośakṛdbhiḥ| nirdagdhaṃ samadhṛtamañjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo'yaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti gārdhram||37||
kṛṣṇasarpavadane sahaviṣkaṃ dagdhamañjananiḥsṛtadhūmam| cūrṇitaṃ naladapatravimiśraṃ bhinnatāramapi rakṣati cakṣuḥ||38||
kṛṣṇasarpaṃ mṛtaṃ nyasya caturaścāpi vṛścikān| kṣīrakumbhe trisaptāhaṃ kledayitvā pramanthayet||39||
tatra yannavanītaṃ syātpuṣṇīyāttena kukkuṭam| andhastasya purīṣeṇa prekṣate dhruvamañjanāt||40||
kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkhaḥ katakāt phalamañjanam| rasakriyeyamacirādandhānaṃ darśanapradā||41||
maricāni daśārdhapicu- stāpyāttutthātpalaṃ picuryaṣṭyāḥ| kṣīrārdradagdhamañjana- mapratisārākhyamuttamaṃ timire||42||
akṣabījamaricāmalakatvak- tutthayaṣṭimadhukairjalapiṣṭaiḥ| chāyayaiva guṭikāḥ pariśuṣkā nāśanyanti timirāṇyacireṇa||43||
maricāmalakajalodbhava- tutthāñjanatāpyadhātubhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ| ṣaṇmākṣika iti yoga- stimirārmakledakācakaṇḍūhantā||44||
ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ srotoñjanaṃ tāmramayaḥ saśaṅkham| kucandanaṃ lohitagairikaṃ ca cūrṇāñjanaṃ sarvadṛgāmayaghnam||45||
tilatailamakṣatailaṃ bhṛṅgasvaraso'sanācca niryūhaḥ| āyasapātravipakvaṃ karoti dṛṣṭerbalaṃ nasyam||46||
doṣānurodhena ca naikaśastaṃ snehāsravisravaṇarekanasyaiḥ| upācaredañjanamūrdhabasti- bastikriyātarpaṇalepasekaiḥ||47||
----------------------------------------------| sāmānyaṃ sādhanamidam pratidoṣamataḥ śṛṇu||48||
kiṃ tat ? ityāha ---- vātaje timire tatra daśamūlāmbhasā ghṛtam| kṣīre caturguṇe śreṣṭhākalkapakvaṃ pibettataḥ||49||
triphalāpañcamūlānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ kṣīrasaṃyutam| eraṇḍatailasaṃyuktaṃ yojayecca virecanam||50||

div.ab: samūlajālajīvantītulāṃ droṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet| aṣṭabhāgasthaite tasmiṃstailaprasthaṃ payaḥsame||51|| balātritayajīvantīvarīmūlaiḥ palonmitaiḥ| yaṣṭīpalaiścaturbhiśca lohapātre vipācayet||52|| loha eva sthitaṃ māsaṃ nāvanādūrdhvajatrujān| vātapittāyamayān hanti tadviśeṣāddṛgāśrayān||53|| keśāsyakandharāskandhapuṣṭilāvaṇyakāntidam| ----------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: ghoṣayā bilvamūlaiśca tailaṃ pakvaṃ payonvitam| nasyaṃ sarvordhvajatrūtthavātaśleṣmāmayārtijit||55||
vasā'ñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate| gṛdhrāhikukkuṭotthā vā madhukenānvitā pṛthak||56||
pratyañjane ca srotojaṃ rasakṣīraghṛte kramāt| niṣiktaṃ pūrvavadyojyaṃ timiraghnamanuttamam||57||
prapauṇḍarīkasaralapippalīdevadārubhiḥ| sarpiraṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ tarpaṇamuttamam||59||
medasastadvadaiṇeyāddugdhasiddhāt khajāhatāt| uddhṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ tejo madhukośīracandanaiḥ||60||
śvāvicchalyakagodhānāṃ dakṣatittiribarhiṇām| pṛthakpṛthaganenaiva vidhinā kalpayedvasām||61||

div.ab: prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca puṭapākaṃ prayojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|62|

ab.seg: pittaje timire sarpirjīvanīyaphalatrayaiḥ| vipācitaṃ pāyayitvā snigdhasya vyadhayetsirām||63||

div.ab: śarkarailātrivṛccūrṇairmadhuyuktairvirecayet| ----------------------------------------------------|64|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| suśītān sekalepādīn yuñjyānnetrāsyamūrdhasu||64||
sārivāpadmakośīramuktāśābaracandanaiḥ| vartiḥ śastā'ñjane, cūrṇastathā patrotpalāñjanaiḥ||65||
sanāgapuṣpakarpūrayaṣṭyāhvasvarṇagairikaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------||66||

div.ab: ----------------------------------------------------| sauvīrāñjanatutthakaśṛṅgīdhātrīphalasphaṭikakarpūtam| pañcāṃśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ tryaṃśamathaikāṃśamañjanaṃ timiraghnam| ----------------------------------------------------|67|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| nasyaṃ cājyaṃ śṛtaṃ kṣīrajīvanīyasitotpalaiḥ||67||

div.ab: śleṣmodbhave'mṛtākvāthavarākaṇaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam| vidhyetsirāṃ pītavato dadyāccānu virecanam||68|| kvāthaṃ pūgābhayāśuṇṭhīkṛṣṇākumbhanikumbhajam| ----------------------------------------------------|69|

----------------------------------------------------| hnīberadārudviniśākṛṣṇākalkaiḥ payonvitaiḥ||69|| dvipañcamūlaniryūhe tailaṃ pakvaṃ ca nāvanam| ----------------------------------------------------|70|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------kokilā punaḥ| kṛṣṇaloharajovyoṣasaindhavatriphalāñjanaiḥ||71||

div.ab: śaśagokharasiṃhoṣṭradvijā lālāṭamasthi ca| śvetagovālamaricaśaṅkhacandanaphenakam||72|| piṣṭaṃ stanyājadugdhābhyāṃ vartistimiśukrajit| ----------------------------------------------------|73|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| raktaje pittavatsiddhiḥ śītaiścāsraṃ prasādayet||73||
drākṣayā naladarodhrayaṣṭibhiḥ śaṅkhatāmrahimapadmapadmakaiḥ| sotpalaiśchagaladugdhavartitai- rasrajaṃ timiramāśu naśyati||74||

div.ab: saṃsargasannipātotthe yathādoṣodayaṃ kriyā| ----------------------------------------------------|75|

----------------------------------------------------| siddhaṃ madhūkakṛmijinmaricāmaradārubhiḥ||75|| sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭairlepo mukhasya ca| ----------------------------------------------------|76|

----------------------------------------------------| natanīlotpalānantāyaṣṭyāhvasuniṣaṇṇakaiḥ||76|| sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirobastau ca śasyate| ----------------------------------------------------|77|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| dadyāduśīraniryūhe cūrṇitaṃ kaṇasaindhavam||77||
tatsrutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacetkṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet| śīte cāsmin hitamidaṃ sarvaje timire'ñjanam||78||

div.ab: asthīni majjapūrṇāni sattvānāṃ rātricāriṇām| srotojāñjanayuktāni vahatyambhasi vāsayet||79|| māsaṃ viṃśatirātraṃ vā tataścoddhṛtya śoṣayet| sameṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpāṇi sayaṣṭyāhvāni tānyanu||80|| cūrṇitānyañjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timire sānnipātike| ----------------------------------------------------|81|

----------------------------------------------------| kāce'pyeṣā kriyā muktvā sirāṃ, yantranipīḍitāḥ||81|| āndhyāya syurmalā dadyātsrāvye tvasre jalaukasaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|82|
----------------------------------------------| guḍaḥ pheno'ñjanaṃ kṛṣṇā maricaṃ kuṅkumādrajaḥ||82|| rasakriyeyaṃ sakṣaudrā kācayāpanamañjanam| ----------------------------------------------|83|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| nakulandhe tridoṣotthe taimiryavihito vidhiḥ||83||
rasakriyā ghṛtakṣaudragomayasvarasadrutaiḥ| tārkṣyagairikatālīsairniśāndhe hitamañjanam||84||

div.ab: daghnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātryandhe'ñjanamuttamam| ----------------------------------------------|85|
----------------------------------------------| karañjikotpalasvarṇagairikāmbhojakesaraiḥ||85|| piṣṭairgomayatoyena vartidoṣāndhanāśinī| ----------------------------------------------|86|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| ajāmūtreṇa vā kauntīkṛṣṇāsrotojasaindhavaiḥ||86||
kālānusārītrikātutriphalālamanaḥśilāḥ| saphenāśchāgadugdhena rātryandhe vartayo hitāḥ||87||
sanniveśya yakṛnmadhye pippalīradahanpacet| tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭhamañjanam||88||

div.ab: khādecca plīhayakṛtī māhiṣe tailasarpiṣā| ----------------------------------------------|89|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet||89||
tathā'timuktakairaṇḍāśophālyabhīrujāni ca| bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam||90||
dhūmarākhyāmlapittoṣṇavidāhe jīrṇasarpiṣā| snigdhaṃ verecayecchītaiḥ śītordihyācca sarvataḥ||91||
gośakṛdrasadugdhājyairvipakvaṃ śasyate'ñjanam| svarṇagairikatālīsacūrṇāvāpā rasakriyā||92||
medāśābarakānantāmañjiṣṭhādārviyaṣṭibhiḥ| kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam||93||

div.ab: tarpaṇaṃ kṣīrasarpiḥ syādaśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|94|

----------------------------------------------| cintābhighātabhīśokaraukṣyāt sotkaṭakāsanāt||94|| virekanasyavamanapuṭapākādivibhramāt| vidagdhāhāravamanāt kṣuttṛṣṇādividhāraṇāt||95|| akṣirogāvasānācca paśyettimirarogivat| ----------------------------------------------|96|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam||96||
sūryoparāgānalavidyudādi- vilokanenopahatekṣaṇasya| santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam||97||
cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvadicchā| vyartho loko'yaṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne'pi vitte||98||
triphalā rudhirasrutirviśuddhi- rmanaso nirvṛtirañjanaṃ sanasyam| śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā||99||

div.ab: ahitādaśanātsadā nivṛtti- rbhṛśabhāsvaccalasūkṣmavīkṣaṇācca| muninā niminopadaṣṭametat paramaṃ rakṣaṇamīkṣaṇasya puṃsām|100| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara sthāne timirapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|13|

div.head: liṅganāśapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto liṅganāśapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) vidhyetsujātaṃ niḥprekṣyaṃ liṅganāśaṃ kaphodbhavam| āvartakyādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhirvivarjitamupadravaiḥ||1||
sujātaṃ kasmādvidhyet ? ityāha ---- so'sañjāto hi viṣamo dadhimastunibhastanuḥ| śalākayā'vakṛṣṭo'pi punarūrdhvaṃ prapadyate||2||
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayetpunaḥ| śleṣmalaiḥ pūryate cāśu so'nyaiḥ sopadravaścirāt||3||

div.ab: ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvācchleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ| tasyānyadoṣābhibhavādbhavatyānīlatā gadaḥ|4|

ab.seg: ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvācchleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ| tasyānyadoṣābhibhavādbhavatyānīlatā gadaḥ||4||

div.ab: rājīmatī dṛṅnicitā śāliśūkābharājibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| viṣamacchinnadagdhābhā saruk chinnāṃśukā smṛtā||6||

div.ab: dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsyasamacchāyā candrakī candrakākṛtiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| chatrābhā naikavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā||7||
na vidhyedasirārhāṇāṃ na tṛṭpīnasakāsinām| nājīrṇabhīruvamitaśiraḥkarṇākṣiśūlinām||8||

div.ab: atha sādhāraṇe kāle śuddhasambhojitātmanaḥ| deśe prakāśo pūrvāhṇe bhiṣagjānūccapīṭhagaḥ||9|| yantritasyopaviṣṭasya svinnākṣasya mukhānilaiḥ| aṅguṣṭhamṛdite netre dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvotplutaṃ malam||10|| svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite| kṛṣṇādardhāṅgulaṃ muktvā tathā'rdhārdhamapāṅgataḥ||11|| tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niścalaṃ dhṛtām| daivacchidraṃ nayetpārśvādūrdhvamāmanthayanniva||12|| savyaṃ dakṣiṇahastena netraṃ savyena cetarat| vidhyet---------------------------------------|13|

----------------------------------------------| -------suviddhe śabdaḥ syādaruk cāmbulavasrutiḥ||13|| sāntvayannāturaṃ cānu netraṃ stanyena secayet| śalākāyāstato'greṇa nirlikheṇṇetramaṇḍalam||14|| abādhamānaḥ śanakairnāsāṃ prati nudaṃstataḥ| ucchiṅghanāccāpahareddṛṣṭimaṇdalagaṃ kapham||15|| sthire doṣe cale vā'ti svedayedakṣi bāhyataḥ| atha dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākāmāharecchanaiḥ||16|| ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā baddhākṣaṃ śāyayettataḥ| viddhādanyena pārśvena tamuttānaṃ dvayorvyadhe||17|| nivāte śayane'bhyaktaśiraḥpādaṃ hite ratam| ----------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| kṣavathuṃ kāsamudgāraṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ pānamambhasaḥ||18||
adhomukhasthitiṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanabhakṣaṇam| saptāhaṃ nācāretsnehapītavaccātra yantraṇā||19||
śaktito laṅghayetseko ruji koṣṇena sarpiṣā| savyoṣāmalakaṃ vāṭyamaśnīyātsaghṛtaṃ dravam||20||
vilepīṃ vā tryahāccāsya kvāthairmuktvā'kṣi secayet| vātaghnaiḥ saptame tvahni sarvathaivākṣi mocayet||21||
yantraṇāmanurudhyeta dṛṣṭerāsthairyalābhataḥ| rūpāṇi sūkṣmadīptāni sahasā nāvalokayet||22||
śopharāgarujādīnāmadhimanthasya codbhavaḥ| ahitairvedhadoṣācca yathāsvaṃ tānupācaret||23||
kalkitāḥ saghṛtā dūrvāyavagairikasārivāḥ| mukhālepe prayoktavyā rujārāgopaśāntaye||24||

div.ab: sasarṣapāstilāstadvanmātuluṅgarasāplutāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|25|
----------------------------------------------| payasyāsārivāpatramañjiṣṭhāmadhuyaṣṭibhiḥ||25|| ajākṣīrayutairlepaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ śarmakṛtparam| ----------------------------------------------|26|
----------------------------------------------| rodhrasaindhavamṛdvīkāmadhukaiśchāgalaṃ payaḥ||26|| śṛtamāścyotanaṃ yojyaṃ rujārāgavināśanam| ----------------------------------------------|27|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| madhukotpalakuṣṭhairva drākṣālākṣāsitānvitaiḥ||27||
vātaghnasiddhe payasi śṛtaṃ sarpiścaturguṇe| padmakādipratīvāpaṃ sarvakarmasu śasyate||28||
sirāṃ tathā'nupaśame snigdhasvinnasya mokṣayet| manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryādvedhe rūḍhe'ñjanaṃ mṛdu||29||
āḍhakīmūlamaricaharitālarasāñjanaiḥ| viddhe'kṣṇi saguḍā vartiryojyā divyāmbupeṣitā||30||

div.ab: jātīśirīṣadhavameṣaviṣāṇipuṣpa vaiḍūryamauktikaphalaṃ payasā supiṣṭam| ājena tāmramamunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punaridaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam||31|| piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitamanātapaśuṣkamakṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛcca dṛṣṭeḥ| ---------------------------------------- - ----------------------------------|32|

---------------------------------------- - ----------------------------------| srotojavidrumaśilāmbudhiphenatīkṣṇai- rasyaiva tulyamuditaṃ guṇakalpanābhiḥ|32| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma catu rdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|14|

div.head: sarvākṣirogavijñāniyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: adhunā kramaprāptaṃ sarvākṣirogavijñānaṃ vakti ---- athātaḥ sarvākṣirogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| vātena netre'bhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāho'lpaśophatā| śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭasya todasphuraṇabhedanam||1|| śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītamacchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ| nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ kṛcchrājjantūnāmiva sarpaṇam||2|| akṣyādhmātamivābhāti sūkṣmaiḥ śalyairivācitam| snigdhoṣṇaiścopaśamanaṃ so'bhiṣyandaḥ--------|3|

ab.seg: adhimantho bhavettatra karṇayornadanaṃ bhramaḥ| araṇyeva ca mathyante lalāṭākṣibhruvādayaḥ||4||
hatādhimanthaḥ so'pi syāt pramādāttena vedanāḥ| anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā||5||

div.ab: manyākṣiśaṅkhato vāyuranyato vā pravartayan| vyathāṃ tīvrāmapaicchilyarāgaśophaṃ vilocanam||6|| saṅkocayati paryaśru so'nyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| tadvajjihmaṃ bhavennetramūnaṃ vā vātaparyaye||7||

div.ab: dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ| antaḥ kledo'śru pītoṣṇaṃ rāgaḥ pītābhadarśanam||8|| kṣārokṣitakṣatākṣitvaṃ pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|9|

---------------------------syande tu kaphasambhave| jāḍyaṃ śopho mahān kaṇḍūrnidrā'nnānabhinandanam||10|| sāndrasnigdhabahuśvetapicchāvaddūṣikāśrutā| -----------------------------------------------|11|
-----------------------------------------------| adhimanthe nataṃ kṛṣṇamunnataṃ śuklamaṇḍalam||11|| praseko nāsikādhmānaṃ pāṃśupūrṇamivekṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|12|
-----------------------------------------------| raktāśrurājīdūṣīkāraktamaṇḍaladarśanam||12|| raktasyandena nayanaṃ sapittasyandalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| manthe'kṣi tāmraparyantamutpāṭanasamānaruk||13||
rogeṇa bandhūkanibhaṃ tāmyati sparśanākṣamam| asṛṅnimagnāriṣṭābhaṃ kṛṣṇamagnyābhadarśanam||14||
adhimanthā yathāsvaṃ ca sarve syāndādhikavyathāḥ| śaṅkadantakapoleśu kapāle cātirukkarāḥ||15||

div.ab: vātapittāturaṃ ghārṣatodabhedopadehavat| rūkṣadāruṇavartmākṣi kṛcchronmīlanimīlanam||16|| vikūṇanaviśuṣkatvaśītecchāśūlapākavat| uktaḥ śuṣkākṣipāko'yaṃ--------------------|17|

-----------------------------------------------| ----------------------saśophaḥ syāttribhirmalaiḥ||17|| saraktaistatra śopho'tirugdāhaṣṭhīvanādimān| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaṃ jāyate śuklamaṇḍalam||18|| aśrūṣṇaśītaviśadapicchilācchaghanaṃ muhuḥ| -----------------------------------------------|19|

-----------------------------------------------| alpaśophe'lpaśophastu pāko'nyairlakṣaṇaistathā||19|| akṣipākātyaye śophaḥ saṃrambhaḥ kaluṣāśrutā| kaphopadigdhamasitaṃ sitaṃ prakledarāgavat||20|| dāho darśanasaṃrodho vedanāścānavasthitāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|21|

-----------------------------------------------| annasāro'mlatāṃ nītaḥ pittaraktolbaṇairmalaiḥ||21|| śirābhirnetramārūḍhaḥ karoti śyāvalohitam| saśophadāhapākāśru bhṛśaṃ cāviladarśanam||22|| amloṣito'yam--------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| hatādhimanthameteṣu sākṣipākātyayaṃ tyajet||23||

div.ab: vātodbhūtaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saptāhena śleṣmajāto'dhimanthaḥ| raktotpanno hanti tadvattrirātrāt mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva|24| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sarvākṣirogavijñānīyo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|25|

div.head: sarvākṣirogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: adhunā sarvākṣirogapratiṣedha upakramyate ---- athātaḥ sarvākṣirogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| prāgrūpa eva syandeṣu tīkṣṇaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam| kārayedupavāsaṃ ca kopādanyatra vātajāt||1||

div.ab: dāhopadeharāgāśruśophaśāntyai biḍālakam| kuryātsarvatra patrailāmaricasvarṇagairikaiḥ||2|| sarasāñjanayaṣṭyāhvanatacandanasaindhavaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|3|

------------------------------------------------| saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ||3|| vātaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā yojyaṃ śabaradeśajam| māṃsīpadmakakālīyayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ pittaraktayoḥ||4|| manohvāphalinīkṣaudraiḥ kaphe, sarvaistu sarvaje| ------------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: sitamaricabhāgamekaṃ caturmanohvaṃ dviraṣṭaśābarkam| sañcūrṇya vastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre'vaguṇṭhanaṃ netre||5||
āraṇyāśchagaṇarase paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnā nakhavituṣīkṛtāḥ kulatthāḥ| taccūrṇaṃ sakṛdavacūrṇanānniśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam||6||
ghoṣābhayātutthakayaṣṭirodhrai- rmūtī susūkṣmaiḥ ślathavastrabaddhaiḥ| tāmrasthadhānyāmlanimagnamūrti- rartiṃ jayatyakṣiṇi naikarūpām||7||
ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ siddham| seko'ṣṭabhāgaśiṣṭaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ sarvadoṣakupite netre||8||
vātapittakaphasannipātajāṃ netrayorbahuvidhāmapi vyathām| śīghrameva jayati prayojitaḥ śigrupallavarasaḥ samākṣikaḥ||9||
taruṇamurubūkapatraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddhamāje kṣīre| vātābhiṣyandarujaṃ sadyo vinihanti saktupiṇḍikā coṣṇā||10||
āścyotanaṃ mārutaje kvātho bilvādibhirhitaḥ| koṣṇaḥ sahairaṇḍajaṭābṛhatīmadhuśigrubhiḥ||11||
hrīberavakraśārṅgeṣṭodumbaratvakṣu sādhitam| sāmbhasā payasā''jena śūlāścyotanamuttamam||12||
mañjiṣṭhārajanīlākṣādrākṣarddhimadhukotpalaiḥ| kvāthaḥ saśarkaraḥ śītaḥ secanaṃ raktapittajit||13||
kaseruyaṣṭyāhvarajastāntave śithilaṃ sthitam| apsu divyāsu nihitaṃ hitaṃ syande'srapittaje||14||
puṇḍrayaṣṭīniśāmūtī plutā stanye saśarkare| chāgadugdhe'thavā dāharugrāgāśrunivartanī||15||
śwetarodhraṃ samadhukaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitaṃ| vastrasthaṃ stanyamṛditaṃ pittaraktābhighātajit||16||
nāgaratriphalānimbavāsarodhrarasaḥ kaphe| koṣṇamāścyotanaṃ miśrairbheṣajaiḥ sānnipātike||17||

div.ab: sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pavane, pitte śarkarayā'nvitam| vyoṣasiddhaṃ kaphe pītvā yavakṣārāvacūrṇitam||18|| srāvayedrudhiraṃ bhūyastataḥ snigdhaṃ virecayet| ------------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca vīkṣya yuñjyādyathāyatham||20||
ayameva vidhiḥ sarvo manthādiṣvapi śasyate| aśāntau sarvathā manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet||21||
rūpyaṃ rūkṣeṇa godadhnā limpennīlatvamāgate| śuṣke tu mastunā vartirvātākṣyāmayanāśinī||22||
sumanaḥkorakāḥ śaṅkhastriphalā madhukaṃ balā| pittaraktāpahā vartiḥ piṣṭā divyena vāriṇā||23||
saindhavaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ śaṅkhanābhiḥ samudrajaḥ| phena aileyakaṃ sarjo vartiḥ śleṣmākṣiroganut||24||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ dārvī cāṣṭapalaṃ pacet| jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet||25||
puṣpāñjanāddaśapalaṃ karṣaṃ ca maricāttataḥ| kṛtaścūrṇo'thavā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyandasambhavān||26||
hanti rāgarujāgharṣān sadyo dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet| ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param||27||

div.ab: śuṣkākṣipāke haviṣaḥ pānamakṣṇośca tarpaṇam| ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena vā'ṇunā||28|| pariṣeko hitaścātra payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam| ------------------------------------------------|29|

------------------------------------------------| sarpiryuktaṃ stanyapiṣṭamañjanaṃ ca mahauṣadham||29|| vasā vā''nūpasattvotthā kiñcitsaindhavanāgarā| ------------------------------------------------|30|

------------------------------------------------| ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān keśān mallakasampuṭe||30|| dagdhvā''jyapiṣṭā lohasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭhamañjanam| ------------------------------------------------|31|

------------------------------------------------| saśophevā'lpaśophe ca snigdhasya vyadhayetsirām||31|| rekaḥ snigdhe punardrākṣāpathyākvāthatrivṛdghṛtaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|32|

------------------------------------------------| śvetarodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tāntavasthitam||32|| uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūlaharaḥ param| ------------------------------------------------|33|
------------------------------------------------| dārvīprapauṇḍarīkasya kvātho vā''ścyotane hitaḥ|33|

ab.seg: sandhavāṃśca prayuñjīta gharṣarāgāśruruggharān| ------------------------------------------------||33||

div.ab: tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ vedanāghnam| tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ||34.5||
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ patrairdhūpitaṃ tadyavaiśca| netre yuktaṃ hanti sandhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cātitīvrām||35.5||
------------------------------------------------| udumbaraphalaṃ lohe ghṛṣṭaṃ stanyena dhūpitam||36|| sājyaiḥ śamīcchadairdāhaśūlarāgāśruharṣajit| ------------------------------------------------|37|
------------------------------------------------| śigrupallavaniryāsaḥ sughṛṣṭastāmrasampuṭe||37|| ghṛtena dhūpito hanti śophagharṣāśruvedanāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|38|

------------------------------------------------| tilāmbhasā mṛtkapālaṃ kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ sudhūpitam||38|| nimbapatrairghṛtābhyaktairgharṣaśūlāśrurāgajit| ------------------------------------------------|39|

------------------------------------------------| sandhāvenāñjite netre vigatauṣadhavedane||39|| stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayecca taiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: jātīmukulakāsīsasaindhavairmūtrapeṣitaiḥ| tāmramālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayetpeṣayettataḥ||41||
mūtreṇaivānu guṭikāḥ kāryāśchāyaviśoṣitāḥ| tāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭā gharṣāśruśophakaṇḍūvināśanāḥ||42||
vyāghrītvaṅ''madhukaṃ tāmrarajo'jākṣīrakalkitam| śamyāmalakapatrājyadhūpitaṃ śopharukpraṇut||43||

div.ab: amloṣite prayuñjīta pittābhiṣyandasādhanam| ---------------------------------------------|44|

---------------------------------------------| utkliṣṭāḥ kaphapittāsranicayotthāḥ kukūṇakaḥ||44|| pakṣmoparodhaḥ śuṣkākṣipākaḥ pūyālaso bisaḥ| pothakyamloṣito'lpākhyaḥ syandamanthā vinā'nilāt||45|| ete'ṣṭādaśa pillākhyā dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|46|

---------------------------------------------| cikitsā pṛthageteṣāṃ svaṃsvamuktā atha vakṣyate||46|| pillībhūteṣu sāmānyāt atha pillākhyarogiṇaḥ| snigdhasya charditavataḥ sirāvyadhahṛtāsṛjaḥ||47|| viriktasya ca vartmānu nirlikhedāviśuddhitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|48|

---------------------------------------------| tutthakasya palaṃ śvetamaricāni ca viṃśatiḥ||48|| triṃśatā kāñjikapalaiḥ piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet| pillānapillān kurute bahuvarṣotthitānapi||49|| tatsekenopadehāśrukaṇḍūśophāṃśca nāśayet| ---------------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| karañjabījaṃ surasaṃ sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca||50||
saṃkṣudya sādhayetkvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā| añjanaṃ pillabhaiṣajyaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam||51||

div.ab: rasāñjanaṃ sarjaraso rītipuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā| samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca||52|| añjanaṃ madhunā piṣṭaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnamuttamam| ---------------------------------------------|53|
---------------------------------------------| abhayārasapiṣṭaṃ vā tagaraṃ pillanāśanam||53|| bhāvitaṃ bastamūtreṇa sasnehaṃ devadāru ca| ---------------------------------------------|54|
---------------------------------------------| saindhavatriphalākṛṣṇākaṭukāśaṅkhnābhayaḥ||54|| satāmrarajaso vartiḥ pillaśukrakanāśinī| ---------------------------------------------|55|
---------------------------------------------| puṣpakāsīsacūrṇo vā surasārasabhāvitaḥ||55|| tāmre daśāhaṃ tat paillyapakṣmaśātajidañjanam| ---------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: alaṃ ca sauvīrakamañjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmrarajaḥ susūkṣmam| pilleṣu romāṇi niṣevito'sau cūrṇaḥ karotyekaśalākayā'pi||56||
lākṣānirguṇḍībhṛṅgadārvīrasena śreṣṭhaṃ kārpāsaṃ bhāvitaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ| dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tatsamutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā||57||
--------------------------------------------| vartmāvalekhaṃ bahuśastadvacchoṇitamokṣaṇam||58||
punaḥpunarvirekaṃ ca nityamāścyotanāñjanam| nāvanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca pillarogāturo bhajet||59||

div.ab: pūyālase tvaśānte'nte dāhaḥ sūkṣmaśalākayā| --------------------------------------------|60|
--------------------------------------------| caturṇavatirityakṣṇo hetulakṣaṇasādhanaiḥ||60|| parasparamasaṅkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyena gaditā gadāḥ| --------------------------------------------|61|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| sarvadā ca niṣeveta svastho'pi nayanapriyaḥ||61||
purāṇayavagodhūmaśāliṣaṣṭikakodravān| mudgādīn kaphapittaghnān bhūrisarpiḥpariplutān||62||
śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām| saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam||63||
ātapatraṃ padatrāṇaṃ vidhivaddoṣaśodhanam| varjayedvegasaṃrodhamajīrṇādhyaśanāni ca||64||
krodhaśokadivāsvapnarātrijāgaraṇātapān| vidāhi viṣṭambhakaraṃ yaccehāhārabheṣajam||65||
dve pādamadhye pṛthusanniveśe śire gate te bahudhā ca netre tā mrakṣaṇodvartanalepanādīn pādaprayuktānnayane nayanti||66||

div.ab: malauṣṇyasaṅghaṭṭanapīḍanādyai- stā dūṣayante nayanāni duṣṭāḥ| bhajetsadā dṛṣṭihitāni tasmā- dupānadabhyañjanadhāvanāni|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|16|

div.head: karṇarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) pratiśyāyajalakrīḍākarṇakaṇḍūyanairmarut| mithyāyogena śabdasya kupito'nyaiśca kopanaiḥ||1||
prāpya śrotrasirāḥ kuryācchūlaṃ srotasi vegavat| ardhāvabhedakaṃ stambhaṃ śiśirānabhinandanam||2||
cirācca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkāmalpaśaḥ sravet| śrotraṃ śūnyamakasmācca syātsañcāravicāravat||3||

div.ab: śūlaṃ pittāt sadāhoṣāśītecchāśvayathujvaram| āśupākaṃ prapakvaṃ ca sapītalasikāsruti||4|| sā lasīkā spṛśedyadyattattatpākamupaiti ca| ---------------------------------------------|5|

-------------------------------------------------| kaphācchirohanugrīvāgauravaṃ mandatā rujaḥ||5|| kaṇḍūḥ śvayathuruṣṇecchā pākācchvetaghanasrutiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|6|
-------------------------------------------------| karoti śravaṇe śūlamabhighātādidūṣitam||6|| raktaṃ pittasamānārti kiñcidvā'dhikalakṣaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śūlaṃ samuditairdoṣaiḥ saśophajvaratīvraruk||7||
paryāyāduṣṇaśītecchaṃ jāyate śrutijāḍyavat| pakvaṃ sitāsitāraktaghanapūyapravāhi ca||8||
śabdavāhisirāsaṃsthe śṛṇoti pavane muhuḥ| nādānakasmādvividhān karṇanādaṃ vadanti tam||9||
śleṣmaṇā'nugato vāyurnādo vā samupekṣitaḥ| uccaiḥ kṛcchrācchrutiṃ kuryādbadhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca||10||
vātena śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā śroto limpettato bhavet| ruggauravaṃ pidhānaṃ ca sa pratīnāhasaṃjñitaḥ||11||

div.ab: kaṇḍūśophau kaphācchrotre sthirau tatsaṃjñayā smṛtau| -------------------------------------------------|12|
-------------------------------------------------| kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tvapi||12|| ghanapūtibahukledaṃ kurute pūtikarṇakam| -------------------------------------------------|13|

-------------------------------------------------| vātādidūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ māṃsāsṛkkledajā rujam||13|| khādanto jantavaḥ kuryustīvrāṃ sa kṛmikarṇakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: ---------------------------śopho'rśo'rbudamīritam| teṣu ruk pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca bādhate||15||

div.ab: garbhe'nilātsaṅkucitā śaṣkulī kucikarṇakaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------sannipātādvidārikā| savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ, sa upekṣitaḥ||17||
kaṭutailanibhaṃ pakvaḥ sravet kṛcchreṇa rohati| saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm||18||

div.ab: sirāsthaḥ kurute vāyuḥ pālīśoṣaṃ tadāhvayam| ---------------------------------------------|19|

---------------------------------------------| kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā||19|| sukumāre cirotsargātsahasaiva pravardhite| karṇe śophaḥ saruk pālyāmaruṇaḥ paripoṭavān||20|| paripoṭaḥ sa pavanāt----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|21|
----------------------utpātaḥ pittaśoṇitāt| gurvābharaṇabhārādyaiḥ śyāvo rugdāhapākavān||21|| śvayathuḥ sphoṭapiṭikārāgoṣākledasaṃyutaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|22|

---------------------------------------------| pālyāṃ śopho'nilakaphātsarvato nirvyathaḥ sthiraḥ||22|| stabdhaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmānunmantho galliraśca saḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|
---------------------------------------------| durviddhe vardhite karṇe sakaṇḍūdāhapākaruk||23|| śvayath uḥ sannipātotthaḥ sa nāmnā duḥkhavardhanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|24|
---------------------------------------------| kaphāsṛk''kṛmijāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sakaṇḍūkledavedanāḥ||24|| lehyākhyāḥ piṭikāstā hi lihyuḥ pālīmupekṣitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|25|

---------------------------------------------| pippalī sarvajaṃ śūlaṃ vidārī kucikarṇakaḥ|25| eṣāmasādhyāḥ, yāpyaikā tantrikā'nyāṃstu sādhayet| pañcaviṃśatirityuktāḥ karṇarogā vibhāgataḥ|26| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|17|

div.head: karṇarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ karṇarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) karṇaśūle pavanaje pibedrātrau rasāśitaḥ| vātaghnasādhitaṃ sarpiḥ, karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet||1|| patrāṇāṃ pṛthagaśvatthabilvārkairaṇḍajanmanām| tailasindhūtthadigdhānāṃ svinnānāṃ puṭapākataḥ||2|| rasaiḥ kavoṣṇaistadvacca mūlakasyāralorapi| ---------------------------------------------|3|
---------------------------------------------| gaṇe vātahare'mleṣu mūtreṣu ca vipācitaḥ||3|| mahāsneho drutaṃ hanti sutīvrāmapi vedanām| ---------------------------------------------|4|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhātkṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt||4||
tailasiktātpradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ| yojyaścaivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhātkuṣṭhātkāṣṭhācca sāralāt||5||
vātavyādhipratiśyāyavihitaṃ hitamatra ca| varjayecchirasā snānaṃ śītāmbhaḥpānamahnyapi||6||
pittaśūle sitāyuktaghṛtasnigdhaṃ virecayet| drākṣāyaṣṭiśṛtaṃ stanyaṃ śasyate karṇapūraṇam||7||

div.ab: yaṣṭyanantāhimośīrakākolīrodhrajīvakaiḥ| mṛṇālabisamañjiṣṭhāsārivābhiśca sādhayet||8|| yaṣṭīmadhurasaprasthakṣīradviprasthasaṃyutam| tailasya kuḍavaṃ nasyapūraṇābhyañjanairidam||9|| nihanti śūladāhoṣāḥ kevalaṃ kṣaudrameva vā| ---------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| yaṣṭyādibhiśca saghṛtaiḥ karṇau dihyātsamantataḥ||10||
vāmayet pippalīsiddhasarpiḥsnigdhaṃ kaphodbhave| dhūmanāvanagaṇḍūṣasvedān kuryātkaphāpahān||11||
laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ muruṅgyā mūlakasya ca| kadalyāḥ svarasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaduṣṇaḥ karṇapūraṇe||12||

div.ab: arkāṅkurānamlapiṣṭāṃstailāktāṃllavaṇānvitān| sannidhāya snuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛtān||13|| svedayetpuṭapākena sa rasaḥ śūlajitparam| ---------------------------------------------|14|
---------------------------------------------| rasena bījapūrasya kapitthasya ca pūrayet||14|| suktena pūrayitvā vā phenenānvavacūrṇayet| ---------------------------------------------|15|
---------------------------------------------| ajāvimūtravaṃśatvak''siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūraṇam||15|| siddhaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgutumburunāgaraiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| raktaje pittavatkāryaṃ sirāṃ cāśu vimokṣayet||16||
pakve pūyavahe karṇe dhūmagaṇḍūṣanāvanam| yuñjyānnāḍīvidhānaṃ ca duṣṭavraṇaharaṃ ca yat||17||
srotaḥ pramujya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picuvartibhiḥ| pureṇa dhūpayitvā tu mākṣikeṇa prapūrayet||18||
surasādigaṇakvāthaphāṇitāktāṃ ca yojayet| picuvartiṃ susūkṣmaiśca taccūrṇairavacūrṇayet||19||
śūlakledagurutvānāṃ vidhireṣa nivartakaḥ| priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhādhātakyutpalaparṇibhiḥ||20||
mañjiṣṭhālodhralākṣābhiḥ kapitthasya rasena ca| pacettailaṃ tadāsrāvaṃ nigṛhṇātyāśu pūraṇāt||21||
nādabādhiryayoḥ kuryād vātaśūloktamauṣadham| śleṣmānubandhe śleṣmāṇaṃ prāgjayedvamanādibhiḥ||22||
eraṇḍaśigruvaruṇamūlakātpatraje rase| caturguṇe pacettailaṃ kṣīre cāṣṭaguṇonmite||23||
yaṣṭyāhvākṣīrakākolīkalkayuktaṃ nihanti tat| nādabādhiryaśūlāni nāvanābhyaṅgapūraṇaiḥ||24||
pakvaṃ prativiṣāhiṅgumiśitvak''svarjikoṣaṇaiḥ| sasuktaiḥ pūraṇāttailaṃ ruk''srāvāśrutinādanut||25||

div.ab: karṇanāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe| ---------------------------------------------|26|

---------------------------------------------| śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍānāṃ kṣāro hiṅgu mahauṣadham||26|| śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhadāruśigrurasāñjanam| sauvarcalayavakṣārasvarjikaudbhidasaindhavam||27|| bhūrjagranthibiḍaṃ mustā madhusuktaṃ caturguṇam| mātuluṅgarasastadvat kadalīsvarasaśca taiḥ||28|| pakvaṃ tailaṃ jayatyāśu sukṛcchrānapi pūraṇāt| kaṇḍūṃ kledaṃ ca bādhiryapūtikarṇatvaruk''kṛmīn||29|| kṣāratailamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhadantāmayeṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| atha suptāviva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ harettataḥ||30||
saśophakledayormandaśrutervamanamācaret| bādhiryaṃ varjayedbālavṛddhayościrajaṃ ca yat||31||
pratīnāhe parikledya snehasvedairviśodhayet| karṇaśodhanakenānu karṇaṃ tailasya pūrayet||32||
sasuktasaindhavamadhormātuluṅgarasasya vā| śodhanādrūkṣatotpattau ghṛtamaṇḍasya pūraṇam||33||
kramo'yaṃ malapūrṇe'pi karṇekaṇḍvāṃ kaphāpaham| nasyādi, tadvacchophe'pi kaṭūṣṇaiścātra lepanam||34||
karṇasrāvoditaṃ kuryātpūtikṛmiṇakarṇayoḥ| pūraṇaṃ kaṭutailena viśeṣāt kṛmikarṇake||35||
vamipūrvā hitā karṇavidradhau vidradhikriyā| pittotthakarṇaśūloktaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣatavidradhau||36||
arśorbudeṣu nāsāvad āmā karṇavidārikā| karṇavidradhivatsādhyā yathādoṣodayena ca||37||

div.ab: pālīśoṣe'nilaśrotraśūlavannasyalepanam| svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīmudvartayettilaiḥ||38|| priyālabījayaṣṭyāhvahayagandhāyavānvitaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|39|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tataḥ puṣṭikaraiḥ snehairabhyaṅgaṃ nityamācaret||39||
śatāvarīvājigandhāpayasyairaṇḍajīvakaiḥ| tailaṃ vipakvaṃ sakṣīraṃ pālīnāṃ puṣṭikṛtparam||40||
kalkena jīvanīyena tailaṃ payasi pācitam| ānūpamāṃsakvāthe ca pālīpoṣaṇavardhanam||41||

div.ab: pālīṃ chittvā'tisaṅkṣīṇāṃ śeṣāṃ sandhāya poṣayet| ---------------------------------------------|42|
---------------------------------------------| yāpyaivaṃ tantrikākhyā'pi paripoṭe'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ||42|| utpāte śītalairlepo jalaukohṛtaśoṇite| ---------------------------------------------|43|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| jambvāmrapallavabalāyaṣṭīrodhratilotpalaiḥ||43||
sadhānyāmlaiḥ samañjiṣṭhaiḥ sakadambaiḥ sasārivaiḥ| siddhamabhyañjane tailaṃ visarpoktaghṛtāni ca||44||

div.ab: unmanthe'bhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ godhākarkavasānvitam| tālapatryaśvagandhārkabākucīphalasaindhavaiḥ||45|| surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam| ---------------------------------------------|46|

---------------------------------------------| durviddhe'śmantajambvāmrapatrakvāthena secitām||46|| tailena pālīṃ svabhyaktāṃ suślakṣṇairavacūrṇayet| cūrṇairmadhukamañjiṣṭhāprapuṇḍrāhvaniśodbhavaiḥ||47|| lākṣāviḍaṅgasiddhaṃ ca tailamabhyañjane hitam| ---------------------------------------------|48|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| svinnāṃ gomayajaiḥ piṇḍairbahuśaḥ parilehikām||48||
viḍaṅgasārairālimpedurabhrīmūtrakalkitaiḥ| kauṭajeṅgudakārañjabījaśamyākavalkalaiḥ||49||
athavā'bhyañjanaṃ tairvā kaṭutailaṃ vipācayet| sanimbapatramaricamadanairlehikāvraṇe||50||
chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandhamālocya yaugikam| śuddhāsraṃ lāgayellagne sadyaśchinne viśodhanam||51||
atha karṇarogavidhānamāha ---- atha grathitvā keśāntaṃ kṛtvā chedanalekhanam| niveśya sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam||52||
abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ picuplotāvaguṇṭhitam| sūtreṇāgāḍhaśithilaṃ baddhvā cūrṇairavākiret||53||
śoṇitasthāpanairvraṇyamācāraṃ cādiśettataḥ| saptāhādāmatailāktaṃ śanairapanayet picum||54||
surūḍhaṃ jātaromāṇaṃ śliṣṭasandhiṃ samaṃ sthiram| suvarṣmāṇamarogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivardhayet||55||

div.ab: varṣmarūpamucyate(?) ---- jalaśūkaḥ svayaṅguptā rajanyau bṛhatīphalam| aśvagandhābalāhastipippalīgaurasarṣapāḥ||56|| mūlaṃ kośātakāśvaghnarūpikāsaptaparṇajam| chucchundarī kālamṛtā gṛhaṃ madhukarīkṛtam||57|| jatūkā jalajanmā ca tathā śabarakandakam| ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam||58|| hastyaśvamūtreṇa paramabhyaṅgātkarṇavardhanam| ---------------------------------------------|59|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| atha kuryādvayasthasya chinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām||59||
chindyānnāsāsamaṃ patraṃ tattulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ| tvaṅmāṃsaṃ nāsikāsanne rakṣaṃstattanutāṃ nayet||60||
sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā| nāsācchede'tha likhite parīvartyopari tvacam||61||
kapolavadhraṃ sandadhyātsīvyennāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ| nāḍībhyāmutkṣipedantaḥ sukhocchvāsapravṛttaye||62||
āmatailena siktvāν pattaṅgamadhukāñjanaiḥ| śoṇitasthāpanaiścānyaiḥ suślakṣṇairavacūrṇayet||63||
tato madhughṛtābhyaktaṃ badhvā''cārikamādiśet| jñātvā'vasthāntaraṃ kuryāt sadyovraṇavidhiṃ tataḥ||64||
chindyādrūḍhe'dhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntācca carma tat| sīvyettataśca suślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayetpunaḥ||65||

div.ab: niveśite yathānyāsaṃ sadyaścchinne'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ| nāḍīyogādvinauṣṭhasya nāsāsandhānavadvidhiḥ|66| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|18|

div.head: nāsārogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha kramaprāptaṃ nāsārogavijñānaṃ bibhaṇiṣurāha ---- athāto nāsārogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| )avaśyāyānilarajobhāṣyātisvapnajāgaraiḥ| nīcātyuccopadhānena pītenānyena vāriṇā||1|| atyambupānaramaṇacchardibāṣpagrahādibhiḥ| kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ||2|| janayanti pratiśyāyaṃ vardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam| ---------------------------------------------|3|

---------------------------------------------| tatra vātātpratiśyāye mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ||3|| ghrāṇoparodhanistodadantaśaṅkhaśirovyathāḥ| kīṭikā iva sarpantīrmanyate parito bhruvau||4|| svarasādaścirātpākaḥ śiśirācchakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|5|
---------------------------------------------| pittāttṛṣṇājvaraghrāṇapiṭikāsambhavabhramāḥ||5|| nāsāgrapāko rūkṣoṣṇatāmrapītakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|6|
---------------------------------------------| kaphātkāso'ruciḥ śvāso vamathurgātragauravam||6|| mādhuryaṃ vadane kaṇḍūḥ snigdhaśuklakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvairakasmādvṛddhiśāntimān||7||

div.ab: duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāpya pratiśyāyaṃ karotyasṛk| urasaḥ suptatā tāmranetratvaṃ śvāsapūtitā||8|| kaṇḍūḥ śrotrākṣināsāsu pittoktaṃ cātra lakṣaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: atha duṣṭapratiśyāyalakṣaṇamāha ---- ---------------------------------------------| sarva eva pratiśyāyā duṣṭatāṃ yāntyupekṣitāḥ||9||
yathoktopadravādhikyātsa sarvendriyatāpanaḥ| sāgnisādajvaraśvāsakāsoraḥpārśvavedanaḥ||10||
kupyatyakasmādbahuśo mukhadaurgandhyaśophakṛt| nāsikākledasaṃśoṣaśuddhirodhakaro muhuḥ||11||
pūyopamāsitāraktagrathitaśleṣmasaṃsrutiḥ| mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayo dīrghasnigdhasitāṇavaḥ||12||
pakvaliṅgāni teṣvaṅgalāghavaṃ kṣavathoḥ śamaḥ| śleṣmā sacikkaṇaḥ pīto'jñānaṃ ca rasagandhayoḥ||13||
tīkṣṇāghrāṇopayogārkaraśmisūtratṛṇādibhiḥ| vātakopibhiranyairvā nāsikātaruṇāsthani||14||
vighaṭṭite'nilaḥ kruddho ruddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ vrajet| nivṛttaḥ kurute'tyarthaṃ kṣavathuṃ sa bhṛśakṣavaḥ||15||

div.ab: śoṣayannāsikāsrotaḥ kaphaṃ ca kurute'nilaḥ| śūkapūrṇābhanāsātvaṃ kṛcchrāducchvasanaṃ tataḥ||16|| smṛto'sau nāsikāśoṣo-----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|17|
---------------------------nāsānāhe tu jāyate| naddhatvamiva nāsāyāḥ śleṣmaruddhena vāyunā||17|| niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva| ---------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: --------srāvastu tatsaṃjñaḥ śleṣmasambhavaḥ| accho jalopamo'jasraṃ viśeṣānniśi jāyate||19||
kaphaḥ pravṛddho nāsāyāṃ ruddhvā srotāṃsyapīnasam| kuryātsaghurghuraśwāsaṃ pīnasādhikavedanam||20||
averiva sravatyasya praklinnā tena nāsikā| ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakwaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam||21||
raktena nāsā dagdheva bāhyāntaḥ sparśanāsahā| bhaveddhūmopamocchvāsā sā dīptirdahatīva ca||22||
tālumūle malairduṣṭairmāruto mukhanāsikāt| śleṣmā ca pūtirnirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti tam||23||
nicayādabhighātādvā pūyāsṛṅnāsikā sravet| tatpūyar aktamākhyātaṃ śirodāharujākaram||24||
pittaśleṣmāvaruddho'ntarnāsāyāṃ śoṣayenmarut| kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat||25||

div.ab: arśorbudāni vibhajeddoṣaliṅgairyathāyatham| sarveṣu kṛcchrocchvasanaṃ pīnasaḥ pratataṃ kṣutiḥ||26|| sānunāsikavāditvaṃ pūtināsaḥ śirovyathā| ---------------------------------------------|27|

---------------------------------------------| aṣṭādaśānāmityeṣāṃ yāpayedduṣṭapīnasam|27| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogavijñānīyo nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|19|

div.head: nāsārogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: adhunā nāsācikitsābhaṇanāvasara ityāha ---- athāto nāsārogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) sarveṣu pīnaseṣvādau nivātāgārago bhajet| snehanasvedavamanadhūmagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam||1|| vāso gurūṣṇaṃ śirasaḥ sughanaṃ pariveṣṭanam| laghvamlalavaṇaṃ snigdhamuṣṇaṃ bhojanamadravam||2|| dhanvamāṃsaguḍakṣīracaṇakatrikaṭūtkaṭam| yavagodhūmabhūyiṣṭhaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam||3|| bālamūlakajo yūṣaḥ kulatthotthaśca pūjitaḥ| kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet||4|| jighreccorakatarkārīvacājājyupakuñcikāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|5|

----------------------------------------------| vyoṣatālīsacavikātintiḍīkāmlavetasam||5|| sāgnyajāji dvipalikaṃ tvagelāpatrapādikam| jīrṇādguḍāttulārdhena pakvena vaṭakīkṛtam||6|| pīnasaśvāsakāsaghnaṃ rucisvarakaraṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| śatāhvātvag''balā mūlaṃ syonākairaṇḍabilvajam||7||
sāragvadhaṃ pibeddhūmaṃ vasājyamadanānvitam| athavā saghṛtān saktūn kṛtvā mallakasampuṭe||8||

div.ab: tyajetsnānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam| ----------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: iti sāmānyena cikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣeṇāha ---- ----------------------------------------------| pibedvātapratiśyāye sarpirvātaghnasādhitam||9||
paṭupañcakasiddhaṃ vā vidāryādigaṇena vā| svedanasyādikāṃ kuryāt cikitsāmarditoditām||10||
pittaraktotthayoḥ peyaṃ sarpirmadhurakaiḥ śṛtam| pariṣekān pradehāṃśca śītaiḥ kurvīta śītalān||11||
dhavatvak''triphalāśyāmāśrīparṇīyaṣṭitilvakaiḥ| kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet||12||
kaphaje laṅghanaṃ lepaḥ śiraso gaurasarṣapaiḥ| sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pītvā vamet, piṣṭaistu nāvanam||13||
bastāmbunā paṭuvyoṣavellavatsakajīrakaiḥ| kaṭutīkṣṇairghṛtairnasyaiḥ kavalaiḥ sarvajaṃ jayet||14||
yakṣmakṛmikramaṃ kurvan yāpayedduṣṭapīnasam| vyoṣorubūkakṛmijiddārumādrīgadeṅgudam||15||
vārtākabījaṃ trivṛtā siddhārthaḥ pūtimatsyakaḥ| agnimanthasya puṣpāṇi pīluśigruphalāni ca||16||
aśvaviḍ''rasamūtrābhyāṃ hastimūtreṇa caikataḥ| kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet||17||

div.ab: kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam| śuṇṭhīkuṣṭhakaṇāvelladrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat||18|| sādhitaṃ tailamājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣavapuṭapraṇut| ----------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| nāsāśoṣe balātailaṃ pānādau bhojanaṃ rasaiḥ||19||
snigdho dhūmastathā svedo nāsānāhe'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ| pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau||20||

div.ab: kaphapīnasavatpūtināsāpīnasayoḥ kriyā| lākṣākarañjamaricavellahiṅgukaṇāguḍaiḥ||21|| avimūtradrutairnasyaṃ kārayedvamane kṛte| śigrusiṃhīnikumbhānāṃ bījaiḥ savyoṣasaindhavaiḥ||22|| savellasurasaistailaṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam| ----------------------------------------------|23|

---------------------dagdheṣvarśorbudeṣu ca| nikumbhakumbhasindhūtthamanohvālakaṇāgnikaiḥ|24| kalkitairghṛtamadhvaktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet| śigrvādi nāvanaṃ cātra pūtināsoditaṃ bhajet|25| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogapratiṣedho nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|20|

div.head: mukharogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: kramaprāptaṃ mukharogavijñānamabhidhitsurāha ---- athato mukharogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) mātsyamāhiṣavārāhapiśitāmakamūlakam| māṣasūpadadhikṣīrasuktekṣurasaphāṇitam||1|| avākśayyāṃ ca bhajato dviṣato dantadhāvanam| dhūmarcchardanagaṇḍūṣānucitaṃ ca sirāvyadham||2|| kṛddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvantyantarmukhaṃ gadān| ---------------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ityukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ||3||
oṣṭhakope tu pavanāt stabdhāvoṣṭhau mahārujau| dālyete paripāṭyete paruṣāsitakarkaśau||4||

div.ab: pittāttīkṣṇāsahau pītau sarṣapākṛtibhiścitau| piṭikābhirbahukledāvāśupākau--------------------|5|
---------------------------------------------------| sannipātādanekābhau durgandhāsrāvapicchilau||6|| akasmānmlānasaṃśūnarujau viṣamapākinau| ---------------------------------------------------|7|

---------------------------------------------------| raktopasṛṣṭau rudhiraṃ sravataḥ śoṇitaprabhau||7|| kharjūrasadṛśaṃ cātra kṣīṇe rakte'rbudaṃ bhavet| ---------------------------------------------------|8|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| māṃsapiṇḍopamau māṃsātsyātāṃ mūrcchatkṛmī kramāt||8||

div.ab: tailābhaśvayathukledau sakaṇḍvau medasā mṛdū| kṣatajāvavatīryete pāṭyete cāsakṛtpunaḥ||9|| grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau| -------------------------------------------------|10|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| jalabudbudavadvātakaphādoṣṭhe jalārbudam||10||

div.ab: gaṇḍālajī sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍe dāhajvarānvitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|11|
-------------------------------------------------| vātāduṣṇasahā dantāḥ śītasparśe'dhikavyathāḥ||11|| dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaśca saḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dantaharṣe pravātāmlaśītabhakṣākṣamā dvijāḥ||12||
bhavantyamlāśaneneva sarujāścalitā iva| dantabhede dvijāstodabhedaruksphuṭanānvitāḥ||13||
cālaścaladbhirdaśanairbhakṣaṇādadhikavyathaiḥ| karālastu karālānāṃ daśanānāṃ samudgamaḥ||14||
danto'dhiko'dhidantākhyaḥ sa coktaḥ khalu vardhanaḥ| jāyamāne'tirug dante, jāte tatra tu śāmyati||15||

div.ab: adhāvanāmalo dante kapho vā vātaśoṣitaḥ| pūtigandhiḥ sthirībhūtaḥ śarkarā----------|16|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śyāvaḥ śyāvatvamāyāto raktapittānilairdvijaḥ||17||

div.ab: samūlaṃ dantamāśritya doṣairulbaṇamārutaiḥ| śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante'nnamalapūrite||18|| pūtitvātkṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante, jāyate tataḥ| ahetutīvrārtiśamaḥ sasaṃrambho'sitaścalaḥ||19|| pralūnaḥ pūyaraktasrut sa coktaḥ kṛmidantakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|20|
-------------------------------------------------| śleṣmaraktena pūtīni vahantyasramahetukam||20|| śīryante dantamāṃsāni mṛduklinnāsitāni ca| śītādo'sau---------------------------------|21|

-------------------------------------------------| ---------------upakuśaḥ pākaḥ pittāsṛgudbhavaḥ||21|| dantamāmsāni dahyante raktānyutsedhavantyataḥ| kaṇḍūmanti sravantyasramādhmāyante'sṛji sthite||22|| calā mandarujo dantā pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate| -------------------------------------------------|23|

-------------------------------------------------| dantayostriṣu vā śopho badarāsthinibho ghanaḥ||23|| kaphāsrāttīvraruk śīghraṃ pacyate dantapuppuṭaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|24|

-------------------------------------------------| dantamāṃse malaiḥ sāsrairbāhyāntaḥ śvayathurguruḥ||24|| sarugdāhaḥ sravedbhinnaḥ pūyāsraṃ dantavidradhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|25|
-------------------------------------------------| śvayathurdantamūleṣu rujāvān pittaraktajaḥ||25|| lālāsrāvī sa suṣiro dantamāṃsapraśātanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|26|
-------------------------------------------------| sa sannipātājjvaravān sapūyarudhirasrutiḥ||26|| mahāsuṣira ityukto viśīrṇadvijabandhanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|27|

-------------------------------------------------| dantānte kīlavacchopho hanukarṇarujākaraḥ||27|| pratihantyabhyavahṛtiṃ śleṣmaṇā so'dhimāṃsakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|28|

-------------------------------------------------| ghṛṣṭeṣu dantamāṃseṣu saṃrambho jāyate mahān||28|| yasmiṃścalanti dantāśca sa vidarbho'bhighātajaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|29|

-------------------------------------------------| dantamāṃsāśritān rogān yaḥ sādhyānapyupekṣate||29|| antastasyāsravan doṣaḥ sūkṣmāṃ sañjanayedgatim| pūyaṃ muhuḥ sā sravati tvaṅmāṃsāsthiprabhedinī||30|| tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svairyathoditaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|31|
-------------------------------------------------| śākhapatrakharā suptā sphuṭitā vātadūṣitā||31|| jihvā pittāt sadāhoṣā raktairmāsāṅkuraiścitā| -------------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śālmalīkaṇṭakābhaistu kaphena bahalā guruḥ||32||
kaphapittādadhaḥ śopho jihvāstambhakṛdunnataḥ| matsyagandhirbhavetpakvaḥ so'laso māṃsaśātanaḥ||33||
prabandhane'dho jihvāyāḥ śopho jihvāgrasannibhaḥ| sāṅkuraḥ kaphapittāsrairlāloṣāstambhavān kharaḥ||34||
adhijihvaḥ sarukkaṇḍūrvākyāhāravighātakṛt| tādṛgevopajihvastu jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ||35||
tālumāṃse'nilādduṣṭe piṭikāḥ sarujaḥ kharāḥ| bahyo ghanāḥ srāvayutāstāstālupiṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ||36||

div.ab: tālumūle kaphātsāsrāt matsyabastinibho mṛduḥ| pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayā''hāramīrayan||37|| kaṇṭhoparodhatṛṭkāsavamikṛt galaśuṇḍikā| -------------------------------------------------|38|

-------------------------------------------------| tālumadhye niruṅmāṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ tālusaṃhatiḥ||38|| padmākṛtistālumadhye raktācchvayathurarbudam| -------------------------------------------------|39|

-------------------------------------------------| kacchapaḥ kacchapākāraściravṛddhiḥ kaphādaruk||39|| kolābhaḥ śleṣmamedobhyāṃ puppuṭo nīrujaḥ sthiraḥ| -------------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| pittena pākaḥ pākākhyaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ||40||

div.ab: vātapittajvarāyāsaistāluśoṣastadāhvayaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|41|

-------------------------------------------------| jihvāprabandhajāḥ kaṇṭhe dāruṇā mārgarodhinaḥ||41|| māṃsāṅkurāḥ śīghracayā rohiṇī śīghrakāriṇī| -------------------------------------------------|42|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣakṛdvātāt sā hanuśrotrarukkarī||42||

div.ab: pittājjvaroṣātṛṇmohakaṇṭhadhūmāyanānvitā| kṣiprajā kṣiprapākā'tirāgiṇī sparśanāsahā||43|| kaphena picchilā pāṇḍuḥ------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|44|

ab.seg: --------------------------asṛjā sphoṭakācitā| taptāṅgāranibhā karṇarukkarī pittajākṛtiḥ||44||

div.ab: gambhīrapākā nicayāt sarvaliṅgasamanvitā| doṣaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ śophaḥ kolavad grathitonnataḥ||45|| śūkakaṇṭakavatkaṇṭhe śālūko mārgarodhanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|46|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| vṛndo vṛttonnato dāhajvarakṛd galapārśvagaḥ||46||
hanusandhyāśritaḥ kaṇṭhe kārpāsīphalasannibhaḥ| picchilo mandaruk śophaḥ kaṭhināstuṇḍikerikā||47||

div.ab: bāhyāntaḥ śvayathurghoro galamārgārgalopamaḥ| galaugho mūrddhagurutātandrālālājvarapradaḥ||48|| valayaṃ nātiruk śophastadvadevāyatonnataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|

-------------------------------------------------| māṃsakīlo gale doṣaireko'neko'thavā'lparuk||49|| kṛcchrocchvāsābhyavahṛtiḥ pṛthumūlo gilāyukaḥ| bhūrimāṃsaṅkuravṛtā tīvratṛḍjvaramūrddharuk||50|| śataghnī nicitā vartiḥ śataghnīvātirukvarī| -------------------------------------------------|51|
