-------------------------------------------------| vyāptasarvagalaḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ||51|| pūtipūyanibhasrāvī śvayathurgalavidradhiḥ| jihvāvasāne kaṇṭhādāvapākaṃ śvayathuṃ malāḥ||52|| janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ tadgalārbudam| -------------------------------------------------|53|

ab.seg: pavanaśleṣmamedobhirgalagaṇḍo bhavedbahiḥ| vardhamānaḥ sa kālena muṣkavallambate'tiruk||53||
kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātātkṛṣṇarājimān| vṛddhastālugale śoṣaṃ kuryācca virasāsyatām||54||
sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt| vṛddhastālugale lepaṃ kuryācca madhurāsyatām||55||
medasaḥ śleṣmavaddhānivṛddhyoḥ so'nuvidhīyate| dehaṃ vṛddhaśca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare'lpatām||56||
śleṣmaruddhā'nilagatiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho hatasvaraḥ| tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahā'nilāt||57||
karoti vadanasyāntarvraṇān sarvasaro'nilaḥ| sañcāriṇo'ruṇān rūkṣānoṣṭhau tāmrau calatvacau||58||
jihvā śītāsahā gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭākācitā| vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ||59||
adhaḥ pratihato vāyurarśogulmakaphādibhiḥ| yātyūrdhvaṃ vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvannūrdhvagudastu saḥ||60||
mukhasya pittaje pāke dāhoṣe tiktavaktratā| kṣārokṣitakṣatasamā vraṇāḥ tadvacca raktaje||61||

div.ab: kaphaje madhurāsyatvaṃ kaṇḍūmatpicchilā vraṇāḥ| antaḥkapolamāśritya śyāvapāṇḍu kapho'rbudam||62|| kuryāttad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate| -------------------------------------------------|63|

-------------------------------------------------| mukhapāko bhavetsāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtirmalaiḥ||63|| pūtyāsyatā ca taireva dantakāṣṭhādividviṣaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|64|

-------------------------------------------------| oṣṭe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale||64|| vaktre sarvatra cetyuktāḥ pañcasaptatirāmayāḥ| ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ||65|| aṣṭāvaṣṭādaśāṣṭau ca kramāt-----------------| -------------------------------------------------|66|

----------------------------teṣvanupakramāḥ| karālo māṃsaraktauṣṭhāvarbudāni jalādvinā|66| kacchapastālupiṭikā galaughaḥ suṣiro mahān| svaraghnordhvagudaśyāvaśataghnīvalayālasāḥ|67| nāḍyoṣṭhakopau nicayāt, raktātsarvaiśca rohiṇī| daśane sphuṭite dantabhedaḥ, pakvopajihvikā|68| galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśī kṛcchrocchvāso'tivatsaraḥ| yāpyastu harṣo bhedaśca śeṣān śastrauṣadhairjayet|69| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne mukharogavijñānīyo nāmai- kaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|21|

div.head: mukharogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto mukharogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) khaṇḍauṣṭhasya vilikhyāntau syūtvā vraṇavadācaret| -------------------------------------------------|1|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| yaṣṭijyotiṣmatīrodhraśrāvaṇīsārivotpalaiḥ||1||
paṭolyā kākamācyā ca tailamabhyañjanaṃ pacet| nasyaṃ ca tailaṃ vātaghnamadhuraskandhasādhitam||2||

div.ab: mahāsnehena vātauṣṭhe siddhenāktaḥ picurhitaḥ| devadhūpamadhūcchiṣṭaguggulvamaradārubhiḥ||3|| yaṣṭyāhvacūrṇayuktena tenaiva pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|4|

-------------------------------------------------| nāḍyoṣṭhaṃ svedayeddugdhasiddhaireraṇḍapallavaiḥ||4|| khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|5|
-------------------------------------------------| pittābhighātajāvoṣṭhau jalaukobhirupācaret||5|| rodhrasarjarasakṣaudramadhukaiḥ pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|6|
-------------------------------------------------| guḍūcīyaṣṭipattaṅgasiddhamabhyañjane ghṛtam||6|| pittavidradhivaccātra kriyā śoṇitaje'pi ca| idameva nave kāryaṃ karma---------------------|7|

ab.seg: pāṭhākṣāramadhuvyoṣairhṛtāsre pratisāraṇam| dhūmanāvanagaṇḍūṣāḥ prayojyāśca kaphacchidaḥ||8||

div.ab: svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vimedaskaṃ dahenmedojamagninā| priyaṅgurodhratriphalāmākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet||9|| sakṣaudrā gharṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇā bhinnaśuddhe jalārbude| avagāḍhe'tivṛddhe vā kṣāro'gnirvā pratikriyā||10|| āmādyavasthāsvalajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavadācaret| -------------------------------------------------|11|

āmādyavasthāsvalajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavadācaret| svinnasya śītadantasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ dahet||11|| tailena, pratisāryā ca sakṣaudraghanasaindhavaiḥ| dāḍimatvagvarātārkṣyakāntājambvasthināgaraiḥ||12|| kavalaḥ kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthairaṇutailaṃ ca nāvanam| dantaharṣe tathā bhede sarvā vātaharā kriyā||13|| tilayaṣṭīmadhuśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sasnehaṃ daśamūlāmbu gaṇḍūṣaḥ pracaladvije||14||
tuttharodhrakaṇāśreṣṭhāpattaṅgapaṭugharṣaṇam| snigdhāḥ śīlyā yathāvasthaṃ nasyānnakavalādayaḥ||15||

div.ab: adhidantakamāliptaṃ yadā kṣāreṇa jarjaram| kṛmidantamivotpāṭya tadvaccopacarettadā||16|| anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā| -------------------------------------------------|17|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| ahiṃsan dantamūlāni dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret||17||
kṣāracūrṇairmadhuyutaistataśca pratisārayet| kapālikāyāmapyevaṃ harṣoktaṃ ca samācaret||18||
jayedvisrāvaṇaiḥ svinnamacalaṃ kṛmidantakam| snigdhaiścālepagaṇḍūṣanasyāhāraiścalāpahaiḥ||19||
guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet| saptacchadārkakṣīrābhyāṃ pūraṇaṃ kṛmiśūlajit||20||
hiṅgukaṭphalakāsīsasvarjikākuṣṭhavellajam| rajo rujaṃ jayatyāśu vastrasthaṃ daśane dhṛtam||21||
gaṇḍūṣaṃ grāhayettailamebhireva ca sādhitam| kvāRthairvā yuktameraṇḍadvivyāghrībhūkadambajaiḥ||22||
kriyāyogairbahuvidhairityaśāntarujaṃ bhṛśam| dṛḍhamapyuddhareddantaṃ pūrvaṃ mūlādvimokṣitam||23||
sandaṃśakena laghunā dantanirghātanena vā| tailaṃ sayaṣṭyāhvarajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ||24||

div.ab: tato vidāriyaṣṭyāhvaśṛṅgāṭakakaserubhiḥ| tailaṃ daśaguṇakṣīraṃ siddhaṃ yuñjīta nāvanam||25|| kṛśadurbalavṛddhānāṃ vātārtānāṃ ca noddharet| noddhareccottaraṃ dantaṃ bahūpadravakṛddhi saḥ||26|| eṣāmapyuddhṛtau snigdhasvāduśītakramo hitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|27|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| visrāvitāsre śītāde sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam||27||
mustārjunatvaktriphalāphalinītāRrkṣyanāgaraiḥ| tatkvāthaḥ kavalo, nasyaṃ tailaṃ madhurasādhitam||28||

div.ab: dantamāṃsānyupakuśe svinnānyuṣṇāmbudhāraṇaiḥ| maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipatrairvā bahuśo likhet||29|| tataśca pratisāryāṇi ghṛtamaṇḍamadhudrutaiḥ| lākṣāpriyaṅgupattaṅgalavaṇottamagairikaiḥ||30|| sakuṣṭhaśuṇṭhīmaricayaṣṭīmadhurasāñjanaiḥ| sukhoṣṇo ghṛtamaṇḍo tailaṃ vā kavalagrahaḥ||31|| ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ| -------------------------------------------------|32|

-------------------------------------------------| dantapuppuṭake svinnachinnabhinnavilekhite||32|| yaṣṭyāhvasvarjikāśuṇṭhīsaindhavaiḥ pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| vidradhau kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaiḥ kavalalepanam||33||
gharṣaṇaṃ kaṭukākuṣṭhavṛścikālīyavodbhavaiḥ| rakṣetpākaṃ himaiḥ pakvaḥ pāṭyo dāhyo'vagāḍhakaḥ||34||

div.ab: suṣire chinnalikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam| rodhramustamiśiśreṣṭhātārkṣyapattaṅgakiṃśukaiḥ||35|| sakaṭphalaiḥ, kaṣāyaiśca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate| yaṣṭīrodhrotpalānantāsārivāgurucandanaiḥ||36|| sagairikasitāpuṇḍraiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam| -------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| chittvā'dhimāṃsakaṃ cūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||37||
vacātejovatīpāṭhāsvarjikāyavaśūkajaiḥ| paṭolanimbatriphalākaṣāyaḥ kavalo hitaḥ||38||
vidarbhe dantamūlāni maṇḍalāgreṇa śodhayet| kṣāraṃ yuñjyāttato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam||39||

div.ab: saṃśodhyobhayataḥ kāyaṃ śiraścopacarettataḥ| nāḍīṃ dantānugāṃ dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet||40|| kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā| dhāvanaṃ jātimadanakhadirasvādukaṇṭakaiḥ||41|| kṣīrivṛkṣāmbugaṇḍūṣo, nasyaṃ tailaṃ ca tatkṛtam| -------------------------------------------------|42|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| kuryādvātauṣṭhakopoktaṃ kaṇṭakeṣvanilātmasu||42||
jihvāyāṃ pittajāteṣu ghṛṣṭeṣu rudhire srute| pratisāraṇagaṇḍūṣanāvanaṃ madhurairhitam||43||
tīkṣṇaiḥ kaphottheṣvevaṃ ca sarṣapatryūṣaṇādibhiḥ| nave jihvālase'pyevaṃ, taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet||44||
unnamya jihvāmākṛṣṭāṃ baḍiśenādhijihvikām| chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa tīkṣṇoṣṇairgharṣaṇādi ca||45||
upajihvāṃ parisrāvya yavakṣāreṇa gharṣayet| kaphaghnaiḥ śuṇḍikā sādhyā nasyagaṇḍūṣagharṣaṇaiḥ||46||
ervārubījapratimaṃ vṛddhāyāmasirātatam| agraṃ niviṣṭaṃ jihvāyā baḍiśādyavalambitam||47||
chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa nātyagre na ca mūlataḥ| chede'tyasṛkkṣayānmṛtyurhīne vyādhirvivarddhate||48||

div.ab: maricātiviṣāpāṭhāvacākuṣṭhakuṭannaṭaiḥ| chinnāyāṃ sapaṭukṣaudrairgharṣaṇaṃ, kavalaḥ punaḥ||49|| kaṭukātiviṣāpāṭhānimbarāsnāvacāmbubhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| saṅghāte puppuṭe kūrme vilikhyaivaṃ samācaret||50||
apakve tālupāke tu kāsīsakṣaudratārkṣyajaiḥ| gharṣaṇaṃ, kavalaḥ śītakaṣāyamadhurauṣadhaiḥ||51||
pakve'ṣṭāpadavadbhinne tīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pratisāraṇam| vṛṣanimbapaṭolādyaistiktaiḥ kavaladhāraṇam||52||

div.ab: tāluśoṣe tvatṛṣṇasya sarpiruttarabhaktikam| kaṇāśuṇṭhīśṛtaṃ pānamamlairgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam||53|| dhanvamāṃsarasāḥ snigdhāḥ, kṣīrasarpiśca nāvanam| -------------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: kaṇṭharogeṣvasṛṅmokṣastīkṣṇairnasyādi karma ca||54||
kvāthaḥ pānaṃ ca dārvītvaṅnimbatārkṣyakaliṅgajaḥ| harītakīkaṣāyo vā peyo mākṣikasaṃyutaḥ| -------------------------------------------------||55||

div.ab: śreṣṭhāvyoṣayavakṣāradārvīdvīpirasāñjanaiḥ| sapāṭhātejinīnimbaiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ|56| kavalo, guṭikā vā'tra kalpitā pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|57|

ab.seg: śreṣṭhāvyoṣayavakṣāradārvīdvīpirasāñjanaiḥ| sapāṭhātejinīnimbaiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ||56||
athāntarbāhyataḥ svinnāṃ vātarohiṇikāṃ likhet||58||
aṅgulīśastrakeṇāśu paṭuyuktanakhena vā| pañcamūlāmbu kavalastailaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam||59||

div.ab: visrāvya pittasambhūtāṃ sitākṣaudrapriyaṅgubhiḥ| gharṣetsarodhrapattaṅgaiḥ kavalaḥ kvathitaiśca taiḥ||60|| drākṣāparūṣakakvātho hitaśca kavalagrahe| -------------------------------------------------|61|

-------------------------------------------------| upācaredevameva pratyākhyāyāsrasambhavām||61|| sāgāradhūmaiḥ kaṭukaiḥ kaphajāṃ pratisārayet| nasyagaṇḍūṣayostailaṃ sādhitaṃ ca praśasyate||62|| apāmārgaphalaśvetādantījantughnasaindhavaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|63|

ab.seg: vidradhau srāvite śreṣṭhārocanātārkṣyagairikaiḥ| sarodhrapaṭupattaṅgakaṇairgaṇḍūṣagharṣaṇe||64||
galagaṇḍaḥ pavanajaḥ svinno niḥsrutaśoṇitaḥ| tilairbījaiśca laṭvomāpriyālaśaṇasambhavaiḥ||65||
upanāhyo, vraṇe rūḍhe pralepyaśca punaḥpunaḥ| śigrutilvakatarkārīgajakṛṣṇāpunarnavaiḥ||66||
kālāmṛtārkamūlaiśca puṣpaiśca karahāṭajaiḥ| ekaiṣikānvitaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ surayā kāñjikena vā||67||
guḍūcīnimbakuṭajahaṃsapādībalādvayaiḥ| sādhitaṃ pāyayettailaṃ sakṛṣṇādevadārubhiḥ||68||

div.ab: kartavyaṃ kaphaje'pyetatsvedavimlāpane tvati| lepo'jagandhātiviṣāviśalyāḥ saviṣāṇikāḥ||69|| guñjālābuśukāhvāśca palāśakṣārakalkitāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|70|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| mūtrasrutaṃ haṭhakṣāraṃ paktvā kodravabhuk pibet||70||
sādhitaṃ vatsakādyairvā tailaṃ sapaṭupañcakaiḥ| kaphaghnān dhūmavamananāvanādīṃśca śīlayet||71||

div.ab: medobhave sirāṃ vidhyetkaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet| asanādirajaścainaṃ prātarmūtreṇa pāyayet||72|| aśāntau pācayitvā ca sarvān vraṇavadācaret| -------------------------------------------------|73|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| mukhapākeṣu sakṣaudrā prayojyā mukhadhāvanāḥ||73||
kvathitāstriphalāpāṭhāmṛdvīkājātipallavāḥ| niṣṭhevyā bhakṣayitvā vā kuṭherādirgaṇo'thavā||74||
mukhapāke'nilāt kṛṣṇāpaṭvelāḥ pratisāraṇam| tailaṃ vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ||75||
pittāsre pittaraktaghnaḥ kaphaghnaśca kaphe vidhiḥ| likhecchākādipatraiśca piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ||76||

div.ab: yathādoṣodayaṃ kuryātsannipāte cikitsitam| nave'rbude tvasaṃvṛddhe chedite pratisāraṇam||77|| svarjikānāgarakṣaudraiḥ, kvātho gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate| -------------------------------------------------|78|

----------------------------------------------------| guḍūcīnimbakalkottho madhutailasamanvitaḥ||78|| yavānnabhuk tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgāṃstathā''caret| ----------------------------------------------------|79|

----------------------------------------------------| vamite pūtivadane dhūmastīkṣṇaḥ sanāvanaḥ||79|| samaṅgādhātakīrodhraphalinīpadmakairjalam| dhāvanaṃ vadanasyāntaścūrṇitairavacūrṇitam||80|| śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca nāvanādi ca śīlayet| ----------------------------------------------------|81|

ab.seg: phalatrayadvīpikirātatikta- yaṣṭyāhvasiddhārthakaṭutrikāṇi| mustāharidrādvayayāvaśūka- vṛkṣāmlakāmlāgrimavetasāśca||81||
aśvatthajambvāmradhanañjayatvak tvak cāhimārātkhadirasya sāraḥ| kvāthena teṣāṃ ghanatāṃ gatena taccūrṇayuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ||82||
tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādigadān sukṛcchrān| viśeṣato rohiṇikāsyaśoṣa- gandhān videhādhipatipraṇītāḥ||83||
khadiratulāmambughaṭe paktvā toyena tena piṣṭaiśca| candanajoṅgakakuṅkumaparipelavavālakośīraiḥ||84||
suratarurodhradrākṣāmañjiṣṭhācocapadmakaviḍaṅgaiḥ| spṛkkānatanakhakaṭphalasūkṣmailādhyāmakaiḥ sapattaṅgaiḥ||85||
tailaprasthaṃ vipacet karṣāṃśaiḥ pānanasyagaṇḍūṣaistat| hatvā''sye sarvagadān janayati gārdhīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm||86||
udvartitaṃ ca prapunāṭarodhra- dārvībhirabhyaktamanena vaktram| nirvyaṅganīlīmukhadūṣikādi sañjāyate candrasamānakānti||87||
palaśataṃ bāṇāttoyaghaṭe paktvā rase'smiṃśca palārdhikaiḥ khadirajambūyaṣṭyānantāmrairahimāranīlotpalānvitaiḥ||88||
tailaprasthaṃ pācayecchlakṣṇapiṣṭai- rebhirdravyairdhāritaṃ tanmukhena| rogān sarvān hanti vaktre viśeṣā- tsthairyaṃ dhatte dantapaṅkteścalāyāḥ||89||
khadirasārād dve tule pacedvalkāttulāṃ cārimedasaḥ| ghaṭacatuṣke pādaśeṣe'smin pūte punaḥ kvathanādghane||90||
ākṣikaṃ kṣipetsusūkṣmaṃ rajaḥ sevyāmbupattaṅgagairikam| candanadvaya(śyāmā) rodhrapuṇḍrā- hvayaṣṭyāhvalākṣāñjanadvayam||91||
dhātakīkaṭuphaladviniśātriphalācaturjātajoṅgakam| mustamañjiṣṭhānyagrodhapraroha|vacā]māṃsīyavāsakam||92||
padmakailāsamaṅgāśca śīte tasmiṃstathā pālikāṃ pṛthak| jātipatrikāṃ sajātīphalāṃ saha- (nakha)lavaṅgakaṅkollakām||93||
sphaṭikaśubhrasurabhikarpūrakuḍavaṃ ca tatrāvapettataḥ| kārayedguṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tadvadāpahāḥ||94||
kvāthyauṣadhavyatyayayojanena tailaṃ pacetkalpanayā'nayaiva| sarvāsyarogoddhṛtaye tadāhu- rdantasthiratve tvidameva mukhyam||95||
khadireṇaitā guṭikā- stailamidaṃ cārimedasā prathitam| anuśīlayan pratidinaṃ svastho'pi dṛḍhadvijo bhavati||96||
kṣudrāguḍūcīsumanaḥpravāla- dārvīyavāsatriphalākaṣāyaḥ| kṣaudreṇa yuktaḥ kavalagraho'yaṃ sarvāmayān vaktragatānnihanti||97||
pāṭhādārvītvakkuṣṭhamustāsamaṅgā- tiktāpītāṅgīrodhratejovatīnām| cūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro dantamāṃsārtikaṇḍū- pākasrāvāṇaṃ nāśano gharṣaṇena||98||
gṛhadhūmatārkṣyapāṭhāvyoṣakṣārāgnyayovarātejohvaiḥ| mukhadantagalavikāre sakṣaudraḥ kālako vidhāryaścūrṇaḥ||99||
dārvītvaksindhūdbhavamanaḥ śilāyāvaśūkaharitālaiḥ| dhāryaḥ pītakacūrṇo dantāsyagalāmaye samadhvājyaḥ||100||
dvikṣāradhūmakavarāpañcapaṭuvyoṣavellagiritārkṣyaiḥ| gomūtreṇa vipakvā galāmayaghnī rasakriyā eṣā||101||
gomūtrakvathanavilīnavigrahāṇāṃ pathyānāṃ jalamiśikuṣṭhabhāvitānām| attāraṃ naramaṇavo'pi vaktrarogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpamiva na spṛśantyanarthāḥ||102||
saptacchadośīrapaṭolamusta- harītakītiktakarohiṇībhiḥ| yaṣṭyāhvarājadrumacandanaiśca kvāthaṃ pibetpākaharaṃ mukhasya||103||
paṭolaśuṇṭhītriphalāviśālā- trāyantitiktādviniśāmṛtānām| pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaścāsyagadānaśeṣān||104||
svarasaḥ kvathito dārvyā ghanībhūtaḥ sagairikaḥ| āsyasthaḥ samadhurvaktrapākanāḍīvraṇāpahaḥ||105||
paṭolanimbayaṣṭyāhvavāsājātyarimedasām| khadirasya varāyāśca pṛthagevaṃ prakalpanā||106||
khadirāyovarāpārthamadayantyahimārakaiḥ| gāṇḍūṣo'mbuśṛtairdhāryo durbaladvijaśāntaye||107||
mukhadantamūlagalajāḥ prāyo rogāḥ kaphāsrabhūyiṣṭhāḥ| tasmātteṣāmasakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayedduṣṭam||108||
kāyaśirasorvireko vamanaṃ kavalagrahāśca kaṭutiktāḥ| prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma||109||
yavatṛṇadhānyaṃ bhaktaṃ vidalaiḥ kṣāroṣitairapasnehāḥ| yūṣā bhakṣyāśca hitā yaccānyacchleṣmanāśāya||110||

div.ab: prāṇānilapathasaṃsthāḥ śvasitamapi nirundhate pramādavataḥ| kaṇṭhāmayāścikitsita- mato drutaṃ teṣu kurvīta|111| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne mukharogapratiṣedho nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|22|

div.head: śirorogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha kramaprāptaṃ śirorogavijñānamāha ---- athātaḥ śirorogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) dhūmātapatuṣārāmbukrīḍātisvapnajāgaraiḥ| utsvedādhipurovātabāṣpanigraharodanaiḥ||1|| atyambumadyapānena kṛmibhirvegadhāraṇaiḥ| upadhānamṛjābhyaṅgadveṣādhaḥpratatekṣaṇaiḥ||2|| asātmyagandhaduṣṭāmabhāṣyādyaiśca śirogatāḥ| janayantyāmayān doṣāḥ--------------------------|3|

-----------------------------------------------| --------------------------tatra mārutakopataḥ||3|| nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā| bhruvormadhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca patatīvātivedanam||4|| bādhyete svanataḥ śrotre niṣkṛṣyeta ivākṣiṇī| ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate||5|| sphuratyati sirājālaṃ kandharāhanusaṅgrahaḥ| prakāśāsahatā ghrāṇasrāvo'kasmādyathāśamau||6|| mārdavaṃ mardanasnehasvedabandhaiśca jāyate| śirastāpo'yam-----------------------------|7|

ab.seg: pakṣātkupyati māsādvā svayameva ca śāmyati| ativṛddhastu nayanaṃ śravaṇaṃ vā vināśayet||8||
śorobhitāpe pittotthe śorodhūmāyanaṃ jvaraḥ| svedo'kṣidahanaṃ mūrcchā niśi śītaiśca mārdavam||9||
aruciḥ kaphaje mūrdhno gurustimitaśītatā| śirānispandatā''lasyaṃ rūṅmandā'hnyadhikāniśi||10||
tandrā śūnākṣikūṭatvaṃ karṇakaṇḍūyanaṃ vamiḥ| raktāt pittādhikarujaḥ sarvaiḥ syātsarvalakṣaṇaḥ||11||

div.ab: saṅkīrṇairbhojanairmūrdhni kleditte rudhirāmiṣe| kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ||12|| śirasaste pibanto'sraṃ ghorāḥ kurvanti vedanāḥ| cittavibhraṃśajananīrjvaraḥ kāso balakṣayaḥ||13|| raukṣyaśophavyadhancchedadāhasphuraṇapūtitāḥ| kapāle tāluśirasoḥ kaṇḍūḥ śoṣaḥ pramīlakaḥ||14|| tāmrācchasiṅghāṇakatā karṇanādaśca jantuje| -----------------------------------------------|15|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vātolbaṇāḥ śiraḥkampaṃ tatsaṃjñaṃ kurvate malāḥ||15||
pittapradhānairvātādyaiḥ śaṅkhe śophaḥ saśoṇitaiḥ| tīvradāharujārāgapralāpajvaratṛḍbhramāḥ||16||
tiktāsyaḥ pītavadanaḥ kṣiprakārī sa śaṅkhakaḥ| trirātrājjīvitaṃ hanti sidhyatyapyāśu sādhitaḥ||17||

div.ab: pittānubaddhaḥ śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭeṣu mārutaḥ| rujaṃ saspandanāṃ kuryādanusūryodayodayām||18|| āmadhyāhnaṃ vivardhiṣṇuḥ kṣudvataḥ sā viśeṣataḥ| avyavasthitaśītoṣṇasukhā śāmyatyataḥ param||19|| sūryāvartaḥ sa ityuktā daśa rogāḥ śirogatāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śirasyeva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava||20||
kapāle pavane duṣṭe garbhasthasyāpi jāyate| savarṇo nīrujaḥ śophastaṃ vidyādupaśīrṣakam||21||

div.ab: yathādoṣodayaṃ brūyāt piṭikārbudavidradhīn| kapāle kledabahulāḥ pittāsṛkśleṣmajantubhiḥ||22|| kaṅgusiddhārthakanibhāḥ piṭikāḥ syuraruṃṣikāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|

---------------------------------------------| kaṇḍūkeśacyutisvāparaukṣyakṛt sphuṭanaṃ tvacaḥ||23|| susūkṣmaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyāddāruṇakaṃ tu tat| romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitam||24|| pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ| romakūpān ruṇaddhyasya tenānyeṣāmasambhavaḥ||25|| tadindraluptaṃ rujyāṃ ca prāhuścāceti cāpare| ---------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| khalaterapi janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt||26||
sā vātādagnidagdhābhā, pittātsvinnasirāvṛtā| kaphāddhanatvagvarṇāśca yathāsvaṃ nirdiśet tvaci||27||
doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvairasādhyā sā nakhaprabhā| dagdhāgnineva nirlomā sadāhā yā ca jāyate||28||

div.ab: śokaśramakrodhakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ| keśān sadoṣaḥ pacati palitaṃ sambhavatyataḥ||29|| tadvātātsphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jalaprabham| pittātsadāhaṃ pītābhaṃ, kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat||30|| sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ, sarvaistu vidyādvyāmiśralakṣaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|31|
---------------------------------------------| śirorujodbhavaṃ cānyadvivarṇaṃ sparśanāsaham||31|| asādhyā sannipātena khalatiḥ palitāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|32|

---------------------------------------------| śarīrapariṇāmotthānyapekṣante rasāyanam|32| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne śirorogavijñānīyo nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|23|

div.head: śirorogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athaitaccikitsitaṃ vyākhyātumāha ----- athātaḥ śirorogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) śirobhitāpe'nilaje vātavyādhividhiṃ caret| ---------------------------------------------|1|

---------------------------------------------| ghṛtamaktaśirā rātrau pibeduṣṇapayonupaḥ||1|| māṣān kulatthān mudgān vā tadvatkhādeddhṛtānvitān| tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet||2|| piṇḍopanāhasvedāśca māṃsadhānyakṛtā hitāḥ| vātaghnadaśamūlādisiddhakṣīreṇa secanam||3|| snigdhaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ śiraḥśravaṇatarpaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|4|

---------------------------------------------| varaṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīramardhodakaṃ pacet||4|| kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tacchītaṃ mathitvā sāramāharet| tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ||5|| varge'tra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram| ---------------------------------------------|6|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kārpāsamajjā tvaṅmustā sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca||6||
nasyamuṣṇāmbupiṣṭāni sarvamūrdharujāpaham| śarkarākuṅkumaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittāsṛganvaye||7||
pralepaḥ saghṛtaiḥ kuṣṭhakuṭilotpalacandanaiḥ| vātodrekabhayādraktaṃ na cāsminnavasecayet||8||
ityaśāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ| ardhāvabhedake'pyeṣā tathā doṣānvayātkriyā||9||

div.ab: śirīṣabījāpāmārgamūlaṃ nasyaṃ biḍānvitam| sthirāraso vā, lepe tu prapunnāṭo'mlakalkitaḥ||10|| sūryovarte'pi tasmiṃstu sirayā'paharedasṛk| ---------------------------------------------|11|

---------------------------------------------| śirobhitāpe pittotthe snigdhasya vyadhayetsirām||11|| śītāḥ śiromukhālepasekaśodhanabastayaḥ| jīvanīyaśṛte kṣīrasarpiṣī pānanasyayoḥ||12|| kartavyaṃ raktaje'pyetat pratyākhyāya ca śaṅkhake| ---------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śleṣmābhitāpe jīrṇājyasnehitaḥ kaṭukairvamet||13||
svedapralepanasyādyā rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇabheṣajaiḥ| śasyante copavāso'tra nicaye miśramācaret||14||

div.ab: kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ| mattāḥ śoṇitagandhena niryānti ghrāṇavaktrayoḥ||15|| sutīkṣṇanasyadhūmābhyāṃ kuryānnirharaṇaṃ tataḥ| viḍaṅgasvarjikādantīhiṅgugomūtrasādhitam||16|| kaṭunimbeṅgudīpīlutailaṃ nasyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------|17|
---------------------------------------------| ajāmūtradrutaṃ nasyaṃ kṛmijit kṛmijitparam||17|| pūtimatsyayutaiḥ kuryād dhūmaṃ nāvanabheṣajaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|18|
---------------------------------------------| kṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvādraktamatra na nirharet||18|| vātābhitāpavihitaḥ kampe dāhādvinā kramaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|19|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| nave janmottaraṃ jāte yojayedupaśīrṣake||19||
vātavyādhikriyāṃ, pakve karma vidradhicoditam| āmapakve yathāyogyaṃ vidradhīpiṭikārbude||20||
aruṃṣikā jalaukobhirhṛtāsrā nimbavāriṇā| siktā prabhūtalavaṇairlimpedaśvaśakṛdrasaiḥ||21||
paṭolanimbapatrairvā saharidraiḥ sukalkitaiḥ| gomūtrajīrṇapiṇyākakṛkavākumalairapi||22||
kapālabhṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ tailasaṃyutam| rūṃṣikālepanaṃ kaṇḍūkledadāhārtināśanam||23||
mālatīcitrakāśvaghnanaktamālaprasādhitam| cācārūṃṣikayostailamabhyaṅgaḥ kṣuraghṛṣṭayoḥ||24||
aśāntau śirasaḥ śudhdyai yateta vamanādibhiḥ| vidhyecchirāṃ dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ, śīlayenmṛjām||25||
nāvanaṃ mūrddhabastiṃ ca, lepayecca samākṣikaiḥ| priyālabhijamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣaiḥ sasarṣapaiḥ||26||
lākṣāśamyākapatraiḍagajadhātrīphalaistathā| koradūṣatṛṇakṣāravāriprakṣālanaṃ hitam||27||
indralupte yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ vidhvā pralepayet| pracchāya gāḍhaṃ kāsīsamanohvātutthakoṣaṇaiḥ||28||
vanyāmaratarubhyāṃ vā guñjāmūlaphalaistathā| tathā lāṅgalikāmūlaiḥ karavīrarasena vā||29||
sakṣaudrakṣudravārtākasvarasena rasena vā| dhattūrakasya patrāṇāṃ bhallātakarasena vā||30||
athavā mākṣikahavistilapuṣpatrikaṇṭakaiḥ| tailāktā hastidantasya maṣī cācauṣadhaṃ param||31||
śuklaromodgame tadvanmaṣī meṣaviṣāṇajā| varjayedvāriṇā sekaṃ yāvadromasamudbhavaḥ||32||
khalatau palite valyāṃ harillomni ca śodhitam| nasyavaktraśirobhyaṅgapradehaiḥ samupācaret||33||
siddhaṃ tailaṃ bṛhatyādyairjīvanīyaiśca nāvanam| māsaṃ vā nimbajaṃ tailaṃ kṣīrabhuṅnāvayedyatiḥ||34||

div.ab: nīlīśirīṣakoraṇṭabhṛṅgasvarasabhāvitam| śelvakṣatilarāmāṇāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakīsamam||35|| piṣṭvā''japayasā lohālliptādarkāśutāpitāt| tailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīrabhujo nāvanāt palitāntakṛt||36|| kṣīrātsāhacarād bhṛṅgarajasaḥ saurasādrasāt| prasthaistailasya kuḍavaḥ siddho yaṣṭipalānvitaḥ||37|| nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|38|

---------------------------------------------| kṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭai vā dugdhikākaravīrakau||38|| utpāṭya palitaṃ deyāvāśaye palitāpahau| kṣīraṃ priyālaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ jīvanīyo gaṇastilāḥ||39|| kṛṣṇāḥ pralepo vaktrasya harillomavalīhitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|40|

---------------------------------------------| tilāḥ sāmalakāḥ padmakiñjalko madhukaṃ madhu||40|| bṛṃhayedrañjayeccaitat keśān mūrddhapralepanāt| māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sārivā nīlamutpalam||41|| kṣaudraṃ ca kṣīrapiṣṭāni keśasaṃvardhanaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|42|

---------------------------------------------| ayorajo bhṛṅgarajastriphalā kṛṣṇamṛttikā||42|| sthitamikṣurase māsaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet| māṣakodravadhānyāmlairyavāgūstridinoṣitā||43|| lohaśuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākāmapi rañjayet| ---------------------------------------------|44|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| prapauṇḍarīkamadhukapippalīcandanotpalaiḥ||44||
siddhaṃ dhātrīrase tailaṃ nasyenābhyañjanena ca| sarvān mūrdhagadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam||45||
varījīvantiniryāsapayobhiryamakaṃ pacet| jīvanīyaiśca tannasyaṃ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit||46||

div.ab: mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrapādaviṭtuṇḍavarjitam| daśamūlavalārāsnāmadhukaistripalairyutam||47|| jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet| kalkitairmadhuradravyaiḥ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit||48|| tadabhyāsīkṛtaṃ pānabastyabhyañjananāvanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|49|

---------------------------------------------| etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||49|| caturguṇena payasā kalkairebhiśca kārṣikaiḥ| jīvantītriphalāmedāmṛdvīkarddhiparūṣakaiḥ||50|| samaṅgācavikābhārgīkāśmarīkarkaṭāhvayaiḥ| ātmaguptāmahāmedātālakharjūramastakaiḥ||51|| mṛṇālabisakharjūrayaṣṭīmadhukajīvakaiḥ| śatāvarīvidārīkṣubṛhatīsārivāyugaiḥ||52|| mūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrarṣabhakaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ| rāsnāsthirātāmalakīsūkṣmailāśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ||53|| punarnavātavakṣīrīkākolīdhanvayāsakaiḥ| madhūkākṣoṭavātāmamuñjātābhiṣukairapi||54|| mahāmāyuramityetanmāyūrādadhikaṃ guṇaiḥ| dhātvindriyasvarabhraṃśaśvāsakāsārditāpaham||55|| yenyasṛkśukradoṣeṣu śastaṃ vandhyāsutapradam| ---------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭairhaṃsaiḥ śaśaiśceti prakalpayet||56||
jatrūrdhvajānāṃ vyādhīnāmekatriṃśacchatadvayam| parasparamasaṅkīrṇaṃ vistareṇa prakāśitam||57||
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamṛṣayaḥ puruṣaṃ viduḥ| mūlaprahāriṇastasmād rogān śīghrataraṃ jayet||58||

div.ab: sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ| tena tasyottamāṅgasya rakṣāyāmādṛto bhavet|59| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭa- viracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne śirorogapratiṣedho nāma- caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|24|

div.head: vranapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto vraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) vraṇo dvidhā nijāgantuduṣṭaśuddhavibhedataḥ| nijo doṣaiḥ śarīrotthairāganturbāhyahetujaḥ||1|| doṣairadhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ śuddhastairanadhiṣṭhitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|2|

-------------------------------------------------| saṃvṛtatvaṃ vivṛtatā kāṭhinyaṃ mṛdutā'ti vā||2|| atyutsannāvasannatvamatyauṣṇyamatiśītatā| raktatvaṃ pāṇḍutā kārṣṇyaṃ pūtipūyaparisrutiḥ||3|| pūtimāṃsasirāsnāyucchannatotsaṅgitā'tiruk| saṃrambhadāhaśvayathukaṇḍvādibhirupadrutaḥ||4|| dīrghakālānubandhaśca vidyādduṣṭavraṇākṛtim| -------------------------------------------------|5|

-------------------------------------------------| ----------------------------------tatra mārutāt||5|| śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo'ruṇo bhasmakapotāsthinibho'pi vā| mastumāṃsapulākāmbutulyatanvalpasaṃsrutiḥ||6|| nirmāṃsastodabhedāḍhyo rūkṣaścaṭacaṭāyate| -------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| pittena kṣiprajaḥ pīto nīlaḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ||7||
mūtrakiṃśukabhasmāmbutailābhoṣṇabahusrutiḥ| kṣārokṣitakṣatasamavyatho rāgoṣmapākavān||8||
kaphena pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūmān bahuśvetaghanasrutiḥ| sthūloṣṭhaḥ kaṭhinaḥ snāyusirājālatato'lparuk||9||
pravālarakto raktena saraktaṃ pūyamudgiret| vājisthānasamo gandhe yukto liṅgaiśca paittikaiḥ||10||

div.ab: dbābhyāṃ tribhiśca sarvaiśca vidyāllakṣaṇasaṅkarāt| -------------------------------------------------|11|

-------------------------------------------------| jihvāprabho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ śyāvauṣṭhapiṭikaḥ samaḥ||11|| kiñcidunnatamadhyo vā vraṇaḥ śuddho'nupadravaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|

-------------------------------------------------| tvagāmiṣasirāsnāyusandhyasthīni vraṇāśayāḥ||12|| koṣṭho marma ca tānyaṣṭau duḥsādhyānyuttarottaram| -------------------------------------------------|13|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| susādhyaḥ sattvamāṃsāgnivayobalavati vraṇaḥ||13||
vṛtto dīrghastripuṭakaścaturasrākṛtiśca yaḥ| tathā sphikpāyumeḍhroṣṭhapṛṣṭhāntarvaktragaṇḍagaḥ||14||
kṛcchrasādhyo'kṣidaśananāsikāpāṅganābhiṣu| sevanījaṭharaśrotrapārśvakakṣāstaneṣu ca||15||

div.ab: phenapūyānilavahaḥ śalyavānūrdhvanirvamī| bhagandaro'ntarvadanastathā kaṭyasthisaṃśritaḥ||16|| kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām| vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhdyanti yeṣāṃ ca syurvraṇe vraṇāḥ||17|| naiva sidhdyanti vīsarpajvarātīsārakāsinām| pipāsūnāmanidrāṇāṃ śvāsināmavipākinām||18|| bhinne śiraḥkapāle vā mastuluṅgasya darśane| snāyukledātsirācchedādgāmbhīryātkṛmibhakṣaṇāt||19|| asthibhedātsaśalyatvātsaviṣatvādatarkitāt| mithyābandhādatisnehādraukṣyādromādighaṭṭanāt||20|| kṣobhādaśuddhakoṣṭhatvātsauhityādatikarśanāt| madyapānāddivāsvapnādvavāyādrātrijāgarāt||21|| vraṇo mithyopacārācca naiva sādhyo'pi sidhyati| -------------------------------------------------|22|
-------------------------------------------------| kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ||22|| sthirāścipiṭikāvanto rohatīti tamādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|23|

-------------------------------------------------| athātra śophāvasthāyāṃ yathāsannaṃ viśodhanam||23|| yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaścāśu praśāmyati| -------------------------------------------------|24|
-------------------------------------------------| kuryācchītopacāraṃ ca śophāvasthasya santatam||24|| doṣāgniragnivattena prayāti sahasā śamam| -------------------------------------------------|25|

ab.seg: viṣayukte viśeṣeṇa jalajādyairharedasṛk| duṣṭāsre'pagate sadyaḥ śopharāgarujāṃ śamaḥ||26||
hṛte hṛte ca rudhire suśītaiḥ sparśavīryayoḥ| suślakṣṇaistadahaḥpiṣṭaiḥ kṣīrekṣusvarasadravaiḥ||27||
śatadhautaghṛtopetairmuhuranyairaśoṣibhiḥ| pratilomaṃ hito lepaḥ sekābhyaṅgāśca tatkṛtāḥ||28||
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaveta savalkalaiḥ| pradeho bhūrisarpibhiḥ śophanirvāpaṇaḥ param||29||
vātolbaṇānāṃ stabdhānāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ mahārujām| srutāsrujāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānāmapi ceddaśām||30||
ānūpavesavārādyaiḥ svedaḥ, somāstilāḥ punaḥ| bhṛṣṭā nirvāpitāḥ kṣīre tatpiṣṭā dāharuggharāḥ||31||
sthirān mandarujaḥ śophān snehairvātakaphapahaiḥ| abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||32||
vimlāpanārthaṃ mṛdgīyāt talenāṅuṣṭhakena vā| yavagodhūmamudgaiśca siddha piṣṭaiḥ pralepayet||33||
vilīyate sa cennaivaṃ tatastamupanāhayet| avidagdhastathā śāntiṃ vidagdhaḥ pākamaśrute||34||
sakolatilavallomā dadhyamlā saktupiṇḍikā| sakiṇvakuṣṭhalavaṇā koṣṇā śastopanāhane||35||
supakve piṇḍite śophe pīḍanairupapīḍite| dāraṇaṃ dāraṇārhasya sukumārasya ceṣyate||36||
guggulvatasigodantasvarṇakṣīrīkapotaviṭ| kṣaurauṣadhāni kṣārāśca pakvaśophavidāraṇam||37||
pūyagarbhānaṇudvārān sotsaṅgānmarmagānapi| niḥsnehaiḥ pīḍanadravyaiḥ samantātpratipīḍayet||38||
śuṣyantaṃ samupekṣeta pralepaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati| na mukhe cainamālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate||39||
kalāyayavagodhūmamāṣamudgahareṇavaḥ| dravyāṇāṃ picchilānāṃ ca tvaṅmūlāni prapīḍanam||40||
saptasu kṣālanādyeṣu surasāragvadhādikau| bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau mehakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca||41||
athavā kṣālanaṃ kvāthaḥ paṭolīnimbapatrajaḥ| aviśuddhe, viśuddhe tu vyagrodhāditvagudbhavaḥ||42||
paṭolītilayaṣṭyāhvatrivṛddantīniśādvayam| nimbapatrāṇi cālepaḥ sapaṭurvraṇaśodhanaḥ||43||
vraṇān viśodhayedvartyā sūkṣmāsyān sandhimarmagān| kṛtayā trivṛtādantīlāṅgalīmadhusaindhavaiḥ||44||
vātābhibhūtān sāsrāvān dhūpayedugravedanān| yavajyabhūrjamadanaśrīveṣṭakasurāhvayaiḥ||45||

div.ab: nirvāpayed bhṛśaṃ śītaiḥ pittaraktaviṣolbaṇān| -------------------------------------------------|46|

-------------------------------------------------| śuṣkālpamāṃse gambhīre vraṇa utsādanaṃ hitam||46|| nyagrodhapadmakādibhyāmaśvagandhābalātilaiḥ| adyānmāṃsādamāṃsāni vidhinopahitāni ca||47|| māṃsaṃ māṃsādamāṃsena vardhate śuddhacetasaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|48|

-------------------------------------------------| utsannamāṃsān kaṭhinān kaṇḍūyuktāṃścirotthitān||49|| vraṇān suduḥkhaśodhyāṃśca śodhayet kṣārakarmaṇā| -------------------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sravanto'śmarijā mūtraṃ ye cānye raktavāhinaḥ||50||
chinnāśca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktairye ca śodhanaiḥ| śodhyamānā na śudhdyanti śodhyāḥ syuste'gnikarmaṇā||51||

div.ab: śuddhānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyamutsādāya yadīritam| -------------------------------------------------|52|

-------------------------------------------------| aśvagandhā ruhā rodhraṃ kaṭphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭikā||52|| samaṅgā dhātakīpuṣpaṃ paramaṃ vraṇaropaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|53|
-------------------------------------------------| apetapūtimāṃsānāṃ māṃsasthānāmarohatām||53|| kalkaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt tilānāṃ madhikānvitam| -------------------------------------------------|54|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| snigdhoṣṇatiktamadhurakaṣāyatvaiḥ sa sarvajit||54||
sa kṣaudranimbapatrābhyāṃ yuktaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ param| pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syādāśu ropaṇaḥ||55||

div.ab: tilavadyavakalkaṃ tu kecidicchanti tadvidaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|56|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sāsrapittaviṣāgantugambhīrān soṣmaṇo vraṇān||56||
kṣīraropaṇabhaiṣajyaśṛtenājyena ropayet| ropaṇauṣadhasiddhena tailena kaphavātajān||57||
kācchīrodhrābhayāsarjasindūrāñjanatutthakam| cūrṇitaṃ tailamadanairyuktaṃ ropaṇamuttamam||58||

div.ab: samānāṃ sthiramāṃsānāṃ tvaksthānāṃ cūrṇa iṣyate| -------------------------------------------------|59|

-------------------------------------------------| kakubhodumbarāśvatthajambūkaṭphalarodhrajaiḥ||59|| tvacamāśu nigṛhṇanti tvakcūrṇaiścūrṇitā vraṇāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|60|

-------------------------------------------------| lākṣāmanohvāmañjiṣṭhāharitālaniśādvayaiḥ||60|| pralepaḥ saghṛtakṣaudrastvagviśuddhikaraḥ param| -------------------------------------------------|61|
-------------------------------------------------| kālīyakalatāmrāsthihemakālārasottamaiḥ||61|| lepaḥ sagomayarasaḥ savarṇakaraṇaḥ param| -------------------------------------------------|62|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dagdho vāraṇadanto'ntardhūmaṃ tailaṃ rasāñjanam||62||
romasañjanano lepastadvattailapariplutā| catuṣpānnakharomāsthitvakśṛṅgakhurajā maṣī||63||

div.ab: vraṇinaḥ śastrakarmoktaṃ pathyāpathyānnamādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|64|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dve pañcamūle vargaśca vātaghno vātike hitaḥ||64||
nyagrodhapadmakādyau tu tadvatpittapradūṣite| āragvadhādiḥ śleṣmaghnaḥ kaphe, miśrāstu miśraje||65||
ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā| cūrṇo vartiśca saṃyojyā vraṇe sapta yathāyatham||66||

div.ab: jātīnimbapaṭolapatrakaṭukādārvīniśāsārivā- mañjiṣṭhābhayasikthatutthamadhukairnaktāhvabījānvitaiḥ| sarpiḥ sādhyamanena sūkṣmavadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ sagatayaḥ śudhdyanti rohanti ca|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭa- viracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vraṇapratiṣedho nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|25|

div.head: sadyovranapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sadyovraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) sadyovraṇā ye sahasā sambhavantyabhighātataḥ| anantairapi tairaṅgamucyate juṣṭamaṣṭadhā||1||

div.ab: tānevāṣṭau prakārānāha ---- ghṛṣṭāvakṛttavicchinnapravilambitapātitam| viddhaṃ bhinnaṃ vidalitaṃ-------------------|2|

ab.seg: raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ saploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet| avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ, vicchinnaṃ syāttato'pi ca||3||
pravilambi saśeṣe'sthni, patitaṃ pātitaṃ tanoḥ| sūkṣmāsyaśalyaviddhaṃ tu viddhaṃ koṣṭhavivarjitam||4||
bhinnamanyadvidalitaṃ majjaraktapariplutam| prahārapīḍanotpeṣāt sahāsthnā pṛthutāṃ gatam||5||
sadyaḥ sadyovraṇaṃ siñcedatha yaṣṭyāhvasarpiṣā| tīvravyathaṃ kavoṣṇena balātailena vā punaḥ||6||
kṣatoṣmaṇo nigrahārthaṃ tatkālaṃ visṛtasya ca| kaṣāyaśītamadhurasnigdhā lepādayo hetāḥ||7||
sadyovraṇeṣvāyateṣu sandhānārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ| madhusarpiśca yuñjīta pittaghnīśca himāḥ kriyāḥ||8||
sasaṃrambheṣu kartavyamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam| upavāso hitaṃ bhuktaṃ pratataṃ raktamokṣaṇam||9||
ghṛṣṭe vidalite caiṣa sutarāmiṣyate vidhiḥ| tayorhyalpaṃ sravatyasraṃ pākastenāśu jāyate||10||
atyarthamasraṃ sravati prāyaśo'nyatra vikṣate| tato raktakṣayādvāyau kupite'tirujākare||11||
snehapānaparīṣekasvedalepopanāhanam| snehabastiṃ ca kurvīta vātaghnauṣadhasādhitam||12||
iti sāptāhikaḥ proktaḥ sadyovraṇahito vidhiḥ| saptāhādgatavege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhimācaret||13||

div.ab: prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthakpṛthak| ---------------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet||14||
-------------------------vicchinnapravilambinoḥ| sīvanaṃ vidhinoktena bandhanaṃ cānu pīḍanam||15||
asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netramadīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat| sanniveśya yathāsthānamavyāviddhasiraṃ bhiṣak||16||
pīḍayet pāṇinā padmapalāśāntaritena tat| tato'sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ||17||
vipakvamājaṃ yaṣṭyāhvajīvakarṣabhakotpalaiḥ| sapayaskaiḥ paraṃ tadvi sarvanetrābhighātajit||18||
galapīḍā'vasanne'kṣṇi vamanotkāsanakṣavāḥ| prāṇāyamo'thavā kāryaḥ kriyā ca kṣatanetravat||19||

div.ab: karṇe sthānāccyute syūte śrotastailena pūrayet| ---------------------------------------------------|20|

---------------------------------------------------| kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ nirgacchatyapi mārute||20|| samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram| ājena sarpiṣā cātra pariṣekaḥ praśasyate||21|| uttāno'nnāni bhuñjīta, śayīta ca suyantritaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|22|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| ghātaṃ śākhāsu tiryaksthaṃ gātre samyaṅniveśite||22||
syūtvā vellitabandhena badhnīyāddhanavāsasā| carmaṇā goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kāryaścāsaṅgate vraṇe||23||
pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā| praveśya vṛṣaṇau sīvyet sevanyā tunnasaṃjñayā||24||
kāryaśca goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kaṭyāmāveśya paṭṭakam| snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ||25||
kālānusāryagurvelājātīcandanaparpaṭaiḥ| śilādārvyamṛtātutthaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam||26||
chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ| badhnīyāt kośabandhena tato vraṇavadācaret||27||

div.ab: kāryā śalyāhṛte viddhe bhaṅgādvidalite kriyā| ---------------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: mastuluṅgasruteḥ kruddho hanyādenaṃ calo'nyathā| vraṇe rohati caikaikaṃ śanairapanayetkacam||29||

div.ab: ācaramocchvāsādāturaṃ samupācarediti vacanānmastuluṅgasrutāvapyupakramamāha ---- mastuluṅgasrutau khādenmastiṣkānanyajīvajān| ---------------------------------------------------|30|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| śalye hṛte'ṅgādanyasmātsnehavartiṃ nidhāpayet||30||
dūrāvagāḍhāḥ sūkṣmāsyā ye vraṇāḥ srutaśoṇitāḥ| secayeccakratailena sūkṣmanetrārpitena tān||31||
bhinne koṣṭhe'sṛjā pūrṇe mūrcchāhṛtpārśvavedanāḥ| jvaro dāhastṛḍādhmānaṃ bhaktasyānabhinandanam||32||
saṅgo viṇmūtramarutāṃ śvāsaḥ svedo'kṣiraktatā| lohagandhitvamāsyasya syād gātre ca vigandhatā||33||
āmāśayasthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayatyapi| ādhmānenātimātreṇa śūlena ca viśasyate||34||
pakvāśayasthe rudhire saśūlaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet| nābheradhastācchītatvaṃ khebhyo raktasya cāgamaḥ||35||
abhinno'pyāśayaḥ sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhirabhipūryate| asṛjā syandamānena pārśve mūtreṇa bastivat||36||
tatrāntarlohitaṃ śītapādocchvāsakarānanam| raktākṣaṃ pāṇḍuvadanamānaddhaṃ ca vivarjayet||37||
amāśayasthe vamanaṃ hitaṃ, pakvāśayāśrite| virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca niḥsnehoṣṇairviśodhanaiḥ||38||
yavakolakulatthānāṃ rasaiḥ snehavivarjitaiḥ| bhuñjītānnaṃ yavāgūṃ vā pibetsaindhavasaṃyutām||39||

div.ab: atiniḥsrutaraktastu bhinnakoṣṭhaḥ pibedasṛk| ---------------------------------------------------|40|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| kliṣṭacchinnāntrabhedena koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā smṛtaḥ||40||
mūrcchādayo'lpāḥ prathamedvitīye tvati bādhakāḥ| kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati||41||
yathāsvaṃ mārgamāpannā yasya viṇmūtramārutāḥ| vyupadravaḥ sa bhinne'pi koṣṭhe jīvatyasaṃśayam||42||
abhinnamantraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tvato'nyathā| utpaṅgilaśirograstaṃ tadapyeke vadanti tu||43||
prakṣālya payasā digdhaṃ tṛṇaśoṇitapāṃsubhiḥ| praveśayetklṛptanakho ghṛtenāktaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||44||

div.ab: kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhūrisarpiḥpariplutam| aṅgulyā pramṛśetkaṇṭhaṃ jalenodvejayedapi||45|| tathā'ntrāṇi viśantyantastatkālaṃ pīḍayanti ca| ---------------------------------------------------|46|

---------------------------------------------------| vraṇasaukṣmyādbahutvādvā koṣṭhamantramanāviśat||46|| tatpramāṇena jaṭharaṃ pāṭayitvā praveśayet| yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyagantre sīvyedanu vraṇam||47|| sthānādapetamādatte jīvitaṃ kupitaṃ ca tat| veṣṭayitvā'nu paṭṭena ghṛtena pariṣecayet||48|| pāyayeta tataḥ koṣṇaṃ citrātailayutaṃ payaḥ| mṛdukriyārthaṃ śakṛto vāyoścādhaḥpravṛttaye||49|| anuvarteta varṣaṃ ca yathoktāṃ vraṇayantraṇām| ---------------------------------------------------|50|

ab.seg: avakīrya kaṣāyairvā ślakṣṇairmūlaistataḥ samam| dṛḍhaṃ badhvā ca sūtreṇa varddhayetkuśalo bhiṣak||51||
tīkṣṇenāgniprataptena śastreṇa sakṛdeva tu| syāndanyathā rugāṭopo mṛtyurvā chidyamānayā||52||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe'nne ghṛtaṃ pibet| kṣīraṃ vā śarkarācitrālākṣāgokṣurakaiḥ śṛtam||53||
rugdāhajitsayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ paraṃ pūrvodito vidhiḥ| medogranthyuditaṃ tatra tailamabhyañjane hitam||54||

div.ab: tālīsaṃ padmakaṃ māṃsīhareṇvagurucandanam| haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ||55|| pakvaṃ sadyovraṇeṣūktaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇamuttamam| ---------------------------------------------------|56|

---------------------------------------------------| gūḍhaprahārābhihate patite viṣamoccakaiḥ||56|| kāryaṃ vātāsrajit tṛptimardanābhyañjanādikam| ---------------------------------------------------|57|

---------------------------------------------------| viśliṣṭadehaṃ mathitaṃ kṣīṇaṃ marmāhataṃ hatam|57| vāsayettailapūrṇāyāṃ droṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinam| 57 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnūśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sadyovraṇapratiṣedho nāma ṣa- ḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|26|

div.head: bhaṅgapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bhaṅgapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) pātaghātādibhirdvedhā bhaṅgo'sthnāṃ sandhyasandhitaḥ| prasāraṇākuñcanayoraśaktiḥ sandhimuktatā||1|| itarasmin bhṛśaṃ śophaḥ sarvavasthāsvativyathā| aśaktiśceṣṭite'lpe'pi pīḍyamāne saśabdatā||2|| samāsāditi bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ, bahudhā tu tat| bhidyate bhaṅgabhedena tasya sarvasya sādhanam||3|| yathā syādupayogāya tathā tadupadekṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| prajyāṇudāri yattvasthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat||4||
yatrāsthileśaḥ praviśenmadhyamasthno vidāritaḥ| bhagnaṃ yaccābhighātena kiñcidevāvaśeṣitam||5||
unnamyamānaṃ kṣatavadyacca majjani majjati| tadduḥsādhyaṃ kṛśāśaktavātalālpāśināmapi||6||
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat| jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yattadvivarjayet||7||

div.ab: asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭaṃ cūrṇitam tathā| yacca bhagnaṃ bhavecchaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanāntare||8|| samyagyamitamapyasthi durnyāsāddurnibandhanāt| saṅkṣobhādapi yadgacchedvikriyāṃ tadvivarjayet||9|| ādito yacca durjātamasthisandhirathāpi vā| taruṇāsthīni bhujyante, bhajyante nalakāni tu||10|| kapālāni vibhidyante, sphuṭantyanyāni bhūyasā| ----------------------------------------------------|11|

----------------------------------------------------| athāvanatamunnamyamunnataṃ cāvapīḍayet||11|| ācchedatikṣiptamadhogataṃ copari vartayet| āñchanotpīḍanonnāmacarmasaṅkṣepabandhanaiḥ||12|| sandhīn śarīragān sarvān calānapyacalānapi| ityetaiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ samyak saṃsthāpya niścalam||13|| paṭṭaiḥ prabhūtasarpirbhirveṣṭayitvā sukhaistataḥ| kadambodumbarāśvatthasarjārjunapalāśajaiḥ||14|| vaṃśodbhavairvā pṛthubhistanubhiḥ suniveśitaiḥ| suślakṣṇaiḥ sapratistambhairvalkalaiḥ śakalairapi||15|| kuśāhvayaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari yojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|16|

----------------------------------------------------| śithilena hi bandhena sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate||16|| gāḍhenāti rujādāhapākaśvayathusambhavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|

----------------------------------------------------| tryahāttryahādṛtau gharme saptāhānmokṣayeddhime||17|| sādhāraṇe tu pañcahād bhaṅgadoṣavaśena vā| ----------------------------------------------------|18|

----------------------------------------------------| nyagrodhādikaṣāyeṇa tataḥ śītena secayet||18|| taṃ pañcamūlapakvena payasā tu savedanam| sukhoṣṇaṃ vā'vacāryaṃ syāccakratailaṃ vijānatā||19|| vibhajya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutam| ----------------------------------------------------|20|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| pratataṃ sekalepāṃśca vidadhyāt bhṛśaśītalān||20||
gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ madhurauṣadhasādhitam| prātaḥ prātaḥ pibedbhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam||21||
savraṇasya tu bhagnasya vraṇo madhughṛtottaraiḥ| kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāryo'tha śeṣo bhaṅgoditaḥ kramaḥ||22||
lambāni vraṇamāṃsāni pralipya madhusarpiṣā| sandhadhīta vraṇān vaidyo bandhanaiścopa0pādayet||23||

div.ab: tān samān susthitāñjñātvā phalinīrodhrakaṭphalaiḥ| samaṅgādhātakīyuktaiścūrṇitairavacūrṇayet||24|| dhātakīrodhracūrṇairvā, rohantyāśu tathā vraṇāḥ| iti bhaṅga upakrāntaḥ-------------------------|25|

----------------------------------------------------| pūrvamadhyāntavayasāmekadvitriguṇaiḥ kramāt||26|| māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavetsandheryathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim| ----------------------------------------------------|27|

----------------------------------------------------| kaṭījaṅghorubhagnānāṃ kapāṭaśayanaṃ hitam||27|| yantraṇārtha tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ| jaṅghorvoḥ pāRśvayordvau dvau tala ekaśca kīlakaḥ||28|| śorṇyāṃ vā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vā vakṣasyakṣakayostathā| ----------------------------------------------------|29|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| vimokṣe bhagnasandhīnāṃ vidhimevaṃ samācaret||29||
sandhīściravimuktāṃstu snigdhasvinnān mṛdūkṛtān| uktairvidhānairbuddhyā ca yathāsvaṃ sthānamānayet||30||
asandhibhagne rūḍhe tu viṣamolbaṇasādhite| āpothya bhaṅgaṃ yamayettato bhagnavadācaret||31||
bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak| pakvamāṃsasirāsnāyuḥ sandhiḥ śleṣaṃ na gacchati||32||
vātavyādhivinirdiṣṭān snehān bhagnasya yojayet| catuṣprayogān balyāṃśca bastikarma ca śīlayet||33||

div.ab: śālyājyarasadugdhādyaiḥ pauṣṭikairavidāhibhiḥ| mātrayopacaredbhagnaṃ sandhisaṃśleṣakāribhiḥ||34|| glānirna śasyate tasya, sandhiviśleṣakṛddhi sā| ----------------------------------------------------|35|

ab.seg: lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāramamlaṃ maithunamātapam| vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam||35||

div.ab: kṛṣṇāṃstilān virajaso dṛḍhavastrabaddhān sapta kṣapā vahati vāriṇi vāsayet| saṃśoṣayedanudinaṃ pravisārya caitān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye|36| punarapi pītapayaskāṃ- sthān pūrvavadeva śoṣitān bāḍham| vigatatuṣānarajaskān sañcūrṇya sucūrṇitairyuñjyāt|37| naladavālakalohitayaṣṭikā- nakhamiśiplavakuṣṭhabalātrayaiḥ| agurukuṅkumacandanasārivā- saralasarjarasāmaradārubhiḥ|38| padmakādigaṇopetaistilapiṣṭaṃ tataśca tat| samastagandhabhaiṣajyasiddhadugdhena pīḍayet|39| śaileyarāsnāṃśumatīkaseru- kālānusārīnatapatrarodhraiḥ| sakṣīraśuklaiḥ sapayaḥ sadūrvai stailaṃ pacettannaladādibhiśca|40| gandhatailamidamuttamamasthi- sthairyakṛjjayati cāśu vikārān| vātāpittajanitānativīryān| vyāpino'pi vividhairupayogaiḥ|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhāṅgapratiṣedho nāma sapta- viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|27|

div.head: bhagandarapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bhagandarapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyaśutre||2|| ) hastyaśvapṛṣṭhagamanakaṭhinotkaṭakāsanaiḥ| arśonidānābhihitairaparaiśca niṣevitaiḥ||1|| aniṣṭādṛṣṭapākena sadyo vā sādhugarhaṇaiḥ| prāyeṇa piṭikāpūrvo yo'ṅgule hyaṅgule'pi vā||2|| pāyorvraṇo'ntarbāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅmāṃsago bhavet| bastimūtrāśayābhyāsagatatvātsyandanātmakaḥ||3|| bhagandaraḥ sa sarvāśca dārayatyakriyāvataḥ| bhagabastigudāṃsteṣu dīryamāṇeṣu bhūribhiḥ||4|| vātamūtraśakṛcchukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmairvamati kramāt| ----------------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| doṣaiḥ pṛthagyutaiḥ sarvairāgantuḥ so'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ||5||

div.ab: apakvaṃ piṭikāmāhuḥ pākaprāptaṃ bhagandaram| ----------------------------------------------------|6|

----------------------------------------------------| gūḍhamūlāṃ sasaṃrambhāṃ rugāḍhyāṃ rūḍhakopinīm||6|| bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt piṭikāṃ na tvato'nyathā| ----------------------------------------------------|7|

ab.seg: --------------pittāduṣṭragrīvāvaducchritā| rāgiṇi tanurūṣmāḍhyā jvaradhūmāyanānvitā||8||

div.ab: sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍumatī kaphāt| ----------------------------------------------------|9|
pāṇḍurā kiñcidāśyāvā kṛcchrapākā kaphānilāt| ----------------------------------------------------|10|

----------------------------------------------------| pādāṅguṣṭhasamā sarvairdoṣairnānāvidhavyathā||10|| śūlārocakatṛḍdāhajvaracchardirupadrutā| ----------------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| bahupicchāparisrāvī parisrāvī kaphodbhavaḥ||13||
vātapittātparikṣepī parikṣipya gudaṃ gatiḥ| jāyate paritastatra prākāraṃ parikheva ca||14||

div.ab: ----------------------------------------------------| kaphapitte tu pūrvotthaṃ durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ||15|| arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍūdāhādimān bhavet| sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno'sya kledayanmūlamarśasaḥ||16|| sravatyajasraṃ gatibhirayamarśobhagandaraḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|

----------------------------------------------------| sarvajaḥ śambukāvartaḥ śambukāvartasannibhaḥ||17|| gatayo dārayantyasmin rugvegairdāruṇairgudam| ----------------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| asthileśo'bhyavahṛto māṃsagṛddhyā yadā gudam||18||
kṣiṇoti tiryaṅnirgacchannunmārgaṃ kṣatato gatiḥ| syāttataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ māṃsakothena tatra ca||19||
jāyante kṛmayastasya khādantaḥ parito gudam| vidārayanti nacirādunmārgī kṣatajaśca saḥ||20||

div.ab: teṣu rugdāhakaṇḍvādīn vidyād vraṇaniṣedhataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|21|

----------------------------------------------------| ṣaṭ kṛcchrasādhanāsteṣāṃ, nicayakṣatajau tyajet||21|| pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam| ----------------------------------------------------|22|

----------------------------------------------------| athāsya piṭikāmeva tathā yatnādupācaret||22|| śudhdyasṛksrutisekādyairyathā pākaṃ na gacchati| ----------------------------------------------------|23|

ab.seg: yantrayitvā'rśasamiva paśyetsamyagbhagandaram| arvācīnaṃ parācīnamantarmukhabahirmukham||24||

div.ab: athāntarmukhameṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet| bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet||25|| agninā vā bhiṣak sādhu kṣāreṇaivoṣṭrakandharam| ----------------------------------------------------|26|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| parikṣepiṇī cāpyevaṃ nāḍyuktaiḥ kṣārasūtrakaiḥ||27||

div.ab: arśobhagandare pūrvamarśāṃsi pratisādhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| tyaktvopacaryaḥ kṣatajaḥ śalyaṃ śalyavatastataḥ||28||
āhārecca tathā dadyāt kṛmighnaṃ lepabhojanam| piṇḍanāḍyādayaḥ svedāḥ susnigdhā ruji pūjitāḥ||29||
sarvatra ca bahucchidre chedānālocya yojayet| gītīrthasarvatobhadradalalāṅgallalāṅgalān||30||

div.ab: pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa chedo gotīrthako mataḥ| sarvataḥ sarvatobhadraḥ, pārśvacchedo'rdhalāṅgalaḥ||31|| pārśvadvaye lāṅgalakaḥ---------------------------| ----------------------------------------------------|32|

ab.seg: -----------------------samastāṃścāgninā dahet| āsrāvamārgānniḥśeṣaṃ naivaṃ vikurute punaḥ||32||

div.ab: yateta koṣṭhaśuddhau ca bhiṣak tasyāntarā'ntarā| ----------------------------------------------------|33|

ab.seg: jyotiṣmatīmalayulāṅgaliśelupāṭhā- kumbhāgnisarja(rji)karavīravacāsudhārkaiḥ| abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitametadeṣām||34||
madhukarodhrakaṇātrureṇukā- dvirajanīphalinīpaṭusārivāḥ| kamalakesarapadmakadhātakī- madanasarjarasāmayarodikāḥ||35||
sabījapūracchadanairebhistailaṃ vipācitam| bhagandarāpacīkuṣṭhamadhumehavraṇāpaham||36||
madhutailayutā viḍaṅgasāra- triphalāmāgadhikākaṇāśca līḍhāḥ| kṛmikuṣṭhabhagandaraprameha- kṣatanāḍīvraṇaropaṇā bhavanti||37||
amṛtātruṭivellavatsakaṃ kalipathyāmalakāni gugguluḥ| kramavṛddhamidaṃ madhudrutaṃ piṭikāsthaulyabhagandarān jayet||38||
māgadhikāgnikaliṅgaviḍaṅgai- rbilvadhṛtaiḥ savarāpalaṣaṭkaiḥ| guggulunā sadṛśena sametaiḥ kṣaudrayutaiḥ sakalāmayanāśaḥ||39||
guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthaksyāt| tvaktruṭikarṣayutaṃ madhulīḍhaṃ kuṣṭhabhagandaragulmagatighnam||40||
śṛṅgaberarajoyuktaṃ tadeva ca subhāvitam| kvāthena daśamūlasya viśeṣādvātarogajit||41||
uttamākhadirasārajaṃ rajaḥ śīlayannasanavāribhāvitam| hanti tulyamahiṣākṣamākṣikaṃ kuṣṭhamehapiṭikābhagandarān||42||
bhagandareṣveṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni| vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanācca samyagviditvaupayikaṃ vidadhyāt||43||

div.ab: aśvapṛṣṭhagamanaṃ calarodhaṃ madyamaithunamajīrṇamasātmyam| sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ pariharedadhikaṃ vā|44| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhagandarapratiṣedho nāmā- ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|28|

div.head: granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto grathyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) kaphapradhānāḥ kurvanti medomāṃsāsragā malāḥ| vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthirgrathanātsmṛtaḥ||1||

div.ab: doṣāsramāṃsamedosthisirāvraṇabhavā nava| te---------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: sthānātsthānāntaragatirakasmāddhānivṛddhimān| mṛdurbastirivānaddho vibhinno'cchaṃ sravatyasṛk||3||

div.ab: pittātsadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā, pacyate drutam| bhinno'sramuṣṇaṃ sravati----------------------|4|

----------------------------------------------------| doṣairduṣṭe'sṛji granthirbhavenmūrcchatsu jantuṣu||5|| sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya sasvāpaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|6|

----------------------------------------------------| māṃsalairdūṣitaṃ māṃsamāhārairgranthimāvahet||6|| snigdhaṃ mahāntaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sirānaddhaṃ kaphākṛtim| ----------------------------------------------------|7|

----------------------------------------------------| pravṛddhaṃ medurairmedo nītaṃ māṃse'thavā tvaci||7|| vāyunā kurute granthi bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam| śleṣamatulyākṛtiṃ dehakṣayavṛddhikṣayodayam||8|| sa vibhinno ghanaṃ medastāmrāsitasitaṃ sravet| ----------------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: -------------------padātestu sahasā'mbhovagāhanāt| vyāyāmādvā pratāntasya sirājālaṃ saśoṇitam||10||
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca| niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ||11||
aruḍhe rūḍhamātre vā vraṇe sarvarasāśinaḥ| sārdre vā bandharahite gātre'śmābhihate'thavā||12||
vāto'sramasrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇam| kuryātsadāhaḥ kaṇḍūmān vraṇagranthirayaṃ smṛtaḥ||13||

div.ab: sādhyā doṣāsramedojāḥ, na tu sthūlakharāścalāḥ| marmakaṇṭhodarasthāśca-------------------------|14|

ab.seg: tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhistu tat| prāyo medaḥ kaphāḍhyatvāsthiratvācca na pacyate||15||
sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṅkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca| pācayeta tadānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsapiṇḍitam||16||
māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ yāti vṛddhi cāśu sravettataḥ| ajasraṃ duṣṭarudhiraṃ bhūri tacchoṇitārbudam||17||

div.ab: teṣvasṛṅmāṃsaje varjye, catvāryanyāni sādhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|18|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| prasthitā vaṅkṣaṇoorvādimadhaḥkāyaṃ kapholbaṇāḥ||18||
doṣā māṃsāsragāḥ pādau kālenāśritya kurvate| śanaiḥśanairghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ tatpracakṣate||19||

div.ab: paripoṭayutaṃ kṛṣṇamanimittarujaṃ kharam| rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt---------------------------|20|
-----------------------------------------------------| kaphādguru snigdhamaruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurairbṛhat|21|

ab.seg: pāṇināsauṣṭhakarṇeṣu vadantyeke tu pādavat| ślīpadaṃ jāyate tacca deśe'nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam||22||

div.ab: medasthāḥ kaṇṭhamanyākṣakakṣāvaṅkṣaṇagā malāḥ| savarṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān vārtākāmalakākṛtīn||23|| avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃścirapākāṃśca kurvate| pacyante'lparujaste'nye sravantyanye'tikaṇḍurāḥ||24|| naśyantyanye bhavantyanye dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| gaṇḍamālā'pacī ceyaṃ dūrveva kṣayavṛddhibhāk|25|

ab.seg: tāṃ tyajetsajvaracchardipārśvarukkāsapīnasām| -----------------------------------------------------||25||

div.ab: ----------------------------------------------------| abhedātpakvaśophasya vraṇe cāpathyasevinaḥ||26|| anupraviśya māṃsādīn dūraṃ pūyo'bhidhāvati| gatiḥ sā dūragamanānnāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ||27|| nāḍyekā'nṛjuranyeṣāṃ saivānekagatirgatiḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|28|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| sā doṣaiḥ pṛthagekasthaiḥ śalyahetuśca pañcamī||28||

div.ab: vātāt saruksūkṣmamūkhī vivarṇā phenilodvamā| sravatyabhyadhikaṃ rātrau--------------------|29|

antaḥsthitaṃ śalyamanāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sā'sya| phenānuviddhaṃ tanumalpamuṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam|31| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|29|

div.head: granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) granthiṣvāmeṣu kartavyā yathāsvaṃ śophavat kriyā| ----------------------------------------------------|1|

----------------------------------------------------| bṛhatīcitrakavyāghrīkaṇāsiddhena sarpiṣā||1|| snehayecchuddhikāmaṃ ca, tīkṣṇaiḥ śuddhasya lepanam| -----------------------------------------------------|2|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ||2||
eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ, pittāsraje punaḥ| jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ, kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ||3||
tathā'pyakvaṃ chittvainaṃ sthite rakte'gninā dahet| sādhvaśeṣaṃ, saśeṣo hi punarāpyāyate dhruvam||4||

div.ab: māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī yāpayedevameva ca| ----------------------------------------------------|5|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| kāryaṃ medobhave'pyetattaptaiḥ phālādibhiśca tam||5||
pramṛdyāttiladigdhena channaṃ dviguṇavāsasā| śastreṇa pāṭayitvā vā dahenmedasi sūddhṛte||6||
sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ, tathā| upanāho'nilaharairbastikarma sirāvyadhaḥ||7||

arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam| -----------------------------------------------------|8| | ajāśakṛcchigrūmūlalākṣāsurasa(lavaṇakṣāra)-kāñjikaiḥ| vastrabaddhairupasvedya mardayitvā pralepayet||1||
upodakāpatrapiṇḍyā chadairācchāditaṃ ghanam| niveśya paṭṭaṃ badhnīyācchāmyatyevaṃ navārbudam||2||
jīrṇe cārkacchadasudhāsāmudraguḍakāñjikaiḥ| pracchāne piṇḍikā baddhā granthyarbudavilāyanī]||3||
-----------------------------------------------------| ślīpade'nilaje vidhyet snigdhasvinnopanāhite||8||
sirāmupari gulphasya dvyaṅgule, pāyayecca tam| māsameraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ gomūtreṇa samanvitam||9||
jīrṇe jīrṇānnamaśnīyācchuṇṭhīśṛtapayonvitam| traivṛtaṃ vā pibedevamaśāntāvagninā dahet||10||

div.ab: gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit| -----------------------------------------------------|11|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| sirāmaṅguṣṭhake vidhvā kaphaje śīlayedyavān||11||
sakṣaudrāṇi kaṣāyāṇi varddhamānāstathā'bhayāḥ| limpetsarṣapavārtākimūlābhyāṃ dhanvayā'thavā||12||
ūrdhvādhaḥśodhanaṃ peyamapacyāṃ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam| dantīdravantītrivṛtājālinīdevadālibhiḥ||13||
śīlayetkaphamedoghnaṃ dhūmagaṇḍūṣanāvanam| sirayā'paharedraktaṃ, pibenmūtreṇa tārkṣyajam||14||
| palamarddhapalaṃ vā'pi karṣaṃ vā'pyuṣṇavāriṇā| kāñcanāratvacaṃ pītvā gaṇḍamālāṃ vyapohati]||1||
granthīnapakvānālimpennākulīpaṭunāgaraiḥ| svinnān lavaṇapoṭalyā kaṭhinānanu mardayet||15||

div.ab: śamīmūlakaśigrūṇāṃ bījaiḥ sayavasarṣapaiḥ| lepaḥ piṣṭo'mlatakreṇa granthigaṇḍavilāyanaḥ||16|| | kṣuṇṇāni nimbapatrāṇi klRptairbhallātakaiḥ saha| śarāvasampuṭe dagdhvā sārdhaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ samaiḥ||1|| etacchāgāmbunā piṣṭaṃ gaṇḍamālāpralepanam]||1.5||

ab.seg: pākonmukhān srutāsrasya pittaśleṣmaharairjayet| apakvāneva voddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyāmupācaret||17||
kākādanīlāṅgalikānahitottuṇḍikīphalaiḥ| jīmūtabījakarkoṭīviśālākṛtavedhanaiḥ||18||
pāṭhānvitaiḥ palārdhaśairviṣakarṣayutaiḥ pacet| prasthaṃ karañjatailasya nirugṇḍīsvarasāḍhake||19||
anena mālā gaṇḍānāṃ cirajā pūyavāhinī| sidhyatyasādhyakalpā'pi pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ||20||
tailaṃ lāṅgalikīkandakalkapādaṃ caturguṇe| nirguṇḍīsvarase pakvaṃ nasyādyairapacīpraṇut||21||
bhadraśrīdārumaricadviharidrātrivṛddhanaiḥ| manaḥ śilālanaladaviśālākaravīrakaiḥ||22||
gomūtrapiṣṭaiḥ palikairviṣasyārdhapalena ca| brāhmīrasārkajakṣīragośakṛdrasasaṃyutam||23||
prasthaṃ sarṣapatailasya siddhamāśu vyapohati| pānādyaiḥ śīlitaṃ kuṣṭhaduṣṭanāḍīvraṇāpacīḥ||24||
vacāharītakīlākṣākaṭurohiṇicandanaiḥ| tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ pītaṃ samūlāmapacīṃ jayet||25||
śarapuṅkhodbhavaṃ mūlaṃ piṣṭaṃ tandulavāriṇā| nasyāllepācca duṣṭārurapacīviṣajantujit||26||

div.ab: mūlairuttamakāraṇyāḥ pīluparṇyāḥ sahācarāt| sarodhrābhayayaṣṭyāhvaśatāhvādvīpidārubhiḥ||27|| tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye'bhyaṅge ca pūjitam| ----------------------------------------------------|28|

----------------------------------------------------| govyajāśvakhurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena lepanam||28|| aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhirvāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|29|

----------------------------------------------------| ityaśāntau gadasyānyapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritam||29|| basterūrdhvamadhastādvā medo hṛtvā'gninā dahet| -----------------------------------------------------|30|

----------------------------------------------------| sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ||30|| tata ūrdhvaṃ hared granthīnityāha bhagavānnimiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|31|

ab.seg: pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendrabastiṃ ca gadānyapārśve| vidārya matsyāṇḍanibhāni madhyājjālāni karṣediti suśrutoktiḥ||31||
ā gulphakarṇātsumitasya jantostasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakādvibhajya| ghrāṇārjave'dhaḥ surarājabasterbhittvā'kṣamātraṃ tvapare vadanti||32||
upanāhyānilānnāḍīṃ pāṭitāṃ sādhu lepayet| pratyakpuṣpīphalayutaistilaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ||33||

div.ab: paittīṃ tu tilamañjiṣṭhānāgadantīniśādvayaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|34|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| ślaiṣmikīṃ tilasaurāṣṭrīnikumbhāriṣṭasaindhavaiḥ||34||

div.ab: śalyajāṃ tilamadhvājyairlepayecchinnaśodhitām| ----------------------------------------------------|35|

----------------------------------------------------| vraṇeṣu duṣṭasūkṣmāsyagambhīrādiṣu sādhanam||36|| yā vartyo yāni tailāni tannāḍīṣvapi śasyate| -----------------------------------------------------|37|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| piṣṭaṃ cañcuphalaṃ lepānnāḍīvraṇaharaṃ param||37||
ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya patraṃ vanitāpayaśca| srugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hantyacireṇa nāḍīm||38||

div.ab: sāmudrasauvarcalasindhujanma supakvaghoṇṭāphalaveśmadhūmāḥ| āmrātagāyatrijapallavāśca kaṭaṃkaṭeryāvatha cetakī ca|39| kalke'bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ caiteṣu śīlyamāneṣu| agatiriva naśyati gatiścapalā capaleṣu bhūtiriva|40| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|30|

div.head: kṣudrarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: kṣudrarogavijñānaṃ kramaprāptamācikhyāsurāha ---- athātaḥ kṣudrarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasannibhā| piṭikā kaphavātābhyāṃ bālānāmajagallikā||1||

div.ab: yavaprakhyā yavaprakhyā tābhyāṃ māṃsāśritā ghanā| -----------------------------------------------|2|
-----------------------------------------------| avaktrā cālajī vṛttā stokapūyā ghanonnatā||2|| granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|3|

ab.seg: ---------------------śophastvalparujaḥ sthiraḥ| hanusandhisamudbhūtastābhyāṃ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ||4||
śālmalīkaṇṭakākārāḥ piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ| medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ||5||
te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmamiva kaṇṭakaiḥ| cīyate nīrujaiḥ śvetaiḥ śarīraṃ kaphavātajaiḥ||6||
pittena piṭikā vṛttā pakvodumbarasannibhā| mahādāhajvarakarī vivṛtā vivṛtānanā||7||
gātreṣvantaśca vaktrasya dāhajvararujānvitāḥ| masūramātrāstadvarṇāstatsaṃjñāḥ piṭikā ghanāḥ||8||

div.ab: tataḥ kaṣṭatarāḥ sphoṭā visphoṭākhyā mahārujāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|9|

ab.seg: -------------------tābhyāmeva ca gardabhī| maṇḍalā vipulotsannā sarāgapiṭikācitā||10||
kakṣeti kakṣāsanneṣu prāyo deśeṣu sā'nilāt| pittādbhavanti piṭikāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ||11||

div.ab: tādṛśī mahatī tvekā gandhanāmeti kīrtitā| -----------------------------------------------|12|
-----------------------------------------------| gharmasvedaparīte'ṅge piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ||12|| rājikāvarṇasaṃsthānapramāṇā rājikāhvayāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|13|
-----------------------------------------------| doṣaiḥ pittolbaṇairmandairvisarpiti visarpavat||13|| śopho'pākastanustāmro jvarakṛjjālagardabhaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|14|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| malaiḥ pittolbaṇaiḥ sphoṭā jvariṇo māṃsadāraṇāḥ||14||
kakṣābhāgeṣu jāyante ye'gnyābhāḥ sā'gnirohiṇī| pañcāhātsaptarātrādvā pakṣādvā hantijīvitam||15||
